title: The effect of limb kinematics on the speed of a legged robot on granular media
summary: Achieving effective locomotion on diverse terrestrial substrates can require subtle changes of limb kinematics. Biologically inspired legged robots (physical models of organisms) have shown impressive mobility on hard ground but suffer performance loss on unconsolidated granular materials like sand. Because comprehensive limb-ground interaction models are lacking, optimal gaits on complex yielding terrain have been determined empirically. To develop predictive models for legged devices and to provide hypotheses for biological locomotors, we systematically study the performance of SandBot, a small legged robot, on granular media as a function of gait parameters. High performance occurs only in a small region of parameter space. A previously introduced kinematic model of the robot combined with a new anisotropic granular penetration force law predicts the speed. Performance on granular media is maximized when gait parameters minimize body acceleration and limb interference, and utilize solidification features of granular media.

AI.tldr: 系统研究小型足式机器人 SandBot 在颗粒介质上的运动性能与步态参数的关系，并结合运动学模型与各向异性颗粒穿透力律预测速度。
AI.motivation: 仿生足式机器人在硬质地面表现优异，但在砂等松散颗粒介质上性能下降；由于缺乏完整的足-地交互模型，复杂可屈服地形上的最优步态只能凭经验确定。作者希望建立可预测模型，并为生物运动机制提供假设。
AI.method: 以 SandBot 为平台，系统扫描步态参数空间，测量颗粒介质上的运动速度；将已有的机器人运动学模型与新提出的各向异性颗粒穿透力律耦合，用于速度预测。
AI.result: 高性能仅出现在参数空间的小范围内；该模型能够预测速度。当步态参数使机身加速度与肢间干涉最小化，并利用颗粒介质的固化（solidification）特性时，颗粒介质上的性能达到最优。
AI.conclusion: 足式机器人在颗粒介质上的性能可由简化的运动学+各向异性穿透力模型预测，为复杂地形步态设计提供定量指导，并对生物运动学提出可检验假设。

title: Physics-Aware Self-Supervised Pretraining on Multi-Domain Raman Spectra
summary: Raman spectroscopy generates large volumes of unlabeled data that are difficult to exploit with conventional supervised learning. This work introduces a multi-domain self-supervised learning framework based on a masked autoencoder (MAE) for learning transferable Raman spectral representations from heterogeneous biological, chemical, forensic, and materials datasets. The proposed pretraining strategy incorporates physics-aware objectives by combining masked intensity reconstruction with a sparse Voigt-profile decoder that models spectral peak structure through differentiable peak centers, widths, and amplitudes. A denoising objective is further included to improve robustness to spectral corruption. The learned encoder is evaluated on substance classification, component identification, concentration estimation, and spectral denoising under linear probing, attention-based probing, end-to-end fine-tuning, and training from scratch. Experimental results show that self-supervised pretraining is most beneficial for challenging tasks with limited labeled data. Attention-based probing also reveals substantially more useful information in the frozen representation than linear probing, indicating that conventional linear evaluation may underestimate representation quality. In addition, the benefits of pretraining become more pronounced with increasing encoder capacity. Overall, the proposed framework demonstrates that physics-aware, multi-domain self-supervised pretraining can improve label efficiency, robustness, and transferability across diverse Raman spectroscopy tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出基于掩码自编码器（MAE）的多域自监督预训练框架，融合物理感知目标（稀疏Voigt峰形解码器+去噪），学习可迁移的拉曼光谱表征。
AI.motivation: 拉曼光谱产生海量无标注数据，传统监督学习难以利用；跨生物、化学、法医、材料等多异构域缺乏通用可迁移表征。
AI.method: 多域混合数据上做MAE预训练；目标函数结合掩码强度重建与可微的稀疏Voigt剖面解码（显式建模峰中心、峰宽、振幅），外加去噪目标以增强对光谱扰动的鲁棒性；下游用线性探针、注意力探针、端到端微调、从头训练四种协议评估物质分类、成分识别、浓度估计、光谱去噪。
AI.result: 自监督预训练在标注数据有限的困难任务上收益最大；注意力探针从冻结表征中提取的信息显著多于线性探针，说明线性评估会低估表征质量；编码器容量越大，预训练收益越明显。
AI.conclusion: 物理感知、多域自监督预训练可提升拉曼光谱多任务的标签效率、鲁棒性与跨域可迁移性，并提示线性探针评估范式的局限。

title: Does LeWorldModel Preserve Local Action Geometry?
comment: 13 pages, 3 figures. Accepted as a poster at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Symmetry and Geometry in Neural Representations (NeurReps), Extended Abstract Track
summary: We examine how closely pretrained LeWorldModel (LeWM) reproduces the effects of small action changes. Using matched simulator and model responses, we measure action sensitivity with Gram matrices at three perturbation scales. Across nearly a thousand states from Reacher and OGBench Cube, the most sensitive action directions differ by median angles of about $36^\circ$ and $42^\circ$, respectively, at the smallest scale. Increasing the perturbation tenfold reduces median normalized Gram discrepancy by roughly 70\% on Reacher and 47\% on Cube. Geometry measured in pixels and embeddings varies more across scales than the chosen physical-state geometry. On held-out directions, environment Grams achieve median embedding response errors of 17\% and 28\%, compared with 26\% and 38\% for an isotropic reference with the same trace. LeWM's errors are higher at this scale. These findings support scale-specific evaluation of action sensitivity; its effect on control remains an open question.

AI.tldr: 该文用Gram矩阵在多尺度扰动下比较LeWM与仿真器的动作敏感方向，发现小扰动下敏感方向偏差约36°/42°，大扰动差异缩小；像素/嵌入几何跨尺度变化比物理状态几何更大。
AI.motivation: 作者想知道预训练世界模型LeWM是否忠实复现小幅动作变化带来的效应，即其局部动作敏感性与真实仿真器是否几何一致。
AI.method: 在Reacher与OGBench Cube近千个状态上，对动作施加三个尺度的扰动，用Gram矩阵度量动作敏感度，比较模型与仿真器的Gram差异、最敏感方向的夹角，以及在留出方向上的嵌入响应误差，并与同迹各向同性参考对比。
AI.result: 最小尺度下最敏感方向中位夹角约36°(Reacher)与42°(Cube)；扰动放大10倍后归一化Gram差异中位下降约70%与47%；留出方向上环境Gram的嵌入响应误差中位为17%与28%，各向同性参考为26%与38%，LeWM在该尺度误差更高。
AI.conclusion: 结论支持对动作敏感性进行尺度相关评估：世界模型在小扰动下的局部动作几何与仿真器并不一致，这一偏差对下游控制的影响仍待研究。

title: DirCast: Live Esports Directing and Commentary with a Single Streaming Video-Language Model
summary: A live esports broadcast needs a director who chooses which camera goes on air and a caster who talks over that choice, every second and without knowing what comes next. Streaming video language models have learned to commentate, but only over a broadcast that a human director has already produced. We study live broadcast production, in which a model receives the raw camera of every player and must both direct and commentate from the past alone. We present DirCast, a single streaming video language model that does both. Every second it scans all cameras at low resolution, decides with a hold-or-switch director whether and where to cut, and reads the chosen camera at high resolution before it speaks. Its context keeps what went on air and what was said and lets the other views expire, which bounds the cost of a stream of any length. We build a dataset of 27 professional Dota 2 matches with a camera for every hero, the human director's choices and the casters' commentary. DirCast directs better than rule-based and zero-shot directors including GPT-5, and its commentary wins 29.2 percent of comparisons against GPT-4o under the Proact-VL protocol, against 19.4 percent for the strongest of eleven streaming commentators that watch the human broadcast.

AI.tldr: DirCast：单一流式视频语言模型同时完成电竞直播的导播（逐秒跨选手视角hold-or-switch切换）与解说，仅依赖历史信息，并通过让未上屏视角过期实现任意长度流的恒定成本。
AI.motivation: 现有流式视频语言模型只能评论已由人类导播剪辑好的画面；真实直播需要模型同时处理多路原始视角并自主决定何时、切向哪一路，且不能看到未来。
AI.method: 每秒钟低分辨率扫描全部相机，由hold-or-switch决策器判定是否切镜及切换目标；随后对被选相机做高分辨率读取再生成解说；上下文仅保留已播出内容与已说内容，使其他视角过期，从而限制长视频流成本。构建27场职业Dota 2比赛数据集（每位英雄一路相机+人类导播选择+解说词）。
AI.result: 导播质量优于规则式与零样本导播（含GPT-5）；按Proact-VL协议，其解说对GPT-4o的胜率为29.2%，而11个观看人类播出流的流式解说器中最强者仅19.4%。
AI.conclusion: 将“看什么”与“说什么”统一进单一流式模型可行，多视角选择性感知+上下文过期机制为长时流式多视角任务提供了有效范式。

title: AudioLift: Audio-Driven Single Image to Full-Head Gaussian Avatar via Multi-view Video Generation
summary: Existing 3D talking avatar methods mainly rely on parametric face models including 3DMM or FLAME, whose compact motion representations limit their ability to synthesize extreme expressions and to model accessories such as headwear. We introduce AudioLift, a two-stage framework that uses generated multi-view videos as the intermediate representation for audio-driven avatar generation without parametric face models or per-instance optimization. Our framework combines a synchronized multi-view video generation stage with an inconsistency-robust Gaussian reconstruction stage to recover coherent full-head geometry from a single portrait image. Extensive experiments demonstrate that AudioLift produces 3D talking avatars capable of capturing more extreme facial expressions than existing methods, with improved geometric completeness and strong multi-view consistency across the full $360^\circ$ viewing range.

AI.tldr: AudioLift：两阶段音频驱动说话头像框架，用多视图视频生成作为中间表示替代3DMM/FLAME参数化人脸模型，再用抗不一致的3D高斯重建获得完整头部几何。
AI.motivation: 现有3D说话头像依赖3DMM/FLAME等参数化人脸模型，其紧凑运动表示限制了极端表情合成与帽子等佩戴物的建模能力，且通常需逐实例优化。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：(1) 同步多视图视频生成阶段，由音频驱动从单张肖像生成多视图一致视频；(2) 不一致性鲁棒的3D高斯泼溅重建阶段，从生成的多视图恢复连贯的完整头部几何；无需参数化人脸模型，也无需逐实例优化。
AI.result: 实验表明可捕捉比现有方法更极端的表情，几何完整性更好，并在完整360°视角范围内保持较强的多视图一致性。
AI.conclusion: 将多视图视频生成作为中间表示可有效突破参数化模型对人脸表情范围与头部配饰建模的约束，实现单图驱动、无需逐实例优化的全身头部说话头像生成。

title: See What I Need, Dream What I Want: A Navigation Foundation Model on a Self-Constructed Representation Space
comment: 28 pages. Project page: this https URL
summary: What visual representation should a navigation policy act on? Navigation policies built on vision foundation models largely leave representation design to the encoders' pretraining objectives. We present RepresentNav, a navigation foundation model built on a self-constructed representation space: a visual representation constructed by the policy's own objectives from vision foundation models. RepresentNav builds this space with Representation Residuals, a compact three-layer transformer that attends over features spanning the full depth of multiple complementary vision foundation models, so that the policy learns to see what it needs for navigation. In the same space it dreams what it wants: before every action a latent chain-of-thought predicts the representation of the scene a moment ahead. The dream is trained end-to-end with the policy as a joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA), with a next-representation prediction loss and a regularizer on its targets. RepresentNav sets a new state of the art on VLNVerse, VLN-CE R2R, EVT-Bench, and two point-goal benchmarks, and its gains carry over to a physical robot amid clutter and moving people. On VLNVerse fine-grained, RepresentNav achieves 83.80% success, outperforming the previous state of the art by 20.05 percentage points, and on EVT-Bench distracted tracking it reaches 85.5% with a single camera (+10.1). With the same encoders, the self-constructed space clearly outperforms concatenating their outputs and learns to weight their layers unevenly, and a dream in it cuts collisions by a quarter. A single dreamed latent decodes into the depth, semantics, and 3D occupancy of the scene a moment ahead, more accurately than pretrained encoders applied to the real future frame, although occupancy is never supervised, and the rollout tracks the robot's own motion over the next second: the dream emerges as a compact latent world model.

AI.tldr: RepresentNav 提出用策略自身目标构建导航视觉表征空间：以 Representation Residuals 三�� transformer 跨多个视觉基础模型全深度特征做注意力融合，并用 JEPA 式隐空间"梦境"（预测未来表征）做动作前的潜链式思考，在 VLNVerse 等多个基准上刷新 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉导航策略直接沿用视觉基础模型的预训练目标所决定的表征，未针对导航任务设计表征。作者认为表征应由策略自身目标驱动构建，即"看到导航所需"，并在同一空间内预见未来。
AI.method: 1) Representation Residuals：紧凑三层 transformer 对多个互补视觉基础模型的全深度层特征做注意力聚合，形成自构建表征空间；2) 在每个动作前用潜链式思考预测"下一刻场景"的表征；3) 以 JEPA（联合嵌入预测架构）端到端训练，损失为下一表征预测损失加目标表征正则化项。
AI.result: 在 VLNVerse、VLN-CE R2R、EVT-Bench 及两个点目标基准上取得 SOTA；VLNVerse 细粒度成功率 83.80%（+20.05），EVT-Bench 单相机干扰跟踪 85.5%（+10.1）；真实机器人在杂乱与行人环境中迁移有效。同等编码器下，自构建空间优于简单拼接并学到非均匀层权重；"梦境"使碰撞减少约 1/4；单个预测潜变量可解码未来深度、语义与 3D 占用（占用未监督），精度超过预训练编码器作用于真实未来帧，并能跟踪机器人自身运动，形成紧凑隐式世界模型。
AI.conclusion: 导航策略应自构建表征空间而非被动继承预训练特征；JEPA 式潜空间预测可同时充当动作前推理与世界模型，带来显著性能与安全性收益，并具真实机器人可迁移性。

title: SyncVid: World-Equivariant Diffusion for Synchronized Video Generation
comment: 28 pages, 8 figures, 9 tables. Project page: this https URL
summary: Generating multiple videos of a dynamic scene from a single reference video requires synthesizing both observed and unobserved content consistently across viewpoints. Existing camera-control methods for video diffusion typically rely on architectural mechanisms, including camera embeddings, cross-view attention, and geometric conditioning. Although effective for static scene content, these approaches often struggle with the fine-grained, dynamic geometry that must remain coherent across views and over time. We synchronize the diffusion process itself by sampling the Gaussian noise prior in a canonical 3D space derived from the source video and rasterizing it into target cameras, rather than sampling independently in each 2D image plane. Our method, SyncVid, lifts a monocular video into a canonical 4D representation, associates noise with scene geometry and unseen space, and rasterizes the resulting structured noise into arbitrary views. Because rendering can introduce local correlations, we further propose a cross-view-consistent whitening procedure that decorrelates neighboring pixels while preserving correspondence across views. The structured noise serves as the diffusion prior for a LoRA-adapted pretrained video diffusion model, requiring no architectural modifications. By enforcing spatiotemporal and cross-view coherence at the source of stochasticity, SyncVid generates synchronized videos and improves both perceptual quality and cross-view consistency in our experiments. Project page: this https URL .

AI.tldr: SyncVid 通过在源自源视频的规范 3D 空间中采样高斯噪声先验并栅格化到目标相机，从随机性源头实现视频扩散的跨视角同步，无需改动网络结构。
AI.motivation: 现有相机可控视频扩散方法依赖相机嵌入、跨视角注意力和几何条件等架构机制，对静态内容有效，但难以保持跨视角、跨时间的细粒度动态几何一致性；同时各视角的 2D 独立噪声采样破坏同步性。
AI.method: 将单目视频提升为规范 4D 表示，把噪声与场景几何及未观测空间绑定，栅格化结构化噪声到任意目标视角；因渲染引入局部相关，提出跨视角一致的白化（whitening）去相关相邻像素并保持跨视角对应；结构化噪声作为 LoRA 适配的预训练视频扩散模型的扩散先验，无需架构修改。
AI.result: 实验表明，在随机性源头施加时空与跨视角一致性，可生成同步的多视角视频，并提升感知质量与跨视角一致性。
AI.conclusion: 同步扩散噪声先验是一种轻量、普适的跨视角一致性机制，可插拔地增强现有多视角视频生成模型。

title: FLORA: An Open Model Suite for Scaling Robotics Data Engines
summary: The life-cycle of robotics foundation models crucially depends on data labels. Outcome reward labels are needed for monitoring real-world deployments. Process reward labels are needed during RL post-training. Timestamped captions are needed for filtering and balancing pretraining data. We present Flora, an industrial-quality data engine used for training GR00T models, that simultaneously covers these capabilities. Flora achieves SOTA scores on the captioning benchmark WGO-Bench and reward benchmarks RoboReward and Robometer. On internal benchmarks it is competitive with GPT-6 Astra while beating other frontier models. The model is substantially cheaper than API-based alternatives, roughly 125 times cheaper than GPT-6 Astra. Florais battle tested at scale, labeling 200,000 hours of data per day across 512 GB300s. By open-sourcing our data engine, we enable researchers to scale custom robotics datasets and explore emerging applications such as physical auto-research and human-to-robot transfer.

AI.tldr: Flora：面向 GR00T 机器人基础模型的工业级数据引擎，统一支持结果奖励标注、过程奖励标注与时间戳字幕，在字幕与奖励基准上取得 SOTA，成本约为 GPT-6 Astra 的 1/125，并已规模化日标注 20 万小时数据。
AI.motivation: 机器人基础模型全生命周期高度依赖数据标签：部署监控需结果奖励标签，RL 后训练需过程奖励标签，预训练数据过滤与配比需时间戳字幕。现有方案多为 API 调用或彼此割裂的专用模型，成本高、能力不统一，难以支撑工业级规模。
AI.method: 提出统一数据引擎 Flora，单一模型同时覆盖 outcome reward、process reward 与 timestamped caption 三类任务；并在 512 块 GB300 上进行大规模推理部署，采用开源方式发布模型与引擎。
AI.result: 在 WGO-Bench 字幕基准与 RoboReward、Robometer 奖励基准上取得 SOTA；内部基准上与 GPT-6 Astra 相当并优于其他前沿模型；成本约为 API 方案的 1/125；每日产能 20 万小时标注数据，已实际用于 GR00T 训练。
AI.conclusion: Flora 表明可负担、可扩展的统一标注引擎是机器人基础模型数据闭环的关键基础设施；开源后有望推动自定义机器人数据集扩展、physical auto-research 与人类到机器人迁移等新应用。

title: PaperScorer: How Predictable Is Paper Acceptance?
summary: Automated research is largely evaluated by benchmark performance, but the value of research rarely reduces to a single score. Humans judge a work's holistic contribution through peer review, which is hard to model because it is noisy and depends on many factors. However, what if, given only the paper, we could predict its peer-review decision directly? We introduce PaperScorer, a family of models that predict a paper's accept or reject decision from its extracted text or page screenshots, training only on the decision after removing author identity and formatting shortcuts. Vision models are the most predictive (68% accuracy on ICLR papers and 77% on ML papers from arXiv), beating text-only and frontier reasoning models. Unlike plain text, page images retain figures, layout, and presentation. This signal is robust, surviving smaller models and even compressing the whole paper into a single image. But accurate predictions are not evenly spread. PaperScorer is strongest on the lowest and highest rated papers, while papers rated in the middle stay unpredictable for our models and frontier systems alike. Additionally, its confidence is calibrated, so its most confident predictions are also its most accurate. Overall, PaperScorer shows how much of the decision a paper carries on its own, marking a first step toward AI-driven research evaluation.

AI.tldr: PaperScorer predicts paper accept/reject decisions from extracted text or page screenshots (vision models best: 68% ICLR, 77% arXiv ML), with calibrated confidence but weak performance on mid-rated papers.
AI.motivation: Automated research is judged mainly by benchmark scores, yet research value is holistic and reflects peer-review judgment, which is noisy and multi-factorial. The authors ask whether, given only the paper itself, the peer-review decision can be predicted — probing how much "signal" a paper carries on its own.
AI.method: Train model families (text-based and page-screenshot/vision-based) to predict accept/reject; train only on decisions after removing author-identity and formatting shortcuts to avoid spurious cues. Compare with text-only baselines and frontier reasoning models; test robustness via smaller models and single-image compression of the full paper.
AI.result: Vision models most predictive: 68% accuracy on ICLR papers, 77% on arXiv ML papers, beating text-only and frontier reasoning models; page images retain figures/layout/presentation. Signal survives smaller models and single-image input. Accuracy uneven: strong on lowest/highest rated papers, near-random on mid-rated. Confidence is calibrated, so high-confidence predictions are most accurate.
AI.conclusion: Much of the review decision is inferable from the paper alone, especially via visual/layout cues; a first step toward AI-driven research evaluation, though mid-quality papers remain unpredictable even for frontier systems.

title: PnP*: A certifiable solver for Perspective-n-Point
summary: Estimating a camera pose from 3D-2D correspondences - Perspective-n-Point - is one of the most fundamental problems in computer vision. Existing methods either solve a minimal problem or replace the objective with an easier one. Surprisingly, no scalable certifiable solver for the actual Maximum Likelihood Estimation (MLE) exists. We propose PnP*, the first practical solver that guarantees efficient computation and returns a certifiable globally optimal solution. We prove that the underlying convex relaxation is exact under moderate noise, which to our knowledge is the first stability guarantee for any relaxation for the MLE of PnP. Furthermore, we reduce the relaxation by exploiting chordal sparsity pattern and quotient ring reduction such that the relaxation is tractable and scalable. The stability and scalability results are verified numerically, as PnP* returns a provably correct camera pose at over 10 Hz.

AI.tldr: 提出PnP*，首个实用的可认证全局最优PnP（MLE）求解器，通过凸松弛精确性证明与弦稀疏性、商环降维实现可扩展求解，10 Hz以上返回可证明正确的位姿。
AI.motivation: 现有PnP方法要么只解最小配置问题，要么用更易优化的替代目标，缺乏针对真实最大似然估计（MLE）的可扩展可认证求解器。
AI.method: 构建MLE问题的凸松弛并证明其在中等噪声下的精确性（首个PnP MLE松弛的稳定性保证）；利用弦稀疏模式（chordal sparsity）与商环约简（quotient ring reduction）缩小松弛规模，使求解可行且可扩展。
AI.result: 数值验证稳定性与可扩展性，PnP*在超过10 Hz的频率下返回可证明正确的相机位姿。
AI.conclusion: 提供了首个理论有保证（精确性+稳定性）且实际可用的全局最优PnP求解器，可作为视觉定位/几何优化的可靠组件。

title: KiRoSe: Using Kinematic Data for Efficient Segmentation of Robot Demonstrations
summary: Segmenting robot demonstration data into disjoint temporal and semantic subsegments is valuable for learning, cleaning, retrieval, and analysis. Segmentation is often performed manually in a tedious and error prone process. Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have the potential for automating this process, but directly ingesting raw multi camera video streams into MLLMs can be costly and can quickly exhaust context windows. In this paper, we introduce KiRoSe (Kinematics for Robot Segmentation), a novel framework that focuses on the companion stream of robot kinematic data. Inspired by the principle of classical entropy coding, such as Huffman coding, where frequently occurring symbols are represented more compactly, we propose Sparse Motion Tokens (SMTs), a discrete kinematic vocabulary designed to compactly represent recurring, temporally localized motion patterns, which we refer to as kinematic events. SMTs are learned by encoding kinematic trajectories with temporal segment supervision and quantizing the resulting features. We use increasingly available robot demonstration subtask annotations to supervise an open language model to interpret the resulting token sequences. Evaluation against human labeled segmentation shows that KiRoSe can substantially outperform baseline segmentation methods in F1 quality and transfers zero shot to unseen robot embodiments and egocentric human motion, while preserving the language models open vocabulary knowledge. Beyond segmentation, KiRoSe tracks task progress on an unseen robot and detects when an action is being reversed.(website: this https URL )

AI.tldr: KiRoSe 用运动学数据替代多相机原始视频，学习离散的稀疏运动 token（SMTs）序列，再用开源语言模型预测机器人示教的分割与子任务，实现高效、可零样本迁移的行为分段。
AI.motivation: 机器人示教数据的时间/语义子段划分对学习、清洗、检索与分析都很有价值，但人工标注繁琐易错；直接用 MLLM 处理多相机原始视频代价高、易耗尽上下文窗口。因此希望找到一种紧凑、可承载语义的运动学表征，让语言模型能在其上进行分段推理。
AI.method: 受经典熵编码（如 Huffman 编码，高频符号用更短编码）启发，构造 Sparse Motion Tokens（SMTs）：将机器人运动轨迹编码为特征，在时间分段监督下学习，再量化成离散的"运动学词表"，用于紧凑表达反复出现、时间局部化的运动模式（kinematic events）。随后用日益增多的人类子任务标注监督一个开源语言模型，使其能解读 SMT 序列并输出分段。整体框架以运动学伴随流为输入，避免直接吞入原始多相机视频。
AI.result: 与人工标注分段对比，KiRoSe 在 F1 质量上明显优于基线分割方法；可零样本迁移到未见过的机器人本体与第一人称人类运动；同时保留语言模型的开放词表知识。此外还能在未见机器人上跟踪任务进度，并检测动作被反转的情况。
AI.conclusion: 用离散运动学 token 作为语言模型与机器人示教的接口，是一种低成本、可迁移且保留开放词表能力的分段范式，并自然扩展到任务进度跟踪与错误/回退检测，对示教数据自动化处理流水线有实用价值。

title: StackGen3D: Stable 3D Block Stack Generation from Multiview Silhouettes
comment: A poster of this work is publicly available on the website of the Creativity in Assembly Workshop at IROS 2026 (non-archival)
summary: Generating physically stable 3D structures from visual specifications requires resolving geometric ambiguity while accounting for physical interactions among objects. We present StackGen3D, a framework for generating stable block assemblies conditioned on a given block inventory and three orthographic silhouettes. Our approach consists of two stages. First, we develop a physics-informed graph neural network (PI-GNN) that models support relations between blocks and serves as a fast stability predictor for curating a diverse dataset of stable structures. Second, we train a conditional flow-matching model on this dataset to capture the multimodal distribution of block configurations consistent with the target silhouettes. At inference time, lightweight geometric selection and refinement reduce inter-block penetration without physics simulation. Preliminary experiments show that the PI-GNN generalizes from simple stacks to complex structures substantially better than a parameter-matched multilayer perceptron. For structure generation, Best-of-10 selection improves physical stability from 45.3% to 72.4% while achieving a silhouette IoU of 0.970. These results highlight the potential of combining relational physical reasoning, scalable data curation, and conditional generative modeling for creative 3D assembly. Project website: [ this https URL ]( this https URL )

AI.tldr: StackGen3D：以给定积木库存与三视图轮廓为条件，先用物理信息图神经网络(PI-GNN)作快速稳定性预测器筛选数据，再训练条件流匹配模型生成多模态稳定积木装配，推理时用轻量几何筛选与细化消除穿透。
AI.motivation: 从视觉规格生成物理稳定3D结构需同时解决几何歧义与物体间物理交互；现有生成方法缺少对支撑关系与稳定性的显式建模，且依赖昂贵的物理仿真。
AI.method: 两阶段框架：(1) PI-GNN 以块间支撑关系为图结构建模，作为快速稳定性预测器用于筛选/构建多样化稳定结构数据集，替代仿真加速数据策划；(2) 在该数据集上训练条件流匹配模型，学习与目标三视图轮廓一致的多模态积木配置分布；(3) 推理阶段采用轻量几何选择(如Best-of-10)与几何细化，减少块间穿透而无需物理仿真。
AI.result: PI-GNN 从简单堆叠泛化到复杂结构的能力显著优于参数量匹配的MLP；生成阶段 Best-of-10 选择将物理稳定率从45.3%提升至72.4%，轮廓IoU达0.970（初步实验）。
AI.conclusion: 将关系型物理推理、可扩展数据策划与条件生成建模相结合，可有效实现兼具稳定性与视觉一致性的创意3D装配生成；为物理约束下的资产/结构生成提供了可行范式。

title: PrefO2O: Zero-Shot Preference-Based Reinforcement Learning via Offline-to-Online Latent Preference Transfer
summary: Preference-based reinforcement learning (PbRL) has emerged as a promising paradigm for learning robot behaviors aligned with human intent. However, its scalability is fundamentally limited by the need to collect expensive human preference labels for every new task. In this work, we present PrefO2O, an offline-to-online latent preference transfer framework that enables zero-shot PbRL on unseen target tasks without requiring any human feedback. The core idea is to learn a task-invariant latent preference space from a small amount of offline preference data on source tasks, where transferable preference structures are disentangled from task-specific variations. This learned manifold allows PrefO2O to transfer preference structures and reward priors to new tasks under distribution shift, while confidence-weighted optimal transport alignment generates reliable pseudo-preference supervision for online reward adaptation. Extensive experiments on robotic manipulation and locomotion benchmarks demonstrate that PrefO2O substantially outperforms existing preference-transfer baselines and matches or exceeds PbRL methods trained with real human feedback, while generalizing across multi-to-one and one-to-one transfer settings as well as across different robot embodiments.

AI.tldr: PrefO2O：从源任务少量离线偏好数据学习任务不变的潜偏好空间，实现无需人类反馈的零样本PbRL迁移（离线到在线）。
AI.motivation: PbRL依赖每个新任务的大量昂贵人类偏好标注，严重限制可扩展性；希望复用已有偏好知识以在未见目标任务上免标注学习。
AI.method: 在源任务的离线偏好数据上学习解耦任务特定变异的任务不变潜偏好流形；借助该流形在分布漂移下迁移偏好结构与奖励先验，并用置信度加权的最优传输对齐生成伪偏好监督，用于在线奖励自适应。
AI.result: 在机器人操作与运动benchmark上显著优于现有偏好迁移基线，达到或超过使用真实人类反馈训练的PbRL方法，并支持多对一/一对一迁移及跨机器人本体泛化。
AI.conclusion: 潜偏好空间迁移+最优传输伪标签为免人工反馈的跨任务、跨本体PbRL提供了可行路线；但结论基于仿真benchmark，尚缺真机部署验证。

title: SEVI: Safe Evidential Real-World Reinforcement Learning
comment: 13 pages, 7 figures. Accepted for publication in IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L), 2026. Project page: this https URL
summary: Real-world reinforcement learning has enabled contact-rich manipulation tasks to be trained directly on physical robots, but unsafe interactions during online learning remain a key barrier to practical deployment. We propose Safe Evidential Real-World Reinforcement Learning (SEVI), a framework for reliability-aware safety intervention during real-world policy learning. SEVI introduces an Evidential Safety Critic that estimates both future constraint-violation risk and epistemic uncertainty in a single forward pass. During online learning, SEVI evaluates each task-policy action before execution; if the action is predicted to be unsafe or the prediction is insufficiently supported by evidence, SEVI overrides it with an offline-trained recovery policy that guides the robot toward a lower-risk region. We evaluate SEVI on two simulated manipulation tasks and a real-world USB insertion task under in-distribution and distribution-shifted conditions. Across task-learning and safety-critic baselines, SEVI achieves the strongest trajectory-level safety prediction, the highest final task success, and the lowest unsafe-event counts. SEVI also reduces unsafe events by 13.4 to 57.1 percent relative to recovery-based safe RL while preserving low-latency execution-time filtering. The project page is available at: this https URL

AI.tldr: SEVI: an evidential safety critic (risk + epistemic uncertainty in one pass) that gates each action during real-world RL; if unsafe or evidence-poor, a pre-trained recovery policy overrides.
AI.motivation: Real-world contact-rich manipulation RL suffers unsafe interactions during online learning, which blocks deployment.
AI.method: Evidential Safety Critic estimating future constraint-violation risk plus epistemic uncertainty in a single forward pass; per-action pre-execution filtering with override by an offline-trained recovery policy driving the robot toward lower-risk regions.
AI.result: On 2 simulated manipulation tasks and a real-world USB insertion task (in-distribution and distribution shift), best trajectory-level safety prediction, highest final success, lowest unsafe events; 13.4–57.1% fewer unsafe events vs recovery-based safe RL with low-latency filtering.
AI.conclusion: Uncertainty-aware evidential safety intervention is a practical, low-latency safeguard for real-world policy learning, complementing rather than replacing core policy learning.

title: WorldMirror: Agentic Real-to-Sim Generation of Interactive Worlds from In-the-Wild Robot Demonstrations
summary: Existing approaches for robot learning in simulation often require substantial manual effort to construct scenes and specify tasks, limiting training scalability and data diversity. Meanwhile, in-the-wild robot demonstrations naturally provide diverse and realistic observations of real-world interactions. Leveraging these demonstrations for simulation requires both high-fidelity visual reconstruction and physically consistent interactions. General-purpose agents offer flexible adaptation to diverse scenarios and strong reasoning about 3D spatial relationships, while specialized generative models provide high-fidelity reconstruction of scene appearance and geometry. We introduce WorldMirror, an agentic real-to-sim framework that constructs interactive digital twins from in-the-wild robot demonstrations. Our central idea is to formulate real-to-sim construction as the iterative refinement of an executable world program. A coding agent decomposes the observed scene, plans reconstruction steps, and orchestrates specialized image and 3D generation tools, refining the program through verification feedback. A camera-pose-anchored scene representation organizes the world into static visual context, support geometry, and editable interactive assets while preserving spatial relationships among the scene, objects, and robot. The agent uses this representation to diagnose and correct reconstruction errors, enabling physically consistent interaction and trajectory replay. Experiments on DROID demonstrate that WorldMirror can reconstruct visually faithful and geometrically consistent interactive worlds while preserving the physical validity of recorded robot trajectories.

AI.tldr: WorldMirror：将 in-the-wild 机器人示范视频转化为可交互数字孪生（real-to-sim），核心是把 real-to-sim 构建表述为"可执行世界程序"的迭代精炼，由编码智能体分解场景、编排图像/3D 生成工具，并借助相机位姿锚定的场景表示做验证反馈纠错。
AI.motivation: 仿真机器人学习需大量人工搭建场景与指定任务，难以扩展且数据多样性受限；而真实机器人示范天然包含多样、真实的交互观测。要用这些示范做仿真，必须同时满足高保真视觉重建与物理一致的交互，单一通用智能体或单一生成模型都无法兼得。
AI.method: 1) 智能体式 real-to-sim 框架：编码智能体负责场景分解、重建步骤规划与专用图像/3D 生成工具调度；2) 将构建过程表述为可执行世界程序的迭代精炼，用验证反馈定位并修复重建误差；3) 相机位姿锚定的场景表示，将世界组织为静态视觉背景、支撑几何（support geometry）与可编辑交互资产，并保持场景—物体—机器人间的空间关系；4) 基于该表示诊断误差，实现物理一致交互与轨迹回放。
AI.result: 在 DROID 数据集上的实验表明，WorldMirror 能重建视觉逼真、几何一致的可交互世界，并保持所记录机器人轨迹的物理有效性。
AI.conclusion: "智能体 + 专用生成工具 + 验证闭环 + 位姿锚定场景表示"的配方是把野外示范转为可交互仿真的可行路径，具备向示范增强与世界模型训练扩展的潜力；但大规模定量评估、失败模式分析与代码/系统开销披露仍显不足。

title: SAGE: A hybrid vision-language and geometry framework for work-zone pathway prediction under temporary traffic control
comment: 26 pages, 9 figures, 7 tables. Project page: this https URL
summary: Temporary traffic control redirects vehicles through work zones, requiring automated vehicles to connect an interpretation of the visible devices to a continuous passing path. Geometric predictors can provide several plausible paths, yet selecting the one consistent with the temporary control remains difficult. We propose SAGE (Semantic-to-Action Grounded Execution), a read-decide-execute-check framework that separates path construction, path preference, and control compliance within a shared candidate space. The central idea is to use a vision-language model's (VLM's) trajectory as a preference over intact geometric candidates. A role-decoupled generator constructs the candidates, and rank fusion combines each candidate's geometric score with its agreement with the VLM trajectory. Supervision structured around the Manual on Uniform Traffic Control Devices (MUTCD) trains SAGE-VLM to state the lane status and hazard side before its passage decision and trajectory. The predicted hazard side enters image-space predicates derived from MUTCD provisions, which support a final intervention bounded in score and displacement. On 2,306 real-world ROADWork validation episodes, the candidates include a path within 10 px of the human demonstration in 87% of episodes, yet selection regret accounts for 53% of the geometric ranker's error. SAGE reduces average and final displacement errors by 8.3% and 12.0% relative to the ranker, mostly in the far field, and hard-constraint violations by 37%. The trajectory opinion improves all four tested generator-selector combinations. SAGE is comparable to state-of-the-art VLM modules in accuracy, with a faster-responding VLM, and outperforms four other adapted driving VLMs in displacement error and safety measures. Project page: this https URL .

AI.tldr: SAGE 用"读-决策-执行-校验"框架,以 VLM 轨迹作为对几何候选路径的偏好信号,结合 MUTCD 语义约束做最终干预,在 ROADWork 临时施工区数据集上降低位移误差与违规率。
AI.motivation: 临时交通管制(施工区)下,自动驾驶需将可见设备(锥桶、标志)的语义解释与连续可行驶路径连接起来。几何预测器能给出多条看似合理的候选路径,但难以判断哪条与临时管制语义一致,导致选择遗憾成为主要误差来源。
AI.method: 1) 角色解耦生成器构造一组完整几何候选路径;2) 用 VLM 输出轨迹作为对所有候选的偏好,通过 rank fusion 融合几何分数与 VLM 轨迹一致性;3) 按 MUTCD 规范设计监督,使 SAGE-VLM 先陈述车道状态与危险侧再做通行决策与轨迹;4) 由危险侧推导图像空间谓词,形成带分数与位移上界的最终干预(校验)。
AI.result: 在 2,306 个 ROADWork 真实验证片段中,87% 的片段候选空间内存在距人类示范 10 px 以内的路径,而选择遗憾占几何排序器误差的 53%。SAGE 使平均与终点位移误差分别下降 8.3% 与 12.0%(主要来自远场),硬约束违规下降 37%;VLM 轨迹意见在四种生成-选择组合上均有提升;精度与 SOTA VLM 模块相当且响应更快,并在位移误差与安全指标上优于四种改造驾驶 VLM。
AI.conclusion: 将 VLM 从直接回归轨迹转为在既定候选空间中的偏好信号,并叠加规范化的语义谓词校验,是一种稳定有效的语义-动作耦合范式;但仍依赖候选生成的上限,且评测局限于单一数据集与离线指标。

title: SAGE: Sense-Aligned Multimodal Grounding Evaluation with Gloss-Augmented Reasoning
summary: This paper introduces Sense-Aligned Grounding Evaluation (SAGE), a unified 10-candidate image-selection benchmark that reformulates VWSD, VerSe, and WikiDiverse into a shared term-centric protocol covering noun-, verb-, and entity-centered grounding. SAGE includes confusable hard negatives and a context-swapped VerSe diagnostic to probe target-term grounding beyond direct caption--image compatibility. We further propose Gloss-Augmented Reasoning (GAR), a training-free framework combining definition grounding with constraint-guided semantic verification. Experiments show that strong VWSD performance does not transfer uniformly across grounding settings. With Gemma3-12B, definition augmentation improves all three subsets, while constraint-guided reasoning improves VWSD and yields particularly strong gains on VerSe, but is less effective on WikiDiverse. Combining the two signals achieves the best macro-average performance, improving Hits@1 from 65.90 to 71.22. These results show that SAGE supports both unified evaluation and fine-grained analysis of explicit semantic reasoning across grounding settings.

AI.tldr: 提出SAGE统一基准，将VWSD、VerSe、WikiDiverse重构为10候选项图像选择协议，覆盖名词/动词/实体中心grounding，并含难负例与上下文交换诊断；同时提出免训练框架GAR（定义接地+约束引导语义验证）。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉词义消歧等多模态grounding评测分散于不同任务与协议，难以统一比较，也无法检验模型是否真正对目标词进行显式语义推理（而非仅依赖图文整体匹配）。
AI.method: 构建统一10候选图像选择benchmark（含confusable hard negatives、VerSe上下文交换诊断）；提出Gloss-Augmented Reasoning（GAR），结合词典释义增强的定义接地与约束引导的语义验证，无需训练。
AI.result: Gemma3-12B上，释义增强在三个子集均提升；约束引导推理提升VWSD并在VerSe上收益显著，但在WikiDiverse上较弱；两信号结合取得最佳宏平均，Hits@1由65.90升至71.22。
AI.conclusion: VWSD强性能不能均匀迁移到其他grounding设定；SAGE支持统一评测与细粒度分析，GAR显示出显式语义推理在多设定下的差异化收益。

title: FORCA: A Force-Aware Coding Agent for Contact-Rich Robot Manipulation
summary: Coding agents can translate language instructions into robot programs. For contact-rich manipulation, a key challenge is to generate and refine control logic that responds to physical interaction. We present FORCA, a coding agent that takes visual observations and wrist force/torque (F/T) measurements as input to write Python programs for contact probing and force-responsive motion. Between executions, the agent inspects force records alongside visual outcomes to diagnose failures and revise both motion and force-feedback control logic. FORCA requires no demonstrations, task-specific training, or simulation. Across five real-robot tasks, we demonstrate its effectiveness in three forms of contact-rich manipulation: improving manipulation accuracy, adapting to changes in object or surface properties, and regulating contact under surface variation and object motion. Compared with a vision-only variant of the same agent, FORCA improves grasp accuracy and task success and reduces contact loss in wiping and peeling.

AI.tldr: FORCA: 一个编码智能体，以视觉观测和腕部力/力矩（F/T）信号为输入，自动编写并迭代修订Python程序，实现接触探测与力响应运动，无需示范、任务训练或仿真。
AI.motivation: 接触丰富操作中，仅靠视觉难以生成能响应物理交互的控制逻辑；现有编码智能体缺乏对力反馈闭环的感知与调试能力。
AI.method: 智能体接收视觉观测与腕部F/T测量，生成Python程序控制接触探测与力反馈运动；执行后检查力记录与视觉结果，诊断失败原因，同时修订运动规划与力反馈控制逻辑，形成"生成—执行—诊断—修订"闭环。
AI.result: 在五个真实机器人任务、三类接触丰富操作（提升操作精度、适应物体/表面属性变化、在表面变化与物体运动下调节接触力）上验证有效；相较同智能体的纯视觉版本，抓取精度与任务成功率更高，擦拭与剥离任务中接触丢失减少。
AI.conclusion: 力/力矩反馈与代码级自我调试结合，可让编码智能体泛化到接触丰富操作，且无需示范数据、任务专用训练或仿真环境，为力感知的机器人程序合成提供轻量实用范式。

title: EgoForesight: Effectively Scaling Policy Learning with Noisy Egocentric Actions
summary: Scaling policy learning requires broad experience and reliable supervision. Robot demonstrations provide high-quality trajectory supervision but are costly to collect. Egocentric videos broaden task and environment coverage, yet motion reconstruction and retargeting introduce noisy action labels. To address this challenge, we introduce EgoForesight, a vision-language-action framework that learns jointly from both sources by reducing the influence of unreliable action labels and exploiting demonstrated outcomes as complementary supervision. A joint vision-action flow couples future visual representation prediction with action generation, unifying reliability-aware action learning with outcome-informed representation transfer. Specifically, reliability-conditioned corruption allocates action supervision across noise levels according to source reliability, while reliability-weighted regression regulates each source's contribution. Complementing this treatment of noisy labels, privileged-future representation distillation draws supervision from demonstrated outcomes. An exponential-moving-average teacher observes the current scene and clean future to encode action-relevant structure from the resulting scene change. Its deeper representations supervise an earlier student layer receiving a corrupted future, providing outcome-informed structure beyond noisy action annotations. Together, these mechanisms support effective scaling with noisy egocentric actions. Over the tested range, EgoForesight exhibits steeper scaling slopes than the baseline, reducing real-world open-loop action MSE by 20.5% and improving RoboCasa few-shot success by 8.1 percentage points at 30,000 hours of pretraining data. After post-training, it also achieves strong absolute performance in both simulated and real-world dexterous manipulation.

AI.tldr: EgoForesight：联合机器人演示与第一人称视频预训练的VLA框架，用可靠性条件化动作监督+特权未来表示蒸馏抑制噪声动作标签，实现随数据规模更陡的scaling。
AI.motivation: VLA规模化受限于数据：机器人演示轨迹标签干净但采集昂贵，第一人称视频覆盖广但动作标签经重建/重定向后噪声大。需要一种能在两类数据上联合学习、既抑制不可靠动作标签又利用"可观测结果"作为补充监督的方法。
AI.method: 联合视觉-动作流：将未来视觉表示预测与动作生成耦合。①可靠性条件化腐蚀：按来源可靠性在不同噪声水平上分配动作监督；②可靠性加权回归：调节各数据源对损失贡献；③特权未来表示蒸馏：EMA教师观察当前场景与干净未来帧，编码动作相关结构变化，监督只能看到腐蚀后未来帧的较浅学生层，从而把结果信息转化为表示层监督。
AI.result: 在测试范围内scaling斜率比基线更陡；3万小时预训练数据下，真实世界开环动作MSE降低20.5%，RoboCasa少样本成功率提升8.1个百分点；后训练后在仿真与真实灵巧操作上绝对性能强。
AI.conclusion: 噪声异质数据下的VLA预训练可通过"标签可靠性建模+结果驱动的表示蒸馏"实现有效规模化，二者共同支撑数据量带来的收益递增；对第一人称视频作为VLA数据扩充源提供可行路径。

title: IFC-SSL-Bench: Benchmarking Self-Supervised Learning for Annotation-Efficient Multispectral Imaging Flow Cytometry
comment: 35 pages, six main figures, seven supplementary figures, five tables and four supplemntary tables
summary: Imaging Flow Cytometry (IFC) generates large multispectral datasets, yet the need for expert annotations bottlenecks the development of supervised deep learning models. While Self-Supervised Learning (SSL) offers a solution, its application to IFC remains fragmented and lacks systematic benchmarking. To address this, we present IFC-SSL-Bench, a modular framework for evaluating SSL in IFC. We benchmark six SSL approaches across four backbones on two heterogeneous datasets. By assessing downstream classification performance across annotation regimes of the training sets (1%-100%), we quantify annotation efficiency and identify optimal configurations for high-dimensional biological imaging. SSL matches the performance of fully supervised baselines trained on 100% of annotated data while using as little as 5% of annotations for morphological classification, with advantages in low-data regimes below 5%. Across both datasets, the contrastive approach MoCo-v2 paired with ConvNeXt backbones emerged as the top-performing configuration, with ConvNeXtV1-T best for immunological synapse classification and ConvNeXtV2-T for morphological classification. We identify a clear pattern in transfer dynamics: ImageNet initialization benefits morphological classification, consistent with its visual similarity to natural images, whereas random initialization better captures the more domain-specific immunological synapse classification. SSL elevates class-specific F1-scores by over 35 percentage points for structurally complex classes at 1% of annotated data. We synthesize these insights into a unified set of guidelines for deploying self-supervised workflows in high-throughput IFC, and release the benchmark as a resource for future work.

AI.tldr: 提出 IFC-SSL-Bench，一个模块化基准框架，系统评测自监督学习在成像流式细胞术（IFC）多光谱数据上的可用性。
AI.motivation: IFC 产生大规模多光谱数据，但专家标注成为监督式深度学习发展的瓶颈；自监督学习虽有潜力，却在 IFC 领域应用零散、缺乏系统评测。
AI.method: 框架在 2 个异构数据集、4 种骨干网络上对 6 种 SSL 方法进行基准测试；按训练集标注比例 1%–100% 分档评估下游分类性能，量化标注效率并寻找高维生物成像的最优配置组合。
AI.result: SSL 仅用 5% 标注即可匹配 100% 标注的全监督基线，低于 5% 时优势更明显；MoCo-v2 + ConvNeXt 整体最佳（免疫突触分类用 ConvNeXtV1-T，形态学分类用 ConvNeXtV2-T）；ImageNet 初始化利于形态学分类，随机初始化更适配领域特异的免疫突触分类；1% 标注下结构复杂类别的类内 F1 提升超过 35 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 总结出面向高通量 IFC 部署自监督流程的统一指南，并开源该基准作为后续研究资源。

title: Multimodal MPC via Bayesian Set Optimization for Dynamic Manipulation of Deformable Linear Objects
summary: Dynamic manipulation of deformable linear objects (DLOs) remains challenging due to underactuated, high-dimensional dynamics, delayed deformation responses, and the presence of multiple feasible motions under obstacle constraints. This paper presents BM2PC, a Bayesian Multimodal MPC framework for agile manipulation of DLOs. Building on the control-as-inference posterior, BM2PC formulates multimodal planning as a set optimization problem that balances control quality and behavioral diversity. An efficient incremental update maintains multiple promising control modes with low additional computational overhead. For real-world deployment, BM2PC incorporates an execution dynamics model that predicts actual end-effector motion and compensates for execution mismatch during fast manipulation. We evaluate BM2PC on rope tracking and obstacle avoidance in simulation and hardware, and on simulated disturbance rejection. In trajectory tracking, BM2PC generalizes better to unseen trajectories than a learning-based baseline without task-specific policy training or fine-tuning. Real-world experiments demonstrate accurate long-horizon tracking, reducing RMSE by 44.0% on the longest task. In obstacle avoidance, BM2PC achieves comparable performance to existing multimodal MPC methods while reducing planning time by 29% to 66%. These results demonstrate accurate dynamic control and efficient multimodal planning within a unified MPC framework. The core implementation of BM2PC and supplementary videos are available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: BM2PC：基于贝叶斯多模态MPC的可变形线性物体（绳/缆）敏捷操作框架，用集合优化统一控制质量与行为多样性，并加入执行动力学模型补偿快速运动失配。
AI.motivation: DLO动力学欠驱动、高维、形变响应滞后，且在障碍约束下存在多种可行运动模式，单模态MPC难以兼顾敏捷性与多样性。
AI.method: 从control-as-inference后验出发构建贝叶斯多模态MPC：将多模态规划建模为权衡控制质量与行为多样性的集合优化问题，并用高效增量更新以低额外开销维持多个候选控制模态；部署端引入执行动力学模型预测末端实际运动、补偿快速操作时的执行失配。
AI.result: 仿真与实机绳索跟踪、避障及扰动抑制评测：跟踪任务上无需任务特定策略训练/微调即可更好泛化到未见轨迹，实机长时程跟踪最长任务RMSE降低44.0%；避障性能与现有多模态MPC相当，规划时间减少29%–66%。
AI.conclusion: 在统一MPC框架内实现了精确动态控制与高效多模态规划，并提供开源核心实现。

title: Full-Weight VLA Fine-Tuning Without an fp32 Master Copy Silently Erases Most Updates
summary: When a vision-language-action (VLA) model is fine-tuned with its trainable weights in bfloat16 (bf16) and no fp32 master copy, AdamW writes each update straight into bf16, silently rounding away any update smaller than 1/512 of a weight. In 9 of 12 open VLA codebases a default or documented recipe trains this way, 4 on full weight matrices, including LeRobot's SmolVLA default and its $\pi_0$/$\pi_{0.5}$ guides. In our LIBERO runs without the copy, a probe every 100 steps finds at least 79% of updates to bf16 weights erased. On the Hugging Face Hub, 99% of sampled full-weight SmolVLA fine-tunes store the action expert in bf16, and 84% of recent $\pi_{0.5}$ fine-tunes with a training configuration set the bf16 flag. On LIBERO-Object, with rules fixed in advance, an fp32 copy raises success over LeRobot's storage from 4.3% to 49.3% for SmolVLA and from 5.1% to 80.9% for $\pi_{0.5}$ at a ten-times lower learning rate, where both models are undertrained, and from 89.0% to 97.7% for $\pi_{0.5}$ at its default rate. For SmolVLA at its default rate it adds 10.2 points with open-loop 50-action chunks but only 4.2 when re-planning every 10 actions. In these five comparisons and two more against SmolVLA with every trainable weight in bf16, every run with the copy beats every run without it (p < 0.05); all gaps but the 8.7- and 4.2-point ones clear our 10-point threshold. The fix is to keep the trainable weights in fp32 during training, a one-line change for SmolVLA in LeRobot.

AI.tldr: VLA微调时若可训练权重以bf16存储且无fp32主副本，AdamW的更新会被大幅舍入丢失；作者统计了开源代码库与HF Hub的普遍性，并在LIBERO上证明保留fp32主副本可将成功率从4.3%提升到49.3%（SmolVLA）和从5.1%提升到80.9%（π0.5）。
AI.motivation: 排查VLA/机器人策略微调实践中的数值训练陷阱：大量开源VLA配方在纯bf16下训练，更新量小于权重1/512即被舍入抹除，可能造成隐性性能损失却无人察觉。
AI.method: 对12个开源VLA代码库做配置审计（9个默认/文档化配方为纯bf16，4个作用于全权重矩阵），统计Hugging Face Hub上SmolVLA与π0.5微调的存储与flag设置；在LIBERO上每100步探测bf16权重的被抹除更新比例；在LIBERO-Object上预先固定规则，对比有/无fp32主副本、不同学习率与不同控制频率（开环50步chunk vs 每10步重规划）的成功率，并做统计检验。
AI.result: 无主副本时≥79%的bf16权重更新被抹除；99%采样的全权重SmolVLA微调以bf16存储action expert，84%近期π0.5微调开启bf16 flag；LIBERO-Object上fp32主副本使SmolVLA从4.3%→49.3%、π0.5从5.1%→80.9%（低学习率、欠训练设定），默认学习率下π0.5从89.0%→97.7%，SmolVLA默认率开环+10.2点、每10步重规划仅+4.2点；5+2组对照中有副本全面优于无副本（p<0.05），除8.7与4.2点外均超10点阈值。
AI.conclusion: VLA微调应始终保持可训练权重为fp32（LeRobot中SmolVLA仅需一行改动）；该问题在社区中普遍存在且被低估，属高杠杆的低成本修复。

title: Emergent Cooperative Thermoregulation in Lunar Swarm Robotics
comment: 7 pages, 4 figures. Submitted to IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters. Video in ancillary files
summary: Swarms of small robots are an attractive way to survey lunar caves and lava tubes. Missions such as NASA's CADRE will fly cooperating rovers for distributed mapping, but only in daylight. The 354 h lunar night drops the surface towards 95 K, and the radioisotope heaters that let single rovers survive it cannot be supplied at swarm scale. In this study we investigate whether a swarm can instead use its own members as thermal shielding. We train one policy, shared by all twenty robots, by reinforcement learning with an evolution-strategies estimator. The policy receives a single reward, once, at the end of the night: the mean temperature of the five coldest robots. Nothing in that reward refers to position, spacing, exposure or motion. Two behaviors nonetheless emerge. The swarm aggregates, and robots circulate between the sheltered core and the exposed rim, the same pair of behaviors with which emperor penguins survive the Antarctic winter. We measure the survival threshold, the smallest stored energy per robot at which every robot is still alive at sunrise. Across ten runs it is 155.6 +/- 1.3 pcm-h, where one pcm-h is 7.2 kJ of stored heat. That is 37% below a motionless huddle and within 13% of a physics-based lower bound, and at a budget where the motionless huddle loses six robots, every robot survives. The behavior needs no shared spatial reference and no robot-robot contact, and transfers from twenty robots to forty without retraining.

AI.tldr: 二十台小机器人共享一个策略，用进化策略型强化学习仅以"夜间结束时最冷五台机器人的平均温度"作为末端奖励，学到了企鹅式"聚集+核心/边缘轮换"行为，将存活能量阈值降低37%。
AI.motivation: 月夜长达354小时、温度降至95 K，单机可用的放射性同位素加热器无法在群体规模上部署，因此探索让群体成员彼此作为热屏蔽的替代方案。
AI.method: 二十台机器人共享单一策略，采用进化策略估计器的强化学习训练；奖励仅在夜间结束时给出一次，为最冷五台机器人的平均温度，不含任何位置、间距、暴露或运动项。
AI.result: 自发涌现聚集与核心-边缘循环两种行为；十次运行的存活阈值155.6±1.3 pcm-h（1 pcm-h=7.2 kJ），比静止抱团低37%，距物理下界13%以内；在静止抱团会损失六台的预算下全员存活；无需共享空间参考与机器人间接触，可从20台零重训迁移到40台。
AI.conclusion: 极简末端奖励即可诱导出类生物群体的涌现热管理策略，为月球洞穴勘探的群体机器人提供低硬件依赖的生存方案。

title: FSVL: Taxonomic Fast-Slow Vision-to-Language Collaborative Framework for Interpretable Confusable Fish Species Identification and Knowledge Generation in the Middle Yangtze River
summary: The Yangtze River Basin is a critical region for freshwater biodiversity conservation. The implementation of the Yangtze River Ten-Year Fishing Ban has increased the importance of effective aquatic biodiversity monitoring and species-level identification. However, fine-grained identification of closely related freshwater fish species remains challenging due to subtle morphological differences. Existing deep learning methods often struggle to balance classification accuracy and inference efficiency, while LLMs may generate unsupported information when producing specialized biological knowledge. To address these challenges, this study proposes FSVL, a fast-slow dual-pathway framework integrating visual recognition with LLM-based Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). A lightweight ResNet50 fast path performs preliminary classification across 51 fish species in the Middle Yangtze River Basin and routes predefined groups of easily confused species to a slow path for refined identification. Guided by taxonomic criteria, the slow path uses YOLOv8n to detect key morphological regions, including the head, dorsal fin, and tail, leveraging morphometric and outline traits to improve discrimination among closely related species. The framework further integrates a retrieval-enhanced Qwen3-14B backend, using soft tokens and Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) for parameter-efficient domain knowledge generation. On the evaluated test set of 607 images, the fast classifier achieved 99.67% accuracy, whereas the cascade corrected the two errors, yielding 100.00% overall accuracy; further validation on independent specimens and external conditions remains needed. Across 255 knowledge generation samples, scientific name accuracy rises from 91.37% to 100.00%, genus accuracy from 90.20% to 98.82%, and ROUGE-L from 0.335 to 0.655, supporting intelligent biodiversity monitoring and fisheries management.

AI.tldr: FSVL：快慢双通路框架，ResNet50 快路对 51 种长江中游鱼类初分类，易混分组路由至 YOLOv8n 检测头/背鳍/尾部的慢路细辨，并接 RAG 增强 Qwen3-14B（软 token + LoRA）生成物种知识。
AI.motivation: 长江十年禁渔使水生生物多样性监测与物种级鉴定需求上升；近缘淡水鱼形态差异细微，细粒度识别困难；现有深度学习方法难以兼顾精度与推理效率，LLM 生成专业生物知识时易产生无据内容。
AI.method: 双通路级联：轻量 ResNet50 快路做 51 类初分类，将预定义易混物种组路由至慢路；慢路依据分类学准则用 YOLOv8n 检测头、背鳍、尾等关键形态区，利用形态测量与外轮廓特征区分近缘种；知识生成端用检索增强 RAG + 软 token + LoRA 微调 Qwen3-14B。
AI.result: 607 张测试图上快路达 99.67%，级联纠正 2 处错误后总体 100.00%（仍需独立样本与外部条件验证）；255 个知识生成样本上，学名准确率 91.37%→100.00%，属名 90.20%→98.82%，ROUGE-L 0.335→0.655。
AI.conclusion: 快慢级联视觉识别 + RAG 知识生成可支撑鱼类物种级智能监测与渔业管理；但需在独立标本、外部环境与更大规模数据上验证泛化性，且 100% 精度多受限于封闭集与路由策略设计。

title: Scaling Transformer Energy-based Models For High Quality Image Synthesis
summary: Energy-Based Models (EBMs) are a flexible class of generative models that decouple probabilistic modeling from the generation process. This decoupling directly enables compositional generation and inference-time scaling, where sample quality can be refined simply by increasing sampling steps. However, severe challenges in high-dimensional sampling and training instabilities with deep architectures have restricted EBMs to low-dimensional regimes. To resolve these bottlenecks, we introduce the Transformer Energy-Based Model (TEM), a scalable transformer energy function operating entirely within a latent space. On top of this backbone, we extract energies at multiple layers and sum them, composing complementary constraints from local texture to global semantics. Furthermore, two components make this high-quality at scale: Positive Representation Alignment (PRA), which supervises TEM's intermediate representations with a vision foundation model, and advanced sampling strategies that improve sample quality at inference. TEM-XL achieves an FID-50K of 3.82 on class-conditional ImageNet 256$\times$256 without classifier-free guidance, showing that a contrastive EBM can generate high-fidelity images. On ImageNet 512$\times$512, TEM achieves an FID-50K of 8.24, demonstrating that the approach scales to higher resolution. We further validate the core promises of EBMs: compositional generation, zero-shot inpainting, and out-of-distribution detection.

AI.tldr: 提出Transformer Energy-Based Model (TEM)，将能量函数换成latent空间中的可扩展Transformer，并用多层能量求和、Positive Representation Alignment和推理期高级采样，实现高分辨率高质量对比式EBM生成。
AI.motivation: EBM解耦建模与生成，天然支持组合生成和推理期扩展，但高维采样困难与深层架构训练不稳使其长期局限于低维数据。
AI.method: 在潜空间上用Transformer参数化能量函数；从多层提取能量并求和以组合局部纹理到全局语义约束；PRA用视觉基础模型监督中间表示；结合改进的推理期采样策略（TEM-XL）。
AI.result: ImageNet 256×256类条件FID-50K 3.82（无CFG）；512×512 FID-50K 8.24；并验证组合生成、零样本图像修复与OOD检测。
AI.conclusion: 对比式EBM在适当骨干、表示对齐与采样设计下可扩展到高分辨率高保真生成，并保留EBM的推理期灵活性与组合推理能力。

title: Move, don't think: sample-efficient collision avoidance with lossy proximity sensors
summary: Data-driven robots must learn to avoid collisions with as few demonstrations as possible to avoid collecting large datasets of destructive collision examples. We explore whole-body proximity sensors as inductive biases for learning reflexive collision-dodging behavior and find that lossy sensors with low resolution were stronger biases than high-resolution coverage. We also found that, perhaps unintuitively, anticipating when and where contact happens on the body of a robot reduced its learning sample efficiency. We investigated eight candidate representations in a reinforcement learning environment, which included latent compression, future contact anticipation, lossy corruption, and privileged state estimation. The candidate representations were tested by training over 200 humanoid robots to play a simplified version of dodgeball end-to-end under an intentionally constrained sample and compute budget.

title: VisFlow: Interpretable Flow Matching for Visibility Reconstruction, Characterization, and Recognition
summary: Methods for learning continuous representations, such as latent manifolds, are fundamental and ubiquitous in modern machine learning. Yet many geometric objects combine continuous shape information with discrete combinatorial structure. This combination presents a fundamental challenge for representation learning because small geometric perturbations can induce abrupt changes in the underlying discrete representation. As a result, the smoothness assumptions that make continuous representations effective no longer hold. Polygons provide a canonical example. Their vertex locations vary continuously, but infinitesimal changes in geometry can dramatically alter the associated visibility graph. Existing methods address the inverse mapping from visibility graphs to polygon geometry using vertex-, triangulation-, or signed-distance-function (SDF)-based representations. Vertex- and triangulation-based approaches construct polygons through explicit geometric operations. However, they are less effective at modeling the relationship between geometry and visibility. SDF-based approaches capture this relationship more naturally. Their intermediate states, however, do not correspond to explicit stages of polygon construction. We present VisFlow, a novel, interpretable flow formulation that combines continuous SDF representations with explicit polygon evolution. We evaluate VisFlow on Visibility Reconstruction and Visibility Characterization. Visibility Reconstruction generates one polygon consistent with a visibility graph (G), while Visibility Characterization characterizes all such polygons. VisFlow maintains 20% more visibility relations on Visibility Reconstruction and improves coverage by 30% on Visibility Characterization compared to state-of-the-art methods.

AI.tldr: VisFlow：将连续SDF表示与显式多边形演化结合的可解释流模型，用于可见性图到多边形几何的逆映射（可见性重建与可见性刻画）。
AI.motivation: 许多几何对象同时具有连续形状信息与离散组合结构（如多边形顶点连续变化但可见性图会突变），破坏连续表示学习所依赖的平滑性假设；现有顶点/三角剖分表示难以建模几何-可见性关系，SDF表示虽自然但中间态缺乏显式几何构造语义。
AI.method: 提出VisFlow：一种可解释的流（flow）公式，将连续SDF表示与显式多边形演化过程相耦合，从可见性图G出发逐步演化出多边形几何，使中间状态对应明确的多边形构造阶段。
AI.result: 在Visibility Reconstruction上比SOTA多保持约20%的可见性关系；在Visibility Characterization上覆盖率提升约30%。
AI.conclusion: 以流式SDF+显式几何演化的可解释框架缓解连续-离散耦合难题，在可见性图逆映射任务上优于顶点、三角剖分与SDF基线。

title: StateBridge: Phase- and Track-Grounded Reasoning for Synthetic-to-Real Traffic Video Captioning and VQA
summary: Traffic safety videos provide rich evidence for understanding interactions between pedestrians and vehicles, but synthetic-to-real evaluation makes this setting challenging because models must learn from simulated scenes and generalize to real-world traffic. In this work, we present StateBridge, a traffic video-language framework designed to operate under this synthetic-only training protocol. Our approach uses phase-aware clip construction, pedestrian and vehicle track summaries, and structured prompts to ground vision-language models in stable traffic evidence rather than appearance alone. We fine-tune public vision-language models on synthetic captioning and visual question answering examples, then combine their outputs through fact-locked caption fusion and evidence-diverse VQA consensus to improve consistency across actor roles, behavioral phases, and question types. StateBridge achieves an official S2 score of 55.4679 on AI City Challenge 2026 Track 2 using only synthetic training data. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of structured evidence transfer for traffic safety captioning and visual question answering.

AI.tldr: StateBridge：仅在合成数据上训练的交通视频-语言框架，用相位感知片段构建、行人/车辆轨迹摘要与结构化提示，结合事实锁定式 caption 融合与证据多样 VQA 共识，在 AI City Challenge 2026 Track 2 取得官方 S2 分数 55.4679。
AI.motivation: 交通场景理解需要从仿真数据训练并泛化到真实路况，纯合成训练下的 sim-to-real 迁移是该任务的核心难点；单纯依赖外观特征的视觉-语言模型难以稳定捕捉行人与车辆的交互证据。
AI.method: 采用相位感知（行为阶段）片段构建、行人/车辆轨迹摘要与结构化提示，将通用视觉-语言模型锚定在稳定交通证据上；在合成 caption 与 VQA 样本上微调公开 VLM，再通过事实锁定的 caption 融合与证据多样性 VQA 共识投票提升跨角色、跨阶段、跨题型的一致性。
AI.result: 仅使用合成训练数据，在 AI City Challenge 2026 Track 2 上取得官方 S2 分数 55.4679。
AI.conclusion: 结构化证据迁移（轨迹摘要+相位建模+多模型输出融合/共识）可有效提升合成到真实交通视频的 caption 与 VQA 表现，属于证据组织与集成式方案，而非端到端新架构。

title: Silence Is Not Assurance: When Production Lane Keeping Assist Does Not Warn, and What It Costs
summary: Production lane keeping assist (LKA) systems tell the driver whether they detect the lane markings, but whether this displayed status reflects what the system perceives, and what happens when it does not, has not been examined in real-world driving. This study introduces CANDID-LKA, a CAN-based Diagnosis of the Indicated Detection status in LKA. It evaluates a proprietary driver-facing status using three signals: the displayed status and the steering torque of the driver, both recorded from the controller area network (CAN) bus of the vehicle, and the lane perception confidence of a third-party vision system observing the same road. The framework examines how the status responds to driving conditions and estimates how completely it reports degraded lane perception by comparing it with the other two signals in a latent-class model. We apply it to 39,800 seconds of real-world driving from 13 vehicle models of three manufacturers. The results show that the status does not respond consistently to the conditions that make markings harder to see, and that the three makes differ widely in how often they report not detected. The latent-class model shows that the displayed status is incomplete: it reports only 47% of degraded seconds as not detected, compared with 80% for the third-party low perception confidence, and in half of the low-confidence episodes it never reports not detected. In the silent seconds in which the status reads detected while the perception confidence is low and the driver is not in control, the standard deviation of lateral position over the next 3 s is about 60% larger than when the status and the perception confidence agree. A detected status thus does not guarantee reliable lane perception, and silence with the driver not in control is the case that most needs attention.

AI.tldr: 提出CANDID-LKA框架，利用CAN总线上的LKA显示状态、驾驶员转向力矩及第三方视觉车道感知置信度，通过潜类别模型评估LKA"已检测/未检测"状态的真实性与完整性，基于13款车型39,800秒真实道路数据发现该状态仅反映了约47%的感知退化时段。
AI.motivation: 量产LKA系统仅向驾驶员显示是否检测到车道线，但该显示状态是否真实反映系统内部感知质量、失效时的后果如何，尚未在真实道路场景中被系统检验。缺乏对驾驶员可见状态与系统实际感知能力一致性的量化评估手段。
AI.method: 提出CANDID-LKA（CAN总线诊断LKA指示检测状态）框架，融合三路信号：来自车辆CAN总线的LKA显示状态与驾驶员转向力矩、以及第三方视觉系统对同一道路的车道感知置信度。分析状态对驾驶条件的响应一致性，并用潜类别模型将显示状态与另两路信号对比，估计其对感知退化的报告完整度；在3家厂商13款车型、39,800秒真实行驶数据上验证。
AI.result: 显示状态对使标线更难辨认的条件响应不一致，三家厂商"未检测"报告频率差异很大；潜类别模型显示状态不完整——仅将47%的退化秒数报告为"未检测"，而第三方低感知置信度为80%，且在一半的低置信度片段中从未报告"未检测"。在状态显示"已检测"但置信度低且驾驶员未接管控制的"沉默秒"中，其后3秒横向位置标准差比状态与置信度一致时大约增大60%。
AI.conclusion: 检测到状态并不保证可靠的感知能力；显示"已检测"而驾驶员未接管控制的沉默失效场景最需关注。所提方法可作为量产ADAS人机接口状态真实性的黑盒审计工具。

title: Distributed Swarm Morphogenesis with Neural Cellular Automata
summary: Swarm morphogenesis requires robots to assemble desired shapes through local interactions. We present a modular framework integrating neural cellular automata (NCA) with existing site selection and collision-aware control. Within this framework, we introduce a decentralized attachment-site discovery mechanism. Robots already in the formation update and share local NCA states to identify new attachment sites, enabling progressive growth without a predefined list of sites during deployment. To bridge the mismatch between conventional NCA growth and gradual physical assembly, we additionally propose offline sparse-retention fine-tuning that simulates partial attachment, together with a false-positive loss that penalizes invalid site activations. Simulations demonstrate formation of diverse lattice morphologies, scaling to several hundred robots, and substantial improvements in morphology accuracy from the proposed fine-tuning. Experiments with Crazyflie quadrotors validate the integrated execution pipeline using robot-relative observations reconstructed from external tracking.

AI.tldr: 将神经细胞自动机(NCA)与现有站点选择及避碰控制结合，提出分散式附着位点发现机制与离线稀疏保留微调+假阳性损失，实现数百机器人的晶格形态自组装，并用Crazyflie四旋翼验证。
AI.motivation: 集群形态发生需要机器人仅靠局部交互组装出目标形状，而传统NCA生长与逐步物理组装存在时序/部分附着不匹配，且部署时难以预知附着位点列表。
AI.method: 模块化框架：机器人共享局部NCA状态以分布式发现新的附着位点；离线稀疏保留微调模拟部分附着过程，并加入假阳性损失惩罚无效位点激活；与站点选择和碰撞感知控制集成。
AI.result: 仿真中可形成多种晶格形态、规模扩展至数百机器人，微调显著提升形态精度；Crazyflie实测（外部动捕重建机器人相对观测）验证了完整执行流水线。
AI.conclusion: NCA驱动的分散式生长可与物理组装控制衔接，稀疏保留微调有效缩小仿真生长与真实逐步装配的差距，具备集群自组装的实机可行性。

title: Automated Nucleus Segmentation in Histology Images: An Attention U-Net Approach with Comprehensive Preprocessing and Inference Pipelines
summary: Objectives: In the area of digital pathology, nucleus segmentation is an essential step for quantitative analysis; however, high nuclear density and staining heterogeneity in histology images pose a great challenge. Methods: This study implements a lightweight Attention U-Net model on the MoNuSeg 2018 dataset to overcome these challenges. The proposed pipeline integrates comprehensive image and mask preprocessing, including stain deconvolution and multi-pass mask smoothing, with a high-fidelity overlapping patch-stitching strategy during inference on high-resolution images. Results: The model achieved an Intersection over Union (IoU) score of 0.8745 on full-resolution, unseen test images. This result demonstrates the effectiveness of attention mechanisms in enhancing feature localization and validates the stitching methodology for generating seamless and accurate segmentation maps. Conclusion: Attention U-Net is an effective and competitive method for automated, scalable nucleus delineation in challenging clinical contexts.

AI.tldr: 在MoNuSeg 2018上实现轻量Attention U-Net细胞核分割，结合染色解卷积、多轮掩膜平滑与重叠滑窗拼接，全分辨率测试IoU 0.8745。
AI.motivation: 数字病理定量分析依赖细胞核分割，但组织图像存在高核密度与染色异质性难题，需兼顾精度与轻量化部署。
AI.method: 轻量Attention U-Net + 完整图像/掩膜预处理（染色解卷积、多轮掩膜平滑）+ 推理阶段高保真重叠patch拼接策略，用于高分辨率全图无缝分割。
AI.result: 全分辨率未见测试图像IoU达0.8745，验证注意力机制对特征定位的提升及拼接方法生成无缝分割图的有效性。
AI.conclusion: Attention U-Net在挑战性临床场景下是有效且具竞争力的自动化可扩展细胞核勾画方案。

title: PixGR: Pixel-Space Generative Decoding for Fast Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction
summary: We present PixGR, an efficient framework that integrates lightweight pixel-space generative modeling into feed-forward 3D Gaussian reconstruction to model scene uncertainty. Context observations are encoded once into a scene latent representation, which conditions generative decoding from noisy target views to produce a shared 3D Gaussian representation. We formulate this process using pixel-space flow matching, enabling end-to-end optimization of 3D reconstruction with direct pixel-space generative supervision through differentiable rendering. This avoids VAE-based latent compression and error propagation inherent in previous two-stage pipelines. To preserve feed-forward efficiency, PixGR caches the scene representation and performs iterative inference using a lightweight DiT decoder. Experiments demonstrate that PixGR outperforms regression-based approaches in challenging sparse-view settings, particularly with widely spaced observations and view extrapolation. Meanwhile, it maintains sub-second inference and remains competitive with substantially heavier pretrained generative models. Our project page is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: PixGR将轻量像素空间生成建模集成进前馈3D Gaussian重建，用像素空间flow matching以随机噪声目标视角生成共享3DGS表示，避免VAE隐空间压缩与两阶段误差传播，在稀疏视角与视角外推下优于回归方法且保持亚秒推理。
AI.motivation: 前馈3D Gaussian重建方法本质是回归式预测，缺乏对场景不确定性的建模，在稀疏、大基线、外推视角下易失真；而已有生成式方案依赖两阶段VAE隐空间管线，存在压缩损失与误差传播，且推理开销大。作者希望在保持前馈效率的同时引入像素空间生成式监督。
AI.method: 将上下文观测一次性编码为场景隐表示；以该表示条件化，从噪声目标视角出发，用像素空间flow matching进行生成式解码，输出统一的3D Gaussian表示；通过可微渲染在像素空间直接施加生成监督，实现3D重建的端到端优化；推理时缓存场景表示，用轻量DiT解码器迭代去噪，避免重复编码。
AI.result: 在稀疏视角设置（尤其宽间隔观测与视角外推）下超过回归式基线；推理保持亚秒级；与规模显著更大的预训练生成模型相比具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 像素空间flow matching可有效替代VAE隐空间两阶段流程，为前馈3DGS引入不确定性建模而不牺牲效率，是一种实用的稀疏视角生成式重建范式。

title: Input Bias Correction in Gaussian Process Regression
comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L) (Oct, 2026)
summary: In traditional Gaussian process (GP) regression, the inputs are typically assumed to be known, and uncertainty enters only through the measurements. When scalar fields are mapped using GP regression with measurements obtained from a mobile sensor, the inputs correspond to the estimated pose of the mobile sensor. The goal in this letter is to understand how a recorded GP, trained on erroneous inputs (e.g., pose estimates from dead-reckoning), can be corrected in a numerically efficient way when better estimates of the inputs become available. In the developed bias-aware GP (Ba-GP) framework, the recorded GP posterior-mean gradient is used to propagate estimated input bias and noise into mean and covariance corrections. The resulting additive covariance structure is then exploited to develop numerically efficient first-order correction algorithms. A simulation study and an indoor light-intensity mapping experiment show that Ba-GP improves predictive accuracy and uncertainty calibration relative to noisy-input GP baselines, with an order-of-magnitude reduction in computational cost relative to full GP retraining.

AI.tldr: 提出偏差感知高斯过程（Ba-GP）框架，利用已记录GP后验均值梯度，将估计的输入偏差与噪声传播为均值、协方差修正，并利用加性协方差结构实现高效的输入修正。
AI.motivation: 移动传感器标量场建图中，GP输入为位姿估计（如航迹推算），当后续获得更准确位姿时，传统方法需完全重训练；作者希望以数值高效的方式修正这种"错误输入"训练出的GP。
AI.method: Ba-GP：基于后验均值梯度的一阶传播，将输入偏差/噪声映射为均值与协方差修正，形成加性协方差结构，据此设计高效的一阶修正算法，避免完整GP重训练。
AI.result: 仿真实验与室内光强建图实验表明，相比含噪输入GP基线，Ba-GP提升预测精度与不确定性校准，计算开销比完整重训练低一个数量级。
AI.conclusion: Ba-GP为位姿不确定条件下的GP标量场建图提供了可增量、低成本的修正途径，适合移动传感器在线建图场景。

title: Not an Accident: Exploiting Safety Filter Inadequacy in Humanoid Robots
summary: As humanoid robots move from research laboratories toward deployment in human-centered environments such as homes, hospitals, and warehouses, safe operation around nearby people and objects becomes a fundamental requirement. Safety filters have emerged as a promising technique to address this challenge by providing mathematical guarantees that generated control actions do not result in collisions. This paper shows that these guarantees hold only when the safety parameters are configured correctly. However, correct parameter configurations are task- and environment-specific, and no general method exists to determine them across diverse deployments. As a result, safety filters shipped with humanoid robots can fail after deployment in specific scenarios. We show that attackers can exploit these failures through only normal user interactions without any additional privileges or capabilities. To demonstrate this risk, we present goal insertion attacks and develop SIREN, an automated tool that identifies vulnerable inserting goals for a given task and environment. Experimental results show that SIREN identifies attacks in all vulnerable scenarios in the SPARK dataset. Compared with a baseline approach, SIREN discovers three times as many attacks. We also show that SIREN is able to generate attacks against a real humanoid and cause it to collide while executing tasks. These results demonstrate that current safety filters introduce exploitable vulnerabilities that can cause safety violations, which reveals that existing safety mechanisms can themselves become a source of safety risk for humanoid robots.

AI.tldr: 该文揭示人形机器人安全滤波器的碰撞保证仅在参数配置正确时成立，而参数配置任务与环境相关且缺乏通用方法，攻击者可通过正常用户交互（目标插入攻击）诱导碰撞；作者提出SIREN自动化工具寻找脆弱插入目标，在SPARK数据集上发现所有脆弱场景并比基线多3倍攻击，且在真实人形机器人上成功触发碰撞。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人进入家庭、医院、仓库等以人为中心的环境，安全滤波器被寄望提供碰撞的数学保证；但这些保证依赖任务与环境特定的安全参数配置，缺乏通用配置方法，因此出厂配置在特定部署场景可能失效。作者旨在证明该失效可被普通用户交互利用，从而说明安全机制本身构成安全隐患。
AI.method: 形式化安全滤波器的参数依赖失效条件，提出"目标插入攻击"：在不具备额外权限或能力的前提下，通过向任务序列中插入特定目标使安全参数失配。构建自动化工具SIREN，对给定任务与环境搜索脆弱的插入目标，并与基线方法对比。
AI.result: 在SPARK数据集的所有脆弱场景中均成功识别攻击，攻击数量为基线的3倍；并在真实人形机器人上生成攻击，使其在执行任务时发生碰撞。
AI.conclusion: 当前安全滤波器的配置脆弱性可被正常交互利用，导致安全性违约；现有安全机制本身可能成为人形机器人的安全风险来源，需重新审视参数配置与出厂部署流程的鲁棒性。

title: Robotic Budding: From Homogeneous Cells to Diverse Morphologies in Physical Self-Reproduction
summary: Physical self-reproduction in modular robots remains difficult because a robot must not only move, but also collect, align, dock, and separate modules reliably in hardware. Taking inspiration from how genetically identical cells form the varied tissues of an organism, we introduce a single standardized robotic module that combines a magnetic docking interface with two actuated joints and folds from a flat, two-dimensional configuration into three-dimensional structures. Modules of this single design can be assembled into two morphologies: a three-module "trilobite" and a five-module "seal". Using a small set of discrete motion commands, a human operator steers an assembled parent robot to dock magnetically with a sequence of spare modules, which are assembled into a second, structurally identical individual that then separates from the parent. Because the parent retains all of its original modules, this is a budding-style form of physical reproduction. Here, we report preliminary hardware demonstrations of this full process on both morphologies. We discuss the current scope of the system, including its present reliance on direct human teleoperation rather than autonomous control, and outline directions toward autonomous execution of this process and repeated validation across a larger number of independent trials.

AI.tldr: 提出一种单一标准化模块化机器人单元（磁吸对接接口+两个驱动关节，可从2D平面折叠为3D结构），用3模块"三叶虫"和5模块"海豹"两种构型演示了"出芽式"物理自我复制：操作者遥控父代机器人依次对接备用模块组装出结构相同的子代，随后两者分离，父代保留全部原有模块。
AI.motivation: 模块化机器人的物理自我复制在硬件层面很难：机器人不仅要运动，还要可靠地完成模块的收集、对齐、对接与分离。受遗传上相同的细胞如何构成生物体多样组织的启发，希望用单一标准化模块实现形态多样性与可重复的物理复制。
AI.method: 统一模块设计：磁吸对接接口 + 两个驱动关节，支持由平面2D构型折叠成3D结构；同一模块可组装为3模块"trilobite"与5模块"seal"两种形态。以少量离散运动指令由人工操作员遥操作父代机器人，依次磁吸对接空闲模块，将其组装为第二个结构相同的个体，再与父代分离。父代保留全部原有模块，构成出芽式（budding）物理繁殖。
AI.result: 在两种形态上给出了完整流程的初步硬件演示，验证了对接、组装与分离的可行性。作者明确指出当前系统依赖人工直接遥操作而非自主控制，属于初步（preliminary）验证，尚未进行大规模独立重复试验。
AI.conclusion: 单一模块设计可实现多形态组装与出芽式物理自复制，具备硬件可行性；后续方向是自主执行该过程并在更多独立试验中重复验证。

title: Synthetic-to-Real Text-Based Person Anomaly Search via Multi-Model Retrieval Fusion and Cross-Encoder Reranking
summary: Text-based person anomaly search requires a model to retrieve individuals from a large image gallery using natural-language descriptions of both appearance and behavior. This task is challenging because model training relies on synthetic image-text pairs, whereas evaluation is performed on real surveillance images containing domain differences, near-duplicate frames, and many visually similar distractors. We present a multi-model retrieval and reranking framework designed to improve synthetic-to-real transfer. The framework first adapts Qwen3-VL-Embedding-8B to synthetic person descriptions using bidirectional contrastive learning, explicit negative sampling, false-negative masking, and domain randomization. It then combines the normalized scores of six complementary Qwen3-VL checkpoints with those of a frozen SigLIP2 model using four-view gallery encoding. The fused retrieval scores identify the strongest candidates, which are jointly evaluated with the query using Qwen3-VL-Reranker-8B. The cross-encoder and retrieval scores are subsequently blended to produce the final ranking. We also construct a distractor-matched validation protocol entirely from synthetic data to select checkpoint weights, fusion coefficients, candidate depths, and reranking parameters without accessing the official test images. The final system achieves 94.7815% mAP and 90.8493% R@1 under the official AI City Challenge 2026 Track 4 test setting, with a reported eighth-place finish on the public leaderboard.

AI.tldr: 提出多模型检索与重排序框架（Qwen3-VL-Embedding-8B + 多检查点融合 + SigLIP2 + Qwen3-VL-Reranker-8B），以合成数据域随机化与假阴性掩码提升合成到真实监控场景的迁移，在 AI City Challenge 2026 Track 4 取得 94.78% mAP / 90.85% R@1。
AI.motivation: 文本行人异常检索的训练依赖合成图文对，而评测使用真实监控图像，存在域差异、近重复帧与大量视觉相似干扰项，需要缩小合成-真实鸿沟。
AI.method: 1) 用双向对比学习、显式负采样、假阴性掩码与域随机化将 Qwen3-VL-Embedding-8B 适配到合成行人描述；2) 四视角图库编码，融合六个 Qwen3-VL 检查点与冻结 SigLIP2 的归一化分数；3) 对融合得分 top 候选与查询送入 Qwen3-VL-Reranker-8B 做联合打分；4) 交叉编码器分数与检索分数加权融合得最终排序；5) 全合成数据构建干扰项匹配验证协议，用于选检查点权重、融合系数、候选深度与重排序超参。
AI.result: 官方 AI City Challenge 2026 Track 4 测试设定下达到 94.7815% mAP、90.8493% R@1，公开榜单第 8 名。
AI.conclusion: 多模型融合检索+重排序的工程化流水线，配合合成数据上的干扰项匹配验证，可有效缓解合成到真实监控的域迁移问题，无需访问官方测试图像即可调参。

title: LOCI: Localized Continuous Control for Multi-Subject Image Editing
summary: Recent instruction-following image editors such as Flux.1-Kontext enable text-driven editing but lack fine-grained control over where and how much an edit is applied. Existing approaches provide either continuous but global control or spatially localized editing at a fixed strength. To our knowledge, none jointly supports explicit spatial localization, continuous per-region strength, and independent simultaneous control of multiple subjects. We present LOCI (LOcalized Continuous control for multi- subject Image editing). Given a multi-subject image with per-subject regions and instructions, LOCI edits each subject at an independently chosen, continuously adjustable strength, for instance gradually aging one person while adding a beard to another with minimal cross-region leakage. LOCI pairs subject-level attention binding for spatial isolation with a Regional LoRA layer that replaces the LoRA's scalar coefficient with a per-token scaling vector aligned to the spatial layout. A single adapter is trained at one suppression point, and continuous edit strengths follow by rescaling its regional residual at inference. Experiments on multi-subject scenes demonstrate that LOCI achieves strong edit fidelity with significantly reduced cross-region interference compared to baselines, while maintaining continuous control over edit strength

AI.tldr: LOCI：为多主体图像编辑提供逐区域、连续强度、可同时独立控制的空间局部化编辑，用主体级注意力绑定实现区域隔离，并用 Regional LoRA（逐 token 缩放向量替代标量系数）实现连续强度，单次训练、推理时重缩放即得连续强度。
AI.motivation: 现有指令式图像编辑器（如 Flux.1-Kontext）缺乏对编辑位置与强度的细粒度控制：已有方法要么是连续但全局的控制，要么是空间局部但强度固定；尚无方法同时支持显式空间定位、逐区域连续强度、以及多主体的独立并行控制。
AI.method: 输入含逐主体区域与指令的多主体图像；1) 主体级注意力绑定（subject-level attention binding）实现空间隔离；2) 设计 Regional LoRA 层，把 LoRA 的标量系数替换为与空间布局对齐的逐 token 缩放向量；3) 仅在单一抑制点训练一个适配器，推理时对区域残差重缩放以获得连续编辑强度。
AI.result: 在多主体场景实验中，LOCI 取得较高的编辑保真度，跨区域干扰显著低于基线方法，同时保持编辑强度的连续可控性（如对一人渐进增龄、对另一人加胡须而相互渗透极小）。
AI.conclusion: 将 LoRA 从全局标量强度升级为空间对齐的逐 token 强度是实现"局部化+连续+多主体独立"编辑的有效途径；单点训练、推理重缩放的设计使连续控制无需多强度训练，方法轻量且实用。

title: STEP: Surgical Point Tracking from Sparse Endpoints and Pseudo-trajectories
summary: Surgical point tracking requires persistent correspondence through tissue deformation and occlusion, yet dense trajectory annotations are costly to obtain. We present STEP, a two-stage framework that learns from surgical video and sparse physical endpoints. First, a frozen offline teacher generates candidate trajectories, and temporal reversibility and stereo consistency select dense supervision for a causal student. Second, a robust physical endpoint loss anchors terminal correspondence, while a round-trip loss constrains temporal consistency. A gradient-free prefix exposes training to accumulated drift, while a final differentiable window bounds activation memory. The trained tracker processes a single RGB stream with fixed weights. In STIR-to-VL-SurgPT transfer, temporal-stereo union selection reduces endpoint error by 7.0% relative to unfiltered trajectories. On a post-hoc diagnostic of 29 VL-SurgPT clips excluded from the endpoint-training manifest, STEP reduces endpoint error from 31.52 to 16.80 pixels relative to dense-label fine-tuning. These results support combining curated trajectories with physical observations to train surgical point trackers.

AI.tldr: 提出两阶段框架STEP，利用稀疏物理端点标签+离线教师模型筛选的稠密伪轨迹训练因果式手术点追踪器。
AI.motivation: 手术点追踪需要在组织形变与遮挡下保持长期对应，但稠密轨迹标注成本极高；需要一种仅依赖视频与稀疏端点监督的可扩展训练范式。
AI.method: 两阶段：①冻结的离线教师生成候选轨迹，用时间可逆性与立体一致性筛选稠密监督给因果学生；②物理端点损失锚定终态对应，往返损失约束时间一致性；无梯度前缀暴露累积漂移，末端可微窗口限制显存。推理时仅用单路RGB、固定权重。
AI.result: STIR→VL-SurgPT迁移中，时间-立体联合筛选使端点误差相对未筛选轨迹降低7.0%；在29个未进入端点训练清单的VL-SurgPT片段上，STEP将端点误差从31.52像素降至16.80像素（相比稠密标签微调）。
AI.conclusion: 将筛选后的伪轨迹与稀疏物理观测相结合，是训练手术点追踪器的有效范式；但评估规模有限，需在更大、更多样的临床数据上验证。

title: Spectra: Multi-Scale Implicit Decomposition for Deepfake Detection
summary: Deepfakes increasingly undermine trust in digital media, yet existing detectors often struggle to generalize across unseen manipulation techniques, compression levels, and dataset shifts. Most approaches rely on RGB appearance, frequency-domain artifacts, or their combination, learning cues present in the final synthesized image. While effective in-distribution, such cues are frequently generator-specific and can diminish as synthesis models evolve. We argue that a complementary perspective can be obtained through implicit neural representations (INRs), which expose how an image is reconstructed rather than merely how it appears. By fitting an INR to an image and analyzing its internal activations, one can reveal reconstruction dynamics that are difficult to observe in the image domain alone and may capture more intrinsic differences between genuine and synthetic content.
