To this end, we propose Spectra, a deepfake detection framework that combines semantic visual representations with artifact-aware cues derived from INR reconstruction. Spectra extracts multi-level reconstruction heatmaps from image-specific INRs and jointly models them with semantic features through a bidirectional fusion mechanism. This enables direct interaction between image semantics and reconstruction artifacts, allowing the model to identify forgery cues that are less dependent on specific generation pipelines. Extensive experiments on multiple deepfake benchmarks demonstrate improved robustness and cross-dataset generalization, consistently outperforming detectors based solely on RGB appearance or semantic representations. Furthermore, we show that the proposed representation extends beyond deepfake detection to face presentation attack detection, highlighting its potential as a unified framework for facial attack detection.

AI.tldr: 提出 Spectra，通过为每张图拟合 INR 并提取多级重建热力图，与语义特征做双向融合，用于深度伪造检测，并扩展到人脸呈现攻击检测。
AI.motivation: 现有深度伪造检测器依赖 RGB 外观、频域伪影或其组合，这些线索与特定生成器强相关，跨未见操纵手法、压缩等级与数据集偏移时泛化差。作者认为 INR 揭示了图像"如何被重建"而非"看起来如何"，可提供更内在的真伪差异。
AI.method: 对输入图像拟合图像特定 INR，提取多级重建热力图作为伪影感知线索；同时抽取语义视觉特征；通过双向融合机制让语义与重建伪影直接交互，联合建模后判别伪造。
AI.result: 在多个深度伪造基准上取得更强的鲁棒性与跨数据集泛化能力，稳定优于仅用 RGB 外观或语义表示的检测器；该表示还可迁移到人脸呈现攻击检测。
AI.conclusion: INR 重建动态是一种与生成管线解耦、补充性强的取证表示，有望作为统一的人脸攻击检测框架。

title: Interpreting Physics in Video Encoders using Multi-Object Interaction Videos
summary: Video encoder models are increasingly used as world models for physical AI, where a policy plans by rolling out the latent, so what physics the latent holds bounds what the agent can plan over. Moreover, existing interpretability work probes quantities belonging to a single object; the quantities that make physics relational, such as momentum transfer, restitution, and friction, are defined between bodies and have not been examined. We probe relational physics attributes in two frozen self-supervised video encoders (V-JEPA2 and VideoMAE) under two-body settings and test if they transfer across environments. Our early findings are mixed. Both encoders separate elastic from inelastic collisions reliably. V-JEPA2's own predictor is less likely to predict a collision that creates kinetic energy compared to one that loses it. Momentum-violation detection appears in only one of the two encoders, a kinetic-energy readout survives a change of environment for V-JEPA2 but not for VideoMAE, and neither model holds a friction coefficient that survives a change of geometry.

AI.tldr: 该文探测两个冻结的自监督视频编码器（V-JEPA2、VideoMAE）在双体碰撞场景中是否编码关系性物理量（动量传递、恢复系数、摩擦系数），并测试其跨环境泛化。
AI.motivation: 视频编码器正被用作物理AI的世界模型，策略在隐空间中进行推演，因此隐空间承载的物理知识界定了智能体的规划能力。而已有可解释性工作只探测单物体量，缺乏对多体间关系性物理量（如动量传递、弹性、摩擦）的考察。
AI.method: 在双体碰撞设定下，对两个冻结的自监督视频编码器（V-JEPA2 与 VideoMAE）进行线性探测实验，检验其能否分离弹性/非弹性碰撞、识别动量守恒违背、读出动能变化，并测试这些读出在环境变化与几何变化下的迁移性。
AI.result: 结果混杂：两者均能可靠区分弹性与非弹性碰撞；V-JEPA2 自身预测器更不易预测产生动能增加的碰撞；动量违背检测仅在其中一个编码器中成立；动能读出对 V-JEPA2 可跨环境迁移而对 VideoMAE 不可；两者均未获得能跨几何变化的摩擦系数表征。
AI.conclusion: 现有视频世界模型的隐空间仅部分捕获关系性物理属性，且缺乏对摩擦等接触参数的可迁移表示，这对以隐推演为基础的规划构成隐患。

title: OpenHome: From Perception to Insight in Smart-Home Camera Videos
summary: Vision language models (VLMs) have been increasingly adopted in consumer smart-home camera systems to interpret recorded videos and provide insights. However, video clips captured from smart-home cameras are different from curated web videos dominating existing VLM benchmarks. Smart-home video clips often do not contain subtitles or narration and are captured from different viewing angles, under various lighting conditions, and in diverse scenarios. However, the capabilities of the model in this domain, under sparse visual signals and limited context, are not fully assessed by existing VLM benchmarks. To close this gap, we introduce OpenHome, a visual-only, four-option multiple-choice benchmark for evaluating smart-home video understanding. It contains 2,254 questions on 1,118 real-world video clips and organizes 10 tasks into three capability levels. Perception evaluates visible content, Reasoning evaluates causal, spatial, and temporal relationships, and Insight evaluates subject intent, supporting evidence and appropriate homeowner responses. Based on the dataset, we describe the task design, data pipeline and evaluation protocol, and report results for 32 closed-source and open-weight VLMs. The best model, Gemini 4 Argon, reaches 81.2% overall accuracy. Frontier closed-source models outperform open-weight models on every level. The best closed-source model leads the best open-weight model by 16.3% on Perception, 22.4% on Reasoning and 37.4% on Insight.

AI.tldr: OpenHome：面向智能家居摄像头的纯视觉四选一基准，2254题/1118段真实片段，按感知—推理—洞察三层10任务评测32个VLM。
AI.motivation: 智能家居摄像头视频无字幕/旁白、视角多样、光照场景各异，与网络策展视频主导的现有VLM基准差异大，现有基准无法充分评估模型在稀疏视觉信号与有限上下文下的能力。
AI.method: 构建纯视觉、四选一多项选择基准：采集1118段真实智能家居视频，标注2254道题，并将10项任务组织为三个能力层次（Perception 感知可见内容；Reasoning 判断因果/空间/时间关系；Insight 推断主体意图、支撑证据与合理回应）；给出任务设计、数据流水线与评测协议，并评测32个闭源与开放权重VLM。
AI.result: 最佳模型Gemini 4 Argon总体准确率81.2%；前沿闭源模型在每一能力层级均优于开放权重模型，领先幅度为Perception 16.3%、Reasoning 22.4%、Insight 37.4%。
AI.conclusion: 智能家居第一视角视频理解仍是VLM的明显短板，尤其在高层的意图推断任务上差距最大；OpenHome可作为该场景的标准化评测工具。

title: MAGIC: Margin-gated Contrastive Debiasing with Evidence Restoration for VLM Test-time Robustness Scaling
summary: This paper studies the problem of test-time robustness scaling for large vision-language models (LVLMs), which aims to mitigate language bias during inference. Existing approaches typically adopt test-time scaling techniques such as contrastive decoding to improve inference performance. Despite the progress, the performance of these approaches is far from satisfactory due to intentional evidence removal during perturbations and redundant inference cost. Towards this end, we propose a novel approach named Margin-gated Contrastive Debiasing with Evidence Restoration (MAGIC). The core of our MAGIC is to evaluate the decision margins of LVLMs to selectively activate textual and visual perturbation branches for efficient debiased inference. In particular, our MAGIC first measures the prediction margins of crucial tokens, and applies a gating function to identify low-confidence responses that are susceptible to language biases. For selected samples, we integrate the token logits from multiple textual and image perturbation branches with the original ones for debiased decision. More importantly, we selectively restore the most informative corrupted views with sharp prediction distributions for ambiguous samples after debiasing, enabling evidence recovery for discriminative decision-making. We further utilize a calibration dataset to actively identify and prune ineffective branches during contrastive debiasing for cost reduction. Extensive experiments on benchmark datasets validate the effectiveness of the proposed MAGIC in comparison with extensive baselines.

AI.tldr: MAGIC：通过评估LVLM关键token的预测margin并设门控，选择性地激活文本/视觉扰动分支进行去偏推理，并对模糊样本恢复信息量最大的损坏视图，同时用校准集剪枝无效分支以降低开销。
AI.motivation: 现有LVLM测试时去偏方法（如对比解码）存在两大问题：扰动过程中有意移除证据导致信息缺失，以及冗余的推理开销，性能仍不理想。
AI.method: 1) 测量关键token的预测margin，用门控函数识别易受语言偏置影响的低置信样本；2) 对选中样本融合多文本/图像扰动分支的token logits与原logits做出无偏决策；3) 对模糊样本选择性恢复预测分布尖锐的最具信息量损坏视图以复原证据；4) 借助校准数据集主动识别并剪除无效分支以降低计算成本。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上与大量基线对比实验验证了MAGIC的有效性（摘要未给出具体量化提升）。
AI.conclusion: 基于margin门控的选择性对比去偏加证据恢复是提升LVLM测试时鲁棒性并降低推理成本的有效途径。

title: CEMIR vs. FISER: a comparative study of reasoning-based and enrichment-based approaches to pragmatic intent recognition
summary: Intent recognition in human-robot interaction requires agents to resolve ambiguous natural language instructions by inferring the speaker's underlying goals. Research has increasingly focused on two notable paradigms for addressing this task: structured symbolic reasoning and multimodal input enrichment. However, it remains unclear whether enrichment-based methods provide benefit in settings where the ambiguity concerns unstated human intent rather than missing observable scene information. In this paper, we present a comparative and diagnostic study benchmarking FISER - a framework utilizing structured social and embodied reasoning - against CEMIR (Context-Enriched Multimodal Intent Recognition), a method that performs multimodal enrichment by synthesizing narratives and photorealistic images from textual prompts. By evaluating both approaches across four Large Language Models (LLMs), ranging from Qwen2.5-Omni-3B to GPT-5, on the HandMeThat v2 benchmark, we analyze their capability to resolve pragmatic ambiguities. Our statistical analysis, employing multiple-comparison correction, reveals no statistically significant difference in performance between FISER and CEMIR across any model or difficulty level. This pattern holds across all sixteen model-by-difficulty comparisons, as well as in a targeted ablation isolating CEMIR's narrative and visual components. Instead, performance is primarily associated with backbone capability and the inherent difficulty of the ambiguity. These findings suggest a boundary condition for text-derived multimodal enrichment: when the relevant task constraints are already available in the textual instruction, synthetic multimodal augmentation may not provide measurable benefit over structured reasoning on the same text.

AI.tldr: 在 HandMeThat v2 基准上对比结构化符号推理框架 FISER 与文本派生多模态增强方法 CEMIR，跨 4 个 LLM 与各难度层级均无统计显著差异，说明合成多模态增强在"隐含意图歧义"场景下不带来增益。
AI.motivation: 人机交互中的指令歧义常涉及未陈述的人类意图，而非缺失的可观测场景信息。既有两条路线（结构化符号/社交-具身推理 vs. 多模态输入增强）在此设定下谁更有效尚不明确，尤其文本派生多模态增强的适用边界缺少诊断性证据。
AI.method: 比较与诊断式基准研究。在 HandMeThat v2 上，将 FISER（结构化社交与具身推理）与 CEMIR（由文本提示合成叙事与照片级真实图像进行多模态增强）对照；使用 Qwen2.5-Omni-3B 至 GPT-5 共 4 个 LLM，覆盖 4 个模型 × 4 个难度层的 16 组比较，采用多重比较校正的统计分析，并对 CEMIR 的叙事与视觉成分做消融。
AI.result: 全部 16 组模型×难度比较均无统计显著差异；针对 CEMIR 叙事与视觉组件的定向消融亦无显著差异。性能差异主要与骨干模型能力和歧义固有难度相关。
AI.conclusion: 给出文本派生多模态增强的边界条件：当任务约束已包含在文本指令中、歧义源于未言明意图时，合成多模态增强相对同一文本上的结构化推理无可测收益。

title: Rethinking Representation Geometry in Supervised Contrastive Learning under Long-Tailed Data
summary: Supervised contrastive learning and its balanced variants have demonstrated their effectiveness for representation learning under long-tailed distributions. However, although prior analyses suggest that their optimal representations may exhibit a regular simplex geometry, whether such a geometry is indeed exhibited remains insufficiently understood. In this work, we present a theoretical framework for these objectives that characterizes whether a regular simplex is formed at the optimum. By applying this to representative objectives, we show that these objectives fail to form a regular simplex at the optimum because they remain dependent on the number of samples per class. Motivated by this analysis, we introduce structural balancing that can be applied to contrastive objectives, and propose a fully balanced contrastive objective that provably forms a regular simplex geometry at its optimum. Both theoretical and empirical results demonstrate that the proposed method yields a more balanced representation space and improves performance on long-tailed recognition and transfer learning tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文对长尾监督对比学习目标建立理论框架，刻画最优解是否为规则单纯形几何，指出既有目标因依赖每类样本数而无法形成规则单纯形，并提出"结构平衡"与完全平衡对比目标，使其最优解可证明为规则单纯形，从而在长尾识别与迁移学习上取得更好性能。
AI.motivation: 已有分析认为长尾监督对比学习的最优表示可能呈现规则单纯形几何，但其是否真正成立缺乏充分刻画；同时平衡化变体虽有效，其最优几何成因不明。
AI.method: 构建针对长尾监督对比目标的几何最优性理论框架，判定最优表示是否构成规则单纯形；据此分析代表性目标，发现其最优点仍依赖类内样本数；进而提出可施加于对比目标的结构平衡（structural balancing）策略，并设计完全平衡对比目标。
AI.result: 理论证明现有代表性目标在最优处无法形成规则单纯形；所提完全平衡目标可证明在最优处形成规则单纯形几何。实验显示其产生更平衡的表示空间，并在长尾识别与迁移学习任务上性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 长尾对比学习的表示几何可被显式刻画与设计，结构平衡是实现规则单纯形最优几何的可行途径，值得作为长尾表示学习的通用改进手段。

title: NUViT: Vision Transformers for Fourier Space Data
summary: Vision Transformers (ViTs) have demonstrated strong performance in many computer vision tasks but do not naturally extend beyond the natural image domain. One important example is Fourier-space data, which is used to represent a rich and diverse set of modalities, including medical imaging and microscopy. Standard ViT tokenization partitions an image into square patches on a Cartesian grid, which poorly fit the frequency and phase structure of Fourier-space data. We introduce Non-Uniform ViT, a simple, general-purpose vision transformer that redesigns image tokenization, data representation, and positional encoding to respect this structure. Experiments on Fourier-domain image classification, 2D crystal lattice identification, MRI annotation, and cryo-EM protein heterogeneity analysis show that NUViT consistently captures the structure of Fourier data better than standard architectures.

AI.tldr: NUViT重新设计ViT的tokenization、数据表示与位置编码，以适配傅里叶空间（频域/相位）结构数据。
AI.motivation: 标准ViT在笛卡尔网格上划分方形patch，与傅里叶空间数据的频率-相位结构不匹配，难以自然扩展到医学影像、显微成像、晶体学、冷冻电镜等傅里叶域模态。
AI.method: 提出Non-Uniform ViT：用非均匀采样替代方形patch划分，并相应改造数据表示与位置编码，使token化遵循频域结构；方法保持简单通用。
AI.result: 在傅里叶域图像分类、二维晶格识别、MRI标注、cryo-EM蛋白异质性分析上，NUViT相比标准架构更稳定地捕获傅里叶数据结构。
AI.conclusion: 面向傅里叶域的tokenization与位置编码改造是有效的通用方向，可推广到多类科学成像任务。

title: X-Dubbing: Speech-to-Speech Translation under Temporal and Visual Constraints
summary: Cross-lingual dubbing aims to convert source speech into target-language speech that remains synchronized with the original video. The key to this task is to produce a faithful translation that is naturally speakable within the source timing, which is non-trivial because languages differ in duration, rhythm, and articulation. In this paper, we propose X-Dubbing, which formulates the task as a joint problem of time-aware speech-to-text translation and video-aware text-to-speech. Specifically, our method consists of a Dubbing Translator that generates temporally structured scripts and a Voice Actor that renders them in synchrony with the source video, both grounded in a language-agnostic timing budget. We further refine the translator with dubbing-aware feedback from the synthesized speech, encouraging scripts that yield well-synchronized dubbing. This design requires no paired dubbing data, as the two components are trained on speech-text and monolingual audio-visual data respectively. Extensive experiments show that X-Dubbing outperforms recent baselines across diverse metrics, including isochrony and audio-visual correspondence.

AI.tldr: X-Dubbing将跨语言配音形式化为“时间感知语音翻译+视频感知语音合成”的联合问题，通过共享的与语言无关的时间预算，让翻译器生成时间结构化的脚本、配音员同步渲染，并用合成语音的配音反馈微调翻译器，训练无需成对配音数据。
AI.motivation: 跨语言配音要求译文在忠实的同时能在原视频时长内自然可说，但不同语言在时长、节奏、发音方式上差异显著，导致传统“先翻译后合成”的流程难以同步。
AI.method: 提出X-Dubbing框架：Dubbing Translator生成带时间结构的译稿，Voice Actor将其同步渲染到原视频，二者共享语言无关的时间预算（timing budget）；再利用合成语音给出的配音感知反馈对翻译器进行迭代优化，实现端到端式的同步性提升。翻译器与配音员分别基于语音-文本数据和单语视听数据训练，因而不依赖成对配音数据。
AI.result: 在等时性（isochrony）和音视频一致性等多项指标上，X-Dubbing优于近期基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 将配音视为翻译与合成的联合优化问题，并以时间预算为桥梁、以合成反馈闭环优化，是提升跨语言配音同步质量且规避配对数据依赖的有效途径。

title: ACVA-Bench: Beyond Prompt Following in Abstract Concept Visualization Ability for Text-to-Image Models
summary: Text-to-image (T2I) models have achieved remarkable progress in image quality and instruction following, prompting growing research interest in their capacity for deep understanding that goes beyond literal prompt matching. However, without an explicit visual scheme provided, it remains unclear and has not been systematically evaluated whether T2I models can autonomously translate abstract concepts lacking a fixed visual referent, such as "loyalty," into visual representations that are accurate, diverse, and distinguishable from closely related concepts. We define this capability as Abstract Concept Visualization Ability (ACVA) and introduce ACVA-Bench, a category-balanced benchmark grounded in psycholinguistic norms of abstract concepts, which examines models' ACVA along three dimensions semantic sufficiency, representational diversity, and conceptual distinctiveness under a low-intervention setting that withholds concrete objects, scenes, or visual metaphors. Since abstract concepts lack a unique reference image, conventional evaluation metrics that rely on reference-image matching are difficult to apply. To address this, we propose a fine-grained visual-semantic evaluation method constrained by concept semantics, which decomposes concept semantics into independently verifiable visual-semantic questions to assess the semantic representation quality of generated images, with its validity further confirmed by human evaluation. Benchmarking results on mainstream T2I models show that these models rely on a small set of prototypical visual patterns, leaving room for improvement in representational diversity and conceptual distinctiveness for abstract concepts, thereby providing an interpretable and reproducible evaluation foundation for future research.

AI.tldr: 提出ACVA-Bench基准与受概念语义约束的细粒度视觉-语义评价方法，系统评测文本到图像模型将抽象概念（如"忠诚")自主可视化的能力。
AI.motivation: T2I模型在图像质量与指令遵循上进展显著，但在不提供明确视觉方案的情况下，能否将缺乏固定视觉指称的抽象概念转化为准确、多样且可与相近概念区分的视觉表征，尚不明确且缺乏系统评测。
AI.method: 定义抽象概念可视化能力（ACVA）；构建类别均衡的ACVA-Bench，基于 Psycholinguistic 抽象概念常模；在低干预设定下（不提供具体物体、场景或视觉隐喻）从语义充分性、表征多样性、概念区分性三个维度评测；由于抽象概念无唯一参考图像，提出将概念语义分解为可独立验证的视觉-语义问题的细粒度评价方法，并以人工评估验证其效度。
AI.result: 主流T2I模型倾向依赖少量原型化视觉模式，在抽象概念的表征多样性与概念区分性上仍有明显改进空间；人工评估证实了该评价方法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 为T2I模型的抽象概念理解与生成提供了可解释、可复现的评测基础，指出其在语义区分与多样性方面的不足。

title: Concept Acupuncturist: An Efficient and Precise Concept Erasure Method for Diffusion Models via Sparse Autoencoders
summary: Diffusion-based image generation models produce high-quality images but may generate harmful or policy-violating content, motivating machine unlearning (MU) to selectively remove target concepts while preserving general capabilities. However, existing MU approaches often struggle with the distributed and entangled nature of concept representations, leading to inefficient optimization and imprecise edits when applied through large-scale fine-tuning over full diffusion trajectories. To bridge this gap, we propose Concept Acupuncturist (ConceptACP), a novel MU framework that integrates interpretability-guided analysis with inference-free fine-tuning for efficient and precise concept removal. By establishing mappings between semantic concepts and cross-attention blocks in the U-Net denoiser and localizing the most concept-relevant block for targeted optimization, ConceptACP avoids full diffusion trajectory optimization, thereby improving fine-tuning efficiency. To mitigate concept entanglement, we propose a feature-level correction mechanism based on Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs), where SAE-derived sparse, semantically meaningful feature activations are manipulated to construct targeted correction signals, which are then projected back to the output space of the corresponding block and used as supervision for precise concept removal. Consequently, ConceptACP eliminates the need for external inference-time modules while achieving efficient and fine-grained unlearning. Instantiated on SDXL-Turbo, ConceptACP improves the forgetting success rate by 36.34 percentage points in the standard one-step generation setting on average over the best-performing baseline, while preserving image quality and prompt fidelity, and generalizes effectively across other Stable Diffusion backbones. Our code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: ConceptACP：通过定位U-Net交叉注意力中最相关的block并结合SAE稀疏特征校正信号，实现免推理的扩散模型概念遗忘。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型生成图像可能含违规内容，需要机器遗忘（MU）定向去除概念并保留通用能力；但概念表征分布式纠缠、全轨迹微调优化低效且编辑不精确。
AI.method: 建立语义概念与U-Net交叉注意力块的映射，定位最相关块做定向微调以避免全轨迹优化；基于稀疏自编码器（SAE）提取稀疏语义特征激活，构造校正信号并投影回该块输出空间作为监督，实现细粒度遗忘，无需推理时外部模块。
AI.result: 在SDXL-Turbo单步生成设定下，遗忘成功率较最佳基线平均提升36.34个百分点，同时保持图像质量与提示保真度，并可泛化到其他Stable Diffusion骨干。
AI.conclusion: 可解释性引导的块定位加SAE特征级校正为扩散模型概念遗忘提供了高效、精确且无需推理开销的范式。

title: Guided Zero-Shot Anomaly Explanation for Anonymized Crowd Video Monitoring: Context, Categorization, and Spatial Localization
summary: Despite the promising development of deep learning for video anomaly detection (VAD), explainability (XAI) of these models remains a challenge. Explainable and privacy-protecting VAD builds transparency and trust that facilitates adoption of computer vision systems, including safety and security monitoring. However, anomaly explainability in privacy-preserving VAD systems is underexplored. In this study, we present the XAVAD approach, a unified descriptive anomaly XAI for an anonymized VAD, that integrates flexible zero-shot anonymization, anomaly type categorization, visual localization, and scene context description. We provide empirical and qualitative assessments of multifaceted explanations integrated with full-body visual anonymization for privacy protection. We adopt a multimodal CLIP embedding for videos, using improved LLM-assisted prompting and pool-scoring mechanisms for anomaly-type identification. We enhance Grad-ECLIP for spatial anomaly heatmap localization, leveraging computation and accuracy through our novel prompt-guided patching autofocus mechanism. We employ VLMs to generate context and reasoning descriptions of detected anomalies through curated prompt engineering. We have evaluated the accuracy and computational cost of XAVAD on several publicly available CCTV and video datasets. Our experiments demonstrate substantial gains of our XAVAD over state-of-the-art benchmark approaches and provide insights into privacy protection trade-offs in XAI for VAD. We further present ablation studies and assessments across diverse configurations and modeling alternatives to demonstrate the efficacy of our proposed methods. Code: this https URL }{ this https URL .

AI.tldr: XAVAD：面向匿名化视频异常检测的统一可解释XAI框架，整合零样本全身匿名化、异常类型分类、空间热图定位与场景语境描述。
AI.motivation: 深度视频异常检测（VAD）缺乏可解释性；在隐私保护（匿名化）前提下如何解释异常仍属空白，而透明度与可信度是监控类视觉系统落地的关键。
AI.method: 采用多模态CLIP视频嵌入；用改进的LLM辅助提示与pool-scoring机制做异常类型识别；在Grad-ECLIP基础上引入prompt-guided patching autofocus提升热图定位精度与算力效率；用VLM配合精选提示工程生成语境与推理描述；并与全身视觉匿名化流水线联合。
AI.result: 在多个公开CCTV与视频数据集上评估精度与计算开销，XAVAD显著优于SOTA基准；给出隐私保护与XAI之间的权衡分析，并附消融与多配置/多建模方案对比。
AI.conclusion: 统一的多面性异常解释可与隐私匿名化共存，为可信VAD部署提供可行路径；但任务属于监控视频理解，与具身/机器人系统无直接耦合。

title: RADIANT: Object-Centric Feed-Forward Global Illumination
summary: Feed-forward neural renderers synthesize global illumination across novel 3D scenes without per-scene optimization or runtime ray tracing. Existing transformer-based renderers tokenize individual triangles, so self-attention scales quadratically with mesh resolution. Yet macroscopic radiative transport is governed by the underlying surface geometry and object arrangements rather than a particular mesh discretization; finer tessellation can thus inflate token counts without changing the underlying transport physics, motivating a discretization-agnostic and object-centric representation. We introduce RADIANT (RADiance-based Inter-Actor Neural Transformer), an object-centric architecture for feed-forward global illumination from point inputs. By representing each object with a compact budget of 32 surface-patch tokens, RADIANT decouples attention sequence length from polygon counts. In a single network, an inter-object scene transformer models 3D radiative exchange and a view decoder renders images at target camera poses. To capture light transport without materializing O(N^2) bias matrices, invariant form-factor attention embeds geometric distances and surface orientations directly into query-key dot products as SE(3)-invariant inner products weighted by learned area and material gains. For primary visibility without mesh connectivity, camera rays cross-attend scene tokens guided by depth-tested point splats in a shared spherical frame. Across a 1.03M-scene benchmark under matched model capacity, RADIANT reaches 25 dB tone-mapped PSNR in 5x fewer training steps than RenderFormer, and achieves 32.2 dB at 600k steps (+3.3 dB over RenderFormer and +7.6 dB over RenderFormer-V2). We further demonstrate the scalability of RADIANT, which completes a 512x512 forward pass of a 500-object scene in 0.83 s, with computational cost scaling with the number of objects rather than polygons.

AI.tldr: RADIANT：以对象为单位的Transformer前馈神经渲染器，用32个表面patch token表示每个物体，将注意力长度与多边形数解耦，并通过不变form-factor注意力建模全局光照。
AI.motivation: 现有基于Transformer的前馈渲染器逐三角面片token化，自注意力随网格分辨率平方增长；而宏观辐射传输由表面几何与物体布局决定，与具体离散化无关，细密网格只会徒增token而不改变传输物理。因此需要一种与离散化无关、以对象为中心的表示。
AI.method: 每个物体用固定预算（32个）表面patch token表示；统一网络中含inter-object场景Transformer建模三维辐射交换，以及视图解码器在目标位姿渲染。提出invariant form-factor注意力，将几何距离与表面朝向以SE(3)不变内积嵌入query-key点积，并以学习到的面积与材质增益加权，避免显式构造O(N^2)偏置矩阵。无需网格连通性即可实现主可见性：相机光线在共享球面坐标下，以经过深度测试的点splat为引导，对场景token做cross-attention。
AI.result: 在103万场景基准、等模型容量条件下，RADIANT在5倍更少的训练步数达到25 dB tone-mapped PSNR；60万步时达32.2 dB，较RenderFormer提升3.3 dB、较RenderFormer-V2提升7.6 dB。500物体场景512×512前向推理耗时0.83 s，计算成本随物体数而非多边形数增长。
AI.conclusion: 以对象为中心的token化结合物理启发的form-factor注意力，可让前馈全局光照渲染摆脱网格离散化与二次复杂度束缚，并在精度与效率上显著优于逐三角面片基线，具备良好的可扩展性。

title: DiscoDemo: Discovering Efficient and Diverse Robot Demonstrations for Imitation Learning
summary: Behavior cloning for robotic manipulation is highly sensitive to the coverage of its training data, yet collecting diverse successful demonstrations remains costly. We study reinforcement learning (RL) not as a deployable controller, but as a data generator for downstream visuomotor imitation learning. Our key premise is that multiple successful solution modes cover a broader range of successful trajectories than repeatedly collecting a single narrow solution. We introduce DiscoDemo, which trains a privileged latent-conditioned RL generator with a parallel reverse curriculum and a success-gated diversity objective to discover diverse solutions while preserving task success. The trained generator produces multiple successful closed-loop behaviors, which are safety-filtered and exported as a static dataset for downstream imitation learning. Across four manipulation tasks, DiscoDemo produces broader successful-state coverage and improves downstream visuomotor policies in both simulation and the real world. Averaged across tasks, downstream success increases to 62% from 40% for the strongest baseline in simulation, and to 78% from 39% on the real robot, respectively. These results suggest that successful solution diversity improves imitation learning for a pretrained flow-matching VLA and remains complementary to corrective data collection. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: DiscoDemo 用"特权隐变量条件 RL 生成器 + 并行反向课程 + 成功门控多样性目标"产生多模态成功轨迹，再经安全过滤导出静态数据集，用于下游视觉-运动模仿学习，显著提升仿真与真机成功率。
AI.motivation: 行为克隆对训练数据覆盖度高度敏感，而采集多样化成功示范成本高；作者希望把 RL 当作"数据生成器"而非部署控制器，通过覆盖多个成功解模式来拓展成功状态分布。
AI.method: 训练带特权信息、以隐变量为条件的 RL 生成器：并行反向课程加速探索并保证可达性，成功门控的多样性目标在保持任务成功的前提下促使不同隐变量对应不同解模式；生成的多条闭环成功轨迹经安全过滤后导出为静态数据集，供预训练流匹配 VLA 做下游模仿学习。
AI.result: 四个操作任务上，DiscoDemo 产生更广的成功状态覆盖；仿真下游平均成功率 62%（最强基线 40%），真机 78%（基线 39%）；与纠错式数据采集互补。
AI.conclusion: 成功的解多样性是提升模仿学习（尤其对预训练 VLA）的有效且可与纠错数据采集叠加的数据侧杠杆；RL 作为数据生成器的范式具备实用价值。

title: TTT in VLA Models: Exploring Training with Human Demonstrations
comment: 22 pages, 6 figures, a techreport form standard-robots company
summary: Long-horizon robot tasks require retaining and using past information. We integrate Test-Time Training (TTT), which stores context in fast weights, into InternVLA-A1 and Pi0.5 to study action generation conditioned on human demonstrations through training on paired demonstrations and robot trajectories. We implement memory transfer between the two phases and truncated backpropagation, and examine training objectives, gradient coverage, and contrastive regularization across video, short-video, and single-frame cue tasks. In our experiments, adding TTT and training on paired data at the current scale did not lead to consistent target selection based on demonstrations. Under the tested settings, shorter sequences, full trajectory gradient connectivity, and contrastive regularization did not clearly improve responsiveness to demonstrations. When demonstrations were reduced to single-frame cues, real-robot execution still showed a preference for cups at fixed positions. We document the implementation, training configurations, and observations to support further inspection and replication.

AI.tldr: 将测试时训练（TTT）以快速权重形式引入 InternVLA-A1 与 Pi0.5，在成对演示-机器人轨迹上训练以检验演示条件化的动作生成，并报告了负向/中性结果。
AI.motivation: 长时程机器人任务需要保留并利用历史信息，作者希望验证在 VLA 中通过 TTT 将人类演示上下文压缩进快速权重，能否实现基于演示的目标选择与动作生成。
AI.method: 在 InternVLA-A1 与 Pi0.5 两个 VLA 主干上集成 TTT（以快速权重存储上下文），在两个阶段间实现记忆迁移并采用截断反向传播；在视频、短视频、单帧线索三类任务上系统消融训练目标、梯度覆盖范围与对比正则化。
AI.result: 在当前规模下，加入 TTT 与成对数据训练并未带来一致的基于演示的目标选择；更短序列、全轨迹梯度连通、对比正则均未明显提升对演示的响应性；将演示退化为单帧线索后，真机执行仍偏好固定位置的杯子。作者未获正向结论，仅记录实现与配置。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为负向结果报告，提示现有规模下 TTT 式快速权重记忆难以有效承载演示信息用于目标选择；价值在于可复现的实现细节与失败分析，而非方法增益。

title: Coupling Execution Horizon and Sampling Depth in Flow-Matching VLA Policies
summary: Flow-matching Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models generate expressive continuous trajectories for robotic manipulation, yet balancing real-time responsiveness with execution stability remains a persistent challenge. Standard deployment workflows typically treat numerical solver depth and execution horizon as decoupled choices. The horizon amortizes inference latency, while solver depth is kept high to preserve integration fidelity. In this paper, we reveal a fundamental compute-execution coupling in flow-matching VLAs governed by a systematic sign reversal. While coarse numerical integration degrades precision under rapid replanning, it markedly improves task performance under extended open-loop commitment. Geometrically, numerical truncation contracts lateral action dispersion around an invariant trajectory centroid, serving as an implicit regularizer that suppresses compounding open-loop drift. Across LIBERO, RoboTwin 2.0, and real-world Franka manipulation on representative VLA backbones including $\pi_0$, $\pi_{0.5}$, and GR00T, exploiting this joint coupling consistently achieves superior task success while drastically lowering inference latency, entirely training-free and without architectural modifications. These findings establish numerical sampling depth as an operational variance regulator, shifting its role from a static precision budget to an active deployment knob in robot learning. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: 揭示流匹配VLA中"数值积分深度"与"开环执行时长"的耦合关系：粗积分虽降低精度，却在长开环执行下压缩横向动作离散度、起到隐式正则作用，从而提升成功率并降低推理延迟。
AI.motivation: 现有部署流程将求解器步数（数值精度）与执行时域（horizon）视为解耦选择，但二者在实际部署中存在根本性耦合，缺乏系统分析与可操作结论。
AI.method: 在LIBERO、RoboTwin 2.0及真实Franka平台上，基于π0、π0.5、GR00T等VLA骨干，系统扫描数值积分步数与开环horizon的联合配置；从几何角度分析数值截断对动作分布的作用，指出其收缩横向动作弥散、稳定轨迹质心，从而抑制开环漂移累积。方法为纯训练无关、无架构改动的部署侧调节。
AI.result: 发现系统性的符号反转：快速重规划下粗积分降低精度，而长开环执行下粗积分显著提升任务成功率；联合调节两者可在多个仿真与真实机器人基准上同时获得更高成功率与更低推理延迟。
AI.conclusion: 将数值采样深度重新定位为运行期方差调节器（deployment knob），而非静态精度预算，为流匹配VLA的部署提供免训练的实用准则。

title: ImageRSI: Verification-Driven Recursive Self-Improvement for Agentic Image Generation
summary: Complex text-to-image requests remain difficult to satisfy reliably. Verifying and repairing an image can fix an individual output, but a successful repair does not necessarily carry over to other requests. We present ImageRSI, a framework that keeps the image generator frozen and combines three components: five-dimensional verification and repair within each task, an experience library shared across tasks, and offline updating of the judge. Candidate experiences enter the library only after paired A/B validation, and the judge is updated with supervised fine-tuning and GRPO on accumulated image-judgment records and evaluated before reuse. We also introduce ImageReq-Bench, a benchmark of 961 requests built around hard cases in real-world image-generation requests, each paired with an evaluation checklist. ImageRSI achieves a Checklist Strict Accuracy (CSA) of 52.6% on MindBench (with Nano Banana Pro as the generator) and 65.66% on ImageReq-Bench, and we compare system outcomes across judge-training configurations.

AI.tldr: ImageRSI：冻结生成器，结合五维校验修复、跨任务经验库（A/B配对验证筛选）与离线更新的judge（SFT+GRPO），提升复杂T2I请求满足率；并提出961条请求的ImageReq-Bench。
AI.motivation: 复杂文生图请求难以可靠满足；单次校验-修复虽可改善单张输出，但修复成功经验无法迁移到其他请求。
AI.method: 生成器保持冻结的三组件框架：(1) 任务内五维验证与修复；(2) 跨任务共享经验库，候选经验须通过配对A/B验证方可入库；(3) judge离线更新（在累积的图像-判定记录上进行SFT与GRPO），复用前先评测。另构建ImageReq-Bench（961条真实场景困难请求，每条附评估清单）。
AI.result: MindBench上以Nano Banana Pro为生成器取得52.6% Checklist Strict Accuracy (CSA)；ImageReq-Bench上65.66%；并对比不同judge训练配置的系统效果。
AI.conclusion: 以“冻结生成器+经验积累+judge自进化”的推理期闭环替代单次修复，可将修复经验跨请求复用；judge训练配置显著影响系统级结果。

title: Data Quality in RVL-CDIP: A Systematic Audit
summary: RVL-CDIP is the de facto standard benchmark for document classification, and reported accuracy on it is now 98.8%. In this paper, we audit RVL-CDIP for data quality issues and find that approximately 10.5% of its 400,000 documents have erroneous labels and that 35.2% of the test set has a duplicate or near-duplicate in the training set. Identification codes on the pages are sufficient to classify at 69% accuracy, and a state-of-the-art model loses 11 points without them. Image-only models trained on RVL-CDIP lose 16 to 28 points on documents from other sources, and the choice of OCR engine changes accuracy by 4.1 to 8.3 points. We find that nearly 16,000 RVL-CDIP documents contain sensitive personal data, and produce de-identified versions of these documents. We re-benchmark 25 models, and with all defects remediated, the 13 that we retrain are 0.9 to 2.9 points more accurate than in the original condition; the most accurate of them, LayoutLMv3, is 96.5% accurate. We release the corrected corpus, the annotations and the out-of-distribution data.

AI.tldr: 对文档分类基准 RVL-CDIP 进行数据质量审计，发现约 10.5% 标签错误、35.2% 测试集存在与训练的重复/近重复、页面识别码可单独分类到 69%，并发布修正语料与去标识化数据，重新基准 25 个模型。
AI.motivation: RVL-CDIP 作为事实标准基准已被报到 98.8% 准确率，但数据质量缺陷可能使这些结果虚高且不可迁移，需要系统审计以厘清基准的真实可信度。
AI.method: 审计标签错误与训练/测试重复（含近重复）；用页面识别码单独训练分类器验证捷径特征；对比有无识别码时的 SOTA 模型性能；测试图像模型跨来源的分布外泛化；比较不同 OCR 引擎影响；识别并去标识化约 1.6 万份含敏感个人数据的文档；在缺陷修复后重新基准 25 个模型并重训其中 13 个。
AI.result: 约 10.5% 文档标签错误，35.2% 测试样本有训练集重复/近重复；识别码单独达 69% 准确率，SOTA 模型去掉识别码下降 11 点；跨源分布外下降 16–28 点；OCR 引擎选择带来 4.1–8.3 点差异；修复后重训模型提升 0.9–2.9 点，最优 LayoutLMv3 为 96.5%。
AI.conclusion: 主流文档分类基准存在显著标签噪声、数据泄漏与捷径特征，报告精度被系统性高估；发布修正语料、标注与分布外数据，为后续评测提供更可靠基础。

title: TravSUITE: Traversability via Self-Supervised, Uncertainty-Aware IRL and Terrain Estimation
summary: Traversability analysis in off-road settings remains a fundamental challenge for mobile robots. Key difficulties include constructing an accurate and expressive local map from multimodal sensor data, and using the map to design traversability rules that yield desirable navigation behavior. Importantly, this system must be resilient to the limited sensing regime brought about by complex environments and high speeds. In this paper, we present TravSUITE, a traversability system suitable for high-speed navigation in off-road environments. TravSUITE consists of two major components: 1) an efficient voxel mapper that leverages visual foundation models (VFMs) to build a rich geometric-semantic local map from streams of on-board sensor data, and 2) a unified neural network that jointly predicts traversability-relevant quantities in bird's eye view (BEV), including geometry, semantics, speed and cost. Our training strategy is entirely annotation-free and self-supervised, leveraging tasks such as map inpainting and inverse reinforcement learning (IRL) to learn both map representations and traversability. We perform a thorough ablation study and comparison to state-of-the-art approaches, and the results indicate that cost learning and auxiliary inpainting each contribute significantly to planning quality, and their combination is critical for achieving state-of-the-art performance in off-road path planning. We also design a simple risk adaptation mechanism to leverage our method's uncertainty estimates at deploy-time, and demonstrate that a combination of inpainting and risk estimation can result in 80% fewer navigation errors and 5% faster autonomous traversal speeds in real-world hardware experiments.

AI.tldr: TravSUITE：用视觉基础模型构建几何-语义体素地图，并以单一神经网络在BEV联合预测几何、语义、速度与代价，全程自监督（地图补全+逆强化学习）实现越野高速可通行性分析。
AI.motivation: 越野可通行性分析的难点在于：多模态传感器数据要构建准确且表达力强的局部地图，地图到可通行性规则的映射要产生理想导航行为，且系统须在复杂环境与高速行驶导致的稀疏/有限感知条件下保持鲁棒。
AI.method: 两大组件：(1) 高效体素建图器，借助视觉基础模型（VFM）从车载多模态数据流构建几何-语义局部地图；(2) 统一神经网络，在鸟瞰图下联合预测几何、语义、速度与代价。训练完全无标注、自监督，通过地图补全（inpainting）与逆强化学习（IRL）学习地图表征与可通行性。部署时提出简单的风险自适应机制，利用不确定性估计。
AI.result: 消融与SOTA对比表明：代价学习与辅助补全各自显著提升规划质量，二者结合对达到越野路径规划SOTA至关重要；实机实验中补全+风险估计结合可减少80%导航错误、提升5%自主通行速度。
AI.conclusion: 自监督代价学习与辅助地图补全的耦合是越野可通行性规划的关键，配合部署期不确定性驱动的风险适应可显著改善真实高速越野导航的可靠性与效率。

title: SyncPro: Synchronous Reasoning and Responding for Proactive Streaming Video Understanding
summary: Proactive streaming video understanding requires assistants to track unfolding events and respond when a user's requested condition is met. To make these decisions, assistants must accumulate relevant evidence and reassess response conditions as new observations arrive. Existing work offers complementary capabilities for this process: proactive video assistants learn when to respond, while streaming video reasoning methods generate scheduled intermediate text to organize observations and support subsequent answers. Together, these capabilities provide a foundation for proactive reasoning, but how to coordinate ongoing reasoning with timely responses remains underexplored. In a direct adaptation, fixed reasoning intervals can trigger updates when nothing relevant has changed or postpone useful updates until the next scheduled step. Sharing one generation path also couples two distinct requirements: preserving evidence for future decisions and producing only the response requested by the user. Moreover, responses generated after reasoning must wait for it to finish, even when sufficient evidence is already available. To address these challenges, we introduce SyncPro, a synchronous dual-stream framework with specialized generation paths for evidence tracking and user-facing responses. Its Inner and Response branches share causal history and activate independently, allowing relevant evidence changes to trigger internal updates and responses to proceed concurrently with ongoing reasoning. We construct 189K dual-stream examples and train SyncPro through supervised fine-tuning followed by trajectory-level reinforcement learning. Experiments across three proactive benchmarks show improved response timing and more accurate answers to user requests.

AI.tldr: SyncPro：双流（Inner 推理流 + Response 响应流）同步生成框架，用于主动式流式视频理解，独立触发内部证据更新与用户响应，构建 189K 双流数据，SFT + 轨迹级 RL 训练，三个主动式基准上提升响应时机与答案准确率。
AI.motivation: 主动式流式视频助手需在事件演进中积累证据并在用户条件满足时及时响应。已有工作分别解决"何时响应"（主动式视频助手）与"流式推理"（按计划生成中间文本），但二者协同未被充分探索：固定推理间隔会在无变化时误触发、或延迟有用更新；共享同一生成路径耦合了"保留证据"与"只输出用户请求内容"两个不同需求；且响应必须等待推理结束，即便证据已足够。
AI.method: 提出 SyncPro 同步双流框架：Inner 分支负责证据追踪与内部更新，Response 分支面向用户输出，二者共享因果历史但可独立激活，使证据变化触发内部更新、响应与推理并发进行。构建 189K 双流样本，先监督微调，再做轨迹级强化学习。
AI.result: 在三个主动式流式视频理解基准上，响应时机更准确，对用户请求的回答正确率提升。
AI.conclusion: 将"证据维护"与"面向用户的响应"解耦为可独立触发的双流生成路径，是协调持续推理与及时响应的有效方案；数据构建加轨迹级 RL 可支撑该范式。属视频流式主动推理方向，与具身/3D/机器人核心议题关联较弱。

title: Geometry-Aware Reinforcement Learning for Close-Fitting Wearable Insertion
summary: Robot-assisted dressing is particularly challenging due to narrow openings and articulated body parts. Even small errors in the relative pose between the body part and garment opening can cause snagging, missed insertion, or incomplete dressing. To address these challenges, we formulate dressing as a geometry-aware insertion problem that represents task-relevant spatial relationships between the body part and object opening, rather than relying on the full deformable-object state. Based on this formulation, we propose a Reinforcement Learning (RL) framework combining a staged curriculum, which progressively guides the policy from coarse alignment to insertion and final placement, with a finger-wise insertion soft gate that provides continuous feedback on individual finger insertion progress and helps suppress premature insertion. We evaluate the framework on rigid and deformable bracelet dressing tasks through component ablations, systematic variations in the initial hand pose, and closed-loop execution of the learned policies on a real robotic system. On the post-training deformable evaluation, the full method reaches 84.7 +- 1.2% success. The insertion gate accounts for the largest gain, and adding the curriculum on top of that gate reaches the top score. On a mannequin hand the same full policy succeeds on 15/20 real-robot trials.

AI.tldr: 将机器人穿衣（手/前臂穿入手镯类开口）建模为几何感知的插入问题，用分阶段课程学习 + 逐手指软插入门控的强化学习框架，在仿真消融与真机人台实验中验证。
AI.motivation: 柔性衣物开口狭窄且身体部位有铰接结构，身体部位与衣物开口相对位姿的微小误差即导致卡挂、插入失败或穿衣不完整；依赖完整可变形物体状态表示既高维又难获取，因此需要更紧凑、任务相关的空间关系表征。
AI.method: 以"身体部位 vs. 开口"的关键几何关系（而非全状态）构造状态；RL 策略配合三阶段课程（粗对齐→插入→最终放置）逐步推进；引入逐手指的软插入门控（连续反馈每个手指的插入进度），用于抑制过早插入并引导手指依次进入。
AI.result: 刚性/柔性手镯穿衣任务上做组件消融与初始手部位姿系统性变化测试；训练后柔性评估成功率 84.7±1.2%，插入门控贡献最大增益，门控+课程组合最优；人台真机闭环执行 20 次试验成功 15 次（75%）。
AI.conclusion: 结构化几何表征 + 细粒度进度门控与课程，比端到端全状态方法更有效地解决窄开口可变形物体穿衣；但真机成功率仍低于仿真，sim-to-real 与感知鲁棒性仍是主要瓶颈。

title: Separating Angular Alignment from Radial Ordering in Hyperbolic Vision-Language Models
summary: Hyperbolic vision-language models are well suited to modeling the hierarchical structure of multimodal data, because hyperbolic volume grows exponentially with radius, enabling low-distortion representations of tree-like taxonomies from general to specific concepts. However, existing pretraining objectives for hyperbolic vision-language models entangle semantic alignment with entailment modeling, forcing radial coordinates to simultaneously encode semantic matching and hierarchical structure, leading to conflicting geometric constraints. In this paper, we introduce AURORA, a hyperbolic vision-language framework that decouples the objectives through angular alignment and a novel Radial-Angular Order Cone (RAOC) for entailment modeling. Angular alignment captures semantic similarity while preserving the radial structure for representing hierarchies. Unlike conventional entailment cones, RAOC determines angular allowance from relative parent-child radial gaps. It is incorporated into hierarchical entailment contrastive training to capture partial-order relations. We further introduce a norm regularization term that prevents undesirable radial degeneration for stable training. We train models on millions of image-text pairs and evaluate them across zero-shot classification, image-text retrieval, hierarchical reasoning, and compositional understanding. Our model consistently outperforms strong Euclidean and hyperbolic vision-language baselines, demonstrating the effectiveness of decoupling semantic alignment from hierarchical entailment modeling.

AI.tldr: AURORA decouples semantic alignment from entailment in hyperbolic vision-language pretraining via angular alignment plus a Radial-Angular Order Cone (RAOC) and norm regularization.
AI.motivation: Existing hyperbolic VLM objectives entangle semantic alignment with entailment modeling, forcing radial coordinates to encode both semantic matching and hierarchy, causing conflicting geometric constraints.
AI.method: Angular alignment to capture semantic similarity while preserving radial structure; RAOC determines angular allowance from relative parent-child radial gaps; hierarchical entailment contrastive training to model partial-order relations; norm regularization to prevent radial degeneration.
AI.result: Trained on millions of image-text pairs; outperforms Euclidean and hyperbolic VLM baselines on zero-shot classification, image-text retrieval, hierarchical reasoning, and compositional understanding.
AI.conclusion: Decoupling semantic alignment from hierarchical entailment modeling yields a more effective hyperbolic vision-language framework.

title: Playing Bias: Epistemic Games for Interpreting Text-to-Image Models
comment: 11 pages. Accepted at iLRN 2026, the 12th International Conference of the Immersive Learning Research Network, Athens, Greece, June 2026. Video presentation: this https URL
summary: Text-to-image (T2I) systems do not merely render prompts; they circulate defaults for "what X looks like," shaping recognition through pose, camera, costume, props, and setting. While technical audits quantify disparities, they rarely cultivate the literacy needed to argue how images assemble stereotypes and confer authority. This paper translates a three-stage, humanities-informed framework into a set of epistemic games that make this cultural work visible and debatable: Interpret (art-historical close looking with AI outputs), Interrogate (counter-intent prompting as artistic exploration), and Expose (creative misuse through paired prompts with a constant motif and a BiasSlot rule, in which only the bias cue varies). In a pilot with undergraduate fine-arts students, the games shifted discussion from impressionistic reactions to concise, warranted hypotheses grounded in visual evidence, supported by lightweight classroom instruments that enabled reproducibility and structured collaboration. We argue that such game-based approaches foster critical literacy across educational contexts, equipping learners to recognize, discuss, and contest how T2I models encode bias.

AI.tldr: 提出将三阶段人文学框架（Interpret—艺术史式细读、Interrogate—反意图提示、Expose—带常量母题的BiasSlot成对提示）转化为"认识论游戏"，用于培养T2I偏见批判素养，并在本科美术生试点中观察到讨论从印象式反应转向基于视觉证据的可辩护假设。
AI.motivation: T2I系统不仅渲染提示词，还扩散"X应该长什么样"的默认设定（姿态、机位、服饰、道具、场景），塑造人们对类别的认知。现有技术审计多量化差异，却很少培养学习者论证图像如何拼装刻板印象、赋予权威的能力，因此需要可教学、可争论的素养路径。
AI.method: 将三阶段人文学框架落地为一组认识论游戏：Interpret（结合艺术史视觉细读与AI输出）、Interrogate（以反意图提示进行艺术探索）、Expose（以常量母题+BiasSlot规则构造仅改变偏见线索的成对提示，实施"创造性误用"）。采用轻量课堂工具记录与复现，在本科美术学生中开展试点。
AI.result: 试点中讨论由印象式评论转向简洁、有依据、基于视觉证据的假设；轻量工具支持可复现性与结构化协作。
AI.conclusion: 基于游戏的方法可在多种教育情境中培养批判素养，使学习者识别、讨论并质疑T2I模型内的偏见编码；属于人文与HCI交叉的教育方法研究，非生成模型技术方法贡献。

title: Forging Emotions: a deep learning experiment on emotions and art
comment: 10 pages. Published in Artnodes no. 31 (2023), Universitat Oberta de Catalunya, under CC BY 4.0. Extended version of a paper presented at ISEA 2022, Barcelona
summary: Affective computing is an interdisciplinary field that studies computational methods that relate to or influence emotion. These methods have been applied to interactive media artworks, but they have focused on affect detection rather than affect generation. For affect generation, computationally creative methods need to be explored that have recently been driven by the use of Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs), a deep learning method. The experiment presented in this paper, Forging Emotions, explores the use of visual emotion datasets and the working processes of GANs for visual affect generation, that is, for generating images that can convey or trigger specified emotions. This experiment concludes that the methodology used so far by computer science researchers to build image datasets for describing high-level concepts such as emotions is insufficient and proposes utilizing emotional networks of associations according to psychology research. Forging Emotions also concludes that to generate affect visually, merely corresponding to basic psychology findings, such as bright or dark colours, does not seem adequate. Therefore, research efforts should aim to understand the structure of trained GANs and compositional GANs in order to produce genuinely novel compositions that can convey or trigger emotions through the subject matter of generated images.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过艺术实验《Forging Emotions》探讨用 GAN 生成能传达或触发特定情绪的视觉图像，并指出计算机科学界现有情感图像数据集构建方法不足、仅靠颜色等基础心理学线索无法充分生成情感，主张研究 GAN 内部结构与组合式 GAN 以生成真正新颖的情感构型。
AI.motivation: 情感计算在交互媒体艺术中多用于情感检测，而情感生成（affect generation）研究稀缺；近期生成对抗网络为计算创造性方法提供可能，但缺乏对"如何用 GAN 生成可传达/触发指定情绪的图像"的系统性实验与方法学反思。
AI.method: 以艺术实践为驱动的实验研究：使用视觉情感图像数据集训练/操作 GAN，考察其工作流程对视觉情感生成的适用性；批判性分析现有高层概念（如情绪）图像数据集的标注与构建范式，并提出结合心理学中的情绪联想网络来构建数据集的替代思路。
AI.result: 实验得出两点结论：(1) 当前用于描述"情绪"这类高层概念的图像数据集构建方法不充分，宜采用心理学研究的情绪联想网络；(2) 仅对应"明亮/暗沉色彩"等基础心理学结论，不足以生成视觉情感，需理解已训练 GAN 及组合式 GAN 的结构与组成机制。
AI.conclusion: 视觉情感生成应超越检测范式与浅层色彩线索，转向对 GAN 潜在结构与组合机制的解析，以通过生成图像的主题内容产生真正新颖、能传达或触发情绪的作品。

title: Real-Time Localisation of Dorsal Anatomical Regions on Dairy Cows in Commercial Rotary Parlours from RGB-D
comment: 9 pages, 7 figures, 3 tables. Submitted to ACRA 2026
summary: Automated monitoring of dairy cows increasingly measures one part of the body, such as the rump for temperature or the back for posture, yet the region itself is usually placed by hand. Existing systems either score the cow as a whole or detect sparse keypoints, often in controlled walkways, and neither yields the named region masks that such measurements need on a crowded commercial rotary platform. We present a perception front end that finds the target cow, ten bony landmarks and four named dorsal regions (withers, back, rump and tail-head) in a single forward pass over a whole RGB-D frame from a commercial rotary parlour. Two encoders, one for colour and one for depth, are fused late and share one decoder with three heads. On an anatomical region dataset that we built on public rotary-parlour RGB-D images (538 annotated frames, cow-disjoint test set), the network reaches PCK@10 0.905 for landmarks and region IoU 0.70 to 0.91, and runs end to end in 26.4 ms per frame on a T4 GPU, against an 11 fps camera. Dense region supervision is what makes the landmarks accurate: removing the region head costs 0.15 PCK@10. Agreement between the two heads flags unreliable frames without labels. On our own rig at the largest dairy farm in Western Australia, the model transfers with ten labelled frames (PCK@10 0.84), and its regions are carried through depth into a radiometric thermal camera, giving one repeatable temperature per region and cow.

AI.tldr: 提出单次前向的RGB-D感知前端：双编码器（颜色+深度）晚期融合、共享解码器三头输出，在商用转盘挤奶厅整帧中同时检测目标奶牛、10个骨性关键点与4个命名背侧区域（肩隆、背、臀、尾根），区域稠密监督显著提升关键点精度，并支持向热像仪传递实现逐牛逐区温度测量。
AI.motivation: 现有奶牛自动监测系统通常只测身体某一部位（臀部测温、背部姿态），但该区域往往靠人工标定；已有方法要么整体打分、要么在受控通道中检测稀疏关键点，无法在拥挤的商用旋转挤奶平台上输出带命名语义的区域掩码，而这类测量正需要这种掩码。
AI.method: 双编码器（颜色、深度）晚期融合，共享一个解码器与三个输出头（目标奶牛检测、10个解剖关键点、4个命名背侧区域掩码）。构建了一个基于公开转盘挤奶厅RGB-D图像的区域数据集（538帧，测试集按牛不重叠）。分析上做了区域头的消融，并利用两个头的输出一致性做无标签的不可靠帧判别；在自建装置上用10帧标注做迁移，并将区域通过深度标定传递到辐射热像仪。
AI.result: 关键点PCK@10达0.905，区域IoU 0.70–0.91；T4 GPU上端到端26.4 ms/帧，相对11 fps相机有实时余量。去掉区域头损失0.15 PCK@10，说明稠密区域监督是提升关键点精度的关键。自建装置上10帧标注迁移即达PCK@10 0.84，且可在热像仪中给出每区域、每头牛可重复的温度。
AI.conclusion: 稠密命名区域监督与关键点联合学习的单阶段RGB-D前端，可在真实商用挤奶环境中实时、稳定地输出目标奶牛、解剖关键点与语义区域，并支撑下游测温等生理测量；少量标注即可跨装置迁移，多头一致性可用于无标签质量筛选。

title: $Ψ$-0.6: Adaptive Streams of Thought in a Unified Vision-Language World Model
summary: Humans reason about the physical world by flexibly combining different forms of inference as a problem unfolds. Achieving this flexibility is a major open challenge in AI: capabilities often remain separated across specialized models, limiting how they can be composed and jointly adapted to a task. We introduce $\Psi$-0.6, a unified vision-language world model that adaptively composes perception, language, geometry, and simulation within a shared reasoning process we call streams of thought. These streams interleave images, text, and explicit representations of geometry and motion, all of which the model can generate and interpret through a shared token interface. $\Psi$-0.6 surpasses leading open-weight models zero-shot on multi-view spatial reasoning, with further gains from reasoning through geometric intermediates. It also supports counterfactual simulation: generating and interpreting imagined scenes to determine, for example, whether moving an object would obstruct a pathway. Reinforcement learning from task feedback jointly optimizes the selection, generation, and use of intermediate representations, improving visual question-answering accuracy with gains that transfer to unseen benchmarks. $\Psi$-0.6 offers a path toward adaptive physical reasoning -- not only predicting the physical world but also choosing the representations through which to reason.

AI.tldr: 提出统一视觉-语言世界模型 Ψ-0.6，通过共享 token 接口将图像、文本、几何与运动表示交织成"思维流"，并借助任务反馈强化学习联合优化中间表示的选择、生成与使用。
AI.motivation: 人类在问题展开过程中灵活组合多种推理形式，而当前 AI 能力分散在不同专用模型中，难以组合并联合适配任务，缺乏可自适应选择推理表征的统一物理世界建模能力。
AI.method: 统一的视觉-语言世界模型：以共享 token 接口交错图像、文本、显式几何与运动表示，形成"思维流"（streams of thought）；模型可生成并解读这些中间表示；并利用任务反馈的强化学习联合优化中间表征的选择、生成与利用，同时支持反事实仿真（生成并解读想象场景）。
AI.result: 在多视角空间推理上零样本超过领先开源权重模型，通过几何中间表示推理带来进一步提升；支持反事实仿真（如判断移动物体是否阻塞通路）；RL 优化提升视觉问答准确率，且增益可迁移至未见基准。
AI.conclusion: Ψ-0.6 为自适应物理推理提供了一条路径——不仅预测物理世界，还能选择用于推理的表示形式；但摘要中缺少机器人实验、真实场景泛化与代码/推理时延等证据。

title: Searching with Sparse Histories: Cross-Task Architecture Search from Incomplete Search Logs and Zero-Cost Proxies
summary: Neural architecture search (NAS) is expensive, but cross-task transfer can reduce costs by reusing knowledge from previous tasks. However, existing methods struggle with sparse search histories and task-specific transfer failures. We propose a method, a risk-robust strategy that combines sparse source logs with zero-cost proxies through champion-based initialization and joint pairwise-ranker pretraining. On TransNAS-Bench-101, the proposal mitigates severe worst-case failures, reducing worst-10% ranks from 290 to 43 for Micro autoencoding and from 465 to 45 for Macro room layout. Across 13 cell-space targets, it outperforms a proxy-only ranker on 10 targets in both mean and worst-case performance, while maintaining competitive average performance.

AI.tldr: 提出一种抗风险迁移策略：以champion-based初始化结合零代价代理(Zero-Cost Proxies)，并通过联合pairwise-ranker预训练，从稀疏源任务日志中稳健迁移到目标任务，显著缓解NAS跨任务迁移的最坏情况失败。
AI.motivation: NAS代价高昂，跨任务迁移可复用历史知识降低成本；但现有方法在源历史稀疏时易失效，且迁移在部分目标任务上完全失败（worst-case灾难性退化）。
AI.method: 将稀疏源日志与零代价代理结合：用champion-based初始化提供稳健先验，联合预训练pairwise ranker（同时学习源任务排序与代理信号排序），使迁移在面对分布偏移时仍保持排序稳健性。
AI.result: TransNAS-Bench-101上，Micro autoencoding的worst-10%排名由290降至43，Macro room layout由465降至45；13个cell-space目标中10个在均值与最坏情况上均优于纯代理ranker，平均性能保持竞争性。
AI.conclusion: 在稀疏历史与任务特异迁移失败场景下，代理+champion初始化+pairwise排序联合训练可同时改善均值与尾部表现，是一种低成本的抗风险NAS迁移方案；但评测限于表格基元，缺少真实大规模搜索验证。

title: Depth-Dependent Safety Geometry in Vision-Language Models: Layer-Wise Localization and Bidirectional Refusal Control
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) are widely deployed, yet the internal mechanisms behind their safety behavior remain poorly understood. We present a lightweight inference-time framework for localizing and manipulating safety-sensitive representations in frozen VLMs, without retraining or modifying parameters. On Qwen3-VL-4B, layer-wise activation divergence analysis reveals non-uniform safety geometry across depth. Causal interventions show that early vision layers support strong bidirectional refusal control through activation steering along a learned safety direction, with unsafe rejection spanning 6%-96%, whereas later layers respond more to activation magnitude scaling and exhibit a substantial safety-selectivity trade-off. Deeper layers remain well separated along the safety direction yet are largely insensitive to steering, distinguishing representational separability from causal controllability. InternVL2.5-4B shows qualitatively similar depth-dependent activation geometry despite differences in layer location and magnitude. Our results expose a white-box, representation-level refusal-bypass attack surface in VLM vision encoders and motivate inference-time stabilization of safety-sensitive representations.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出轻量级推理时框架，通过逐层激活差异分析与因果干预（沿"安全方向"激活引导、幅度缩放），在冻结的VLM中定位并操控负责拒答的安全表征。
AI.motivation: VLM广泛部署但其安全行为的内部机制尚不清楚，且现有工作缺乏对"可分离性"与"因果可控性"的区分与跨模型验证。
AI.method: 在Qwen3-VL-4B与InternVL2.5-4B上做逐层激活差异分析；沿学习到的安全方向进行激活引导（activation steering）与幅度缩放干预，测量拒答率变化，构建逐层因果曲线。
AI.result: 早期视觉层沿安全方向的双向引导可将不安全拒答率从6%调控至96%；后期层对幅度缩放更敏感并出现明显安全性—选择性权衡；深层虽沿安全方向可分但几乎不受引导影响，说明表征可分性≠因果可控性；InternVL2.5-4B呈现类似的深度依赖几何但层位置与幅度不同。
AI.conclusion: 揭示了VLM视觉编码器中白盒、表征层面的拒答绕过攻击面，呼吁在推理时对安全敏感表征进行稳定化处理。

title: RAISE-Vision: An Automated Contact Angle Measurement Platform for Contact Lens Wettability Characterization
summary: Contact angle (CA) is a common parameter measured in the development of novel contact lens materials and surface coating technologies. Existing literature on in vitro CA of contact lenses via the sessile drop method is hindered in repeatability, reliability, and comparability due to inter-laboratory and inter-operator protocol variation. In this work, the Robotic Autonomous Imaging Surface Evaluator for vision applications (RAISE-Vision) is introduced as an automated platform for CA measurement on curved hydrogel surfaces, with specific application to in vitro contact lens wettability analysis throughout air exposure. Customized 3D printed hardware, such as lens mounts, camera holders and drying apparatuses, was designed to facilitate an automated repeated sessile drop workflow within a liquid handler. Collected images were directly fed to a custom open-source image processing script for CA determination on a curved surface that combines the elliptical fit and tangent methods to allow for variations in droplet shape. The CA of senofilcon A contact lenses measured using the RAISE-Vision platform increased from $62.6 \pm 5.5^\circ$ to $83.4 \pm 2.1^\circ$ over 10 sequential measurements in air and was able to replicate results obtained using an analogous manual protocol ($p = 0.470$). The custom image processing script was also separately demonstrated to generate comparable results to a commercially available CA determination software ($p = 0.343$). Aside from minimizing operator variability for CA measurement, RAISE-Vision provides a platform for standardized in vitro contact lens wettability analysis and understanding of surface wetting behaviour during air exposure.

AI.tldr: 提出RAISE-Vision自动化平台，用3D打印夹具+液体处理机器人+定制开源图像处理脚本（椭圆拟合与切线法结合）实现曲面水凝胶（隐形眼镜）接触角的标准化重复测量。
AI.motivation: 现有坐滴法在体外测量隐形眼镜接触角时，因实验室间和操作者间协议差异导致重复性、可靠性和可比性差。
AI.method: 定制3D打印硬件（镜片支架、相机支架、干燥装置）嵌入液体处理工作站，自动化重复坐滴流程；图像直接输入开源脚本，结合椭圆拟合与切线法在曲面上计算接触角，以适应液滴形状变化。
AI.result: senofilcon A镜片在空气中连续10次测量接触角由62.6±5.5°升至83.4±2.1°；与人工协议结果一致（p=0.470），图像处理脚本与商用软件结果相当（p=0.343）。
AI.conclusion: RAISE-Vision降低操作者变异，为隐形眼镜体外润湿性分析提供标准化平台，并揭示空气暴露过程中的表面润湿行为演变。

title: DS-BiCA-Net: Pair-Preserving Cross-Temporal Modeling for Remote Sensing Change Captioning
summary: Remote sensing image change captioning (RSICC) describes in natural language the semantic changes between two images of the same scene captured at different times. Previous methods commonly merge the pair during repeated processing or combine intra-image and cross-image relations in one operation, weakening source identity and leaving the two temporal directions implicit. Without separate modules for intra-image and cross-temporal processing and a separate path for each direction, the contribution of each part cannot be measured on its own, so it remains unclear which part matters most, and the design of later models has no such evidence to build on. To address these issues, we propose DS-BiCA-Net, which assigns the two kinds of processing to separate modules and keeps the two images as separate streams throughout the encoder. A windowed state-space module models context within each image, and a bidirectional cross-attention module compares the two images along two directed paths that share their projections. The two modules use the same pre-normalisation residual architecture and differ only in their mixers, and the two streams are fused only in the aggregation head, so each module and each direction can be removed and its contribution measured on its own. Controlled experiments on LEVIR-CC and Dubai-CC examine operator interaction, temporal direction and module order, showing that intra-image refinement carries no benefit alone and becomes beneficial only when followed by bidirectional cross-attention, an order that outperforms the reverse at matched parameter count and FLOPs. The bidirectional module also outperforms either temporal direction alone. Our method reaches an S_m^* of 82.65 on LEVIR-CC, the highest among the published results compared, and 66.72 on Dubai-CC without geometric augmentation, the second-highest among the published results compared.

AI.tldr: DS-BiCA-Net 将图像内上下文建模与跨时相比较解耦为独立模块，并保持双流编码直至融合头，从而可单独消融每个模块与每个时间方向；在 LEVIR-CC 上取得 S_m^*=82.65。
AI.motivation: 现有遥感图像变化描述方法在重复处理中直接融合图像对，或将图内与跨图关系混在一次操作中，削弱了源图像身份信息，也使两个时间方向隐含不可分；缺少独立模块与独立方向路径导致各部件贡献无法单独度量，后续设计缺乏经验依据。
AI.method: 提出双流双向交叉注意力网络：编码器全程保持两幅图像为独立流；用窗口化状态空间模块（windowed state-space）建模单图内上下文；用双向交叉注意力模块沿两条有向路径比较两图并共享投影参数；两模块采用相同预归一化残差架构，仅 mixer 不同；仅在聚合头处融合双流。
AI.result: 在 LEVIR-CC 与 Dubai-CC 上做了受控实验，考察算子交互、时间方向与模块顺序：图内精炼单独无增益，仅在其后接双向交叉注意力时才有收益，且该顺序在参数量与 FLOPs 匹配下优于反向顺序；双向模块优于任一单向时间路径。LEVIR-CC S_m^*=82.65（对比已发表结果最高），Dubai-CC 无几何增强下 66.72（次高）。
AI.conclusion: 模块与方向的显式解耦使归因可测，并给出"先图内精炼、后双向跨时相比较"这一有实证支撑的架构顺序；但任务属遥感变化描述，非具身/三维核心方向。

title: Neural Disjunctive Normal Forms for Learning Exact Rank Filters
summary: Gradient-based learning of morphological operators is hindered by locally sparse derivatives with respect to the structuring elements. We develop a method for learning rank filters that retains exact operator evaluation while distributing the derivatives across the window. Using threshold decomposition, we construct a neural disjunctive normal form representation and establish a sufficient condition for exactness with integer-valued images and structuring elements. We then derive a smooth surrogate from the unique root of a smooth threshold equation. Implicit differentiation gives closed-form derivatives with normalised local weights, whose distribution is controlled by a smoothing parameter. These derivatives are used in a straight-through procedure: the forward pass evaluates the exact rank filter, while the backward pass uses the surrogate. For fixed ranks, the procedure learns real-valued structuring elements of any rank filter, including the median, and extends to compositions, infima, and suprema of rank filters. Experiments on image denoising using MNIST and Fashion-MNIST and retinal vessel segmentation show that, starting from a generic random initialisation, the proposed approach consistently improves performance over training with exact subgradients in every setting. In image denoising, our best network also outperforms smooth morphological networks in all settings. On vessel segmentation, the learned erosions recover structuring elements that fit the vessels, as theoretically expected, whereas most of those trained with exact subgradients remain close to their initialisation.

AI.tldr: 提出基于阈值分解与光滑代理的秩滤波器可微学习方法，实现精确前向与分布式梯度反向的直通估计。
AI.motivation: 基于梯度的形态学算子学习因结构元素的结构元素局部导数稀疏而受阻，需要一种保持算子精确求值同时把梯度分散到整个窗口的方法。
AI.method: 用阈值分解构造神经析取范式表示，给出整数图像与结构元素下精确性充分条件；由光滑阈值方程的唯一根导出光滑代理；隐式微分给出带归一化局部权重的闭式导数，权重分布由平滑参数控制；反传用代理、前传用精确秩滤波器构成直通（straight-through）流程；可学习任意秩（含中值）的实值结构元素，并扩展到组合、下确界与上确界。
AI.result: MNIST/Fashion-MNIST去噪与视网膜血管分割实验表明，从随机初始化开始，该方法在所有设置下均稳定优于精确次梯度训练；去噪中最佳网络在所有设置下超过光滑形态网络；血管分割中学到的腐蚀结构元素贴合血管形态，而多数次梯度训练结果仍接近初始化。
AI.conclusion: 直通式精确前向+光滑代理反向的秩滤波器学习框架有效缓解形态学算子梯度稀疏问题，并可推广至更一般的秩滤波组合。

title: Benchmarking Data-Free Continual Model Merging for Whole-Slide Image Survival Analysis
summary: Continual survival analysis on whole-slide images (WSIs) requires models to integrate knowledge from sequentially arriving cancer cohorts while preserving previously learned information. Model merging offers a data-free alternative by combining independently fine-tuned task experts without retaining previous training data. However, the relative behavior of different merging strategies for WSI-based survival prediction remains insufficiently understood. In this work, we establish an end-to-end benchmark for data-free continual model merging, covering task-specific fine-tuning, sequential merging, and inference under both TASK-IL and CLASS-IL settings. We systematically evaluate six representative merging strategies across four TCGA cancer cohorts and three task orders using C-index, IPCW C-index, Forgetting, and Backward Transfer under a controlled protocol. Results show that no merging strategy consistently dominates across all evaluation criteria, while censoring-aware evaluation can substantially alter the relative ranking of the compared methods. This benchmark provides a unified foundation for developing and evaluating more effective continual model merging methods for WSI-based survival analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了面向全切片图像(WSI)生存分析的无数据持续模型合并端到端基准，系统比较6种合并策略在4个TCGA队列、3种任务顺序、TASK-IL与CLASS-IL两种设定下的表现。
AI.motivation: 持续生存分析需在保留旧知识的同时整合新到癌症队列，模型合并可免存储旧数据，但不同合并策略在WSI生存预测中的相对表现尚不清楚。
AI.method: 构建统一协议流水线：任务特定微调 → 顺序合并 → 推理；在TASK-IL与CLASS-IL设定下评估6种代表性合并策略，覆盖4个TCGA队列与3种任务顺序，采用C-index、IPCW C-index、Forgetting与Backward Transfer四项指标。
AI.result: 没有任何单一合并策略在所有指标上稳定占优；引入删失感知的评估(IPCW C-index)会显著改变方法间的相对排名。
AI.conclusion: 该基准为WSI生存分析中持续模型合并方法的开发与评估提供统一基础，并提示评估指标选择对结论的关键影响。

title: Do VLAs Know They Will Fail? Interpretable Success and Failure Patterns in Physical AI Systems
comment: 12 pages (4 main pages + 8 pages appendix), 4 figures. Accepted at the Science of Physical AI Safety Workshop at the 2026 Conference on Robotic Learning (CoRL 2026, non-archival)
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as powerful general-purpose robot policies, but their successes and failures remain difficult to diagnose and understand. In this work, we show that sparse autoencoder (SAE) representations of OpenVLA activations contain outcome-predictive information and can be used to predict task failure before the robot reaches an unrecoverable state. Moreover, to provide insights into what common behaviors may contribute to these outcomes, we identify individual SAE features whose strong activations are associated with specific stages of success or failure, and uncover recurring behavioral patterns by localizing temporal intervals where these features exhibit significant activation changes. We further develop a VLM-based interpretation pipeline to generate behavioral descriptions of these patterns and validate their correspondence to feature activations on held-out intervals.

AI.tldr: 用稀疏自编码器（SAE）解析 OpenVLA 激活，提取具有结果预测性的特征，可在机器人进入不可恢复状态前预测任务失败，并定位与行为模式相关的时序区间、用 VLM 生成行为描述。
AI.motivation: VLA 模型已成为通用机器人策略，但其成功/失败原因难以诊断与理解，缺乏可解释、可预测失败的表征工具。
AI.method: 对 OpenVLA 内部激活训练稀疏自编码器获得稀疏特征；用这些特征做任务结果（成功/失败）预测；筛选在成功/失败特定阶段强激活的单特征，通过定位特征激活显著变化的时序区间识别重复行为模式；再用基于 VLM 的解释流程生成这些模式的行为描述，并在留出区间上验证描述与特征激活的对应关系。
AI.result: SAE 表征包含结果预测信息，可在不可恢复状态前预测失败；识别出与成功/失败各阶段相关的个体特征，发现重复行为模式，VLM 生成的行为描述在留出区间上与特征激活具有对应关系。
AI.conclusion: SAE + VLM 解释流程为 VLA 策略提供了可解释的失败预测与行为诊断手段，可作为机器人策略机理解析与在线监控的分析工具。

title: Angular Supervision for Visual Object Grounding in Autoregressive Vision-Language Models
summary: Autoregressive vision-language models (VLMs) struggle to ground generated text in the correct image regions, and existing explainability methods, such as attention maps and Logit Lens, often produce poor spatial explanations due to weak text-to-vision attention and sink tokens. We propose \textbf{Angular Relevance} ($R_L$), a simple visualization measure based on cosine similarity between visual token embeddings and unembedding-matrix rows. Because $R_L$ is invariant to token norm, it produces substantially sharper and more faithful heatmaps than attention maps or Logit Lens on out-of-the-box models. Without any training, $R_L$ yields competitive referring-expression segmentation (RES), outperforming prior diagnostic maps and CLIP-based training-free methods. To preserve localized object information during cross-modal mixing, we introduce \textbf{Angular Object-Aware Loss (AOL)}, an auxiliary loss that directly supervises visual token embeddings to align angularly with the vocabulary directions of their corresponding object concepts. Finetuning with AOL alongside the standard next-token prediction objective significantly sharpens object localization in heatmaps, showing that the VLM's own visual tokens can be used directly for grounding and improving RES, without training any segmentation heads and without degrading general VQA performance. We further demonstrate that the learned grounding also transfers to category-level segmentation of object categories not seen during training.

AI.tldr: 提出 Angular Relevance (RL)，基于视觉 token 嵌入与 unembedding 矩阵行向量的余弦相似度做可解释性可视化，无需训练即可获得比 attention map / Logit Lens 更锐利、更忠实的热力图，并在无训练条件下取得有竞争力的指代表达分割结果；同时提出 Angular Object-Aware Loss (AOL) 辅助损失，直接监督视觉 token 与对应物体概念词向量方向对齐，微调后显著增强热力图定位能力与 RES 性能且不损害通用 VQA。
AI.motivation: 自回归 VLM 生成文本难以在正确图像区域落地（grounding 弱），现有可解释性方法（attention map、Logit Lens）受 text-to-vision attention 弱化与 sink token 干扰，空间解释质量差；作者认为根因是词嵌入范数与方向耦合，需要一种对范数不变、只反映语义方向对齐的度量。
AI.method: 1) RL 度量：对每个视觉 token 嵌入与 unembedding 矩阵各行取余弦相似度（角度度量，范数不变），生成热力图；2) AOL：辅助损失，显式约束视觉 token 嵌入与其对应物体概念词汇方向的角度对齐，与标准 next-token prediction 联合微调；3) 不引入分割头，直接用模型自身视觉 token 完成 grounding。
AI.result: RL 在现成模型上热力图显著更锐利、更忠实；无需训练即在 RES 上优于既有诊断类映射与 CLIP 类无训练方法；加入 AOL 微调后物体定位显著增强、RES 进一步提升，且通用 VQA 性能不下降；学到的 grounding 能迁移到训练中未见的类别级分割。
AI.conclusion: 范数不变的角相似度是 VLM 视觉 grounding 的简洁有效代理；通过 AOL 让视觉 token 在方向上对齐物体概念，可在无需专用分割头的情况下把 VLM 自身视觉 token 变成可用的 grounding 表征，并具备未见类别泛化能力。

title: ACWM-RM: A Reference-Free Reward Model from Complementary Mismatch Preferences
summary: Reinforcement learning has gained attention for improving action-conditioned world models (ACWMs), as it enables reward-driven optimization of visual quality (VQ) and action-following fidelity (AF) beyond flow-matching optimization. Realizing this potential requires reward signals that reliably rank videos by both VQ and AF. However, existing rewards capture only one dimension: metric-based rewards assess VQ but require ground-truth videos and do not directly assess AF, while inverse dynamics model (IDM) rewards assess AF without references but do not guarantee VQ. Moreover, IDMs, typically trained on real videos, may provide unreliable rewards for generated videos containing visual artifacts and physical inconsistencies. In this work, we introduce the Action and Video Mismatch Benchmark (AVM-Eval), comprising 67.2k pairs that evaluate how reliably IDMs assess AF on real and generated videos. We then propose ACWM-RM, a reward model that jointly assesses VQ and AF without ground-truth videos during reward computation. To train it, we first construct the Action and Video Mismatch Preference Dataset (AVM-Pref) with 506.3k pairs providing complementary supervision: action-mismatch pairs supervise AF, while video-mismatch pairs supervise VQ and expose the model to generated videos. We then pretrain an action-conditioned predictor on real videos to learn forward dynamics before jointly training it with a patch-weighted score head on AVM-Pref to transfer these dynamics to AF assessment on generated videos. Evaluation on AVM-Eval reveals the limited reliability of IDMs on generated videos, while downstream RL experiments show that ACWM-RM outperforms reward baselines in both criteria.

AI.tldr: 提出AVM-Eval基准（67.2k对）揭示IDM在生成视频上评估动作跟随（AF）不可靠，并构建AVM-Pref偏好数据集（506.3k对）训练ACWM-RM奖励模型，无需真值视频即可同时评估视觉质量与动作跟随性，下游RL优于基线。
AI.motivation: 用RL优化动作条件世界模型（ACWM）需要能同时可靠排序VQ与AF的奖励信号；现有奖励只能覆盖单一维度：度量类奖励需真值视频且不直接评估AF，IDM奖励无需参考但不保证VQ，且IDM多在真实视频上训练，对含视觉伪影与物理不一致的生成视频奖励不可靠。
AI.method: 1) AVM-Eval：67.2k对，评测IDM在真实/生成视频上评估AF的可靠性；2) AVM-Pref：506.3k对，动作不匹配对监督AF、视频不匹配对监督VQ并引入生成视频；3) 先在真实视频上预训练动作条件预测器学习前向动力学，再与patch加权打分头在AVM-Pref上联合训练，将动力学迁移到生成视频的AF评估。
AI.result: AVM-Eval显示IDM在生成视频上可靠性有限；下游RL实验中，ACWM-RM在VQ与AF两项指标上均优于奖励基线。
AI.conclusion: 无参考、联合评估VQ与AF的奖励模型可有效用于世界模型的奖励驱动后训练，弥补单一维度奖励的不足。

title: RoboCode: Learning Reusable Action Primitives for Robot Manipulation
summary: Recent robot manipulation policies commonly predict continuous action chunks directly from observations, without explicitly modeling reusable structure in the action space. However, manipulation demonstrations often contain recurring short-horizon motion patterns that are shared across tasks. We introduce \textsc{RoboCode}, which learns these patterns through a shared soft-gated primitive action interface. Rather than assigning each action chunk to a single discrete code, \textsc{RoboCode} represents it as a soft composition of multiple learned primitives, providing a flexible intermediate representation of short-horizon actions. The primitive interface is learned from action chunks pooled across multiple tasks and then frozen while task-specific state encoders are trained to map current state inputs into the shared latent space. Experiments on five ManiSkill manipulation tasks address three questions. First, the learned primitive interface reconstructs action chunks with an average reconstruction MSE of 0.0187. Second, analysis of code activations reveals structured code reuse across tasks. Third, \textsc{RoboCode} achieves the highest or tied closed-loop success rate on all evaluated tasks, with an average success rate of 75.6%, compared with 68.8% for ACT and 41.6% for the larger Diffusion Policy baseline. These results suggest that soft-gated primitive codebooks provide an effective and interpretable intermediate action representation for robot manipulation.

AI.tldr: RoboCode用软门控基元码本把动作块表示为多个学习基元的软组合，作为跨任务共享的短时程动作中间表示，在ManiSkill五个任务上取得最高成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人操作策略直接从观测预测连续动作块，未显式建模动作空间中可复用的结构；而演示数据中往往存在跨任务共享的短时程运动模式。
AI.method: 学习一个共享的软门控基元动作接口：动作块不硬分配给单一离散码，而是表示为多个学习基元的软组合；该基元接口在跨多任务聚合的动作块上学习后冻结，再训练任务特定的状态编码器将当前状态映射到共享潜空间。
AI.result: 基元接口重建动作块的平均MSE为0.0187；码激活分析显示跨任务存在结构化的码复用；闭环成功率在所有评估任务上最高或并列，平均75.6%，对比ACT的68.8%与更大规模Diffusion Policy基线的41.6%。
AI.conclusion: 软门控基元码本可作为有效且可解释的机器人操作中间动作表示。

title: Towards Effective and Transferable Physical Camouflage against Multi-View BEV-based 3D Perception in Autonomous Driving
summary: Modern autonomous driving systems widely adopt multi-view Bird's-Eye-View (BEV) based 3D perception models due to their superior performance. Despite their success, the robustness of these models against adversarial camouflage attacks remains largely unexplored. Existing camouflage attacks primarily target single-view 2D detectors, limiting their effectiveness in multi-view 3D perception settings. To address this gap, we propose BEVCA, a novel adversarial camouflage generation framework tailored for multi-view BEV-based 3D perception. Our framework integrates a BEV-feature-based adversarial loss with a multi-view neural rendering module, enabling effective and transferable camouflage attacks across different models and tasks. Extensive experiments in both digital and physical settings demonstrate that BEVCA outperforms state-of-the-art baselines and exhibits strong robustness under real-world conditions. Our code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出BEVCA：面向多视角BEV 3D感知的对抗性伪装攻击生成框架，结合BEV特征对抗损失与多视角神经渲染模块，在数字与物理实验中优于现有基线并具跨模型/跨任务迁移性。
AI.motivation: 多视角BEV 3D感知在自动驾驶中被广泛采用，但其对对抗伪装攻击的鲁棒性研究几乎空白；现有伪装攻击主要针对单视角2D检测器，无法有效迁移到多视角3D感知场景。
AI.method: BEV特征空间上的对抗损失 + 多视角可微神经渲染模块（用于将2D伪装纹理渲染为多视角一致观测），整体优化伪装纹理参数，实现跨模型、跨任务的可迁移攻击。
AI.result: 数字与物理实验均显示BEVCA优于当前最优基线，并在真实世界条件下保持较强鲁棒性（攻击有效/稳定），代码开源。
AI.conclusion: 该工作首次系统研究了多视角BEV 3D感知的对抗伪装攻击，验证了多视角神经渲染+BEV特征损失是生成可物理实现、可迁移伪装的有效途径，可作为BEV感知鲁棒性评估的红队工具。

title: TileShare: Training-Free Acceleration of Overlapping Tiled ViT Decoding
summary: Fixed-window Vision Transformer (ViT) decoders run at deployment resolution as overlapping tiles: every token in an overlap band is processed by several full decoder instances. In the 2.4B-parameter MiniMax-H3 video decoder, about half of all per-token computation is duplicated. Removing the tiles fails because attention, global tokens and coordinates are bound to them. TileShare keeps each released tile's attention and computes every other operation once per token. The released computation changes at one kind of step only: an overlap token's per-tile results are blended into one shared state with the released weights. Interventions show that this blend costs quality where attention reads the shared states, mainly in the first few layers, which TileShare therefore keeps per tile. Without training, keeping six layers per tile decodes 1.38-1.51x faster than batched and compiled tiling on two GPU types (up to 1.96x with FP8) and is equivalent to the released decoder in PSNR, LPIPS and DISTS on DAVIS videos. On unseen UVG videos with the setting frozen beforehand, it matches PSNR and DISTS and improves LPIPS. TileShare carries over to two further decoders and is again confirmed on unseen data. It is equivalent in PSNR and DISTS on MAGI-1. On the ViTok-v2 image autoencoder at 2K-4K, it matches overlapping tiling in PSNR, improves LPIPS and DISTS and decodes 1.5-1.8x faster. How many layers stay per tile is measured once per model (for decoders, without labels); we report it for 14 decoders and encoders. Optionally, two GPU-hours of self-distillation let MiniMax-H3 share every layer without a loss in PSNR, and a coordinate field trained while the network stays frozen brings fully shared CLIP-based open-vocabulary segmentation to parity with sliding windows on seven benchmarks.

AI.tldr: TileShare is a training-free inference scheme for fixed-window ViT decoders that removes duplicated computation in overlapping tile bands: each tile keeps its own attention (and, in practice, only the first ~6 layers per tile), while all other per-token computations are shared via weight-blended shared states, yielding 1.38-1.51x (up to 1.96x with FP8) speedup at equivalent PSNR/LPIPS/DISTS.
AI.motivation: Fixed-window ViT decoders at deployment resolution run as overlapping tiles, so every token in an overlap band is processed by multiple full decoder instances; in the 2.4B MiniMax-H3 video decoder roughly half of per-token compute is duplicated. Naive tile removal fails because attention, global tokens and coordinates are bound to tile structure.
AI.method: Keep each tile's attention, compute every other operation once per token, and blend an overlap token's per-tile results into one shared state using the released weights. Ablation shows the blend degrades quality where attention reads shared states, mainly in early layers, so the first N layers are kept per tile (N=6, no training). The cross-tile sharing ratio is measured once per model without labels (reported for 14 decoders/encoders). Optional extensions: ~2 GPU-hours self-distillation to share all layers in MiniMax-H3; a coordinate field trained with frozen backbone for fully shared CLIP-based open-vocabulary segmentation.
AI.result: Training-free, 6 layers per tile: 1.38-1.51x faster than batched+compiled tiling on two GPU types (1.96x with FP8); equivalent PSNR/LPIPS/DISTS on DAVIS; on unseen UVG with the setting frozen, matches PSNR/DISTS and improves LPIPS. Transfers to two more decoders (equivalent PSNR/DISTS on MAGI-1, reconfirmed on unseen data) and to ViTok-v2 image autoencoder at 2K-4K (matches PSNR, improves LPIPS/DISTS, 1.5-1.8x faster). Self-distilled full sharing retains PSNR; frozen-backbone coordinate field brings fully shared open-vocab segmentation to parity with sliding windows on seven benchmarks.
AI.conclusion: Tile-level compute redundancy in fixed-window ViT decoders can be largely eliminated by sharing non-attention computation across tiles with weight-based state blending, requiring only a small per-tile attention/system-layer budget; the recipe is training-free, model-agnostic, measurable per model, and complemented by cheap self-distillation or a learned coordinate field for full sharing.

title: Easy-3Dfy: Object-Level Geometric Composition for Single-Image 3D Scene Construction
summary: Single-image 3D scene construction is a fundamental problem in 3D vision. Recent methods such as SAM-3Dfy enable end-to-end reconstruction of 3D assets and their scene layouts, but still struggle with fine-grained scene geometry and asset quality. Meanwhile, specialized 3D object generators provide detailed object geometry, while 3D foundation models offer strong and generalizable spatial understanding. We propose Easy-3Dfy, a compositional workflow that decouples object generation from scene layout estimation, allowing specialized models to fully exploit their respective strengths. An RPF-based aligner then bridges these capabilities by establishing geometric correspondence between object-local meshes and partial scene pointmaps, recovering object layout for scene composition. Without requiring complete scene-level supervision, the proposed workflow consistently outperforms SAM-3Dfy across multiple geometric metrics on Scene-Maker and 3D-FUTURE200.
