Our results demonstrate that explicit geometric composition can effectively combine high-quality object generation with strong spatial understanding, while enabling the workflow to benefit independently from advances in both 3D object generation and foundation models.

AI.tldr: Easy-3Dfy：将单图3D场景构建分解为「专用物体生成」与「场景布局估计」两条独立支路，并用基于 RPF 的对齐器在物体局部网格与部分场景点图之间建立几何对应以恢复物体位姿，无需完整场景级监督，即在多几何指标上超越 SAM-3Dfy。
AI.motivation: 现有端到端单图3D场景重建方法（如 SAM-3Dfy）可联合输出3D资产与场景布局，但细粒度几何与资产质量不足；而专用3D物体生成器擅长细节几何、3D基础模型擅长可泛化的空间理解。作者希望解耦二者以各自发挥优势，并避免对完整场景级监督的依赖。
AI.method: 提出组合式（compositional）工作流：1）用专用3D物体生成模型对单图检测出的物体实例生成局部网格；2）用3D基础模型（点图/pointmap）估计场景空间结构；3）设计基于 RPF（相机坐标系下的刚体变换/位姿估计范式）的对齐器，在物体局部网格与部分场景点图间建立几何对应，估计物体 6-DoF 布局并完成场景合成。整体为免训练/免完整场景监督的模块化流水线。
AI.result: 在 Scene-Maker 与 3D-FUTURE200 两个数据集上，多项几何指标一致优于 SAM-3Dfy；物体资产质量与布局精度同时提升。结果表明显式几何组合可有效整合高质量物体生成与强空间理解，且工作流可分别受益于两条支路模型各自的进步。
AI.conclusion: 显式几何组合（生成 + 对齐）是可扩展的单图3D场景构建路径，具备良好的模块可插拔性与随基础模型升级而自动增益的特性；局限在于依赖点图的深度/尺度可靠性，属于前馈式离线重建，尚无真机或交互场景验证。

title: Representation Learning via Composite Subspace Flow Matching
summary: Distilling semantic meaning from raw image data remains a challenge in machine learning. Current self-supervised paradigms face a trade-off: joint-embedding architectures produce relevant features by aggressively discarding intra-class variance, irreversibly spatial and reconstruction. Conversely, generative models preserve spatial details but struggle to isolate semantics, as their optimization is dominated by pixel variations. To bridge this divide, we propose composite subspace flow matching (CSFM). Rather than corrupting data with unstructured isotropic noise, CSFM formulates representation learning as the variance-minimizing inversion of a deterministic degradation curriculum across spectral, color, and illumination subspaces. By bounding trajectory variance with hard temporal style truncation, a capacity-constrained encoder is driven to ignore transient style artifacts and encode persistent content. Empirical evaluations across CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and STL-10 show that CSFM yields competitive discriminative transferability while preserving generative synthesis across both convolutional and vision transformer architectures. By avoiding the collapse pathologies of non-generative methods, CSFM forms a smooth latent space that outperforms standard optimal transport flows on linear probing and few-shot classification, while enabling coherent synthesis and trajectory interpolation. These results confirm that steering the physical dynamics of generative flows offers a scalable paradigm for learning representations that are simultaneously linearly separable and generatively invertible.

AI.tldr: CSFM：用谱/颜色/光照子空间上的确定性退化课程构造方差最小的反向流匹配，配合硬时间风格截断，使编码器丢弃瞬态风格、保留持久内容，兼顾判别表征与生成可逆性。
AI.motivation: 自监督学习存在两难：联合嵌入方法靠激进丢弃类内方差获得判别特征，但丢失空间与重建能力且不可逆；生成模型保留空间细节却被像素变化主导，难以分离语义。作者希望在同一框架内同时获得线性可分且可生成反演的表示。
AI.method: 提出复合子空间流匹配（CSFM）。不对数据施加无结构各向同性噪声，而是将表征学习表述为在谱、颜色、光照三类子空间上的确定性退化课程，并学习其方差最小化的反向（inversion）过程；通过硬时间风格截断（hard temporal style truncation）限制轨迹方差，迫使容量受限的编码器忽略瞬态风格伪影、编码持久内容。在CNN与ViT上均验证。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100、STL-10上，判别迁移性能有竞争力，同时保留生成合成能力；避免了非生成方法的表征塌缩病理，形成平滑潜空间，在线性探测与少样本分类上优于标准最优传输流；支持一致合成与轨迹插值。
AI.conclusion: 通过引导生成流的物理动力学（结构化退化而非各向同性噪声），可在单一框架内获得既线性可分又生成可逆的表示，为可扩展的表征学习范式提供依据。

title: Incremental-Smoothing-Based ARAIM Protection Levels for Tightly Coupled GNSS/IMU Integration in Urban Canyons
summary: Protection levels (PLs) bound position errors under specified fault hypotheses and risk budgets, but advanced re-ceiver autonomous integrity monitoring (ARAIM) is formulated for snapshot GNSS estimation rather than the correlated poste-rior of tightly coupled GNSS/IMU factor graph optimization (FGO). This paper formulates ARAIM solution separation and PL computation on the FGO posterior. Because current-epoch pseudorange factors enter only the current-state block of the fixed-lag information matrix, the fault-excluded position covari-ance, solution separation, and nominal-bias propagation follow exactly from the linearized current-state marginal, which re-tains correlations with velocity, IMU-bias, and clock states and with historical information. Woodbury updates with selected-output evaluation compute these quantities for fault-free, single-satellite, constellation-wide, and second-order hypotheses with-out repeated full-state inversion or graph re-optimization. Sur-rounding monitoring layers screen measurements, handle post-fit outliers, and determine PL validity and availability. In two road experiments, both nominal sequences achieve 100% hori-zontal and vertical empirical bounding over PL-valid epochs, with a maximum error-to-PL ratio of 0.96. Normalized errors show that the posterior covariance alone does not capture slowly varying ranging biases: a covariance-only bound computed from the same posteriors retains no resolvable margin, and strong temporal correlation limits the empirical evidence to consisten-cy checks rather than validation of the integrity budget. On identical Experiment A posteriors, the proposed method reduces fault-hypothesis evaluation and PL solving time by 65.2% rela-tive to direct full-state inversion with matching integrity deci-sions, and controlled fault injections demonstrate fail-safe PL invalidation while navigation continues.

AI.tldr: 将ARAIM解分离与保护级计算推广到紧耦合GNSS/IMU因子图优化的后验，利用稠密伍德伯里更新实现高效多故障假设评估，道路实验达到100%经验包络并通过注入故障验证失效安全。
AI.motivation: 现有ARAIM面向快照式GNSS估计，无法覆盖紧耦合GNSS/IMU因子图优化中带有相关性的后验分布，因而缺少对这一后验的位置误差保护级（PL）理论支撑。
AI.method: 在当前历元伪距因子仅进入固定滞后信息矩阵当前状态块的条件下，用线性化当前状态边缘协方差（保留与速度、IMU零偏、钟差及历史信息的相关性）精确给出故障剔除后的位置协方差、解分离量与标称偏差传播；采用选中输出求值的伍德伯里更新，免去全状态求逆与图重优化，覆盖无故障、单星、星座级和二阶故障假设；外围监测层负责量测筛选、后拟合粗差处理与PL有效性和可用性判定。
AI.result: 两段道路实验中两段标称序列在PL有效历元上水平与垂直经验包络率均为100%，最大误差与PL之比为0.96；仅用后验协方差的对照界无可用余量，说明缓慢变化的测距偏差未被协方差刻画；实验A上故障假设评估与PL求解时间较全状态直接求逆降低65.2%且完整性决策一致，受控故障注入显示PL失效安全地判为无效而导航持续。
AI.conclusion: 提出首套可落在FGO后验上的ARAIM解分离框架，兼顾严格性与计算可行性，并明确在强时间相关条件下实证结果属于一致性检验而非完整性预算验证。

title: Beyond Pattern Matching in 3D MLLMs: Part-Level Functional Reasoning for Generalizable Recognition
summary: 3D MLLMs recognize objects via pattern matching, which fails when geometrically similar objects require functional reasoning to disambiguate (e.g., dresser vs. wardrobe). Our per-sample Geometric Confusion Score (GCS) exposes this failure: baseline accuracy is 33.7% on ModelNet40's most ambiguous 20% versus 84.0% on its least ambiguous 20%. We identify a function-as-annotation pattern, in which functional language decorates a known identity instead of supporting inference, and hypothesize that reversing this information flow should concentrate improvements on the most ambiguous samples. PFIR (Part-level Functional Inference for Recognition) reverses that flow. Built on PartNeXt part segmentation, its data pipeline produces 507K QA pairs with functional CoTs (geometry $\to$ function $\to$ identity), and its progressive curriculum culminates in dual-objective GRPO: strict functional reasoning and descriptive grounding for Objaverse's diverse distribution. The two RL objectives yield nearly orthogonal task vectors ($\cos = 0.056$), enabling composition via Task Arithmetic. Under a strict dual OOD protocol (Objaverse $\to$ ModelNet40; XYZRGB $\to$ XYZ-only), PFIR raises zero-shot accuracy from 60.5% to 66.7%, with gains concentrated $2.6\times$ more on geometrically ambiguous samples---supporting part-level functional reasoning as an effective route to more generalizable 3D recognition. Code: this https URL .

AI.tldr: 提出几何混淆分数GCS揭示3D MLLMs依赖模式匹配而非功能推理；构建PFIR，基于部件级功能推理的数据管线（507K QA + 功能CoT）与双目标GRPO课程，经Task Arithmetic组合两个近乎正交的RL任务向量，在严格OOD设置下零样本精度60.5%→66.7%，且增益集中于几何相似样本。
AI.motivation: 3D MLLMs通过模式匹配识别物体，在需要功能性推理消歧的几何相似物体（如梳妆台vs衣柜）上失效；作者发现现有数据中"功能作为标注"而非推理依据的捷径模式，并假设反转信息流可使改进集中在最模糊样本上。
AI.method: 1) 提出逐样本Geometric Confusion Score (GCS) 量化几何混淆；2) 基于PartNeXt部件分割的数据管线生成507K QA对，含"几何→功能→身份"功能链式推理；3) 渐进式课程学习，最终用双目标GRPO（严格功能推理 + 描述性接地，适配Objaverse多样分布）；4) 两目标产出近正交任务向量（cos=0.056），用Task Arithmetic组合。
AI.result: 基线在最模糊20%（ModelNet40）上33.7% vs. 最不模糊20%上84.0%；PFIR在严格双OOD协议（Objaverse→ModelNet40；XYZRGB→XYZ-only）下将零样本精度从60.5%提升至66.7%，几何模糊样本上的增益高出2.6倍。
AI.conclusion: 部件级功能推理是通往更泛化3D识别的有效路径；反转"功能作为标注"的信息流，使改善集中于几何歧义样本，验证了假设。代码已开源。

title: LapaFM: A Laparoscopic Foundation Model via Multi-Stage Continual Learning
summary: Artificial intelligence-based analysis of intraoperative laparoscopic videos has the potential to improve surgical decision-making and precision. However, effective surgical assistance requires models that can generalize across diverse intraoperative tasks. Here we present LapaFM, a foundation model for laparoscopic surgery trained on more than 20,000 minutes of surgical videos using a multi-stage continual learning strategy that mitigates catastrophic forgetting and inter-task interference. LapaFM learns multimodal visual representations and supports multiple tasks, including smoke removal, surgical phase recognition, instrument and polyp segmentation, and lesion identification. The model was evaluated on 13 retrospective and two prospective cohorts collected from different imaging devices. LapaFM consistently outperformed task-specific models and existing foundation models across datasets, and also generalized to gastrointestinal endoscopy tasks, including polyp detection and classification. Notably, it recovered over 90% of smoke-obscured frames and achieved clinician-level or superior performance in lymph node metastasis prediction and prospective polyp classification.

AI.tldr: LapaFM是一个腹腔镜手术基础模型，基于超2万分钟手术视频，采用多阶段持续学习策略缓解灾难性遗忘与任务间干扰，学习多模态视觉表示，支持去烟、术式阶段识别、器械/息肉分割与病灶识别等多任务，在13个回顾性+2个前瞻性队列上全面超越任务专用模型与现有基础模型。
AI.motivation: 术中腹腔镜视频的AI分析可提升手术决策与精度，但有效的手术辅助需要能跨多种术中任务泛化的统一模型，而现有任务专用模型缺乏跨任务、跨设备泛化能力。
AI.method: 构建LapaFM基础模型：在>20,000分钟手术视频上预训练，采用多阶段持续学习（continual learning）策略抑制灾难性遗忘与任务间干扰，学习多模态视觉表示；以统一模型支持去烟、手术阶段识别、器械与息肉分割、病灶识别等多下游任务；在13个回顾性队列与2个前瞻性队列（来自不同成像设备）上评测，并与任务专用模型及现有基础模型对比。
AI.result: 在各数据集上稳定优于任务专用模型与现有基础模型；可泛化至胃肠内镜任务（息肉检测与分类）；恢复超90%被烟雾遮挡的帧；在淋巴结转移预测与前瞻性息肉分类上达到或超过临床医生水平。
AI.conclusion: 作者证明持续学习训练的多任务手术基础模型可实现跨任务、跨设备乃至跨术式（内镜）泛化，并具备临床级性能，为术中实时手术辅助奠定基础。

title: Hyperparameter-Free Boundary-Interior t-vMF Dice Loss for Medical Image Segmentation
summary: Class imbalance and errors near anatomical boundaries remain challenges in medical image segmentation, motivating loss functions that account for these difficulties. Adaptive t-vMF Dice Loss adjusts the similarity function during training but requires hyperparameter tuning. We propose Self-Tuned Boundary-Aware t-vMF Dice Loss (STB-tvMF Dice), which adapts the function separately for boundary and interior regions without tuning shape-adaptation parameters. Each region's shape parameter of t-vMF function is determined from its mean prediction-target cosine similarity in the preceding epoch and remains fixed throughout the current epoch. This rule maximizes the slope of the similarity function at the observed mean similarity, providing a principled basis for adaptation without validation-based parameter selection. Experiments on three datasets and architectures demonstrated its effectiveness. On Synapse with U-Net, STB-tvMF Dice achieved a mean DSC of 70.75%, compared with 63.03% for Adaptive t-vMF Dice Loss. Our code will be available soon.

AI.tldr: STB-tvMF Dice: 医学分割损失函数,按边界/内部区域分别用上一轮平均余弦相似度自适应设定 t-vMF 形状参数,免调参,Synapse+U-Net DSC 70.75% vs 63.03%。
AI.motivation: 医学图像分割中类别不平衡与解剖边界附近错误是主要难点;Adaptive t-vMF Dice Loss 能动态调整相似度函数但需调形状自适应超参。
AI.method: 将边界与内部区域分开处理;每个区域的 t-vMF 形状参数由前一轮该区域预测-目标平均余弦相似度决定,并在当前 epoch 内固定;该规则使相似度函数在观测均值处的斜率最大化,提供无需验证集选参的原理性依据。
AI.result: 在 3 个数据集与多种架构上验证有效;Synapse/U-Net 上平均 DSC 70.75%,对比 Adaptive t-vMF 的 63.03%。
AI.conclusion: 提出确定性、免调参的区域自适应损失,提升边界与不平衡条件下的医学分割性能;与 Physical AI/机器人等核心方向无关。

title: RVG-Bench: A Benchmark for Reasoning-Driven Audio-Visual Temporal Grounding
comment: 42 pages, including appendices. Project page: this https URL
summary: Existing temporal video grounding (TVG) benchmarks primarily focus on localizing target video segments according to descriptive text queries of the visual content. However, real-world queries are more diverse and often require the model to first understand the user's intent before localization, such as finding visual evidence, identifying the cause of an event, or recalling a remembered moment, yet such queries remain largely overlooked. To mitigate this gap, we introduce RVG-Bench, a benchmark for reasoning-driven audio-visual temporal grounding, where every query is constructed such that the target segment can only be identified through reasoning about the query's underlying intent. We carefully construct the benchmark and rigorously verify its data quality to ensure models truly comprehend the audio-visual content. RVG-Bench comprises 1,255 videos and 1,890 query-interval pairs across eight reasoning types. We evaluate 22 models and find that the strongest, Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash, achieves only 49.6 mIoU. Through a series of controlled analyses, including oracle-grounding probes and test-time scaling experiments, we systematically examine where and why current models struggle, providing insights for future model development.

AI.tldr: 提出 RVG-Bench，一个面向"推理驱动"音视频时序定位（TVG）的基准：查询不再直接描述视觉内容，而必须通过推理查询背后的意图（如寻找证据、判断事件原因、回忆某时刻）才能定位目标片段。含 1,255 视频、1,890 查询-区间对、8 类推理任务，评测 22 个模型，最强模型仅 49.6 mIoU。
AI.motivation: 现有 TVG 基准的查询均为对视觉内容的描述性文本，模型只需做跨模态匹配；而真实用户查询更强调意图推理（找证据、查原因、回忆片段），这类能力在现有基准中基本缺位，导致对模型真实推理能力的高估。
AI.method: 构建 RVG-Bench：精心设计查询形式，使目标片段只能通过对查询潜在意图的推理来识别；覆盖 8 种推理类型，共 1,255 个视频与 1,890 个查询-区间对，并进行严格的数据质量校验（人工/自动验证）以确保必须真正理解音视频内容；对 22 个（多模态）模型进行统一评测，并辅以 oracle-grounding 探针与 test-time scaling 等受控实验，分析失败位置与原因。
AI.result: 最强模型 Qwen3.8-Omni-Flash 仅达 49.6 mIoU，与描述式查询场景下的高分数形成显著落差；受控实验显示性能瓶颈主要来自意图推理与音视频证据整合环节，test-time scaling 有一定但对推理类查询收益有限。
AI.conclusion: 现有音视频时序定位模型在意图驱动的推理式查询上仍严重不足，RVG-Bench 揭示了从"描述匹配"到"意图推理"的能力缺口，并为后续模型设计（更强的意图理解、音视频证据对齐，而非仅靠测试时扩展）提供方向指引。

title: From Tabletop to Walking Bot: Deploying a VLA Model on a Legged Manipulator Robot
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models are typically pretrained on broad, diverse datasets and subsequently fine-tuned on a comparatively small dataset tailored to a specific target robot. Such adaptation recipe is now widely established, achieving its most mature results on fixed-base arms due to their static base dynamics and consistent reference frame. Mounting the same arm on a quadruped extends the workspace to the entire floor, but fundamentally changes the embodiment: rather than controlling the arm in isolation, the policy must jointly coordinate base navigation, body posture, and end-effector motion. In this work, we study the practical demands of this embodiment change across data collection, model adaptation, and inference design to achieve closed-loop loco-manipulation on a Unitree Go2 with an AgileX Piper arm. We report the choices that made this real-robot deployment feasible, namely model variant, action horizon, and demonstration conventions, together with a study tailored to a pick-and-place task, separating data coverage from model capacity. We show that expanding demonstration coverage reduces held-out end-effector error by 30%, and incorporating secondary skills (such as pushing rather than grasping) introduces new behavioral modes without degrading baseline performance. Finally, closed-loop real-world experiments show how dataset composition shapes success and failure, validating the pipeline for more complex loco-manipulation.

AI.tldr: 该工作在Unitree Go2四足+AgileX Piper机械臂平台上研究VLA模型面向移动操作跨具身适配的实践链路，报告数据采集、动作horizon、模型变体与示教约定等工程选择，并分离数据覆盖与模型容量对抓放任务的影响。
AI.motivation: VLA预训练+小规模目标机器人微调范式在固定底座机械臂上成熟，但把臂装到四足上会改变具身本质：需联合协调底盘导航、机身姿态与末端执行器运动，原有的静态基座假设与统一参考系失效。作者希望厘清该具身变化在数据采集、模型适配与推理设计上的实际需求。
AI.method: 在Go2+Piper真机上搭建闭环loco-manipulation流水线；系统比较模型变体、动作执行horizon与示教约定等部署选择；针对pick-and-place任务设计对照研究，将示教数据覆盖度与模型容量分离评估；并引入次级技能（如用推动替代抓取）观察新增行为模式。
AI.result: 扩展示教覆盖使held-out末端执行器误差降低30%；加入次级技能（pushing）可引入新行为模式且基线性能不退化；闭环真机实验显示数据集构成显著影响成功/失败模式。
AI.conclusion: 移动操作的关键瓶颈更多在数据覆盖与示教约定而非单纯模型容量，所给工程配方验证了四足移动操作VLA部署管线的可行性，可支撑更复杂loco-manipulation任务；但方法层面偏工程实践，缺少新算法与规模化定量对比。

title: RootDown: Deploying and Benchmarking Models for Beet-Root Detection on Edge Devices
comment: Accepted at MLCSA Workshop at Asian Conference on Computer Vision (ACCV 2026). Benchmark, code and models available at this https URL
summary: Quality inspection of sugar beets after harvest and storage is critical to preserve sugar content and ensure optimal processing efficiency. The transfer of harvested beets to field clamps or trucks provides an opportunity to visually inspect individual beets automatically on loader conveyors. However, this is a challenging task as the large number of beets causes partial overlap and occlusion, complicating both annotation and detection. In this work, we propose an end-to-end image-based pipeline for detecting partially occluded sugar beets in loading scenarios as a first step toward automated quality inspection. We introduce a dedicated benchmark and present an automatic annotation strategy that leverages the SAM 3 foundation model to generate bounding boxes. We compare models trained on manually annotated and automatically generated labels. Additionally, we investigate deployment considerations by benchmarking multiple inference configurations, including execution on an edge device, under realistic operational constraints regarding precision, inference time and power consumption. Our results show that, despite substantial occlusion and inherent annotation ambiguity, foundation-model-based labels can substitute for a substantial share of manual annotation, trading labeling effort for data volume at a modest accuracy cost. Furthermore, we demonstrate that a Raspberry Pi 5 equipped with a Hailo accelerator enables high-performance, low-power inference, making it a practical solution for mobile outdoor deployment.

AI.tldr: 提出端到端图像流水线检测装卸场景中被部分遮挡的甜菜，构建专用基准，用SAM 3基础模型自动生成边界框标注，并对比人工标注与自动标注训练的检测模型，同时在Raspberry Pi 5 + Hailo加速器上评测精度-时延-功耗部署权衡。
AI.motivation: 收获及储藏后甜菜的品质检测对保糖与加工效率至关重要；在装载输送带上自动视觉检测单颗甜菜可替代人工，但大量甜菜相互重叠遮挡，导致标注与检测均很困难。
AI.method: 1) 构建甜菜装载遮挡检测基准数据集；2) 提出基于SAM 3基础模型的自动标注策略生成边界框，替代部分人工标注；3) 在人工标注与自动标注数据上训练检测模型并对比；4) 基准测试多种推理配置（含边缘设备），评估精度、推理时间与功耗。
AI.result: 尽管存在显著遮挡和固有标注歧义，基础模型生成的标签可替代相当比例的人工标注，以适度精度损失换取数据量扩展；Raspberry Pi 5 + Hailo加速器实现高性能低功耗推理，适合移动户外部署。
AI.conclusion: 基础模型辅助自动标注是可行的数据扩展手段，边缘AI方案为田间输送带上的甜菜自动化质检提供了实用路径；后续可扩展到细粒度品质（如损伤、病害）分级。

title: Delay Randomization Widens the Delay Margin of Learned Humanoid Motion Trackers
summary: Learned humanoid controllers are usually trained in one simulator and then checked in a second one before they go near hardware. We ask what that check says about command delay. We train motion-tracking policies for a 24-joint humanoid on five motions taken from monocular video and test them in an independent CPU MuJoCo harness, which we first verify against the training model. Every policy completes its motion in at least 26 of 30 episodes under the training randomization. With 40 ms of constant command delay, however, survival drops to 15% on average (0% - 45%), and the delay margin is only 20 - 30 ms. Randomizing the delay during training (0 - 50 ms) lifts survival at 40 ms to 95% on average (75% - 100%) and moves the margin to 50 - 70 ms. A control arm trained for the same number of extra iterations without delay does not improve, so the gain comes from the randomization itself. This holds for all five motions with three training seeds each, and a policy trained in PhysX behaves the same way. The price is slightly looser tracking (0.02 - 0.06 rad on four motions) and, for the most dynamic motion, less robustness to other perturbations. We also show that the first sim-to-sim gap we saw came from the harness, a missing floor and a wrong timestep, and not from the physics engines. The 0 - 20 ms delay ranges common in locomotion training lie inside the margin an unrandomized tracker already has. The benefit comes from randomizing beyond it, so the range should be set from the robot's measured latency, and delay margin belongs next to other sim-to-sim metrics.

AI.tldr: 人形机器人运动跟踪策略在独立CPU MuJoCo中检验时，40ms恒定指令延迟使存活率从≥87%骤降至均值15%，训练时随机化0–50ms延迟可将40ms存活率提升至95%均值，延迟裕度从20–30ms扩大到50–70ms。
AI.motivation: 现有仿真到仿真（sim-to-sim）检验只报告"是否通过"，未明确其对执行器/指令延迟这一硬件必然存在的因素的诊断能力。作者希望回答：独立harness检验究竟能否暴露延迟脆弱性，以及延迟随机化范围的设置依据应是什么。
AI.method: 对24自由度人形机器人，从单目视频提取的5条动作上训练运动跟踪策略；先在CPU MuJoCo独立harness中做训练模型对齐验证（排查先前gap来自缺失地面与错误时间步而非物理引擎差异）；再施加恒定40ms指令延迟及0–50ms训练期延迟随机化，设置无延迟额外迭代的对照臂，5动作×3种子重复；并对比PhysX训练的策略。
AI.result: 训练随机化下各策略30回合中至少26回合完成动作；40ms恒定延迟使平均存活率降至15%（0%–45%），延迟裕度仅20–30ms；训练期延迟随机化（0–50ms）使40ms延迟下存活率升至平均95%（75%–100%），裕度提升至50–70ms；对照臂无改善，证实收益来自随机化本身；代价为跟踪精度略降（4条动作上0.02–0.06 rad），最具动态性动作对其它扰动鲁棒性下降。
AI.conclusion: 常规的0–20ms延迟区间落在未随机化策略固有裕度之内，因此无诊断价值；延迟随机化范围应依据机器人实测延迟设定并外扩，延迟裕度应作为与sim-to-sim其它指标并列的标准报告项；独立harness的第一类gap可能来自自身实现缺陷而非引擎差异。

title: Polyp-VSSD: A Pre-trained Transformer with Local-Global Joint VSSD Decoding for Polyp Segmentation
summary: Early detection of colorectal polyps is essential for preventing colorectal cancer, making accurate polyp segmentation a key component in computer-aided diagnosis systems. However, existing endoscopic segmentation methods often exhibit limited representational capacity and insufficient integration of global and local contextual information. To address these limitations, we propose Polyp-VSSD, a novel local-global joint decoding framework built upon a pre-trained Transformer backbone for high-precision polyp segmentation. Polyp-VSSD leverages the strong feature expressiveness of large-scale visual pre-training and unifies global semantic modeling with local fine-grained reconstruction to enhance segmentation fidelity. Extensive experiments on multiple public endoscopic datasets demonstrate that our approach significantly outperforms state-of-the-art methods in both Dice and IoU. On the EndoScene dataset, Polyp-VSSD achieves mIoU and mDice scores of 0.903 and 0.946, respectively, highlighting its robustness and strong generalization capability. This work presents an effective and scalable solution for intelligent endoscopic image analysis.

AI.tldr: 提出 Polyp-VSSD，一个基于预训练 Transformer 骨干的局部-全局联合解码框架，用于结直肠息肉分割，在多个公开内镜数据集上 Dice/IoU 超越 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有内镜息肉分割方法表示能力有限，全局与局部上下文信息融合不足，影响计算机辅助诊断的早期筛查准确性。
AI.method: 以大规模视觉预训练 Transformer 为骨干，构建局部-全局联合解码（local-global joint decoding）框架：利用预训练特征的强表达能力，将全局语义建模与局部细粒度重建相统一以提升分割保真度。
AI.result: 在多个公开内镜数据集上 Dice 与 IoU 显著优于 SOTA；EndoScene 上 mIoU 0.903、mDice 0.946，体现鲁棒性与泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为智能内镜图像分析提供了一个有效且可扩展的解决方案，但属于医学图像分割领域，与具身智能/3D 重建等核心方向关联较弱。

title: ReLEAP: Upcycling Vision Datasets through Cross-Task Unification and Semi-Supervised Annotation
comment: Accepted at Asian Conference on Computer Vision (ACCV) 2026. Code and models available at this https URL
summary: Developing robust vision models requires large amounts of annotated data, especially for tasks involving fine-grained class distinctions under variable environmental conditions. Even in domains with numerous existing datasets, differences in annotation formats, label definitions and targeted learning tasks hinder data reuse and integration. To address this challenge, we introduce ReLEAP, a scalable Python framework for unifying heterogeneous image datasets through data-source abstraction, systematic reuse of annotations across learning tasks, and mapping of labels to a shared hierarchical taxonomy. We demonstrate its applicability in precision agriculture by integrating fifteen diverse datasets covering a broad range of plant species and annotation types. Beyond unification, ReLEAP enables systematic recycling of existing data and provides a robust foundation for learning-based annotation upcycling. Leveraging this foundation, we conduct extensive cross-dataset and fine-tuning experiments to investigate how domain-specific models trained on unified data and foundation models can be used to automatically generate higher-level annotations under unsupervised, weakly supervised and semi-supervised settings, and how dataset characteristics influence their effectiveness. Our results show that unified data access and annotation upcycling substantially expand the pool of reusable training data and annotations while improving data transparency, enabling more sustainable and resource-efficient use of existing datasets. We release the framework and trained models for academic use to support accessible and collaborative research, particularly in data-scarce and heterogeneous domains.

AI.tldr: ReLEAP：统一异构图像数据集的Python框架，通过数据源抽象、跨任务标注复用与层级分类标签映射，在精准农业15个数据集上实现数据与标注的"升级再利用"（annotation upcycling）。
AI.motivation: 细粒度视觉任务需大量标注数据，但现有数据集在标注格式、标签定义与目标任务上互不兼容，导致数据难以复用与整合，尤其在数据稀缺、异构的领域。
AI.method: 构建可扩展Python框架：数据源抽象统一访问接口；将各数据集标签映射到共享层级分类体系；系统性复用标注支撑多学习任务；并以此为基础进行标注"升级循环"——用域内模型与基础模型在无监督、弱监督、半监督设置下自动生成更高层级标注，开展跨数据集与微调实验分析数据特性对效果的影响。
AI.result: 在精准农业中整合15个覆盖多植物物种与标注类型的数据集；实验表明统一数据访问与标注升级显著扩充可复用训练数据与标注池，提升数据透明度，并量化了数据集特性对自动标注生成效果的影响。
AI.conclusion: 统一数据访问与标注升级可提升数据可持续性与资源效率；框架与模型学术开放，支持协作研究。

title: Complementing DINO Features with Image Structure for Part Discovery
summary: Self-supervised Vision Transformers (ViTs) like DINO encode rich semantics, enabling training-free segmentation of objects from the background and discovery of their parts via feature clustering. This paper focuses on part discovery: partitioning a foreground object into semantic parts. Existing approaches produce imprecise part boundaries. We trace this to the rigid ViT patch grid used in training DINO, where patches straddling boundaries contain pixels from multiple parts. While DINO's invariance-based training could absorb this pixel-level mixing into clean features, experiments with over 26K foreground patches show it does not: boundary-overlapping patches produce features with higher entropy and lower assignment confidence, blurring predicted part boundaries. Rather than make the massive effort of retraining DINO over geometrically coherent regions, an easier approach is to take boundaries directly from a boundary detector, which supplies the geometric information DINO's features lack. Motivated by this, we introduce Part-DINO, a training-free framework that combines boundaries from low-level image segmentation with DINO's semantic features. We use the boundaries to partition the image into regions, pool DINO features within each region, and group them to discover parts. Without any training, Part-DINO produces structurally coherent part assignments, outperforming training-free baselines across four standard benchmarks (CUB, CelebA, PartImageNet-OOD, PartImageNet-Seg) and remaining competitive with weakly-supervised and unsupervised methods.

AI.tldr: Part-DINO：将低层图像分割边界与 DINO 语义特征结合，免训练实现前景物体的部件发现与分割。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 DINO 特征聚类的部件发现方法部件边界不精确。作者将原因归结为 DINO 训练时固定的 ViT patch 网格：跨越边界的 patch 混合了多个部件的像素。对 26K+ 前景 patch 的实验表明，DINO 的不变性训练并未吸收这种像素级混合，边界重叠 patch 的特征熵更高、赋值置信度更低，导致边界模糊。相比重训练 DINO 的巨大代价，直接从边界检测器获取几何信息更经济。
AI.method: 免训练框架 Part-DINO：(1) 用低层图像分割（边界检测器）得到边界；(2) 用边界将图像划分成区域；(3) 在每个区域内池化 DINO 特征；(4) 对区域特征聚类分组以发现部件。全程无任何训练。
AI.result: 在 CUB、CelebA、PartImageNet-OOD、PartImageNet-Seg 四个基准上，Part-DINO 生成结构一致的部件赋值，优于所有免训练基线，并与弱监督和无监督方法保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: DINO 特征的部件边界模糊源于 patch 网格的像素混合而非训练不变性不足；用低层边界补足几何信息、在区域内池化语义特征是有效的免训练方案。属于通用视觉部件分割工作，与具身/3D/机器人核心方向关联有限。

title: OlmoEarth v1.3: Embeddings
summary: We make some OlmoEarth embeddings. To do this, we train a new model: OlmoEarth v1.3. OlmoEarth v1.3 is designed to condense multimodal, multitemporal remote sensing data into a single digestible 64 or 128-dimensional vector. OlmoEarth v1.3 produces state-of-the-art embeddings. In addition, OlmoEarth v1.3 is a strong encoder backbone -- competitive with OlmoEarth v1 and v1.2 -- while requiring 18% and 53% of the GPU hours to train, respectively. We use OlmoEarth v1.3 to compute global, annualized 10m embeddings, which we release under the OlmoEarth artifact license.

AI.tldr: OlmoEarth v1.3 是一个遥感多模态、多时序嵌入模型，将遥感数据压缩为64或128维向量，并训练效率优于前代（18%/53% GPU小时），同时发布了全球10m年度嵌入数据集。
AI.motivation: 作者希望获得高质量、紧凑的遥感数据表示（OlmoEarth embeddings），需要一个新的嵌入模型在精度与训练成本上取得优势。
AI.method: 训练 OlmoEarth v1.3 模型，将多模态、多时序遥感数据编码为单一 64/128 维稠密向量；并以其作为骨干网络与 v1/v1.2 对比。
AI.result: 嵌入性能达到 state-of-the-art；作为编码器骨干与 v1、v1.2 相当，训练 GPU 小时分别为其 18% 与 53%；发布了全球 10m 年度嵌入数据。
AI.conclusion: OlmoEarth v1.3 提供了高效、可复用的遥感嵌入与骨干模型，并开放了全球尺度嵌入产物。

title: GeoLEON-CLIP: Graph-Anchored Multimodal Contrastive Learning for Geographic Region Representation
comment: Accepted at the 9th International Workshop on AI for Geographic Knowledge Discovery (GeoAI 2026), co-located with the 34th ACM SIGSPATIAL International Conference on Advances in Geographic Information Systems (SIGSPATIAL 2026)
summary: Geographic regions are multimodal: satellite imagery captures visual morphology, text conveys human-interpretable semantics, and map structures describe urban context. Existing geospatial contrastive methods typically align image-text or image-location pairs, underusing structured map data. We introduce GeoLEON-CLIP, a graph-anchored contrastive framework that aligns three views of each H3-indexed region: an OpenStreetMap-derived graph embedding, a satellite image crop, and a textual description. Frozen pretrained LEON graph embeddings provide a semantic anchor between vision and language. Frozen graph, image, and text encoders are connected by trainable residual projection heads and trained with a symmetric tri-modal contrastive objective. Experiments show strong graph-image and graph-text alignment; graph-image retrieval achieves the best cross-modal performance in a mixed-resolution pool. To evaluate the anchoring hypothesis, we propose chained cross-modal recall $\mathrm{R}@A@B$, which routes retrieval through the graph modality and compares it with direct retrieval under a matched candidate budget. At $\mathrm{R}@1@1$, image$\rightarrow$graph$\rightarrow$text and text$\rightarrow$graph$\rightarrow$image outperform direct image-text retrieval by 4.8 and 4.4 points, respectively, despite using a single intermediate cell. Downstream probes show task-dependent gains, with the largest improvements on Airbnb and Beijing housing. These results indicate that OpenStreetMap graph structure can anchor multimodal representations combining maps, imagery, and language.

AI.tldr: GeoLEON-CLIP 用冻结的 OSM 图嵌入作为锚点，通过可训练残差投影头与对称三模态对比目标对齐"图-卫星影像-文本"，并提出链式跨模态召回 R@A@B 验证图结构的锚定作用。
AI.motivation: 地理区域本质是多模态的（影像形态、文本语义、地图结构），而现有地理空间对比方法多只对齐图文或图像-坐标，结构化地图数据被浪费；作者希望验证 OSM 图结构能否作为视觉与语言的语义锚点。
AI.method: 对每个 H3 网格区域构造三视图：OpenStreetMap 派生的图嵌入、卫星影像切片、文本描述。采用冻结的 LEON 图编码器、冻结图像编码器与文本编码器，三者经可训练残差投影头连接，用对称三模态对比损失训练；进一步提出链式跨模态召回 R@A@B，将检索经图模态中转，并在候选预算匹配下与直接检索对比。
AI.result: 图-影像、图-文本对齐效果强，图-影像检索在混合分辨率候选池中取得最佳跨模态性能；R@1@1 下 image→graph→text 与 text→graph→image 分别比直接图-文检索高 4.8 与 4.4 个点，仅用一个中间单元；下游探针任务收益随任务而异，Airbnb 与北京房价任务提升最大。
AI.conclusion: OSM 图结构可作为锚点，有效桥接地图、影像与语言的多模态表征；链式跨模态评估为"锚定假设"提供了可量化证据。方法属地理空间表征学习，未涉及机器人或具身感知。

title: MAST-VLA: Skill-Conditioned Adaptation with Trajectory-Affordance Priors for Multi-Skill Robot Manipulation
summary: Generalist robot manipulation requires a single vision-language-action (VLA) policy to execute diverse skills across scenes and instructions. However, current multi-skill VLA policies often leave two aspects of an instruction insufficiently modeled: which primitive skill to execute and where/how to contact and move objects. We propose MAST-VLA (Multi-skill Adaptation with Skill-conditioned experts and Trajectory-affordance priors), a dual-conditioning framework for robot manipulation. MAST-VLA introduces skill-conditioned LoRA Mixture-of-Experts (LoRA-MoE) adapters in the LLM backbone, where skill-query tokens and routing biases guide low-rank expert specialization, and converts a predicted affordance heatmap into a patch-level trajectory-affordance spatial prior for the action head. On the CALVIN ABC$\rightarrow$D long-horizon multi-skill cross-scene generalization setting, MAST-VLA achieves state-of-the-art performance, reaching an Avg. Len of 4.65 over five-subtask evaluation sequences. Real-robot multi-skill sequence experiments further validate its deployability under real perception and control noise.

AI.tldr: MAST-VLA提出双条件VLA框架：在LLM主干中引入技能条件化LoRA-MoE（技能查询token+路由偏置引导专家特化），并将预测的affordance热图转为patch级轨迹-可供性空间先验注入动作头；在CALVIN ABC→D跨场景多技能长程设置达SOTA（Avg. Len 4.65），并有真机多技能序列验证。
AI.motivation: 多技能VLA策略对指令的两方面建模不足：该执行哪个原始技能（skill identity），以及在何处/如何接触与移动物体（空间操作先验）。二者共同决定了跨场景多技能泛化能力。
AI.method: 双条件架构：(1) 技能条件化LoRA-MoE适配器，用技能query token与路由bias驱动低秩专家特化，实现技能级参数解耦；(2) 将预测的affordance热图转化为patch级轨迹-可供性空间先验，作为动作头的条件输入。评估于CALVIN ABC→D长程多技能跨场景设置与真机序列实验。
AI.result: CALVIN ABC→D五子任务序列Avg. Len 4.65，达SOTA；真机多技能序列实验在真实感知与控制噪声下验证可部署性。
AI.conclusion: 显式解耦"技能选择"与"接触/运动空间先验"两条条件通路，可有效提升多技能VLA的长程跨场景泛化；二者互补，适配器级技能特化与affordance空间引导结合具备真机可行性。

title: Organizing Temporal Evidence in Hyperbolic Space for Video Moment Retrieval
summary: Video moment retrieval aims to localize a query-relevant temporal segment in an untrimmed video. Existing methods typically perform video-text alignment in Euclidean space, where representations are embedded in a flat geometry. However, accurate moment localization requires organizing query-relevant evidence across multiple grounding states, where target regions, boundary transitions, and contextual distractors exhibit distinct temporal structures and relevance patterns. Such Euclidean representations lack an explicit geometry to jointly capture these relationships, motivating us to explore structured temporal evidence organization from a geometric perspective. Specifically, we propose Hyperbolic Temporal Evidence Organization (HTEO), a geometric framework that organizes query-aware temporal memory in hyperbolic space. HTEO maps temporal representations into a Poincaré ball and organizes temporal evidence through Radial Evidence Organization (REO) and Orthogonal Angular Refinement (OAR). REO adjusts temporal tokens' radial positions to encode the structural differences among temporal evidence, while OAR enhances query-conditioned semantic alignment through orthogonal rotation. The organized representation is then projected back to the Euclidean tangent space and injected into the decoder through a lightweight residual memory update, enabling hyperbolic geometric cues to be incorporated into standard Transformer decoders while preserving the original cross-modal memory. Furthermore, we introduce radial structure regularization and angular relevance supervision to explicitly guide temporal evidence organization and query-conditioned semantic alignment, respectively. Extensive experiments and analyses across multiple benchmarks demonstrate that HTEO improves temporal localization while providing an interpretable geometric organization of temporal evidence.

AI.tldr: 提出双曲几何框架HTEO，将视频时刻检索中的时序表征映射到Poincaré球，通过径向证据组织与正交角度细化区分目标/边界/干扰证据，并以残差记忆更新注入标准Transformer解码器。
AI.motivation: 现有视频-文本对齐方法在平坦欧氏空间中完成表征对齐，缺乏显式几何来统一刻画目标区域、边界过渡与上下文干扰这三类具有不同时序结构与相关性模式的证据，难以支撑精确时刻定位。
AI.method: 将时序表征映射至Poincaré球；REO调整时序token的径向位置以编码证据结构差异（层级性），OAR通过正交旋转增强查询条件化的语义对齐；组织后的表征投影回欧氏切空间，经轻量残差记忆更新注入解码器，保留原始跨模态记忆；并引入径向结构正则与角度相关性监督作为辅助损失。
AI.result: 在多个基准上实验与分析显示，HTEO提升了时序定位性能，并提供可解释的时序证据几何组织。
AI.conclusion: 双曲几何为多状态时序证据的组织提供了有效的显式结构归纳偏置，可与标准Transformer兼容并带来定位收益。

title: DeformStruct: Deformable Structure Modeling for Point-Supervised Temporal Action Localization
summary: Point-supervised Temporal Action Localization (PTAL) aims to localize action instances using only a single annotated timestamp for each instance. Such sparse supervision offers limited guidance for modeling the structural organization of an action instance. Existing PTAL methods primarily infer action regions from classification responses, leaving the structural organization of multiple action-related parts within each instance insufficiently modeled. To address this problem, we propose DeformStruct, an instance-level deformable structure modeling framework for PTAL. DeformStruct progressively constructs the structure of each action instance through three stages. First, Structural Anchor Mining discovers multiple anchors from annotated points and action-responsive regions, providing structural nodes grounded in the current instance. Second, Deformable Part Alignment associates latent structural parts with these anchors through deformation-aware matching, allowing their temporal supports to adapt to instance-dependent variations. Third, Relational Structural Organization explicitly models the relative temporal relations among the aligned parts, forming a relational representation that characterizes how different action-related parts are organized together. Extensive experiments on THUMOS14, ActivityNet-v1.3, GTEA, and BEOID demonstrate consistent improvements in point-supervised temporal localization and validate the effectiveness of deformable structural modeling.

AI.tldr: DeformStruct：点监督时序动作定位（PTAL）的实例级可变形结构建模框架，通过锚点挖掘、可变形部件对齐、关系结构组织三阶段建模动作内部部件结构，在 THUMOS14/ActivityNet-v1.3/GTEA/BEOID 上稳定提升。
AI.motivation: PTAL 每个实例仅有一个标注时间点，监督极稀疏，难以指导动作实例内部结构建模。现有方法主要依赖分类响应回归动作区间，未显式刻画实例内多个动作相关部件的组织方式。
AI.method: 三阶段级联：(1) Structural Anchor Mining——从标注点和动作响应区域挖掘多个锚点作为结构节点；(2) Deformable Part Alignment——通过变形感知匹配将潜在结构部件与锚点关联，使各部件时序支撑区间可随实例变化自适应；(3) Relational Structural Organization——显式建模对齐部件间的相对时序关系，形成描述部件组织方式的关系表征。
AI.result: 在 THUMOS14、ActivityNet-v1.3、GTEA、BEOID 四个数据集上取得一致性提升，验证可变形结构建模的有效性（摘要未给出具体 mAP 数值）。
AI.conclusion: 显式引入部件级可变形结构与关系建模可缓解点监督的稀疏性约束，为弱监督时序动作定位提供结构化的实例表征思路。

title: ChoreoStudio: Planning What, When, and Who in Music-Driven Group Choreography
summary: Music-driven group dance generation must decide not only how each dancer moves, but also what formation the group should form, when it should change, and who should execute each transition. Existing methods can generate orderly and rhythmically synchronized group motion, but remain limited in formation evolution and inter-dancer interaction. In human choreography, formation transitions often align with changes in high-level musical structure, such as the progression from an introduction to a chorus or from a chorus to a climax. We present ChoreoStudio, which makes choreography planning explicit. A music disentangler first decomposes the audio into frame-level rhythmic features and segment-level structural features. Given the segment-level features and sparse labels, a frozen omni-modal model acts as a scriptwriter, producing a global semantic description that guides the Director's choreography planning. Based on this context, the Director produces three coupled interaction decisions: a centroid-relative point set specifies what formation to produce, a transition gate determines when it should change, and a mobility allocation indicates who should execute the transition. The transition gate and mobility allocation are further conditioned on the planned geometric change, coupling formation targets with their temporal and dancer-specific execution. At a finer temporal scale, frame-aligned music features condition the diffusion generator to control detailed body motion and preserve beat-level alignment. The segment-level interaction plan is injected in parallel through frame-aligned instruction tokens and cross-dancer attention biases, coordinating how the generator realizes each transition. Experiments on AIOZ-GDance demonstrate that ChoreoStudio follows the planned interactions while achieving state-of-the-art performance in motion quality, group organization, and formation dynamics.

AI.tldr: ChoreoStudio 将群舞生成显式分解为"编舞规划"与"运动生成"两级：音乐解耦模块输出帧级节奏与段落级结构特征，冻结的全模态大模型充当剧本作者生成全局语义描述，指导"导演"模块产出三项耦合的交互决策（质心相对点集=队形、转移门控=何时变阵、机动分配=谁执行），再以帧对齐指令 token 与跨舞者注意力偏置注入扩散生成器，实现节拍级对齐的细粒度动作。
AI.motivation: 现有音乐驱动群舞生成方法虽能产生有序、节奏同步的群体运动，但队形演化能力弱、舞者间交互缺失。人类编舞中队形转换常与音乐高层结构（前奏→副歌、副歌→高潮）对齐，因此需要把编舞规划显式化，让"变什么队形、何时变、谁来变"成为可控的结构化决策，而非隐式涌现。
AI.method: 1) 音乐解耦器：将音频分解为帧级节奏特征与段落级结构特征；2) 冻结全模态模型作为 scriptwriter，结合段落特征与稀疏标签生成全局语义描述；3) Director 基于该上下文输出三项耦合决策——质心相对点集（队形几何）、转移门控（时间）、机动分配（舞者分配），且后两者以计划几何变化为条件；4) 扩散生成器以帧对齐音乐特征控制细节动作，段落级交互计划通过帧对齐指令 token 与跨舞者注意力偏置并行注入。
AI.result: 在 AIOZ-GDance 数据集上，ChoreoStudio 能够遵循规划出的交互安排，并在动作质量、群体组织性与队形动态性三方面取得 SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 将编舞规划从生成器中解耦为可解释的结构化中间表示（队形点集+转移时机+执行者分配），并以注意力偏置形式回注扩散生成，是提升群舞队形演化可控性与交互真实性的有效范式；该"规划-生成"层级化思路对多智能体协同运动生成具借鉴价值。

title: DynaSlots: Slot-Centric 3D Dynamics Pretraining for Robot Manipulation
summary: Robot manipulation involves localized changes: picking up a cup moves the cup while leaving the surrounding scene largely unchanged. Yet existing 3D visual pretraining methods, including recent dynamics-aware variants, model state transitions at the scene level, compressing the motion of everything in a scene into a single global latent action. This conflates semantically distinct transitions in scenes with multiple moving parts, obscures dependencies between changing regions, and leaves the learned representation vulnerable to task-irrelevant scene content. We introduce DynaSlots, an action-free, label-free pretraining framework that decomposes each point cloud frame into a small set of temporally consistent slots and models dynamics at this per-slot level rather than the scene level. A temporal slot propagation module promotes consistent slot assignments across frames; an inverse dynamics model then extracts one latent action per slot from feature differences, and a diffusion-based forward dynamics model, paired with a self-supervised interaction head, predicts each slot's future state while learning pairwise proximity-and-motion relations. Experiments on Meta-World, Adroit, and a RealMan RM65-B robot demonstrate that DynaSlots outperforms prior scene-level baselines. It achieves superior success rates in simulation and exhibits strong robustness to scene clutter and unseen objects in real-world manipulation. Code is available at \href{ this https URL }{ this https URL }.

AI.tldr: DynaSlots：无动作、无标签的3D点云预训练框架，将每帧点云分解为少量时序一致的slot，并在slot级别（而非场景级别）建模动力学；用时序slot传播保证跨帧一致性，用逆动力学模型为每个slot提取潜在动作，用扩散式前向动力学模型加自监督交互头预测各slot未来状态并学习成对邻近/运动关系。在Meta-World、Adroit与RealMan RM65-B上成功率与抗杂乱/新物体鲁棒性优于场景级基线。
AI.motivation: 机器人操作本质是局部化变化（抓杯子只动杯子），而现有3D视觉预训练（含dynamics-aware变体）在场景级别建模状态转移，把整场景运动压缩为单一全局潜在动作，导致多运动部件场景中语义不同的转移被混淆、变化区域间依赖被掩盖、表征对任务无关场景内容敏感。
AI.method: 1) 每帧点云分解为少量时序一致slot（object-centric分解）；2) 时序slot传播模块提升跨帧slot分配一致性；3) 逆动力学模型从特征差分中抽取每slot的潜在动作；4) 扩散式前向动力学模型+自监督交互头预测slot未来状态并学习两两邻近与运动关系。全程无需动作标签与人工标注。
AI.result: 在Meta-World、Adroit及真实RealMan RM65-B机械臂上，仿真成功率优于先前场景级基线；真实环境中对场景杂乱与未见物体展现强鲁棒性。代码开源。
AI.conclusion: 把3D动态预训练从场景级全局潜动作细化到slot级局部潜动作，是提升操作表征可迁移性与鲁棒性的有效方向，且可由无标注视频/点云序列自监督获得，具备接入下游策略学习的潜力。

title: 4DMemory: Benchmarking Long-Horizon Spatiotemporal Memory with Harness-Augmented Agents
summary: Humans efficiently process multimodal streams spanning hours to years, building persistent, fine-grained spatiotemporal memories that support reasoning about and predicting long-horizon events. In contrast, existing benchmarks focus on short- and medium-context tasks, and most foundation models struggle to preserve fine-grained information over long horizons. To evaluate and improve long-horizon spatiotemporal reasoning, we introduce the LongVideo dataset and the 4DMemoryBench. LongVideo comprises about 900 hours of video and over 5,000 manually reviewed questions covering visual, textual, and spatiotemporal reasoning across diverse context lengths. We further develop the 4DMemory Harness, which integrates four complementary skills, 22+ specialized tool models, and a model-specific retrieval-augmented generation system. Evaluating 13 leading models, we find that standalone foundation models struggle with long-horizon tasks, while the 4DMemory Harness improves all of them by over 50\%. Compared to previous benchmark, the same models exhibit a performance drop of more than 10\% on 4DMemoryBench. We hope 4DMemory will facilitate the development of spatiotemporal agents capable of addressing complex, long-horizon tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出 LongVideo 数据集（约900小时视频、5000+人工审核问答）与 4DMemoryBench 长时域时空推理基准，并开发 4DMemory Harness（融合四类技能、22+专用工具模型及RAG检索系统）以提升基础模型长时域表现。
AI.motivation: 人类能构建持久、细粒度的时空记忆以支持长时域推理，而现有基准集中于短/中上下文任务，基础模型难以在长时域保持细粒度信息，缺乏系统性评测与改进手段。
AI.method: 构建约900小时、跨不同上下文长度的多模态视频数据集与5000+人工审核问题（涵盖视觉、文本、时空推理）；提出 4DMemoryBench 评测基准；设计 4DMemory Harness，整合四类互补技能、22+专用工具模型与模型特定的检索增强生成系统。
AI.result: 评测13个主流模型：独立基础模型在长时域任务上普遍表现不佳；4DMemory Harness 使所有模型提升超过50%；相较以往基准，同模型在 4DMemoryBench 上性能下降超10%。
AI.conclusion: 长时域时空记忆是基础模型的显著短板，工具增强+检索式记忆框架可有效缓解；作者期望 4DMemory 推动具备复杂长时域任务能力的时空智能体发展。

title: LogLook: Execution-Grounded Memory for Frontier-Model Robot Planners
summary: Many manipulation tasks require a robot to remember what it has done and what it has seen. Frontier vision-language models can plan such tasks without task-specific training, but how such a planner should remember an episode is an open question. We argue that its memory must keep track of what the planner has done and learned, and must let the planner choose what to look at, since every frame costs tokens; a note rewritten at every step meets both poorly. We propose LogLook, whose execution-grounded memory lets the system keep the record, an execution log and the model's earlier notes, while the model decides where to look: frames are returned only where it expects a change, and demonstrations are skimmed before it inspects the parts it chooses. Measured with the benchmark's motion planner, LogLook matches the success of a note-only memory with 43% fewer tokens and less than half the images, and fails far fewer episodes through what it remembered or saw. With direct control, LogLook solves 93.5% of the RoboMME test set.

AI.tldr: LogLook提出一种"执行日志+按需查看"的视觉语言规划记忆机制：保留执行日志与模型自己写过的高层笔记，并由模型自主决定何时回看哪些帧（仅在预期发生变化处返回图像），从而在长时序操作任务中显著降低token与图像开销。
AI.motivation: 在操作任务的长时序规划中，前沿VLM规划器无需任务特定训练即可给出计划，但"记忆如何组织"仍是开放问题。每步重写一条文本笔记的记忆方式，既难以同时记录"已做什么"与"已学到什么"，也无法让规划器自主选择看哪里；而每帧图像都带来token成本，因此提出应把记忆设计成同时满足"记录动作与所获知识"以及"自主选择查看内容"两项要求。
AI.method: LogLook将记忆解耦为两部分：一是execution-grounded memory，包含append式的执行日志(execution log)与模型早期写下的notes，前者防止遗忘已执行动作，后者承载语义抽象；二是主动视觉机制——由模型自主决定回看位置，仅在预测会发生变化的区域回传帧，并对示范(demonstration)先做快速略读(skim)，再定点细看。整个过程不依赖任务特定训练，直接插入VLM规划器。
AI.result: 在与benchmark自带motion planner配合时，LogLook在成功率上追平纯笔记式记忆，同时减少43%的token、所用图像数不到一半，因"记忆错误"或"看错"导致的失败回合数大幅减少；在直接控制(direct control)设置下，RoboMME测试集成功率达到93.5%。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明长时序机器人操作中的记忆关键不在于"压缩文本"，而在于"记录与选择性感知的分离"：执行日志保证动作一致性，预测变化驱动的帧查询保证视觉信息按需付费。其代价低、可插拔、不依赖微调，适合作为VLM规划器的通用记忆层，但对需要密集几何/接触细节的操作任务仍可能不足。

title: Search-Based Testing of Modality Sensitivity in Vision Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) process images and text jointly, yet robustness evaluations often perturb these inputs separately or assess only predefined corruption levels. Such evaluations provide limited evidence of which modality is more susceptible to perturbations and whether smaller changes across both modalities can jointly expose failures. We present MoST, a black-box testing framework that characterizes modality sensitivity by comparing image-only, text-only, and joint perturbations. MoST uses multi-objective search to select and combine perturbations and adjust their severity, seeking prediction degradation while limiting changes to images and prompts. We evaluate MoST on four VLMs performing object localization on ImageNet and driving images. The models exhibit distinct sensitivities: textual perturbations dominate for some, whereas others are susceptible across both modalities. In several configurations, joint perturbations match or exceed the effectiveness of single-modality perturbations with smaller modifications to each input. In a human study, 60-76% of assessments across models judge the perturbed inputs sufficiently understandable to perform the task, and human localization is more accurate than that of the corresponding VLMs. These results show that evaluating modalities separately can overlook failure-inducing combinations and that modality sensitivity provides a more detailed account of VLM robustness than aggregate failure rates alone.

AI.tldr: MoST：黑盒多目标搜索框架，联合调整图像与文本扰动强度，比较单模态与跨模态敏感性，揭示VLM的模态特异性失效。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM鲁棒性评估多单独扰动图像或文本、或仅用预设腐蚀等级，难以判断哪一模态更敏感，也难发现小幅度跨模态联合扰动导致的失效。
AI.method: 提出MoST黑盒测试框架：以多目标搜索选择并组合图像/文本扰动，同时调节扰动强度，目标为最大化预测退化、最小化图像与提示词改动；在4个VLM上于ImageNet与驾驶图像做目标定位评测，并辅以人类主观研究。
AI.result: 模型呈现不同敏感性模式：部分以文本扰动为主导，部分对两模态均敏感；多组配置下联合扰动以更小单模态改动达到或超过单模态扰动效果。人类研究中60–76%的样本被判为任务可理解，且人类定位精度高于对应VLM。
AI.conclusion: 单独评估单模态会漏掉诱发失效的组合扰动；模态敏感性分析比单一聚合失败率更能刻画VLM鲁棒性。

title: Graphs of Trajectory Bundles for Nonlinear Motion Planning
summary: We present the Graphs of Trajectory Bundles (GTB) method for motion planning of systems with nonlinear and black-box dynamics, combining sampling-based motion planning with trajectory optimization and graph search. Based on a graph-of-convex-sets decomposition of the workspace, GTB iteratively constructs a graph of trajectory bundles that captures the local dynamics of the system at any vertex. By solving a shortest-path problem on this graph, we find maximally dynamically feasible iterates that satisfy the system's dynamics in the limit and any constraints such as collision avoidance or additional safety or specification constraints by construction of the underlying graph. As a result, GTB can handle highly nonlinear, unstable, and even black-box dynamics with complex collision and specification constraints, making it a powerful tool for motion planning of complex systems.

AI.tldr: GTB方法将基于采样的规划、轨迹优化与图搜索结合，在工作空间的凸集分解图上迭代构建"轨迹束图"，通过最短路求解获得在极限意义下满足系统动力学与各类约束的最大可行迭代解。
AI.motivation: 现有运动规划方法难以同时处理高度非线性、不稳定甚至黑箱动力学，以及复杂碰撞与规格约束；需要一种能在构造层面保证动力学可行性并兼容采样规划灵活性的统一框架。
AI.method: 基于工作空间的graph-of-convex-sets分解，在每个顶点处维护捕获局部动力学的轨迹束（trajectory bundle）；迭代地构建轨迹束图，并在该图上求解最短路问题，逐步得到满足动力学（极限收敛）与碰撞/安全/规格约束的轨迹迭代解。
AI.result: 摘要未给出定量实验数据；声称可处理高度非线性、不稳定乃至黑箱动力学，并同时满足复杂碰撞与规格约束，具备较强通用性。
AI.conclusion: GTB提供了一种可扩展的运动规划框架，将图搜索的全局性与轨迹优化的局部动态可行性结合，适用于复杂黑箱系统的约束规划，但缺乏具体实验验证与可复现信息。

title: A Regularity Condition Under Which a CPAB Transformation is a Diffeomorphism
summary: Continuous Piecewise-Affine Based (CPAB) transformations, introduced by Freifeld et al. (2015, 2017), are flows obtained by integrating continuous piecewise-affine (CPA) velocity fields. These expressive transformations have proven useful in applications including nonlinear temporal warping and trainable activation functions in 1D, as well as nonrigid spatial deformations in 2D and 3D. While computational costs were not an issue in 1D, they originally limited the practical expressiveness of CPAB transformations in higher dimensions, especially in 3D. Our recent work (Aflalo et al., 2026) removed this bottleneck, enabling efficient optimization with much finer tessellations and substantially greater expressiveness. There is, however, a mathematical subtlety that was overlooked in the original CPAB papers (Freifeld et al., 2015, 2017). CPAB transformations are always bi-Lipschitz homeomorphisms, implying that both the transformations and their inverses are differentiable almost everywhere. They are not, however, necessarily diffeomorphisms. This note remedies the omission by identifying sufficient regularity conditions under which a CPAB transformation is guaranteed to be a diffeomorphism. We explain how differentiability can fail and how the proposed conditions prevent this failure. In 1D and 2D, we show that these conditions can be easily enforced and, for commonly used tessellations, hold with probability one under standard sampling assumptions. We expect analogous behavior in 3D.

AI.tldr: 针对CPAB变换被误认为微分同胚的问题，给出其成为微分同胚的充分正则性条件，并证明1D/2D常用剖分下条件易满足且几乎必然成立。
AI.motivation: Freifeld等(2015,2017)提出的CPAB变换实为双Lipschitz同胚，仅几乎处处可微，并非必然为微分同胚；原论文对此数学细节存在遗漏，需澄清并补足。
AI.method: 分析CPAB变换的可微性可能失效的机制，提出保证其为微分同胚的充分正则性条件；在1D与2D中给出易于实施的约束方式，并结合标准采样假设给出概率1成立的分析（3D预期类似）。
AI.result: 证明所提条件可防止可微性失效；在1D、2D常用剖分下这些条件可便捷施加，且在标准采样假设下以概率1满足。
AI.conclusion: CPAB变换需附加正则性条件才保证为微分同胚；该注记形式化并修正了原有理论缺口，为高维（含3D）精细剖分下的可靠使用提供理论依据。

title: Past as State, Present as Attention: Persistent-State Blockwise Flow Matching for Long-Horizon Co-Speech Motion Generation
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 38 pages, 10 figures, 17 tables
summary: Co-speech motion generation remains challenging over long horizons due to the need for temporal coherence and consistent style. Existing methods typically generate long motions segment by segment, either conditioning on a short seed of recent frames, which gradually drifts, or retaining ever-longer explicit histories, which are costly to maintain and hard to learn from limited data. We trace these limitations to a key asymmetry between past and present: past motion carries slowly varying style that should be compactly summarized, whereas the current segment exhibits fast-changing local dynamics that require fine-grained modeling. This asymmetry motivates a simple Past-As-State, Present-as-Attention principle for long-horizon co-speech motion generation. Following this principle, we propose PASPA, which summarizes past history with an inter-block persistent state and models the current segment with intra-block bidirectional self-attention. We instantiate PASPA within a blockwise flow matching framework, with multi-block supervision for effective training over variable histories, prefill-decode state caching for efficient rollout, and hybrid classifier-free guidance for enhanced history and speech conditioning. Extensive public-benchmark experiments show that PASPA achieves state-of-the-art FGD performance and preserves motion style across long-sequence generation.

AI.tldr: 提出 PASPA：基于"过去为状态、当前为注意力"原则的长时程协同语音动作生成，用块间持久状态压缩历史风格、块内双向自注意力建模局部动态，并在分块 flow matching 框架下实现。
AI.motivation: 长时程协同语音动作生成面临时间连贯性与风格一致性难题。现有逐段生成方法存在两种极端：只用近若干帧作种子会逐渐漂移；维护无限增长的显式历史代价高且受限于数据难以学习。作者将其归因于"过去"与"当前"的非对称性——过去运动承载缓变风格应被紧凑摘要，当前段包含快变局部动态需细粒度建模。
AI.method: 按 Past-As-State, Present-as-Attention 原则设计 PASPA：用 inter-block persistent state 汇总历史，用 intra-block bidirectional self-attention 建模当前段；在 blockwise flow matching 框架中实例化，辅以多块监督（适配可变长度历史）、prefill-decode 状态缓存（高效 rollout）与混合 classifier-free guidance（增强历史与语音条件）。
AI.result: 在公开基准上取得 SOTA 的 FGD 指标，并在长序列生成中保持动作风格一致。
AI.conclusion: 以状态-注意力不对称建模替代"短种子"或"长显式历史"，是长时程条件生成的可扩展方案；摘要未提供实时性、代码或用户研究证据。

title: EigenGradCAM with AugSmooth: Enhancing Explainability and Precision in Multi-Stage Alzheimer's Disease Detection
summary: Alzheimer's disease (AD) is a progressive neurological disorder associated with memory loss, cognitive decline, and behavioral disturbances. Early and accurate diagnosis is essential, yet MRI-based deep learning models often lack interpretability, limiting their clinical use. This study presents an explainable deep learning approach for four-class AD staging using 2D axial MRI images. The method combines eigenvector-based Grad-CAM with gradient smoothing to improve saliency localization and heatmap stability. Principal component analysis is applied to gradient-weighted convolutional layers, while Gaussian noise is added to saliency weights before decomposition. To address class imbalance in the Moderate Dementia category, Wasserstein Generative Adversarial Network with Gradient Penalty (WGAN-GP) generates synthetic samples to balance the four-stage training distribution. Custom convolutional neural networks are trained on the Best Alzheimer MRI Dataset, achieving 97.2% test accuracy, 97.0% balanced accuracy, and a Matthews correlation coefficient of 0.944. The area under the ROC curve ranges from 0.96 to 0.99 across classes. Generated heatmaps highlight the hippocampus and entorhinal cortex, regions associated with Alzheimer's disease biomarkers. These findings suggest that the proposed approach combines strong classification performance with improved model interpretability, although further clinical validation is needed.

AI.tldr: 提出可解释四分类阿尔茨海默病MRI分期框架：特征向量化Grad-CAM+梯度平滑提升显著图稳定性，WGAN-GP合成样本缓解类别不平衡，自建CNN达97.2%准确率。
AI.motivation: MRI深度学习AD诊断模型缺乏可解释性，且四阶段数据存在中度痴呆类别不平衡，限制临床落地。
AI.method: 基于2D轴位MRI，将特征向量PCA应用于梯度加权卷积层生成Grad-CAM，并在分解前对显著权重加入高斯噪声并做梯度平滑；用WGAN-GP对中度痴呆类别过采样平衡训练分布；在Best Alzheimer MRI数据集上训练自定义CNN做四分类。
AI.result: 测试准确率97.2%，平衡准确率97.0%，MCC 0.944，各类AUC 0.96–0.99；热图集中于海马与内嗅皮层。
AI.conclusion: 方法兼顾分类性能与可解释性，但缺乏临床验证；属医学影像应用，对通用方法学贡献有限。

title: Sam-Correction: Fully Adaptive Label Noise Reduction for Medical Image Segmentation
comment: 5 pages, accepted to IEEE International Symposium on Biomedical Imaging (ISBI) 2024
summary: The quality of the teacher label has a dramatic impact on the outcome of the machine learning process. Medical image segmentation often suffers from a noisy ground truth (GT) mask due to difficulties in consistent annotation. Although a recent study has proposed a promising method to curate the noisy GT mask, this requires additional well-curated GT masks that are not always accessible without the aid of multiple medical experts. As an alternative, we propose SAM-Correction, which utilizes a foundation model to correct the noisy GT mask in a fully adaptive manner instead of manually preparing well-curated masks. In our approach, we progressively mitigate label noise via the segment anything model (SAM), where prompts are given from another segmentation network that we train concurrently. Experiments with various types of label noise derived from actual human annotations demonstrate that SAM-C achieves precise noise reduction and high-performing segmentation models trained thereby. Our method paves the way for robust model training even when clean labels are entirely unavailable.

AI.tldr: SAM-Correction 用 SAM 基础模型配合一个同步训练的、互为提示来源的分割网络，全自动纠正医学图像分割中噪声 GT，无需人工标注的干净掩码即可训练出鲁棒分割模型。
AI.motivation: 医学图像分割的 GT 常因标注一致性差而带噪，而现有的噪声 GT 修正方法依赖多位专家提供的干净掩码，实际难以获得；作者希望彻底摆脱对干净标签的依赖。
AI.method: 提出 SAM-C 框架：以 SAM 作为纠错器，提示（prompt）由另一个正在同步训练的分割网络生成；通过迭代式、渐进地“分割网络给提示—SAM 出掩码—回灌训练”闭环逐步降低标签噪声，全过程自适应、无需人工策展。
AI.result: 在基于真实人工标注构造的多种类型标签噪声上实验，SAM-C 能精确降噪，并训练出高性能分割模型。
AI.conclusion: 当干净标签完全不可得时，利用基础模型自举纠错仍可支撑鲁棒模型训练；为医学图像等弱标注场景提供了无监督式标签净化范式。

title: UniWorld: A Unified World Model for Real-Time Visual World Simulation
summary: Continuous visual world simulation requires coupling evolving scene geometry with temporally persistent appearance. We present UniWorld, a unified framework that integrates depth trajectories and reference appearance within a shared video generation model. The central design maintains visual and geometric histories on a common timeline. Noise-aligned overlapping continuation places generated history at the prescribed sampling noise level and commits only newly generated latents. Rolling depth latent state preserves the corresponding geometric controls, incrementally reads newly available geometry, and keeps the conditioning fixed within each sampling window. Together, these mechanisms ensure exact preservation of latent history while bounding the active depth state by the window size. We evaluate continuous generation, paired history interventions, and long-horizon behavior across diverse scene categories. The same generator supports estimated, native, and on-demand simulator depth, while cached and incremental execution paths produce bitwise-identical outputs. Appearance changes and geometric control branches operate through the same interface without modifying committed history. The measured steady-state DiT execution path achieves real-time generation throughput, demonstrating the efficiency of UniWorld for continuous visual world simulation.

AI.tldr: UniWorld：在统一视频生成模型中耦合深度轨迹与参考外观，实现连续视觉世界仿真；通过噪声对齐的重叠续接与滚动深度潜状态保留历史并固定窗口内条件，支持实时 DiT 吞吐与缓存/增量路径位级一致输出。
AI.motivation: 连续视觉世界仿真需同时耦合演化的场景几何与时间上持久的外观，而现有视频生成模型难以在长时程中精确保持潜变量历史与几何控制的一致性。
AI.method: 共享视频生成模型内统一深度轨迹与参考外观：在同一时间轴上维护视觉与几何历史；采用噪声对齐的重叠续接，将已生成历史置于对应采样噪声水平，仅提交新生成潜变量；采用滚动深度潜状态，增量读取新几何并在采样窗口内固定条件，从而使活跃深度状态受窗口大小约束。
AI.result: 在多样场景类别的连续生成、成对历史干预与长时程行为上完成评估；同一生成器支持估计、原生与按需模拟器深度；缓存与增量执行路径输出位级一致；外观变化与几何控制分支通过同一接口操作且不修改已提交历史；稳态 DiT 执行路径达到实时生成吞吐。
AI.conclusion: UniWorld 以历史精确保持与窗口受限深度状态为设计核心，实现几何—外观联合可控的连续世界仿真，并提供实时高效、确定性一致的推理路径。

title: PASTA: Prompt-Aware Annealed Diffusion Sampling
comment: 15 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables. Accepted to ICONIP2026
summary: While Diffusion models produce high-quality images, real-world visual design requires intentionally preserving clean regions for headlines, logos, or UI elements. Existing layout-aware text-to-image methods struggle to strictly preserve reserved regions, often introducing unwanted content that complicates downstream editing. Existing approaches either manipulate attention to displace content or suppress conditioning via noise-level interventions. However, these methods sacrifice visual coherence, producing flat regions or noticeable style inconsistencies between reserved and non-reserved areas. To address this limitation, we propose a Prompt-Aware Shared-Latent Training-Free Annealed Diffusion Sampling (PASTA), a training-free framework that enforces reserved-region constraints by selectively applying semantic guidance to object-allowed regions during sampling. PASTA operates on a shared latent trajectory, where full-prompt and context-prompt guidance are fused through mask-guided sampling. An annealed schedule suppresses semantic leakage during early denoising stages while gradually restoring visual consistency in later stages. Extensive experiments demonstrate that PASTA improves reserved-region fidelity while preserving overall image realism and perceptual consistency.

AI.tldr: PASTA：无需训练的扩散采样框架，通过在共享潜轨迹上按掩码融合全提示与上下文提示引导，并用退火调度抑制语义泄漏，从而严格保留版式预留区域且保持风格一致性。
AI.motivation: 真实视觉设计需在生成图中为标题、Logo、UI 元素刻意保留干净区域；现有布局感知文生图方法要么扰动注意力挪移内容，要么在噪声层面对条件做抑制，导致预留区与非预留区视觉连贯性受损（平坦区域或明显风格不一致）。
AI.method: 提出 PASTA（Prompt-Aware Shared-Latent Training-Free Annealed Diffusion Sampling）：完全无需训练。在单一共享潜变量轨迹上同时运行全提示与上下文提示的引导，通过掩码引导采样按区域选择性施加语义引导（仅对允许物体的区域生效）；引入退火式调度，在去噪早期阶段压制语义泄漏以保护预留区，在后期逐步恢复以维持整体视觉一致性。
AI.result: 实验表明 PASTA 在提升预留区域保真度的同时，保持了整体图像真实感与感知一致性，优于基于注意力操控或噪声干预的现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 掩码引导的提示融合加退火式泄漏抑制，是训练无关地实现严格布局约束且不牺牲风格连贯性的有效方案，便于下游排版编辑。

title: Interactive image diagnosis using test-time backpropagation from the auxiliary task
comment: 8 pages, accepted to SPIE Medical Imaging 2025
summary: Multi-task deep learning has been developed to ensure explainability in computer-aided diagnosis (CAD) systems. These systems simultaneously predict interpretable characteristics of findings in auxiliary tasks to help radiologists assess the reliability of the diagnostic prediction. However, the CAD's opinion would not be referred to when the auxiliary task prediction deviates from the radiologist's expectation. To further leverage CAD's knowledge in the above situation, we proposed a multi-task gradient assist (MGA) method that brings interactivity to multi-task models without additional training. MGA allows radiologists to give feedback to the CAD and ask for additional diagnostic suggestions. Using two datasets of mammography and CT, we show that MGA successfully improves diagnostic accuracy upon feedback on various auxiliary tasks. Compared to an existing method using forward propagation only, MGA performs more robustly and can be combined to further improve accuracy. Our method paves a promising way for integrating artificial intelligence into image diagnosis.

AI.tldr: 提出多任务梯度辅助(MGA)方法，在不重新训练的前提下为多任务CAD模型引入交互性，使放射科医生可在辅助任务预测不符预期时给出反馈并获取额外诊断建议。
AI.motivation: 多任务CAD系统通过辅助任务输出可解释特征以提升可信度，但当辅助任务预测偏离放射科医生预期时，医生通常不再参考CAD意见，导致模型知识被浪费。
AI.method: 基于多任务模型梯度的反馈式推断：利用放射科医生对辅助任务的反馈，通过梯度引导调整主任务诊断输出，无需额外训练即可实现交互式修正；并与仅用前向传播的既有方法进行对比。
AI.result: 在乳腺钼靶与CT两个数据集上，MGA在多种辅助任务反馈下均提升诊断准确率；相较仅前向传播的基线方法表现更稳健，且二者可组合进一步提升精度。
AI.conclusion: MGA展示了多任务模型的免训练交互式推理路径，为AI融入影像诊断提供可行方向；但验证限于医学影像领域。

title: An Error Budget for Shuffled Multimodal Windows in the 3rd WEAR Challenge: Stacking, Count Constraints and Seam Matching
comment: 12 pages, 10 tables, 1 figure. Technical report on a post-deadline system for the 3rd WEAR Dataset Challenge at HASCA 2026. Code: this https URL
summary: The 3rd WEAR Dataset Challenge asks for an activity label for every one-second window of four unseen participants. Each window has 15 VideoMAEv2 frame embeddings, the accelerometer signal of one random limb, and the windows are shuffled. This report is an empirical analysis of one system built after the challenge deadline. Window classifiers are stacked with features averaged over per-participant graphs of video neighbours and scored successor candidates, and a mean-field style decoder with a soft count constraint per activity labels all windows of a participant together. The setting is offline and transductive, and the count constraint relies on each activity being performed once. In a participant-wise simulation with participant-level bootstrap intervals, stacking added 0.051 macro F1 over stage-1 fusion and the count constraint 0.011 (95% interval 0.006 to 0.017). A quadratic seam distance ranks the true same-limb successor first among about 720 candidates in 83.9% of cases, but adding it to the link model changed macro F1 by -0.0001 (-0.0006 to 0.0005). With the decoder settings and the mixing weight chosen inside the folds and the mislabelled spans left out of training, the system scores 0.936 in simulation (0.940 for participants who performed each activity once); the submitted configuration scores 0.938 (0.943). Per-participant scores range from 0.80 to 0.97. These results come from a non-nested stacking protocol that uses unlabelled features transductively, so they are not a fully inductive estimate. An oracle that averages the final unary scores over the true segments reaches 0.973, and 79% of the remaining errors involve the null class. On the private leaderboard, which no choice used, the selected Kaggle submission scored 0.9231 (public 0.9254, with bounds partly tuned there), and a later one with bounds chosen in simulation scored 0.9247 (public 0.9253).

AI.tldr: WEAR 数据集挑战后构建的人体活动识别系统实证分析：窗口分类器 + 视频近邻图上的特征堆叠 + 带软计数约束的均值场式解码器。
AI.motivation: 挑战要求对 4 名未见参与者每个 1 秒窗口给出活动标签，窗口仅含 15 个 VideoMAEv2 帧嵌入与单一随机肢体加速度信号且被打乱；需要在离线转导设定下整合异构弱信息并利用"每个活动只做一次"的先验。
AI.method: 1）以窗口分类器为基元，在参与者级视频近邻图上平均特征做堆叠（stacking）；2）引入后继候选打分（二次 seam 距离）刻画肢体连续性链接；3）对每名参与者的全部窗口用均值场式解码器联合解码，施加每个活动计数的软约束；4）采用非嵌套堆叠协议、参与者级自助法区间评估各组件贡献。
AI.result: 堆叠较一阶段融合提升 0.051 macro F1，计数约束提升 0.011（95% 区间 0.006–0.017）；二次 seam 距离在 83.9% 情况下将真同肢后继排至约 720 个候选之首，但加入链接模型后 macro F1 变化 -0.0001；模拟得分 0.936（单次完成活动的参与者 0.940），提交配置 0.938（0.943），个体 0.80–0.97；用真值段平均一元分数的 oracle 达 0.973，剩余错误 79% 涉及 null 类；私榜 0.9231/0.9247。
AI.conclusion: 图特征堆叠与全局计数约束是有效增益来源，而链接/后继度量虽排序判别力强却未转化为整体收益；结果源于转导式非嵌套协议，不构成完全归纳性估计，错误主要集中于空类。

title: TIE: Training-free CLIP Embedding Guidance for Compositional Text-to-Image Alignment
summary: Text-to-image (T2I) diffusion models have advanced notably, but still fail to satisfy prompt conditions, resulting in attribute mismatches and missing objects. These errors normally fall into two categories: concept loss, when an object or attribute (i.e., concept) goes missing, and concept confusion, when an attribute is assigned to the wrong object or multiple objects blend together. Recent studies suggest that these challenges are caused by the limited capacity of CLIP text encoder to capture fine-grained semantic details. Although several methods have been proposed, concept loss and concept confusion persist in recent T2I models when handling multi-object, multi-attribute prompts. In this paper, we conduct an embedding-level analysis to develop a training-free, inference-time solution for concept loss and concept confusion across CLIP-based T2I models. We find that (1) concepts mentioned later exhibit higher embedding entropy, reflecting less concentrated representations that are more often associated with concept loss, and (2) the first CLIP attention layer captures the strength of binding between each object and its attribute. Guided by our findings, we introduce TIE, a method that improves semantic alignment through a single text-embedding update. TIE addresses concept loss via entropy-aware singular value amplification and resolves concept confusion through interpolation-extrapolation binding based on CLIP attention scores, all in a training-free manner. Extensive experiments demonstrate that TIE enhances semantic fidelity in multi-concept scenarios with minimal sampling overhead. The project page is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: Embedding 层面的分析发现后提及概念的 CLIP 文本嵌入熵更高（易导致概念丢失）、首个 CLIP attention 层编码物体-属性绑定强度，据此提出免训练、推理期单次文本嵌入更新方法 TIE（熵感知奇异值放大 + 基于 attention 分数的插值-外推绑定）。
AI.motivation: T2I 扩散模型在多物体、多属性提示下仍存在概念丢失与概念混淆，已有工作归因于 CLIP 文本编码器细粒度语义容量不足，但现有方法未能同时解决两类错误。
AI.method: 免训练的推理期方法：仅在文本嵌入空间做一次更新——用熵感知的奇异值放大缓解概念丢失，用基于 CLIP 第一层 attention 分数的插值-外推绑定解决概念混淆。
AI.result: 大量实验表明 TIE 在多概念场景下提升语义保真度，采样开销极小；项目主页公开。
AI.conclusion: 文本嵌入层面的可解释分析可转化为通用的、即插即用的推理期修正，适用于各类 CLIP-based T2I 模型。

title: AlphaAnything: Extending Pretrained RGB Generators to RGBA
summary: Existing RGBA generation methods commonly learn a transparency-specific representation through reconstruction, introducing an additional training stage and potentially altering the RGB decoding function inherited from pretrained models. We present AlphaAnything, a lightweight framework that extends pretrained RGB generators to RGBA directly in their original latent space, without RGBA reconstruction pretraining. AlphaAnything inserts LoRA modules into the generative transformer and attaches an alpha branch to the frozen RGB VAE decoder. Unidirectional RGB-to-alpha feature sharing allows opacity supervision to shape the generative latent while guaranteeing that, for any fixed latent, RGB decoding remains identical to that of the pretrained decoder. We further introduce Endpoint-Aware Alpha Loss (EA Loss), which derives opacity supervision from the complementary foreground--background weights used in compositing. It supports exact opacity endpoints and continuous partial transparency while emphasizing localized alpha errors. Experiments on text-to-RGBA and image-to-RGBA tasks across multiple pretrained RGB backbones demonstrate competitive generation quality, and controlled ablations validate the shared-latent training design and EA Loss.

AI.tldr: AlphaAnything将预训练RGB生成器直接扩展为RGBA生成：在生成Transformer中插入LoRA、在冻结的RGB VAE解码器上附加alpha分支，并通过单向RGB→alpha特征共享与Endpoint-Aware Alpha Loss实现透明通道监督，无需RGBA重建预训练。
AI.motivation: 现有RGBA生成方法依赖重建式学习透明度专用表示，需额外训练阶段，且可能改变预训练模型继承的RGB解码函数，破坏原有RGB生成能力。
AI.method: 在原始潜空间中扩展：冻结RGB VAE解码器，附加alpha分支；生成Transformer插入LoRA；单向RGB到alpha的特征共享，保证任意固定潜变量下RGB解码与预训练一致；提出EA Loss，从合成（compositing）中的前景-背景互补权重导出不透明度监督，支持精确端点与连续半透明，并强调局部alpha误差。
AI.result: 在多个预训练RGB骨干上的文生RGBA与图生RGBA任务中取得有竞争力的生成质量；消融实验验证了共享潜空间训练设计与EA Loss的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 轻量、无需RGBA重建预训练的透明图像生成方案，可在保持预训练RGB解码一致性的同时获得alpha监督，具备良好的可移植性。

title: Cycle-of-Thought: Self-Evaluative Iterative Reasoning for Table Visual Question Answering in Document Images
summary: Recent advances in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have significantly improved Visual Question Answering (VQA) performance, yet their reasoning over structured content such as tables remains inconsistent, often plagued by spatial misalignment and logical hallucinations. Existing approaches for improving table VQA typically rely on architectural modifications or expensive supervised fine-tuning (SFT), which impose high barriers to entry due to the need for large-scale, expert-annotated datasets and significant computational resources. In this work, we propose Self-RefineVQA, a training-free, inference-time self-correction framework that improves table VQA performance without additional labeled data or model updates. Inspired by human revision behavior, our method enables a single VLM to iteratively act as a generator, critic, and refiner, forming a closed self-feedback loop that corrects common reasoning errors through prompt-guided re-evaluation. Experiments on tabular VQA benchmarks demonstrate that Self-RefineVQA yields consistent accuracy gains in monolingual and cross-lingual understanding, with a particularly significant boost for small models, enabling lightweight models (e.g., 2B-7B parameters) to rival the performance of significantly larger counterparts. Furthermore, we provide a comparative complexity analysis demonstrating that while inference cost increases linearly, our framework offers superior data efficiency and a lower cumulative cost by eliminating the prohibitive annotation bottleneck of human labeling required for fine-tuning. Our results highlight the potential of prompt-based self-improvement as a scalable, accessible paradigm for reliable table reasoning in VLMs.

AI.tldr: Self-RefineVQA：训练无关、推理期的表格VQA自纠错框架，单VLM循环扮演生成器/批评者/精炼者，构建闭环自反馈以纠正常见推理错误。
AI.motivation: VLM在表格等结构化内容上的推理不稳定，存在空间错位与逻辑幻觉；现有改进依赖架构改动或有监督微调（SFT），需要大规模专家标注数据与高昂算力，门槛高。
AI.method: 提出Self-RefineVQA，无需额外标注与模型更新；受人类修订行为启发，用提示引导让单个VLM迭代地充当generator、critic、refiner，通过再评估形成自反馈闭环修正错误。并给出推理成本随迭代线性增长、但数据效率更高、累计成本更低的复杂度对比分析。
AI.result: 在表格VQA基准上，单语与跨语言理解均获得稳定精度提升；小模型（2B-7B）提升尤为显著，可媲美更大模型；成本分析显示推理开销线性增长但免除了人工标注瓶颈，累计成本更低。
AI.conclusion: 基于提示的自改进可作为可扩展、低门槛的范式，提升VLM在表格推理上的可靠性；但缺乏与本文研究方向（具身/3D/世界模型/机器人操作）的实质关联。

title: Tempo-Zero: Recursive Self-Play in Executable Worlds for Video Reasoning
summary: Video reasoning requires understanding how events unfold over time, yet videos with accurate temporal annotations are expensive to collect. Self-play offers an alternative by letting a model generate and solve its own tasks without manual annotation. However, existing video self-play methods train on fixed sets of recorded videos, so they cannot alter the underlying event dynamics and rely on noisy pseudo-labels derived from the model's own outputs, such as majority voting, that risk reinforcing shared model errors. To overcome these limitations, we introduce Tempo-Zero, a self-improvement framework that closes a loop of executable environments, execution-verified self-play, and environment evolution, where executing a program renders a video with the ground-truth option and interval of every question. A single policy plays both Questioner and Solver, proposing questions and answering them with timestamped evidence lines, and is trained on execution-grounded rewards instead of model consensus. The Solver's performance steers a curriculum over tasks and difficulty levels, and the policy selects rule changes that enrich the event dynamics of later rounds. Despite being trained solely on simple programs, without supervised fine-tuning or external video data which prior methods typically require, Tempo-Zero outperforms the base models and recent self-play baselines on average across twelve real-world video benchmarks at different model scales, with particularly strong gains on temporal grounding tasks. Project page: this https URL

AI.tldr: Tempo-Zero：以可执行程序渲染视频作为可验证环境，闭环自博弈（问题生成+时间戳作答）并用执行级奖励与课程/环境演化实现视频时序推理自我提升。
AI.motivation: 视频时序标注昂贵；既有视频自博弈在固定录制的视频集上训练，无法改变事件动态，且依赖多数投票等伪标签，易放大模型自身错误。
AI.method: 构建“可执行环境—执行验证自博弈—环境演化”闭环：执行程序渲染出带真实答案选项与时间区间的视频；单一策略兼任提问者与解答者，以时间戳证据行作答；用执行真值奖励替代模型共识训练；解答者表现驱动任务与难度课程；策略选择规则变更以丰富后续轮次事件动态。无需SFT或外部视频数据。
AI.result: 仅用简单程序训练，在12个真实视频基准、多模型规模上平均超过基线与近期自博弈方法，时序定位任务增益尤为显著。
AI.conclusion: 执行验证的自生成环境可替代人工标注与伪标签共识，成为视频时序推理的可扩展自我改进范式；但结论基于基准评测，未见真实机器人/具身部署验证。

title: $R^2E:$ A Role-driven Reward Evolutionary Framework for Automated Reward Function Design
summary: Designing effective reward functions is a critical challenge in Reinforcement Learning (RL), which traditionally requires costly manual trial-and-error. While Large Language Model (LLM)-based methods have shown promise in reward design, undifferentiated sampling and limited use of historical feedback often lead to insufficient exploration of the reward space and optimization instability. To address these challenges, we propose $R^2E$, a Role-driven Reward Evolutionary framework for automated reward function design that structures the process through explicit role specialization. $R^2E$ employs multiple LLM roles with complementary objectives: an Explorer that promotes novelty to expand the search space, a Guardian that performs conservative refinements to improve training stability, and an Evolver that recombines high-performing rewards via crossover and mutation to integrate effective structures. A dynamic scheduling strategy coordinates these roles, progressively shifting the search from broad exploration to focused exploitation. To mitigate optimization instability and provide a medium for cross-role collaboration, $R^2E$ incorporates a Global Elite Pool that retains the best-performing rewards to guide subsequent generations, thereby enabling coordinated interaction among roles and ensuring a reliable and consistent refinement process. Extensive experiments on multiple robotic tasks demonstrate the effectiveness of our method.

AI.tldr: 提出R²E：通过多LLM角色（Explorer/Guardian/Evolver）与全局精英池、动态调度实现自动化奖励函数设计的进化框架。
AI.motivation: LLM驱动的奖励设计存在采样无区分、历史反馈利用不足，导致奖励空间探索不充分与优化不稳定。
AI.method: 角色化多LLM进化搜索：Explorer促新颖性扩展搜索空间，Guardian做保守精修保证稳定性，Evolver通过交叉变异重组高性能奖励；动态调度从探索渐向利用过渡；Global Elite Pool保留最优奖励作为跨角色协作与引导后续生成的媒介。
AI.result: 在多个机器人任务上实验验证了方法的有效性（摘要未给出具体量化指标）。
AI.conclusion: 角色分工＋精英池＋调度策略可缓解LLM自动奖励设计中的探索不足与不稳定问题，为自动化奖励工程提供可行范式。

title: PROVE: Probabilistic Visual Grounding via Patch-Level Evidence for Vision-Language Models
summary: Visual grounding with vision-language models such as CLIP typically produces a single deterministic relevance map for an image-query pair, without indicating whether the localisation is reliable or whether the referent is present at all. We introduce \textbf{PROVE} (\textbf{Pro}babilistic \textbf{V}isual Grounding via Patch-Level \textbf{E}vidence), a post-hoc evidential adapter that maps frozen CLIP patch features to per-patch Beta distributions without modifying the backbone. PROVE casts grounding as per-patch membership: each patch accumulates positive and negative evidence for whether it belongs to the referent, so a query may match zero, one, or many patches. We train PROVE with an evidential objective on soft patch-coverage targets, and define a prior-pull objective that keeps absent-referent examples near an uninformative prior, so that vacuity serves as an absence signal without a dedicated presence classifier. During inference, a single forward pass yields, in closed form, a posterior-mean grounding map, a spatial vacuity map, and an image-level absence score. We evaluate PROVE on referring-expression benchmarks: it is competitive in localisation with state-of-the-art CLIP grounding methods, its uncertainty tracks localisation error and supports selective prediction under abstention, and its image-level score detects when the referent is absent altogether. Our evidential patch-membership modelling offers a simple, drop-in mechanism for probabilistic verification in frozen vision-language grounding systems.

AI.tldr: PROVE：冻结CLIP补丁特征上的事后证据适配器，将视觉定位建模为每个patch是否属于指称物的Beta分布成员判定，单次前向即可闭式输出均值定位图、空间"空泛度"图与图像级缺失分数。
AI.motivation: CLIP类视觉语言模型的定位只给出一张确定性相关图，无法说明定位是否可靠、指称物是否存在。需要一种无需重训主干、能同时给出定位、不确定性与"缺失"判定的概率化验证机制。
AI.method: 在冻结CLIP patch特征上接轻量证据适配器，把定位表述为逐patch成员归属：每个patch累积支持/反对证据形成Beta分布，因此查询可匹配0个、1个或多个patch。训练采用两项损失：在软patch覆盖目标上的证据损失，以及prior-pull损失，使"指称物缺失"样本停留在无信息先验附近，从而以"空泛度(vacuity)"充当缺失信号，无需单独的presence分类器。推理时一次前向闭式得到后验均值定位图、空间vacuity图与图像级缺失分。
AI.result: 在referring-expression基准上定位精度与SOTA CLIP定位方法相当；不确定性可跟踪定位误差，支持弃权下的选择性预测；图像级分数可检测指称物整体缺失。
AI.conclusion: 以证据式patch成员建模为冻结VLM定位系统提供即插即用的概率验证手段，兼具定位、不确定性与缺失检测。

title: Learning Fine-Grained Visual Classification with Text as Privileged Information via Multimodal Distillation
summary: Fine-grained visual classification (FGVC) requires distinguishing between highly similar categories by focusing on subtle, localized visual differences. Recent multimodal methods have demonstrated that textual attribute descriptions can provide valuable semantic supervision by explicitly describing discriminative object characteristics. However, these descriptions are typically unavailable at test time, limiting their direct use in deployment. We propose FG-LUPI, a Learning Using Privileged Information (LUPI)-based framework that leverages attribute descriptions during training.
