We train a multimodal teacher that integrates image patches and textual attributes via gated cross-attention, allowing semantic attributes to condition visual representations. We distill this knowledge into an image-only student using multi-level distillation at the prediction, patch, and attention levels, aligning global predictions, patch representations, and attention patterns with the teacher. This encourages the student to inherit attention structure learned from multimodal supervision while maintaining image-only inference. Experiments on multiple FGVC benchmarks show consistent improvements in classification accuracy over strong ViT-based baselines. Furthermore, evaluation using Expected Calibration Error (ECE) shows that FG-LUPI also produces better-calibrated predictions across all six benchmarks. These results suggest that textual attribute supervision can benefit not only fine-grained recognition performance but also the reliability of model confidence, while preserving the efficiency and practicality of image-only inference.

AI.tldr: FG-LUPI 用"特权信息学习"框架把训练期的文本属性描述蒸馏进纯图像学生模型，实现测试期仅图像的细粒度分类，并改善置信度校准。
AI.motivation: 细粒度视觉分类依赖局部细微差异，多模态方法虽能用文本属性描述提供语义监督，但描述在推理阶段不可得，难以部署。作者希望在不增加测试期成本的前提下保留多模态监督的收益。
AI.method: 以 LUPI 范式训练一个多模态教师：图像 patch 与文本属性经门控交叉注意力融合，使语义属性调制视觉表征；再通过预测级、patch 级、注意力级三层蒸馏，把全局预测、patch 表征与注意力图对齐到仅图像学生模型。
AI.result: 在多个 FGVC 基准上相对强 ViT 基线的分类准确率一致提升；在全部六个基准上 ECE 均更优，说明预测校准也得到改善。
AI.conclusion: 文本属性监督不仅提升细粒度识别性能，也提升置信度可靠性，同时保留仅图像推理的效率与实用性；属于通用多模态蒸馏范式，可迁移到其他需免文本推理的领域。

title: AutoMIL: Automated Multiple Instance Learning for Whole-Slide Image Classification
summary: Developing multiple instance learning pipelines for the classification of whole-slide images involves many interdependent design decisions and expertise in both pathology and machine learning. We present AutoMIL, an open-source framework that applies principles from the field of automated machine learning to tackle this task by automating integral pipeline steps, such as preprocessing, training and evaluation. In a benchmark evaluation with default settings, AutoMIL reached ROC-AUC scores of 0.94 on UBC-OCEAN, 0.99 on PCam and 0.93-0.96 on a TCGA-NSCLC subset, comparable to specialised pipelines in related work. Ensembling mainly improved performance on imbalanced data, showing that an automated pipeline must adapt to dataset characteristics. AutoMIL thus provides an accessible baseline for whole-slide image classification without manual pipeline configuration.

AI.tldr: AutoMIL：面向全切片图像（WSI）分类的开源自动化流水线框架，将AutoML原则用于预处理、训练与评估，免手动配置即可复现接近专用流水线的性能。
AI.motivation: WSI多示例学习（MIL）流水线涉及众多相互依赖的设计决策，需同时具备病理与机器学习专业知识，人工调参成本高、入门门槛大，缺少易用且可复现的自动化基线。
AI.method: 构建开源框架AutoMIL，采用AutoML思路自动化WSI-MIL的关键环节（预处理、训练、评估），并系统评估集成（ensembling）等策略对不同数据集特性的影响。
AI.result: 默认设置下取得ROC-AUC：UBC-OCEAN 0.94、PCam 0.99、TCGA-NSCLC子集0.93–0.96，与已有专用流水线相当；集成主要提升不平衡数据上的表现。
AI.conclusion: 自动化流水线需针对数据特性自适应；AutoMIL为WSI分类提供了无需手动配置的可访问基线。

title: MDMR-Bench: A Multi-Dimensional Benchmark for Multi-Reference Image Generation
comment: Bowen Zheng and Jintao Lin contributed equally to this work. Accepted at NeurIPS 2026, Evaluations & Datasets Track
summary: Image generation models have rapidly advanced, with many models now supporting generation conditioned on multiple reference images and textual instructions. Such models enable a wide range of applications, including entity fusion and attribute transfer across images. However, existing benchmarks for multi-reference image generation rely on limited evaluation dimensions and fail to capture the diverse challenges of the task. To address this limitation, we propose MDMR-Bench, a Multi-Dimensional benchmark for Multi-Reference image generation. MDMR-Bench is organized around representative capability settings and consists of multiple evaluation subsets spanning diverse dimensions of multi-reference image generation, including (1) common entity fusion and attribute transfer, (2) multi-element extraction from a single image, (3) infographic manipulation, and (4) visual reasoning-intensive generation. This design enables systematic analysis of model capabilities and failure modes across different challenge dimensions. Furthermore, to achieve more reliable and interpretable evaluation, we introduce a checklist-based evaluation protocol that decomposes generation quality into fine-grained evaluation aspects. Instead of relying solely on holistic scoring, our framework uses structured checklists composed of both global-level and atomic-level queries, enabling more diagnostic assessment of model performance. By benchmarking both open-source and proprietary models, we demonstrate that MDMR-Bench provides fine-grained insights into model performance across different dimensions. The dataset and code are publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出 MDMR-Bench，一个面向多参考图像生成的多维度评测基准，覆盖实体融合/属性迁移、单图多元素提取、信息图操控、视觉推理密集型生成四类能力，并提出基于结构化 checklist（全局级+原子级查询）的评测协议，对开源与闭源模型做细粒度诊断。
AI.motivation: 现有多参考图像生成基准的评测维度有限，无法刻画该任务在多种挑战维度上的多样性与失败模式；同时整体打分式评测不具可解释性与诊断性。
AI.method: 构建 MDMR-Bench：按代表性能力设置组织多个评测子集（实体融合与属性迁移、单图多元素提取、信息图操控、推理密集型生成）；引入 checklist 式评测协议，将生成质量分解为全局级与原子级查询，替代单一整体评分，以获得可解释、可诊断的评估。
AI.result: 对开源与专有模型进行基准测试，表明该基准能在不同维度上给出细粒度性能洞察，并揭示各维度下的能力差异与失败模式。
AI.conclusion: MDMR-Bench 提供了更系统、更可诊断的多参考图像生成评测框架，数据集与代码已公开，可作为该方向后续模型研发的评测参照。

title: CoCarry: Contact-Support-Structured Retargeting for Dual-Humanoid Cooperative Carrying
summary: Recent advances in large-scale human motion data, motion retargeting, and motion imitation have enabled increasingly capable whole-body control for individual humanoids. Cooperative carrying is more challenging because successful coordination requires not only plausible individual motions, but also consistent cross-agent and agent-object relations, including shared grasp, relative configuration, and whole-body support. We introduce CoCarry, a cooperative-carrying dataset containing 220 synchronized two-person sequences across 21 task schemes, five shared-object geometries, four terrain types, and approximately 61 minutes of motion. We further propose Contact-Support-Structured Retargeting, which starts from nominal individual motions and jointly refines both humanoids around the same prescribed object trajectory. Cooperation-aware object-local hand anchors preserve compatible four-hand grasp relations, while complementary upper object-interaction and lower support structures retain object-relative geometry and coordinated support. Across all 220 CoCarry sequences retargeted to two A3 humanoids, our method achieves 0.9995 contact preservation, reduces penetration duration by 67.0% and 71.0% relative to GMR and OmniRetarget, respectively, and maintains a 100% retargeting success rate. On CORE4D with Unitree G1 humanoids, it achieves 0.9906 contact preservation with zero measured sliding. We further validate the generated references through physics simulation and multiple real-world cooperative carrying experiments on two physical A3 humanoids, demonstrating their usability for downstream dual-humanoid control.

AI.tldr: 提出CoCarry双人协同搬运数据集(220段同步序列、21种任务方案、5种共享物体几何、4类地形,约61分钟),并配套Contact-Support-Structured Retargeting方法,将人类协同搬运动作联合重定向到两个A3人形机器人上。
AI.motivation: 单人形全身控制已较成熟,但双人形协同搬运更困难:不仅需要单人动作合理,还需要跨智能体与智能体-物体的一致关系(共享抓握、相对构型、整体支撑),现有重定向方法缺乏协同结构约束与对应数据。
AI.method: (1) CoCarry:同步双人动捕数据集,覆盖共享物体几何与地形多样性;(2) Contact-Support-Structured Retargeting:从单人名义动作出发,围绕同一指定物体轨迹联合优化两个机器人;采用合作感知的物体局部手部锚点保持四手抓握兼容性,并以互补的上部物体交互结构与下部支撑结构维持物体相对几何与协同支撑。
AI.result: 在220段序列重定向到两台A3人形上:接触保持率0.9995,穿透时长相对GMR降低67.0%、相对OmniRetarget降低71.0%,重定向成功率100%;在CORE4D与Unitree G1上接触保持率0.9906、测得滑动为零;并通过物理仿真与两台实体A3的真机协同搬运实验验证了参考动作可用于下游双人形控制。
AI.conclusion: 协同搬运重定向的关键在于显式建模跨智能体共享抓握与支撑一致性;所提结构化约束可在保持高接触质量与低穿透的同时获得稳定成功率,并且生成的参考可直接驱动实体双人形系统,为多智能体人形操作提供了数据与算法基线。

title: OPTARI: An open-source software framework for clinical translation of optoacoustic imaging
comment: 15 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables. Submitted to the Journal of Biomedical Optics. Code and documentation: this https URL
summary: Combined optoacoustic (OptA) and ultrasound imaging is a promising modality across a wide range of pathologies. Its use in clinical research, however, is limited by a lack of analysis software accessible to users without programming expertise. Existing tools are either script-based engineering frameworks or proprietary vendor applications. We present OPTARI, an open-source graphical software application to facilitate large-scale clinical optoacoustic-ultrasound (OPUS) studies. OPTARI builds on the napari image viewer and the PATATO toolkit for OptA data processing. It supports native vendor and open HDF5 data formats, aligns with the IPASC standard, and is distributed as a standalone executable. Features include region-of-interest annotation, reconstruction, chromophore unmixing, deep-learning-based tissue segmentation, and temporal and spectral analysis modules. OPTARI offers a combination of features for clinical study analysis that none of the compared tools provide. The automated tissue segmentation produced results comparable to expert labeling for muscle tissue, and batch processing reduced analysis time from minutes to under one second per scan. The tool is used in ongoing clinical OPUS studies. OPTARI connects engineering frameworks with medical research and provides an open-source basis for reproducible and standardized analysis in clinical OptA imaging studies.

AI.tldr: OPTARI：基于 napari 与 PATATO 的开源图形化光声-超声（OPUS）临床影像分析软件，支持 ROI 标注、重建、发色团解混、深度学习组织分割与时空谱分析，单次扫描批处理时间降至 1 秒以内。
AI.motivation: 光声与超声联合成像在临床研究中受限于缺少面向非编程用户的易用分析软件；现有工具为脚本化工程框架或厂商专有软件，难以支撑大规模临床研究。
AI.method: 构建开源 GUI 应用：以 napari 为可视化前端、PATATO 为光声数据处理后端；兼容厂商原生格式与开放 HDF5，对齐 IPASC 标准，打包为独立可执行文件；集成 ROI 标注、图像重建、发色团解混、深度学习组织分割与时间/频谱分析模块。
AI.result: 自动组织分割在肌肉组织上的结果与专家标注相当；批处理将单次扫描分析从数分钟缩短至不足 1 秒；功能组合优于对比工具；已在在研临床 OPUS 研究中实际使用。
AI.conclusion: OPTARI 打通工程框架与医学研究之间的鸿沟，为临床光声成像的可复现、标准化分析提供开源基础。

title: Online Continual Learning in Edge-Cloud Applications
summary: Deployed machine learning models in real-world IoT and edge/cloud systems face a critical reliability bottleneck: the requirement for online adaptation to non-stationary data streams while operating without access to the full original training dataset. Performance is severely degraded when models encounter Out-of-Distribution (OOD) inputs or suffer from catastrophic forgetting. Addressing these challenges requires adaptation mechanisms capable of learning from evolving data streams while preserving previously acquired knowledge. This paper proposes an edge-cloud methodology for integrating Continual Learning (CL) with Out-of-Distribution (OOD) Detection and Concept Drift Detection in IoT applications. The methodology incorporates ODIN and ECDD as alternative mechanisms for identifying informative samples for annotation and triggering rehearsal-based model updates. Experimental results across automotive, healthcare, and agricultural datasets demonstrate the applicability of the proposed methodology and its potential to support model adaptation while mitigating catastrophic forgetting.

AI.tldr: 提出边缘-云协同方法，将持续学习(CL)与OOD检测(ODIN)及概念漂移检测(ECDD)结合，用于IoT流数据下的模型在线自适应。
AI.motivation: 部署在IoT边缘/云系统中的模型需在无完整原始训练集条件下对非平稳数据流在线自适应，面临OOD输入与灾难性遗忘导致性能严重退化的问题。
AI.method: 以ODIN和ECDD作为互补机制识别信息量样本用于标注并触发基于回放(rehearsal)的模型更新，形成边缘-云持续学习流程。
AI.result: 在汽车、医疗健康、农业三类数据集上验证了方法的适用性，并显示可在支持模型自适应的同时缓解灾难性遗忘。
AI.conclusion: OOD检测与漂移检测兼具样本挑选功能，可作为低成本触发信号驱动回放式持续学习，实现受约束条件下的可靠部署更新。

title: From Perception to Pixels: Human-Derived Visually Distinct Colors for Improved Dominant Color Extraction
summary: Dominant color extraction is a fundamental task in computer vision, with applications in design, image retrieval, and content recommendation. However, conventional algorithms based on device-oriented color spaces (e.g., RGB) and fixed quantization often fail to capture how humans perceive color differences. In this study, we propose a human-perception-based framework for dominant color extraction, built on a novel Human Color Dictionary (HCD) derived from a perceptual experiment. Participants (n=110) were sequentially shown 120 colors and asked to identify those they perceived as unique. Based on their responses, we constructed a 120 by 120 co-occurrence matrix and applied a greedy selection algorithm to derive 64 perceptually distinct colors, forming the HCD. This dictionary was integrated into RGB color histogram and K-means color extraction algorithms by initializing centroids and mapping pixel values to their nearest perceptual color using the deltaE 00 distance. Evaluation on a dataset of 4,562 images paired with expert-designed palettes demonstrated that our method improves perceptual alignment, as measured by Earth Mover's Distance (EMD) and best-match distance. Our findings suggest no meaningful gender differences in the number of uniquely perceived colors, indicating that sex does not significantly influence color perception in this task. Another key finding is that highly saturated colors are perceived as the most distinguishable, whereas dark and deep colors tend to perceptually collapse and are less reliably differentiated. The results confirm that incorporating experimentally derived human color representations ensures the generated color clusters align more closely with human perception, thus improving the usability of color palette generation in practical applications.

AI.tldr: 提出基于人类感知的主色提取框架，通过感知实验构建"人类色彩词典"(HCD)，并以其初始化K-means与RGB直方图算法，使提取结果更贴近人类色彩感知。
AI.motivation: 传统主色提取依赖面向设备的色空间（如RGB）与固定量化，无法反映人类对色差的真实感知，导致生成的色板与专家/人眼判断不一致。
AI.method: 110名被试依次观看120种颜色并标注自认"独特"的颜色，据此构建120×120共现矩阵，用贪心选择算法得到64个感知上彼此区分的颜色构成HCD；将该词典以deltaE00距离做像素最近色映射并初始化K-means质心，同时集成进RGB直方图与K-means主色提取流程。
AI.result: 在4,562张图像及其专家设计色板数据集上，以EMD和最佳匹配距离评估，感知对齐度优于基线；未发现性别在独特色感知数量上有显著差异；高饱和色最易区分，暗色与深色在感知上易塌缩、区分度低。
AI.conclusion: 引入实验导出的感知色彩表示可显著提升颜色聚类与人类感知的一致性，改善实际应用中色板生成的可用性。

title: PathJev: Decision-Native Vision-Language Modelling for Histopathology
comment: 25 pages, 4 figures. Code: this https URL ; model and demo: this https URL
summary: Vision-language models used for decisions in histopathology rarely return calibrated probabilities over the candidates a user cares about. Decision-native models write a question and a candidate set chosen at run time into the input and return a normalised distribution from a small decision head in one forward pass. We build PathJev-P, a decision-native model for histopathology: MedGemma-1.5-4B with LoRA adapters and a decision head, trained on 40,000 patch states from three public collections whose expert labels are turned into typed questions with organ-specific candidate sets and a "none of these" option. In a comparison over 3 seeds with an analysis plan fixed before testing, on test sets without documented overlap with the training data of the backbone, PathJev-P is more accurate than a generative model trained with the same backbone, data and selection rule, the zero-shot pathology model CONCH and a general medical decision model (balanced accuracy 0.541 against 0.492, 0.345 and 0.213); its advantage over the generative model comes from two organs absent from training. The calibration advantage depends on how the generative model's probabilities are read out. With the summed candidate log-likelihood used in previous work, PathJev-P has the lower calibration error (ECE 0.204 against 0.279); with a length-normalised read-out of the same generative model, examined post hoc, the two have similar mean calibration error (0.201) and the generative model is better calibrated on the unseen organs, where PathJev-P remains over-confident. A supervised linear probe on a pathology foundation model is better calibrated in every setting. In a qualitative whole-slide demonstration, PathJev-P labels unsupervised tissue clusters with abstention and separates carcinoma from other tissue while running the model on a fraction of the tiles.

AI.tldr: 提出决策原生模型PathJev-P（MedGemma-1.5-4B+LoRA+决策头），在输入中写入问题与候选集，一次前向返回归一化分布；在组织病理数据上平衡准确率优于同等生成式模型、CONCH与通用医疗决策模型，但校准优势依赖读出方式，线性探针校准更好。
AI.motivation: 组织病理视觉语言模型用于决策时，很少对用户关心的候选集合输出校准概率；作者希望获得“决策原生”的模型，在一次前向中直接给出候选集上的归一化概率分布，而非通过生成文本再解析。
AI.method: 以MedGemma-1.5-4B为骨干，加LoRA适配器与小型决策头；将专家标签转化为带器官特异候选集和“none of these”选项的类型化问题；用三个公开数据集共40,000个patch状态训练；实验在测试前固定分析计划，3个随机种子比较；消融概率读出方式（候选对数似然求和 vs 长度归一化），并与监督线性探针（病理基础模型）对比校准，另做全切片定性演示。
AI.result: 平衡准确率0.541，对比同骨干同数据同选择规则的生成式模型0.492、zero-shot CONCH 0.345、通用医疗决策模型0.213；相对生成式模型的优势主要来自训练中未出现的两个器官。校准：对生成式模型取候选对数似然求和时ECE 0.204 vs 0.279；事后采用长度归一化读出时两者均值接近（0.201），且生成式模型在未见器官上校准更好，PathJev-P过自信。监督线性探针在所有设置下校准最优。全切片演示中，PathJev-P在部分tile上运行即可用弃权机制标注无监督组织簇并区分癌与其他组织。
AI.conclusion: 决策原生头部可在单次前向给出候选集上的归一化分布并提升准确率与部分场景校准，但其校准优势对生成式模型读出方式高度敏感，且仍不及线性探针；结论稳健性有限，属于医学影像领域的决策接口探索。

title: PCFBench: How Far Can Large Vision-Language Models Go in Physics-aware Photonic Inverse Design?
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026, 66 pages, 30 figures, 27 tables
summary: Photonic crystal fibers (PCFs) underpin critical applications in telecommunications, sensing, and high-power laser delivery, yet their design remains a manual, expert-intensive process that couples geometric intuition with deep waveguide physics. Vision-language models (VLMs) offer a promising path toward automating PCF design, but can they truly reason about photonic physics from microscopy images, or do they merely recognize visual patterns? We introduce PCFBench, the first comprehensive benchmark for evaluating VLMs on the perception, reasoning, and decision steps of the photonic inverse-design loop. PCFBench spans 26 tasks organized into six categories of increasing cognitive demand (Geometry Perception, Physics Understanding, Text Generation, Multi-modal Reasoning, Inverse-Design Decision, and Code Generation), built from over 220K FDTD simulation samples across 18 structurally diverse fiber families. We evaluate both individual VLMs on isolated tasks and multi-agent systems (MAS) on the full sequential pipeline from perception to design. Our results reveal a striking perception-design gap: current models can identify fiber geometry with moderate success, yet consistently fail to translate that visual understanding into physics-aware design actions. Moreover, cascading agents through the pipeline exposes significant error propagation, where upstream perception mistakes compound into downstream design failures. These findings suggest that neither model scaling nor naive agent chaining suffices, and that closing the loop demands explicit physical grounding. PCFBench provides the community with a rigorous, multi-dimensional testbed to measure progress toward AI-assisted photonic engineering. The project is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: PCFBench是首个系统评测视觉语言模型（VLM）在光子晶体光纤（PCF）逆向设计全流程（几何感知、物理理解、多模态推理、设计决策、代码生成）中能力的基准，含26项任务、6个认知层级、覆盖18类光纤结构与22万+FDTD仿真样本，揭示出"感知—设计鸿沟"与多智能体级联误差传播。
AI.motivation: PCF设计长期依赖专家手工迭代，耦合几何直觉与波导物理；VLM被视为自动化设计的可能路径，但其是否真正具备光子物理推理能力（而非仅做视觉模式匹配）尚缺乏量化评测手段。作者据此构建标准化、多维度的测试床。
AI.method: 构建PCFBench基准：以FDTD仿真生成大规模样本（>220K、18个结构族），按认知难度递增设计六类26项任务（Geometry Perception、Physics Understanding、Text Generation、Multi-modal Reasoning、Inverse-Design Decision、Code Generation）；既评测单体VLM的孤立任务表现，也评测多智能体系统（MAS）在"感知→设计"完整串行流水线上的端到端性能与误差传播。
AI.result: 实验显示明显"感知—设计鸿沟"：模型能以中等成功率识别光纤几何结构，但难以将视觉理解转化为符合物理约束的设计动作；智能体级联时上游感知错误显著累积放大，导致下游设计失败。
AI.conclusion: 仅靠模型规模扩展或简单串联智能体不足以闭环光子逆向设计，需引入显式物理接地（physical grounding）；PCFBench为AI辅助光子工程提供可度量进展的严格测试平台。

title: Efficient Zero-Shot Video Anomaly Detection via Signal-Aware Adaptive Fusion (SAAF)
summary: Deploying Vision-Language Models for video anomaly detection confronts a fundamental constraint. Their semantic reasoning demands computational budgets incompatible with the scale of real-world video streams. We present Signal-Aware Adaptive Fusion (SAAF), a framework that achieves efficient zero-shot anomaly detection through three key innovations. First, we introduce a dual-signal adaptive sampler operating in semantic embedding space: a delta signal captures sudden events via frame-to-frame cosine distance, while a drift signal detects static and gradual anomalies through deviation from rolling temporal context. Their OR-gated combination with adaptive EMA-based thresholding provides comprehensive anomaly coverage without training data. Second, we propose a threshold-gated cascaded architecture where lightweight frame-level scoring precedes expensive video-level temporal analysis, invoking it only when confidence warrants additional context. Third, we design a signal-aware weighted fusion mechanism that dynamically adapts score combination based on which signal triggered frame selection. Across four benchmarks, SAAF delivers competitive accuracy at substantially lower cost. Among training-free zero-shot methods, SAAF sets a new state of the art on XD-Violence (92.07%), MSAD (86.70%), and ShanghaiTech (80.54%) AUC-ROC, with XD-Violence and MSAD also surpassing supervised baselines. SAAF sustains 44.95, 48.61, and 41.06 FPS on XD-Violence, UCF-Crime, and MSAD, a 2.43$\times$, 2.63$\times$, and 2.22$\times$ throughput improvement over the prior best zero-shot method. Code: this https URL

AI.tldr: SAAF：在语义嵌入空间用"delta+漂移"双信号自适应采样 + 阈值门控级联架构 + 信号感知加权融合，实现免训练零样本视频异常检测，在XD-Violence/MSAD/ShanghaiTech刷新SOTA并显著提速。
AI.motivation: VLM做视频异常检测的语义推理开销与真实视频流规模严重不匹配；需要在无训练数据条件下兼顾异常覆盖完备性与推理效率。
AI.method: 三重设计：(1) 语义嵌入空间双信号采样器——帧间余弦距离的delta信号抓突变，相对滚动时序上下文的drift信号抓静止/渐变异常，OR门控加自适应EMA阈值；(2) 阈值门控级联架构——先做轻量帧级打分，仅在置信度足够时才触发昂贵的视频级时序分析；(3) 信号感知加权融合，按触发采样的信号动态调整打分组合。
AI.result: 四个基准上精度有竞争力且成本大幅下降：免训练零样本方法中，XD-Violence 92.07%、MSAD 86.70%、ShanghaiTech 80.54% AUC-ROC 均为SOTA，其中XD-Violence与MSAD超过监督基线；XD-Violence/UCF-Crime/MSAD吞吐44.95/48.61/41.06 FPS，较此前最佳零样本方法提升2.43×/2.63×/2.22×。
AI.conclusion: 信号感知的自适应采样与门控级联能有效把VLM语义推理预算集中到关键片段，实现零样本、低成本、超监督精度的视频异常检测；方法对"何时调用重模型"这一通用效率问题有可迁移思路。

title: L0-Norm-Based CycleGAN for Unpaired Brain CT-to-MR Synthesis
summary: Computed tomography (CT) and magnetic resonance (MR) imaging provide complementary information for the brain, but acquiring both modalities is not always possible. The cycle-consistent adversarial network (CycleGAN) enables unpaired CT-to-MR synthesis, but because the standard L1-norm cycle?consistency penalty grows linearly with the residual magnitude, the network tends to focus on large residuals. This paper introduces an L0-norm-based cycle?consistency term, in which the L0-norm is approximated by a smooth and bounded function. This approximation not only increases sensitivity to small residuals but also effectively suppresses the influence of large residuals. The proposed model and an otherwise identical L1-norm baseline were trained on 102 images and evaluated on 9 test images. The proposed model achieves a lower mean squared error (0.02746 versus 0.03464, a 20.7% reduction), a higher mean peak signal-to-noise ratio (15.80 versus 14.77 dB), and a higher mean structural similarity index (0.5689 versus 0.5407). It also has a lower maximum MSE and higher minimum PSNR and SSIM than the baseline. These results indicate that modifying the cycle-consistency penalty can improve reconstruction accuracy on this dataset.

AI.tldr: 提出以平滑有界函数近似 L0 范数的循环一致性惩罚，替代 CycleGAN 中的 L1 惩罚用于无配对 CT→MR 合成，在 9 例测试集上 MSE、PSNR、SSIM 均优于 L1 基线。
AI.motivation: CT 与 MR 对脑部成像信息互补，但难以同时获取。CycleGAN 可实现无配对 CT→MR 合成，然而标准 L1 循环一致性惩罚随残差幅值线性增长，导致网络过度关注大残差、忽视小残差，限制重建精度。
AI.method: 将循环一致性项改为 L0 范数（近似为平滑且有界函数）：该近似提升对小残差的敏感度，同时抑制大残差的影响。与结构完全相同的 L1 基线在同一数据上对比，102 张训练图像，9 张测试图像。
AI.result: MSE 0.02746 vs 0.03464（降低 20.7%）；峰值信噪比 15.80 vs 14.77 dB；SSIM 0.5689 vs 0.5407；且最大 MSE 更低、最小 PSNR 与 SSIM 更高，说明改进在 worst-case 上也更稳健。
AI.conclusion: 修改循环一致性惩罚形式可提升该数据集上的重建精度，属于对 CycleGAN 损失设计的轻量改进；但验证仅限 9 例医学图像，且绝对指标偏低（PSNR ~15.8 dB），泛化性与临床可用性尚未验证。

title: K-CLUE: A Segmentation-to-Clustering Framework for Ki67 Cell Typing
comment: Accepted at the BD-MedVis Workshop, BMVC 2026
summary: Ki67 is a key marker of tumor proliferation in breast cancer, but its quantification from immunohistochemistry images normally depends on supervised classifiers trained per dataset. We examine the role of frozen pretrained visual representations in annotation-free Ki67 cell typing. To this end, we use K-CLUE, a framework that segments individual nuclei, represents each nucleus with a pretrained encoder, reduces the resulting embeddings with principal component analysis, and separates Ki67-positive from Ki67-negative nuclei using k-means clustering, without task-specific training or manual annotations. Clustering the raw components is highly sensitive to the choice of encoder: across seven encoders, the Ki67-positive F1-score on matched MIST nuclei varies by 44 points, although Ki67 status remains linearly decodable from every representation, with supervised probe AUCs above 0.98. Analysis of the embedding spaces shows that clustering succeeds when DAB-related variation occupies the leading directions of variance. Whitening the retained principal components removes this dependence, reducing the spread across encoders to 1.00 F1-score point. Handcrafted color representations are also competitive, confirming that Ki67 status is strongly reflected in chromatic information, but they require an explicit choice of color space. In end-to-end evaluation, K-CLUE reaches F1-scores of 85.00% and 81.91% for Ki67-positive and Ki67-negative nuclei on MIST, and 79.59% and 81.16% on BCData, outperforming DeepLIIF and IHCScoreGAN on both datasets. These results show that pretrained representations can support annotation-free Ki67 typing when their variance structure is accounted for.

AI.tldr: 冻结预训练视觉表征可用于无标注的Ki67细胞分型，但需通过白化处理使DAB相关变异占据主方差方向，从而消除对编码器选择的敏感性。
AI.motivation: Ki67免疫组化图像的定量通常依赖针对每个数据集单独训练的有监督分类器，缺乏标注时难以迁移。作者希望考察冻结预训练表征能否在无标注、无任务训练条件下完成Ki67阳/阴性细胞判定。
AI.method: 采用K-CLUE框架：分割单核，用预训练编码器提取嵌入，PCA降维，再用k-means将细胞分为Ki67阳性与阴性。对比7种编码器，并在保留的主成分上做白化以去除聚类对编码器方差结构的依赖；另考察手工颜色表征。
AI.result: 直接对原始主成分聚类时，MIST匹配核上的Ki67阳性F1在7种编码器间波动达44个百分点，而线性探针AUC均超过0.98；白化后编码器间差异收缩至1.00个F1点。端到端评估中MIST阳/阴性F1为85.00%/81.91%，BCData为79.59%/81.16%，均优于DeepLIIF与IHCScoreGAN。
AI.conclusion: 预训练表征可支撑无标注Ki67分型，但前提是处理其方差结构；聚类成功的关键在于DAB相关变异处于方差主导方向。该结论对无监督细胞分型的编码器鲁棒性具有方法学启示。

title: Distortion-Aware Spatiotemporal Learning for Real-Time Wide-Angle Video Rectification
summary: While wide-angle lenses provide an expanded field of view (FoV), they exhibit severe nonlinear distortion near image boundaries, unnaturally stretching people in these regions. Existing methods mostly focus on facial regions, require high computational costs, and lack temporal modeling, resulting in incomplete full-body rectification, impractical real-time deployment, and noticeable inter-frame shakes. To tackle these issues, we propose \textbf{FastVC}, an efficient full-body video rectification framework driven by distortion-aware spatiotemporal learning. Grounded in lens physics, FastVC introduces a distortion-aware thin-plate spline (DA-TPS) module that nonlinearly remaps control points into a peripheral-dense layout, enabling more accurate geometric fitting without additional computational cost. We further develop a dual-level spatiotemporal learning scheme for causal and stable video rectification. At the model level, neighborhood spatiotemporal attention (NST) aggregates local context and selectively fuses historical features with low overhead. At the optimization level, sparse spatiotemporal supervision applies spatial alignment only to anchor frames, decoupling frame-wise accuracy from temporal stability. Besides, we contribute the first benchmark dataset for wide-angle full-body video correction. Extensive experiments show that FastVC achieves state-of-the-art rectification fidelity and visual stability at 57.0 FPS.

AI.tldr: FastVC：基于畸变感知时空学习的广角全身体视频矫正框架，含DA-TPS、邻域时空注意力与稀疏时空监督，并构建首个广角全身体视频矫正基准，57 FPS达SOTA。
AI.motivation: 广角镜头视野大但在边界处存在强烈非线性畸变，导致人物被拉伸。现有方法多只处理人脸、计算开销大、缺乏时序建模，因而无法完成全身体矫正、难以实时部署且帧间抖动明显。
AI.method: 1) 基于镜头物理的畸变感知薄板样条模块DA-TPS，将控制点非线性重映射为周边密集布局，在不增加计算量的前提下提升几何拟合精度；2) 双层时空学习：模型层面用邻域时空注意力（NST）聚合局部上下文并低开销融合历史特征，优化层面用稀疏时空监督仅对锚帧施加空间对齐，解耦逐帧精度与时间稳定性；3) 构建首个广角全身体视频矫正基准数据集。
AI.result: 在矫正保真度与视觉稳定性上达到SOTA，运行速度57.0 FPS；实现全身体完整矫正并抑制帧间抖动。
AI.conclusion: 将镜头物理先验嵌入控制点布局、并以轻量时空建模与锚帧监督兼顾精度与稳定性，为实时全身体广角视频矫正提供了可行方案与评测基准。

title: Augmentation Strategy for DINO in Glaucoma Classification
comment: 11 pages, 3 figures. Accepted at the 17th International Workshop on Machine Learning in Medical Imaging (MLMI 2026), held in conjunction with MICCAI 2026
summary: Self-supervised learning (SSL) offers a promising approach to medical image representation learning, yet augmentation strategies of SSL frameworks validated on natural images do not reliably transfer to specialized medical imaging domains. We analyze DINO, a knowledge-distillation based SSL framework, and empirically demonstrate that its default augmentation strategy produces unreliable representations for retinal fundus images, degrading downstream glaucoma classification performance. Guided by the principle that effective cropped views should share minimal redundant information while retaining clinically relevant signal, we redesign DINO's augmentation strategy. Our approach biases the learned representations toward diagnostically critical features rather than low-level image statistics. We evaluate our method for glaucoma classification by training a linear classifier on the frozen representations, achieving strong generalization across seven benchmark datasets. URL for code and weights: this https URL

AI.tldr: 分析DINO自监督框架在视网膜眼底图像上默认增强策略的失效问题，并基于"裁剪视图应共享最少冗余信息同时保留临床信号"原则重新设计增强策略，使表示偏向诊断关键特征。
AI.motivation: 在自然图像上验证有效的SSL增强策略不能可靠迁移到专业医学影像领域；DINO默认增强在视网膜眼底图像上产生不可靠表示，劣化青光眼分类下游性能。
AI.method: 分析DINO（知识蒸馏式SSL框架）的经验性失效；依据"有效裁剪视图间最小冗余信息 + 保留临床相关信号"的原则重新设计DINO的增强策略，使学到的表示偏向诊断关键特征而非低层图像统计量。
AI.result: 在冻结表示上训练线性分类器进行青光眼分类，在七个基准数据集上取得强泛化表现；论文公开了代码与权重。
AI.conclusion: SSL增强策略需针对医学影像领域做领域特定重设计；以临床诊断相关性为导向的裁剪增强能显著提升跨数据集的迁移泛化性。

title: Fast and Useful: Adapting Distilled Generators for Visual Learning
summary: Distilled text-to-image models generate images quickly, but classifiers trained on those images can perform substantially worse than classifiers trained on images from their slower base models. We adapt released distilled generators to produce better training data while retaining fast generation. We fit a low-rank update to the student's first prediction so that it reaches an intermediate state produced by its unguided base, then disable the update and let the unchanged student finish generation. The base supplies training targets and is absent at inference. Guided targets and shorter jumps give classifiers lower accuracy in our ablations, showing why the state used for supervision matters. Across three generator families, the adapted images train better classifiers than images from the released students. With class-name templates at full ImageNet-1k scale, ResNet-50 top-1 rises from 8.4% to 34.2% for FLUX.2-klein and from 12.7% to 32.1% for SD-Turbo, using two and three denoiser evaluations per image, respectively. Fixed adapters also improve results on additional classes, fine-grained datasets, and other learner architectures and training recipes. Template-based adaptation remains useful against richer-prompt alternatives, while the benefit of combining adaptation with LLM generation prompts depends on the generator. Adapting a single generation step makes fast generators substantially more useful for training visual models.

AI.tldr: 通过给蒸馏生成器的首步预测拟合一个低秩更新，使其到达无引导基模的中间状态，随后关闭该更新完成生成，从而在保持快速推理的同时产出可训练出更好分类器的图像数据。
AI.motivation: 蒸馏/少步文生图模型生成快，但其生成图像训练出的分类器性能明显弱于慢速基模生成的图像；作者希望在不牺牲推理速度的前提下改善这些生成数据的训练价值。
AI.method: 对已发布蒸馏学生模型的第一步去噪预测拟合低秩适配器（fixed adapter），使其匹配无引导基模产生的中间状态；之后关闭该更新，由未修改的学生模型完成剩余生成。基模仅离线提供监督目标与训练目标，推理时不参与。对引导目标、跳步长度做了消融。
AI.result: 在三个生成器家族上均优于原学生模型图像；ImageNet-1k 全量、类名模板提示下，FLUX.2-klein 的 ResNet-50 top-1 从 8.4% 提升至 34.2%（每图 2 次去噪评估），SD-Turbo 从 12.7% 提升至 32.1%（每图 3 次评估）；固定适配器在额外类别、细粒度数据集、其他学习器架构与训练配方上同样有效；相比更丰富提示，基于模板的适配仍有优势，适配与 LLM 生成提示的协同收益依生成器而异。
AI.conclusion: 只需适配一个生成步，即可显著提升快速蒸馏生成器在视觉模型训练数据上的实用价值；用于监督的中间状态选择至关重要。

title: VERA-Hand: A Verified Multidimensional Benchmark for 2D Hand Pose Estimation in Third-Person Dynamic Gesture Videos
summary: Hand landmarks serve as input for gesture recognition, sign language understanding, and touchless human-computer interaction. Yet hand pose estimators are typically evaluated with frame-wise localization metrics such as PCK or MPJPE, which are computed over matched predictions and overlook missed or spurious hands, handedness errors, and temporal instability. To address these limitations, we present VERA-Hand, a benchmark that evaluates estimators using manually verified, frame-level 2D annotations for 10,690 hands across four complementary dimensions (detection, localization, identification, and temporal stability), as well as a joint Pose-F1 metric that requires both correct detection and accurate localization. Evaluating six estimators spanning hand-specific, whole-body, reconstruction-based, and foundation-model paradigms, we find that no estimator dominates: rankings reorder sharply across dimensions. VERA-Hand also exposes failures that localization-only and downstream evaluations may not reveal, including cross-hand overlap in over 85% of frames for a recent foundation model. A post-hoc cleanup case study demonstrates how the benchmark can validate corrective interventions, while stratified analyses show that robustness varies across motion-blur classes and hand regions. We release the verified annotations, protocol, and code at this https URL

AI.tldr: VERA-Hand 是一个手部姿态估计基准，使用人工核验的帧级 2D 标注（10,690 只手），从检测、定位、左右手识别、时序稳定性四个维度评测，并提出联合 Pose-F1 指标；对六类估计器的评测显示各维度排名不一致。
AI.motivation: 现有手部姿态估计器通常只用逐帧局部化指标（PCK、MPJPE）在匹配后的预测上评估，忽略了漏检/误检、左右手判别错误与时序不稳定，导致评测与实际应用（手势识别、手语理解、非接触交互）脱节。
AI.method: 构建 VERA-Hand 基准：对 10,690 只手进行人工核验的帧级 2D 标注，设计检测、定位、左右手识别、时序稳定性四维评测协议，并引入要求同时满足正确检测与准确定位的 Pose-F1 联合指标；评测六种估计器（手部专用、全身、重建式、基础模型范式），并进行后处理清理案例研究与按运动模糊类别/手部区域的分层分析。
AI.result: 无单一估计器在各维度占优，维度间排名显著重排；暴露出仅局部化与下游评测难以发现的失败模式，如某近期基础模型在超过 85% 帧中出现左右手重叠；后处理清理实验可验证纠错干预效果，分层分析显示鲁棒性随运动模糊等级与手部区域变化。
AI.conclusion: 评测手部姿态估计需从单一局部化指标转向多维度、包含检测与识别的联合评估；VERA-Hand 公开标注、协议与代码，可作为纠错方法的验证平台。

title: From Freehand Demonstrations to Autonomous Robotic Ultrasound: An Anatomy-Anchored Learning Framework
summary: Ultrasound imaging is highly operator-dependent, motivating robotic systems that reproduce expert scanning skills consistently. These skills involve coordinated interpretation of anatomical landmarks, ultrasound images, and probe-tissue interactions that are difficult to encode in hand-designed control strategies. Imitation learning offers an alternative, but its observation and action representations should reflect the anatomically structured nature of scanning. We propose an anatomy-anchored imitation-learning framework that combines anatomy-guided probe placement with learned ultrasound navigation. The placement module identifies a task-specific anatomical starting point from external visual observations and establishes the initial probe pose as the reference frame for scanning. A flow-based policy then generates scanning motions from anchor-relative probe poses, ultrasound images, probe-mounted camera views, and contact forces, while a termination head predicts task completion. This avoids continuous reliance on third-person vision and reduces dependence on the robot-patient configuration. A handheld acquisition platform enables multimodal demonstrations to be collected during natural freehand scanning without a robot. On 16 unseen participants, task success reaches 96%, 94%, 88%, and 94% for kidney, gallbladder, and liver standard-plane acquisition and radial artery sweeping, respectively. Compared with a fine-tuned pi_0 model, success on the abdominal tasks improves by 10-42 percentage points, with lower time-to-target, peak contact force, and trajectory jerk. Ablations support the complementary roles of anatomical anchoring, egocentric vision, and force feedback. End-to-end trials with automatic placement achieve 90-100% success, and the policies transfer without retraining to a second robot with 83-100% success.

AI.tldr: 提出解剖锚定的模仿学习框架：先用外部视觉确定解剖起始点并以其为扫描参考系，再用基于流的策略结合锚点相对位姿、超声图像、探头相机视角与接触力生成扫描动作，配合终止预测头；用手持采集平台在自然人扫查中收集多模态示教。
AI.motivation: 超声成像高度依赖操作者，需机器人复现专家扫查技能；但扫查涉及解剖标志、超声图像与探头-组织交互的协同，难以手工编码，而标准模仿学习的观测/动作表征未体现解剖结构。
AI.method: 两阶段：解剖引导的探头放置模块（外部视觉定位任务相关解剖起点，建立初始探头位姿为参考系）+ 基于流的扫描策略（输入锚点相对位姿、超声图像、探头相机图像、接触力）+ 终止预测头；手持采集平台在免机器人自由手扫查中采集多模态示教，避免持续依赖第三人称视觉。
AI.result: 16名未见被试上，肾脏、胆囊、肝脏标准切面获取与桡动脉扫掠成功率分别为96%、94%、88%、94%；较微调pi_0在腹部任务提升10–42个百分点，到达时间、峰值接触力与轨迹抖动更低；消融验证解剖锚定、自视角视觉与力反馈的互补作用；端到端自动放置成功率90–100%，策略零重训迁移至第二台机器人成功率83–100%。
AI.conclusion: 以解剖锚定参考系+多模态力/视觉输入的表征设计可显著提升超声扫查模仿学习的鲁棒性与跨机器人、跨被试泛化性，为技能型医疗机器人策略学习提供可复用的范式。

title: Facultative Swarming: A Capability, Not a Category, for Multi-Robot Systems
summary: Collective robotics is split by a long-standing but increasingly artificial boundary between centralised multi-robot systems that prioritise optimality and decentralised swarms that prioritise robustness and adaptivity. We propose a unified control framework, shifting from `obligate' swarms---systems constrained to pure self-organisation---to facultatively swarming systems: hybrid architectures that operate as centrally planned systems under permissive conditions yet degrade gracefully into decentralised swarming under environmental stress. By reframing swarming as a dynamic capability, rather than a rigid system category, we outline a pathway towards collective robotic systems that benefit from centralised optimality when conditions permit and from the flexibility of self-organisation when they do not.

AI.tldr: 提出"兼性集群"（facultative swarming）统一控制框架：系统在条件宽松时按集中式规划运行以获得最优性，在环境压力下平滑退化为去中心化自组织集群以保持鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 集中式多机器人系统与去中心化集群长期被人为分割——前者追求最优性，后者追求鲁棒性与自适应性。该二分法日益显得刻意，缺乏兼具两者优势的统一架构。
AI.method: 概念/框架层面工作：将"集群行为"从刚性系统类别重塑为一种动态能力，定义"兼性集群系统"这一混合架构类别，并勾勒其在宽松/受压两种环境条件下的运行模式切换路径。
AI.result: 摘要为立场/展望类论文，未提供具体算法、实验或实机验证结果；仅提出分类重构与设计方向的论述框架。
AI.conclusion: 兼性集群可作为弥合集中式最优性与自组织灵活性之间鸿沟的研究路线图，但需后续具体控制律、切换准则与实机实验加以支撑。

title: Optimization, Optimal Control, and Reinforcement Learning for Robotics
comment: Preliminary lecture notes, version 1. Compiled and edited by Yonghyeon Lee through a human and AI collaborative writing process. No figures; revisions and expansions are planned
summary: These lecture notes provide an introduction to optimization, optimal control, and reinforcement learning for robotics, emphasizing their mathematical connections and practical relevance. They present established material compiled and edited by Yonghyeon Lee, rather than new research results. The notes were developed through a human and AI collaborative writing process, with AI assistance in drafting, organizing, and refining the exposition. This first version is a preliminary collection of notes, not yet a fully developed textbook, and currently contains no figures or graphs. The notes may be revised, corrected, and expanded in future versions.

AI.tldr: 机器人优化、最优控制与强化学习的讲义（非新研究），AI 辅助撰写，无图，初版。
AI.motivation: 为机器人学习提供统一的数学视角，把优化、最优控制与强化学习联系起来，服务教学与入门。
AI.method: 讲义式综述/教学编排：整理已有成熟材料，由人机协作撰写与润色，强调数学联系与实践相关性。
AI.result: 产出为初版讲义合集，无图表，尚无实验或新结果。
AI.conclusion: 适合作为背景学习资料，未来版本可能修订扩充；不提供新方法或可验证证据。

title: HGWM: Hierarchical Graph-Guided World Model for Zero-Shot Object Navigation via Graph Matching
summary: Zero-shot object navigation requires an embodied agent to choose where to search while retaining evidence from previous observations. HGWM couples an LLM-generated room-anchor prior with persistent spatial-semantic memory. A coarse stage assigns visual-semantic scores to candidate headings on a 0-10 scale; a fine stage measures symbolic compatibility between observed objects, room context, and the goal prior. Phase-dependent fusion combines these scores with an LLM direction recommendation before local action selection. On HM3D v0.1, the reported HGWM configuration achieves 62.6% success rate (SR) and 31.5% success weighted by path length (SPL), compared with 58.1% and 31.2% for WMNav. On MP3D, the corresponding values are 46.8% and 17.9%, compared with 45.4% and 17.2%. The results indicate higher success point estimates and modest path-efficiency gains. On HM3D v0.2, the full model obtains 74.4% SR and 31.9% SPL. Additional component ablations reduce SR by 0.9-2.3 percentage points and SPL by 0.6-1.5 points. These are author-reported aggregate measurements. The accompanying implementation repairs pass offline tests; episode-level rerun records are not available. Evaluation is confined to simulation.

AI.tldr: HGWM将LLM生成的房间锚点先验与持久空间-语义记忆耦合，用粗粒度（视觉-语义0-10打分）加细粒度（符号兼容性）两级评分，配合LLM方向建议做分阶段融合，用于零样本目标导航。
AI.motivation: 零样本身份目标导航需要智能体在搜索时保留历史观测证据并决定搜索方向，现有世界模型/记忆方法在房间级先验与符号推理结合上不足。
AI.method: LLM生成房间锚点先验＋持久空间-语义记忆；粗阶段对候选朝向做0-10视觉-语义打分，细阶段衡量观测物体、房间上下文与目标先验的符号兼容性；阶段相关融合结合LLM方向推荐，再做局部动作选择。
AI.conclusion: 方法在仿真基准上取得更高成功点估计与有限路径效率提升，但提升幅度小、仅作者自报聚合结果、缺少episode级复跑记录且未做真机验证。

title: UAV-SwarmAgent: Scalable Multi-UAV Reconnaissance and Task Allocation via Code Generation and Vision-Language Reasoning
summary: Supervising a multi-UAV reconnaissance mission usually means plotting waypoints and watching every drone. We present UAV SwarmAgent, a hierarchical multi-agent system in which an operator states the mission in one natural-language sentence and a ground-station agent writes and executes code that turns it into per-UAV routes. The agent grounds inspection targets in an aerial map with a vision-language model, splits them among N UAVs by balancing route length, and dispatches worker agents that verify incidents with a compact onboard decision model. In simulation over 4 incident types and 3 foundation models, the swarm located the incident in 244 of 255 missions (95.7%). A paired scaling study with one to 5 UAVs shows that flight time follows an Amdahl-type law. The second UAV delivers half of the attainable saving and the speedup is bounded at 1.52x. We discuss what this predictability, and the false alarms we observed, imply for an operator who supervises the swarm, and outline the user study needed to test it.

AI.tldr: UAV SwarmAgent：单句自然语言下达任务，地面站智能体生成并执行代码，为N架无人机分配侦察航点，并用机载紧凑决策模型核验事件；仿真中95.7%任务定位到事件，飞行时间呈Amdahl型缩放（上限1.52×）。
AI.motivation: 多无人机侦察任务通常需要人工逐点规划航点并逐一监视每架无人机，操作负担重；作者希望让操作者只用一句自然语言描述任务即可完成多机侦察规划与执行。
AI.method: 分层多智能体系统：地面站智能体以代码生成-执行方式把自然语言任务转成逐机航线；用视觉语言模型在航拍地图上定位巡检目标；以路径长度均衡为准则在N架无人机间划分目标；下发worker智能体，用轻量机载决策模型现场核验事件。
AI.result: 仿真中4类事件×3个基础模型共255次任务，244次成功定位（95.7%）；1–5架无人机的配对缩放实验显示飞行时间服从Amdahl型规律，第二架无人机贡献可达节省量的一半，加速比上限为1.52×；同时观察到误报现象。
AI.conclusion: 多机收益可预测且存在理论上限，这对操作者的监督方式有直接含义；误报需纳入监督界面设计。作者仅给出设想，尚需用户研究验证人机交互层面的有效性。

title: HEALPix-Based Implicit Neural Compression of Omnidirectional Images
comment: [N] pages, 10 figures, 4 tables. Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Image Processing
summary: Real-time decoding of omnidirectional images is essential for immersive virtual reality (VR) experiences. Compared with conventional transform-based learned image compression (LIC), overfitted codecs offer lower decoding complexity by representing each image with a lightweight implicit neural representation (INR). However, existing approaches typically operate on the equirectangular projection (ERP), which introduces nonuniform spherical sampling and spatial distortion, leading to redundant sampling near the poles and latitude-dependent receptive fields. To address these limitations, we propose a spherical overfitted codec based on a multi-scale Hierarchical Equal Area isoLatitude Pixelization (HEALPix) representation, which enables equal-area sampling and efficient hierarchical modeling of spherical signals. Building on this representation, we develop a Spherical Inter-Scale Conditional entropy model that exploits spatial dependencies and cross-scale correlations among HEALPix latents to improve coding efficiency. We further introduce a Multi-Ring Spherical Convolution that aggregates neighboring pixels over a nearly uniform spherical receptive field across latitudes. Experiments on a public omnidirectional image dataset demonstrate BD-rate reductions of 16.3%, 26.5%, and 19.5% over VVC in terms of V-PSNR, V-MS-SSIM, and V-LPIPS, respectively. Our method also achieves a 13.1% BD-rate reduction over ERP-based Cool-Chic 5.0 in terms of V-PSNR, while providing 2.6-3.6x faster decoding than the evaluated learned autoencoder codecs.

AI.tldr: 提出基于HEALPix多尺度球面表示的过拟合神经编解码器，配合球面跨尺度条件熵模型与多环球面卷积，实现全景图像低复杂度实时解码，BD-rate较VVC降低16.3%（V-PSNR）。
AI.motivation: 全景/VR图像需实时解码。过拟合式LIC（如Cool-Chic）以轻量INR表示单图，解码复杂度低于变换式LIC，但现有方法基于ERP投影，存在球面采样不均匀、极点附近冗余采样、感受野随纬度变化等失真问题。
AI.method: 1）采用多尺度HEALPix像素化表示球面信号，实现等面积采样与分层建模；2）设计球面跨尺度条件熵模型（Spherical Inter-Scale Conditional），同时建模HEALPix潜变量的空间依赖与跨尺度相关性以提升编码效率；3）提出多环球面卷积（Multi-Ring Spherical Convolution），在各纬度上以近均匀球面感受野聚合邻域像素。
AI.result: 在公开全景图像数据集上，相对VVC在V-PSNR、V-MS-SSIM、V-LPIPS上分别取得16.3%、26.5%、19.5%的BD-rate增益；相对基于ERP的Cool-Chic 5.0在V-PSNR上再降13.1% BD-rate；解码速度比所对比的学习式自编码器编解码器快2.6–3.6倍。
AI.conclusion: 球面等面积表示可有效消除ERP极区冗余与感受野畸变，在提升全景图像压缩效率的同时保持低解码复杂度，适合沉浸式VR的实时解码需求。

title: Shared Is Not Enough: Predictor Width and Factor Readability Under Masked Latent Prediction
summary: Masked latent prediction methods such as I-JEPA aim to learn predictable features, but what determines which information they retain is less clear. We built a simulator in which every factor behind an image is known, so a probe can measure how readable each factor remains after training. We trained small encoders (0.7M parameters) with I-JEPA, SimCLR and BYOL on the same pairs of views and probed a factor that both views share. I-JEPA had a predictor with half the encoder's width and depth, the proportions it uses for ViT-B. Its median score was about 40% of SimCLR's. Widening the predictor to the encoder's width reversed this ordering at every training seed, against both other methods. We release the simulator and the trained models.

AI.tldr: 在可控因子模拟器上训练小规模编码器（I-JEPA / SimCLR / BYOL），用线性探针测量共享因子的可读性，发现 I-JEPA 默认窄预测器（宽度深度为编码器一半）使其表征信息量仅为 SimCLR 的约 40%，而将预测器加宽至编码器规模后排序完全反转。
AI.motivation: 掩码潜变量预测（如 I-JEPA）旨在学习可预测特征，但"保留哪些信息"由什么决定尚不清楚；作者希望用因子已知的合成数据定位该决定性因素。
AI.method: 构建每个图像因子均已知的模拟器，可对训练后表征逐因子做探针评估；在相同视图对（同增广分布）上训练 0.7M 参数的小编码器，比较 I-JEPA、SimCLR、BYOL；对两视图共享的因子做可读性探针；I-JEPA 预测器采用 ViT-B 比例（宽度与深度为编码器一半），并做"预测器加宽至编码器宽度"的对照实验，跨多个训练随机种子重复。
AI.result: I-JEPA 探针得分中位数约为 SimCLR 的 40%；将预测器宽度提升至与编码器相同后，在每个训练种子下 I-JEPA 对所有共享因子的可读性均反超 SimCLR 与 BYOL，排序完全反转。
AI.conclusion: 掩码潜变量预测所保留的信息量在很大程度上由预测器容量（相对编码器的宽度/深度）而非目标函数本身决定；标准的非对称窄预测器设计可能系统性地丢弃共享信息。未涉及机器人、3D 重建或世界模型实验，属表征学习机制分析。

title: Reuse, Don't Retrain: Efficient, Modality-Versatile Geospatial Foundation Models through Feature Distillation
summary: Geospatial foundation models (GeoFMs) are costly to pretrain, yet model families often repeat this process across backbone scales and sensing modalities. We investigate feature distillation as a more efficient way to reuse existing representations. First, we distill frozen CROMA and TerraMind teachers into smaller Vision Transformers through patch-level feature matching. Across nine PANGAEA tasks, distilled TerraMind Tiny, Small, and Base outperform their scale-matched released counterparts by 2.76, 3.02, and 1.87 mean IoU points, respectively; each also matches or exceeds the next-larger released model. Distilled CROMA-Base gains 2.05 points. TerraMind-Base required only 43 A6000 GPU-hours, approximately 0.5\% of the reported cost of independent pretraining. Second, we introduce TEDI, an unpaired multi-expert approach combining TerraMind for multispectral imagery and DINOv3 for high-resolution RGB. Separate patch embeddings route unpaired inputs into a shared Transformer trunk, removing the need for co-registered data. TEDI-Large achieves the highest single-model mean in our PANGAEA-9 comparison (62.51 mIoU), outperforming both teachers overall while retaining their modality-specific strengths. TEDI-Base reaches 61.75 mIoU with 72\% fewer parameters. These results show that distillation improves the GeoFM accuracy-compute frontier while consolidating complementary experts into a single versatile backbone.

AI.tldr: Geospatial foundation models can be reused via patch-level feature distillation from frozen CROMA/TerraMind teachers into small ViTs, and via TEDI, an unpaired multi-expert distillation combining TerraMind (multispectral) and DINOv3 (high-res RGB) in a shared trunk.
AI.motivation: Pretraining geospatial foundation models is expensive, and existing model families redundantly repeat the process across backbone scales and sensing modalities; a cheaper way to reuse representations is needed.
AI.method: (1) Patch-level feature matching distillation from frozen CROMA and TerraMind teachers into smaller Vision Transformers; (2) TEDI: separate patch embeddings route unpaired inputs (TerraMind multispectral, DINOv3 high-res RGB) into a shared Transformer trunk, avoiding co-registered data requirements.
AI.result: Across nine PANGAEA tasks, distilled TerraMind Tiny/Small/Base outperform scale-matched released counterparts by 2.76/3.02/1.87 mean IoU, each matching or exceeding the next-larger released model; distilled CROMA-Base gains +2.05; TerraMind-Base distillation costs only 43 A6000 GPU-hours (~0.5% of independent pretraining). TEDI-Large reaches 62.51 mIoU (best single model), surpassing both teachers; TEDI-Base reaches 61.75 mIoU with 72% fewer parameters.
AI.conclusion: Distillation improves the accuracy-compute frontier of GeoFMs and consolidates complementary modality experts into a single versatile backbone.

title: Standing on Open Shoulders: Regional Fine-Tuning of Open-Weight Camera-Trap Models for UK Wildlife with Modest Data and Compute
summary: Camera-trap species classification is dominated by large models from well-resourced organisations, which often lack the species-level distinctions regional conservation needs, such as native red versus invasive grey squirrels in the UK. We ask whether open weights let a small team with a modest dataset and a single GPU take a real part in AI development. We fine-tuned the open DeepFaune classifier on 28 UK classes, paired it with the unmodified MegaDetector v6, and compared the resulting DeepFaune-UK v1.2 with DeepFaune v1.5.0 and SpeciesNet on 20,212 hand-verified MammalWeb citizen-science images, after removing sequences sharing any of 1,039 images with our training archive. DeepFaune-UK achieved a strict image-level accuracy of 88.8%, including empty frames, against 56.5% and 59.0% for the baselines, but at DeepFaune's coarser label resolution DeepFaune v1.5.0 was more accurate, though not significantly under contributor resampling (91.4% vs. 88.8%). As DeepFaune v1.5.0 uses a newer DINOv3-based classifier, we applied the identical recipe, without new data, to that classifier. The resulting DeepFaune-UK v1.3 reached 90.6% strict accuracy, narrowed the like-for-like gap to 0.8 points and reduced roe deer misclassified as fallow deer by 69%. On 1,850 images from the 26 contributors with no overlapping images, the three DeepFaune-based models did not differ significantly (90.5%, 90.6%, 89.9% like-for-like). Fine-tuning on 10% of the training crops (about 150 per class) gave out-of-distribution accuracy similar to using all of them, and a DINOv2 run on this subset took about 22 minutes with under 4 GB of GPU memory. Open weights thus make regional model development feasible for small teams, but the largest like-for-like gain came from a newer base model trained by others, so this democratisation depends on large actors continuing to release open weights, under licences that may change.

AI.tldr: 开放式权重能让小团队在单块GPU上完成地区性相机陷阱物种分类微调，但最大收益来自他人训练的更新基座模型。
AI.motivation: 相机陷阱物种分类被资源雄厚机构的大模型主导，且常缺少地区保护所需的物种级区分（如英国本土红松鼠与入侵灰松鼠）；作者检验开源权重能否让小团队以有限数据和单卡GPU参与AI开发。
AI.method: 在开放DeepFaune分类器上对28个英国类别微调，搭配未修改的MegaDetector v6，得到DeepFaune-UK v1.2；与DeepFaune v1.5.0和SpeciesNet在20,212张人工核验的MammalWeb公民科学图像上比较，并剔除与训练档案1,039张图像存在重叠的序列。随后将相同配方无新增数据地迁移到基于DINOv3的新分类器，得到v1.3；并做10%训练裁剪（每类约150张）的消融与贡献者重采样显著性检验。
AI.result: 严格图像级准确率（含空帧）：DeepFaune-UK v1.2为88.8%，DeepFaune v1.5.0为56.5%，SpeciesNet为59.0%；但在DeepFaune更粗标签粒度下v1.5.0更高（91.4% vs 88.8%，贡献者重采样下不显著）。迁移到DINOv3分类器后v1.3达90.6%，like-for-like差距缩小至0.8点，狍误判为黇鹿减少69%。在26位无图像重叠贡献者的1,850张图像上，三个DeepFaune系列模型无显著差异（90.5%/90.6%/89.9%）。仅用10%训练裁剪的分布外准确率与全量相当，DINOv2子集训练约22分钟、显存不足4 GB。
AI.conclusion: 开放权重使地区级模型开发对小团队可行，数据高效且算力门槛低；但最大like-for-like提升来自他人训练的更新基座模型，故这种民主化依赖于大型机构持续以开放许可发布权重，而许可可能变化。

title: OWLS: Open-world Language-conditioned Speed Fields for Zero-Shot Rover Navigation
summary: Semantics can provide a proxy for physical traversability. Terrain that looks like loose sand or a rock field is likely to have similar physical properties. Open-vocabulary vision-language models (VLMs) enable this physical reasoning over terrain outside any fixed label set. We present Open-world Language-conditioned Speed Fields (OWLS), which plans directly over the dense feature map of a VLM. Prompted with a description of traversable terrain, the VLM scores every pixel of a single camera image; OWLS projects these scores onto the ground, adapts them to the platform with two morphological operations, and uses the result as the speed field of a minimum-time planner, so terrain appearance and obstacle clearance shape one trajectory. OWLS needs no task-specific training, no terrain annotation, no persistent map, and no exteroceptive sensor beyond the camera. We evaluate it on a physical rover indoors and off-road, on simulated Mars and Moon rovers over 200 procedurally generated terrains, and on real planetary imagery.

AI.tldr: OWLS 用开放词表视觉语言模型的稠密特征图作为代价/速度场：按可通行地形描述对单张图像逐像素打分，反投影到地面后经两次形态学操作适配平台，作为最小时间规划器的速度场，实现无需训练、无地图、仅单目相机的无任务特定训练的可通行性规划。
AI.motivation: 语义可作为物理可通行性的代理：看起来像松沙或乱石的地形往往具有相似的物理性质。已有方法受限于固定标签集与地形标注，难以泛化到开放世界；希望利用开放词表 VLM 的物理常识，摆脱任务特定训练、地形标注与持久地图的依赖。
AI.method: 1) 以可通行地形的自然语言描述作为 prompt，让开放词表 VLM 对单张相机图像的每个像素打分；2) 将像素分数投影到地面平面（ground projection）；3) 用两次形态学操作把分数场适配到具体平台尺度（如膨胀/腐蚀以表达车体尺寸与最小间隙）；4) 将最终速度场输入最小时间规划器，使地形外观与障碍间隙共同塑造单一轨迹。全程无训练、无标注、无持久建图、除相机外无外部感知传感器。
AI.result: 在室内与越野场景的真实 rover 上验证；在 200 个程序化生成地形上对模拟火星/月球 rover 评测；并在真实行星影像上测试，均表明该方法可直接用于开放世界地形上的时间最优路径规划。
AI.conclusion: 开放词表 VLM 语义分数可直接充当可通行性代价，通过地面投影与形态学校准即构成有效的速度场，形成"感知—规划"紧耦合的轻量导航方案；其最大价值在于零样本、零标注、单目、免建图的部署便捷性，适用于行星/越野等无先验标注的开放环境。

title: Hair Segmentation and Skin Characterization on Macroscopic Dermatological Images for Laser Treatment Parameterization
comment: Published open access in Journal of Imaging Informatics in Medicine (2026)
summary: Current light-based devices, such as laser hair removal, intense pulsed light (IPL), vascular laser therapy, and dermatologic phototherapy, are widely used in clinical dermatology but rely heavily on subjective manual parameterization or uncalibrated point-based colorimeters. To overcome these limitations, this work presents a unified system for hair segmentation and skin characterization in macroscopic dermatological images. Unlike most existing literature that relies on dermoscopic datasets captured under highly controlled conditions, our approach is specifically designed for macroscopic images that replicate real clinical laser treatments. The proposed pipeline integrates a custom-trained variant of the YOLOv9 deep learning architecture for instance segmentation and classical image processing within a single workflow to extract objective skin and hair parameters such as phototype, hair density, color, and thickness. A color calibration stage using spectrophotometric measurements ensures accurate feature estimation regardless of illumination conditions. Experimental results show competitive segmentation metrics (mAP@50 $\approx$ 0.80) on a custom dataset featuring short, shaved hairs, typical of pre-treatment scenarios. These findings demonstrate the feasibility of the proposed pipeline in providing the objective, foundational skin and hair features required for future automated laser parameterization, paving the way for its extension to broader light-based medical therapies.

AI.tldr: 提出一个用于宏观皮肤图像的单流程系统：自训练YOLOv9变体做毛发实例分割，结合经典图像处理与分光光度计色彩标定，提取光型、毛发密度、颜色与粗细等客观参数。
AI.motivation: 现有激光脱毛、IPL、血管激光等光疗设备依赖主观人工设参或未标定的点式色度计；而多数已有研究基于受控条件下采集的皮肤镜数据集，难以直接对应真实临床宏观图像场景。
AI.method: 面向宏观临床图像的统一毛发分割与皮肤表征管线：自定义训练的YOLOv9实例分割变体 + 经典图像处理，并引入基于分光光度测量的颜色标定阶段以消除光照影响；在自建短毛/剃毛预处理数据集上评测。
AI.result: 在含短剃毛的定制数据集上取得具竞争力的分割指标（mAP@50 ≈ 0.80），并验证颜色标定可支持跨光照条件的特征估计。
AI.conclusion: 验证了该管线可为未来自动化激光参数设定提供客观的皮肤与毛发基础特征，并具备推广至更广泛光疗医学场景的可行性。

title: DriveOSS: Dataset and Benchmark for 3D Anomaly Segmentation and Open-set Semantic Segmentation in Autonomous Driving
summary: Recent advances in 3D semantic segmentation have significantly improved scene understanding in autonomous driving. However, existing methods are typically developed under a closed-set assumption and evaluated under standard driving conditions, where all categories are known in advance. In real-world driving, autonomous vehicles inevitably encounter previously unseen objects, making closed-set perception insufficient for safe deployment. To address this challenge, we introduce DriveOSS, which, to the best of our knowledge, is the first real-world multimodal dataset and benchmark specifically designed for 3D anomaly segmentation and open-set semantic segmentation. It contains 12,661 synchronized and annotated frames captured using six surround-view RGB cameras, a 128-beam LiDAR, and a GPS/IMU unit. The dataset comprises 52 real-world driving scenes collected under clear, nighttime, cloudy, rainy, and snowy conditions and is organized into ID (in-distribution) and OOD (out-of-distribution) subsets. The ID scenes contain only known classes and are used for training, whereas the OOD scenes additionally contain unknown objects annotated as the outlier class and are used for validation and testing. Extensive experiments show that unseen objects remain a major challenge for current 3D perception systems. The dataset, benchmark protocols, and code are available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: DriveOSS是首个面向真实场景3D异常分割与开放集语义分割的多模态数据集与基准，含12,661帧同步标注数据（6路环视相机+128线LiDAR+GPS/IMU），覆盖52个晴/夜/阴/雨/雪驾驶场景，划分ID/OOD子集，揭示未知物体仍是当前3D感知系统的主要挑战。
AI.motivation: 现有3D语义分割方法多在闭集假设与标准驾驶条件下开发，所有类别预先已知；而真实自动驾驶必然遇到未见过的物体，闭集感知不足以支撑安全部署，因此需要一个真实世界、多模态、含异常/开放集标注的数据集与评测基准。
AI.method: 构建DriveOSS数据集与基准：使用6个环视RGB相机、128线LiDAR与GPS/IMU同步采集，获得12,661帧标注数据；涵盖晴天、夜间、多云、雨天、雪天等多种真实天气与光照条件，共52个驾驶场景；按ID（仅含已知类别，用于训练）与OOD（额外含标注为outlier的未知物体，用于验证与测试）组织；并设计相应的基准评测协议。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，未见过的物体（异常/开放集目标）仍是当前3D感知系统面临的重大挑战，现有方法在OOD场景上性能明显受限。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了真实场景下3D异常分割与开放集语义分割的数据集、评测协议与代码，为自动驾驶开放世界感知研究建立了统一基准，指出闭集感知的局限与后续研究方向。

title: Earth embeddings are decomposable records of the land surface
summary: Ecological monitoring, carbon accounting and biodiversity assessment increasingly rely on annual Earth embeddings--learned vectors that compress a year of satellite observation for every ten-meter pixel on Earth, consumed in place of the imagery itself. What these vectors mean has not been established. Here we decompose two widely used embedding products and show that they contain individual ecological features, including fire, forest clearing and crop type, validated against independent reference data on events across six continents. The recovered concepts date abrupt canopy loss to the first post-disturbance growing season and resolve severity well enough to separate prescribed fire from wildfire. Small fires that recover quickly are detectable in one product but not the other, which instead separates crops more strongly.

AI.tldr: 对两个广泛使用的地球年度嵌入产品进行概念分解，证明其内含火灾、森林砍伐、作物类型等可解释生态特征，并与独立参考数据在六大洲验证一致。
AI.motivation: 年度地球嵌入（每10米像素压缩一年的卫星观测）已被广泛用于生态监测、碳核算与生物多样性评估，但向量语义未被厘清，使用者主要依赖黑箱。
AI.method: 对两类嵌入产品做表征分解（稀疏/字典式概念提取），利用六大洲独立事件参考数据做验证，并比较两者对林冠突变时间定位、扰动强度与作物类型的可分性。
AI.result: 可恢复出单个生态概念；林冠突然损失可定位到扰动后首个生长季；严重度分辨率足以区分计划烧除与野火；快速恢复的小火仅在一个产品中可检测，另一产品则对作物区分更强。
AI.conclusion: 地球嵌入具有可解释的生态语义，可作为影像替代品被审计与选择性使用；不同产品存在能力互补与盲区，应按任务选型。

title: Natural-Language to Nav2: Operational Policies for Costmap-Based Navigation
comment: 23 pages, 16 figures, including supplementary material. Jiyeong Chae and Hyunkyo Seo contributed equally. Project page: this https URL
summary: Autonomous mobile robots support material transport in warehouses and industrial facilities, where navigation must adapt to changing operating conditions. Sensor observations reveal physical obstacles, but do not by themselves specify temporary access rules, route preferences, or exceptions known to operators. This paper presents a natural-language policy interface that brings this knowledge into ROS 2 Nav2. A local large language model converts instructions into JSON policies specifying destinations, spatial constraints, and temporal or event conditions. Deterministic checks govern mission acceptance, and three costmap adapters project accepted policies into the existing navigation stack without changing its planner or controller. On 150 researcher-authored English commands, four local models produce 107-142 correct accepted policies, compared with 44 for a rule-based parser, with 3-20 incorrect acceptances per model. Fault injection records rejection of eight endpoint/JSON faults and 29 validator-stage faults. Navigation experiments use correct task policies to evaluate keepouts, zone costs, person-dependent regions, and event-conditioned passage in simulation and on a TurtleBot3. For Tasks 1-3, mean travel times are 18.4-24.5% lower in simulation and 23.1-35.0% lower on the physical testbed than with the baseline lacking those policies. A native KeepoutFilter comparison and two-robot demonstrations examine basic keepout behavior and shared policy projection. The interface connects operator instructions to explicit navigation policies while retaining Nav2's planning and control components.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种自然语言策略接口，将操作员的英文指令经本地大模型转换为 JSON 策略（目的地、空间约束、时间/事件条件），通过确定性校验后由三个 costmap 适配器投影到 ROS 2 Nav2 中，无需修改规划器与控制器。
AI.motivation: 传感器只能感知物理障碍，无法表达操作员掌握的临时通行规则、路线偏好与例外；现有 Nav2 导航栈缺乏将这类高层语义知识注入底层的机制。
AI.method: 本地 LLM 指令→JSON 策略；确定性校验控制任务接受；三个 costmap 适配器将接受策略映射为禁行区、区域代价、人员相关区域与事件触发通行，保持 Nav2 规划/控制组件不变；并用故障注入与四模型对比评估。
AI.result: 150 条英文指令下，四个本地模型产生 107–142 条正确接受策略，规则解析器仅 44 条，错误接受 3–20 条；故障注入中 8 个端点/JSON 故障和 29 个校验级故障被拒绝；任务 1–3 平均行驶时间仿真降低 18.4–24.5%，TurtleBot3 实机降低 23.1–35.0%。
AI.conclusion: 该接口将操作员指令显式转化为导航策略，同时保留 Nav2 原有规划与控制模块，实现语言到导航约束的可验证落地。

title: EditJev: System One Routing for Image Editing Models
summary: Instruction-based image editing models exhibit pronounced sample-specific performance variation: different models can produce substantially different results for the same source image and editing instruction, and the best-performing model often varies across requests. These models also differ substantially in inference latency, making fixed-model deployment inefficient. We therefore study image editing model routing, which dynamically selects an editor from a candidate pool given an input image and editing instruction. We introduce EditJev, a System One routing model that directly predicts sample-level preference scores over candidate image editing models in a single forward pass. A lightweight preference head on a vision-language backbone produces a fixed-dimensional score vector without autoregressive model-name generation or response parsing. To train EditJev, we construct pairwise preferences from offline candidate outputs and optimize a pairwise ranking objective to learn relative model suitability. At inference time, EditJev combines the predicted preference scores with model-level speed scores to balance editing quality and generation latency. Experiments on ImgEdit and GEdit-En show that EditJev improves aggregate quality over the strongest fixed editor, from 4.540 to 4.592 and from 8.194 to 8.255, respectively, while reducing estimated end-to-end latency by 60.8% and 31.7%. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of direct, structured model routing for efficient image editing.

AI.tldr: EditJev：单次前向预测样本级偏好分数的图像编辑模型路由（System One），结合模型级速度分数平衡质量与时延。
AI.motivation: 指令式图像编辑模型存在显著样本特异性差异：同一图像+指令下不同模型效果差异大，最优模型随请求变化，且推理时延差异大，固定单一模型部署低效。故研究编辑模型路由问题。
AI.method: 在视觉-语言主干上接轻量偏好头（preference head），单次前向输出固定维度的候选模型分数向量，避免自回归生成模型名与响应解析。训练时由离线候选输出构建成对偏好，优化 pairwise ranking 目标学习相对适用性。推理时将预测偏好分数与模型级速度分数融合，权衡质量与延迟。
AI.result: ImgEdit 上聚合质量由 4.540 提升至 4.592，GEdit-En 上由 8.194 提升至 8.255（均超过最强固定编辑器），同时端到端估计时延分别降低 60.8% 与 31.7%。
AI.conclusion: 直接、结构化的模型路由可有效提升图像编辑的效率与整体质量，验证了 System One 式单次前向偏好打分范式的可行性。

title: Monte Carlo-Based Indoor UAV Localization in Dynamic Environments Using Only Four Onboard Range Sensors
summary: Indoor UAV localization with minimal onboard sensing remains challenging, particularly in dynamic environments. We propose augmented filtered Monte Carlo localization (AF-MCL) for 2D localization using only four single-point range sensors and measured heading. AF-MCL rejects range measurements inconsistent with the known static map and adaptively injects particles to recover from localization divergence and kidnapping. Beam classification is performed only at the previous position estimate, making its ray-casting cost independent of the particle count. The particle distribution additionally provides an online measure of localization uncertainty. Real-world experiments in a 2.10x1.63 m environment yield mean position errors of 6.4-7.7 cm under static and dynamic conditions. Simulations in 6x6 m and 10x10 m environments yield 4.5-5.2 cm mean errors; under dynamic obstacles, standard MCL reaches 12.3 cm and reliable MCL 7.7 cm. The results show that robust indoor localization under dynamic obstacles is achievable with only four single-point range measurements and heading.

AI.tldr: 提出增强型滤波蒙特卡洛定位（AF-MCL），仅用四个单点测距传感器与测得航向实现二维室内无人机定位，在先前位姿处做波束分类以剔除与静态地图不一致的测距并自适应注入粒子恢复发散。
AI.motivation: 最小机载感知下的室内无人机定位困难，尤其在动态环境中：动态障碍会造成测距与静态地图不一致，导致标准MCL定位漂移乃至绑架问题。
AI.method: 在MCL框架中引入测距测量与已知静态地图的一致性检验（否决离群波束），并自适应注入粒子以从定位发散/绑架中恢复；波束分类仅在上一时刻位置估计处执行，使射线投射代价与粒子数无关；粒子分布同时提供在线定位不确定性度量。仅用4个单点测距传感器+航向。
AI.result: 真实环境2.10×1.63 m实验：静态与动态条件下平均位置误差6.4–7.7 cm；6×6 m与10×10 m仿真平均误差4.5–5.2 cm，动态障碍下标准MCL为12.3 cm、reliable MCL为7.7 cm。
AI.conclusion: 仅用四个单点测距与航向即可实现动态障碍下鲁棒的室内定位，且计算成本可控。

title: Computational imaging through turbid, bubbly and flowing water near the telescope
summary: Cameras in the surf zone or behind ship wakes look through turbid, bubbly, moving water close to the lens, yet restoration networks are usually scored only on displayed images. We introduce a measured dataset of a telescope viewing displayed images and physical objects through a 25~mm water layer 45~mm in front of its objective, under seven combinations of flow, bubbles and turbidity, with clear-water recordings as a second reference. Because the suspension scatters light far outside the 1.3\textdegree{} field of view, turbidity mainly removes contrast, 4.4- to 4.8-fold on a Siemens star. Restoring the mean of eight frames improves structural similarity (SSIM) by 0.032 over a single frame, and learned fusion of the frames adds little. One raw frame supports five-category recognition (96.8\%) as well as restored images. Adding synthetic training pairs leaves display-image scores unchanged but raises the correlation of a restored Siemens star with its clear-water recording from below 0.5 to above 0.9. These networks also improve ordinary underwater photographs without retraining, where training on measured pairs alone fails. Scoring against the digital source or a clear-water recording reverses the ranking of raw and restored images. These results support a simple pipeline: average the frames, classify raw frames directly, and restore with networks trained on measured and synthetic pairs.

AI.tldr: 测量式浑浊水层成像数据集与清晰水参考；平均8帧SSIM+0.032；原始单帧即可96.8%五类识别；实测+合成配对训练可把Siemens star与清晰水相关性从<0.5提升到>0.9；评分基准（数字源vs清晰水）会反转原始与复原图像排序。
AI.motivation: 水下/尾流相机需透过近镜头浑浊、含气泡、运动水体成像，而复原网络仅在显示图像上评测，缺少与清晰水参考对照的实测数据与合理评价基准。
AI.method: 搭建望远镜隔45mm、25mm水层观测显示图像与实物，控制流动/气泡/浑浊度7种组合并录清晰水参考；比较单帧、8帧平均与学习式融合；结合实测对与合成对训练复原网络；并用数字源与清晰水记录两种参考做评测。
AI.result: 浑浊主要致对比度损失（Siemens star上4.4–4.8倍）；8帧平均较单帧SSIM提升0.032，学习式融合增益甚微；原始单帧识别96.8%与复原图相当；合成对不改变显示图像分数但显著提升与清晰水记录的相关性；复原网络免微调泛化到普通水下照片。
AI.conclusion: 推荐流水线：帧平均预处理、原始帧直接分类、用实测+合成配对训练的复原网络；评测基准选择会反转方法排序，需明确参考标准。

title: SemGeo-Gen: Unsupervised Generation of Approximate Cross-Instance Semantic-Geometric Correspondences
summary: We introduce SemGeo-Gen, an unsupervised method for generating approximate cross-instance semantic-geometric supervision from weakly aligned 3D object collections. Our goal is not to recover exact point-level correspondences, which are often ambiguous across different instances and would require expensive, impractical manual supervision at scale. Instead, we automatically produce approximate correspondences that are semantically meaningful, geometrically consistent, and diverse enough to train modern correspondence models. Given only coarse category-level rotation alignment, SemGeo-Gen lifts multi-view DINOv2 features to 3D, aligns object instances using continuous piecewise-affine registration, and prunes candidate matches using semantic consistency. The resulting 3D correspondences can be projected into rendered views, yielding scalable 3D-3D, 3D-2D, and 2D-2D supervision without manual annotation. We validate the generated correspondences against sparse human annotations from KeypointNet, obtaining 93% PCK@0.10 and 97% PCK@0.15. More importantly, we show that using the generated correspondences for synthetic pretraining improves recent state-of-the-art semantic correspondence models on SPair-71k after fine-tuning on real data, with gains of up to 5 PCK@0.10 points. Together, these results indicate that approximate semantic-geometric supervision generated from 3D assets can improve real-image correspondence learning and serve as a scalable alternative to costly manual annotation. Project page: this https URL .

AI.tldr: SemGeo-Gen 以弱对齐 3D 物体集合为输入，将多视图 DINOv2 特征提升到 3D，用分段仿射配准与语义一致性剪枝生成近似的跨实例语义-几何对应监督，可投影为 3D-3D/3D-2D/2D-2D 监督，用于预训练语义对应模型。
AI.motivation: 跨实例的稠密语义对应标注昂贵且点级对应本身存在歧义，因此作者不追求精确的点级对应，而是希望以无监督方式获得语义有意义、几何一致且多样的近似对应，为现代对应模型提供可扩展的监督信号，替代昂贵的人工标注。
AI.method: 仅依赖类别级粗旋转对齐：将多视图 DINOv2 特征反投影提升到 3D；用连续分段仿射（piecewise-affine）配准对齐不同实例；基于语义一致性剪枝候选匹配；再将得到的 3D 对应投影到渲染视图，生成 3D-3D、3D-2D、2D-2D 三类监督。
AI.result: 与 KeypointNet 稀疏人工标注比对取得 93% PCK@0.10 与 97% PCK@0.15；将生成的对应用于合成预训练、再在真实数据上微调，使多个 SOTA 语义对应模型在 SPair-71k 上提升最多 5 个 PCK@0.10 点。
AI.conclusion: 由 3D 资产自动生成的近似语义-几何监督可有效提升真实图像上的对应学习，是可扩展的人工标注替代方案；但整体属于 3D 资产驱动的 2D 语义对应预训练工作，与 Physical AI/VLA/世界模型/前馈重建/物理仿真等核心方向关联较弱。

title: The Answer Knows Where to Look: Zooming before MLLMs Answer under Visual-Token Budgets
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) read images through visual tokens, and under the small per-image budgets that efficient deployment requires, the fine text of documents, charts and infographics becomes illegible. Zooming in recovers the evidence, but the region must be chosen before the model answers. We find that MLLMs know where the evidence is, but not in a form that can be read before they answer: the answer tokens localize it from the middle layers on, whereas the attention available before answering does so only in the top layers, at a depth that varies across models, and diffusely. Supervising the pre-answer attention to point degrades reading, and the benefit of zooming is governed by each image's information gap. Building on these findings, we introduce ours, which lets an MLLM look where its answer would. A dedicated look token, processed in a single prefill and kept out of the answering pass, learns in hindsight to attend as the model's own correct answers do, extracting this knowledge into a concentrated pointer before any answer exists. Its hidden state then selects how to look, from no zoom to crops, square windows, windows that adapt to the pointer and foveated warps, supervised by the counterfactual outcome of every view. ours needs no box annotations, per-model layer search, external localizers or generation before the answer. On Qwen3-VL at three scales and five text-rich benchmarks, it surpasses the strongest baseline by 4.8-9.1 points at 98 visual tokens per view and attention-guided zooming by 11.1-17.0 points, while running faster than attention-guided and grounding-based zooming.

AI.tldr: 提出"look token"机制：在单次prefill中用一个专用token以"事后监督"方式模仿模型自身正确答案的注意力，生成集中指针，再据其隐状态选择缩放策略（无缩放/裁剪/方窗/指针自适应窗/中央凹变形），无需框标注与逐模型层搜索。
AI.motivation: MLLM以视觉token读图，小预算下文档/图表细字不可读；放大需在回答前选定区域。作者发现模型答案token在中层即能定位证据，而回答前的注意力仅在顶层且弥散，说明"知识存在但不可在回答前读取"。
AI.method: 专用look token在预填充阶段处理并排除于回答阶段，学习模仿正确回答中答案token的注意力分布，将定位知识蒸馏为集中指针；指针隐状态经事后反事实监督（对每种视图/无缩放分别评估结果）选择缩放方式；无需box标注、外部定位器、逐层搜索或先生成。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-VL三个规模、五个文本密集基准上，每视图98视觉token下比最强基线高4.8–9.1分，比注意力引导缩放高11.1–17.0分，且速度更快。
AI.conclusion: 回答前注意力难以直接监督，而"事后模仿答案注意力"可有效提取定位知识，实现无标注、模型无关的自适应视觉聚焦，并揭示缩放收益由单图信息差决定。

title: Robust Offset-Free Lane-Keeping Control Framework for Vision-Only Automated Vehicles
summary: Achieving accurate, real-time lane-keeping control during high-speed cornering on large-curvature roads while ensuring robust vehicle stability is a critical challenge in autonomous driving. To address this challenge, this study developed a robust offset-free model predictive control (OF-MPC) framework for vision-based autonomous vehicle lane-keeping. The regulation problem in this framework is solved using several algorithms. Numerical simulation results indicated that the interpolation-tube-based constrained iterative linear quadratic regulator (itube-CILQR) algorithm outperformed solvers based on the standard Interior Point Optimizer (IPOPT) and Operator Splitting Quadratic Program (OSQP), achieving a mean computation time of less than 5 ms. The itube-CILQR algorithm was then used for vehicle control in vision-based lane-keeping experiments in a simulation environment to quantify the perceptual uncertainty of a visual perception model (multitask UNet). This quantification was performed using the OF-MPC framework for traffic scenes that were not encountered during model training. Overall, the developed OF-MPC framework and the proposed method for characterizing the perceptual uncertainty of a visual perception system in unseen environments can contribute to the future development of advanced autonomous driving systems.

AI.tldr: 提出鲁棒无偏差模型预测控制（OF-MPC）框架用于视觉车道保持，并用基于插值管（interpolation-tube）的约束迭代LQR（itube-CILQR）求解调节问题，平均计算时间<5ms，优于IPOPT与OSQP，同时量化了视觉感知模型（multitask UNet）在未训练场景下的感知不确定性。
AI.motivation: 大曲率道路高速过弯时需要兼顾实时性与车辆稳定性，视觉感知存在不确定性，需在控制层同时实现无偏差跟踪、鲁棒性与高求解效率。
AI.method: 构建视觉车道保持的鲁棒无偏差MPC（OF-MPC）框架；对比IPOPT、OSQP与提出itube-CILQR三种求解器；在仿真中用itube-CILQR闭环控制，并借OF-MPC框架量化multitask UNet在未见交通场景中的感知不确定性。
AI.result: itube-CILQR平均求解时间<5 ms，性能优于IPOPT与OSQP；完成仿真车道保持实验并给出感知不确定性的定量刻画。
AI.conclusion: 该OF-MPC框架与感知不确定性量化方法可为高级自动驾驶系统提供参考；但验证仅在仿真环境，缺乏实车证据。

title: Retiming Robot Demonstrations with a Learned Speed Prior
summary: The pace of a robot demonstration is often determined by the teleoperator rather than by the task itself. As a result, the same motion can appear at widely different speeds across demonstrations, and policies trained on such data may inherit operator-specific timing along with task behavior. We propose to learn a speed prior directly from large-scale demonstration data. Given a task instruction, a motion path and the images along it, it predicts a distribution over execution speed along the path, from which a chosen quantile defines a consistent clock for retiming each demonstration. Existing methods derive the acceleration signal from the very data they accelerate, so each new task costs another fit, annotation, or pair of predefined rates. A single trained speed prior instead covers every task in a corpus. We fit a speed prior on both robot teleoperation data and handheld demonstrations in which a human arm, rather than a robot arm, moves the gripper, and use it to retime robot demonstrations to the handheld pace before fine-tuning a vision-language-action policy. For execution, we pair the policy with a real-time optimal-control layer that tracks predicted action chunks under robot constraints using the predicted pace. On 120 RoboLab tasks, policies fine-tuned on our learned clocks succeed more often and move with up to half the jerk compared with policies fine-tuned on the original demonstration timing and uniformly accelerated to the same speed. On a real robot, our policy stacks cups in 3.50s, 1.72$\times$ faster than the default policy's 6.02s while succeeding as often, in 29 of 30 trials. Videos and further material are available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: 从大规模示教数据中学习"速度先验"，用选定分位数作为统一时钟对示教进行重定时，并结合实时最优控制层跟踪预测动作块。
AI.motivation: 遥操作节奏由操作者而非任务决定，导致同一动作在不同示教中速度差异大，策略会继承操作者特有的时序偏置。现有加速方法需针对每个新任务重新拟合或标注，且加速度信号源自被加速的数据本身。
AI.method: 给定任务指令、运动路径及沿途图像，预测沿路径的执行速度分布；取选定分位作为统一时钟，对机器人示教重定时到手持示教节奏后再微调VLA策略。速度先验在机器人遥操作数据与手持（人臂驱动夹爪）示教上联合拟合。执行端配实时最优控制层，在机器人约束下按预测节奏跟踪动作块。
AI.result: 120个RoboLab任务上成功率更高，jerk降至基线一半（与原始时序微调并均匀加速到同速度的策略相比）；真机堆叠杯子3.50s，比默认策略6.02s快1.72×，成功率持平（29/30）。
AI.conclusion: 统一的速度先验可跨任务复用，替代逐任务拟合/标注的加速流程，并可作为VLA微调的数据重定时工具与运行时跟踪节拍。

title: Conditional Neural Processes for Self-Supervised Goal Discovery in Action Imitation
comment: Presented at the poster session of the Workshop on World Models and Predictive Coding in Cognitive Robotics @ IROS2023 ( this https URL )
summary: Inspired by infants' ability to learn novel tasks by imitating others, in this work we evaluate to what extent Conditional Neural Processes can autonomously learn representations of actions that are informative about their underlying goal. We show that the addition of an attention mechanism in the hidden space fosters the emergence of robust goal representations early on in the observation of an action sequence, making it a promising model for a robotic self-supervised general learner.

AI.tldr: 在隐空间加入注意力机制的Conditional Neural Process能尽早从动作序列中无监督地形成目标表征，可作为机器人自监督通用学习器的方向。
AI.motivation: 受婴儿通过模仿学习新任务的启发，希望模型能自主学到"动作—目标"的有效表征，服务于机器人自监督通用学习。
AI.method: 以Conditional Neural Processes为基础框架，在隐空间中融入注意力机制，对动作序列进行编码并评估其目标可辨识性。
AI.result: 注意力机制使目标表征在动作观察的早期阶段即稳健涌现，且较为鲁棒。
AI.conclusion: 在CNP中引入隐空间注意力是获取动作目标表征的有效手段，有望用于机器人自监督通用学习。但摘要仅为表征学习层面的初步验证，缺少真实机器人实验与定量证据。

title: SP-Guide: Enhancing Aerial Vision-Language Navigation with Spatial Priors
summary: Aerial vision-language navigation (AVLN) requires a UAV to reach a language-described target from partial egocentric observations while reasoning over large outdoor scenes. Existing approaches typically fuse view-centered RGB observations and globally anchored history maps as generic visual embeddings, leaving cross-modal spatial alignment to be learned from sparse navigation supervision. We present SP-Guide, a transformer- based goal-prediction framework that addresses this weakness of alignment through a Spatial Prior Cross-Modal Encoder, an Instruction Enhanced Decoder, and a Goal Convergence Filter for terminal target refinement. Experiments implemented on the CityNav benchmark show that SP-Guide improves success rate over the representative baselines, with the largest gains on unseen environments. These results indicate that physically grounded spatial priors provide an effective inductive bias for robust AVLN.

AI.tldr: SP-Guide：面向空中视觉语言导航（AVLN）的Transformer目标预测框架，通过空间先验跨模态编码器、指令增强解码器和目标收敛滤波器显式对齐RGB视觉与全局history map的空间关系，在CityNav上提升成功率，且unseen环境增益最大。
AI.motivation: 现有AVLN方法把view-centered RGB观测与全局锚定history map直接融为通用视觉embedding，跨模态空间对齐只能依赖稀疏导航监督隐式学习，效率低、泛化差。
AI.method: 提出Spatial Prior Cross-Modal Encoder注入物理/几何先验实现跨模态空间对齐；Instruction Enhanced Decoder强化语言指令对目标预测的引导；Goal Convergence Filter做终点目标精化。整体为基于Transformer的目标预测框架。
AI.result: 在CityNav基准上成功率优于代表性基线，unseen环境提升最大，说明空间先验是AVLN的有效归纳偏置。
AI.conclusion: 将物理可解释的空间先验作为归纳偏置，可显著提升空中导航的跨模态对齐与未见环境泛化能力。

title: Are Textual Residuals Truly Complementary? Learning Visual Complements under Semantic Superposition for Visible-Infrared Person Re-Identification
summary: Text-enhanced visible-infrared person re-identification (VI-ReID) exploits textual descriptions to compensate for appearance cues that are weak or unavailable under infrared imaging.
