Existing methods construct compensation from differences between modality-oriented textual representations, implicitly assuming that textual differences are visually complementary. We revisit this assumption through semantic superposition and show that dense textual residuals may entangle useful appearance variations with redundant, making direct residual fusion unreliable. We propose Superposition-Aware Residual Calibration, which transforms dense textual differences into selective and visually grounded complements. Low-Interference Sparse Residual Learning represents modality-oriented text embeddings as sparse activation strengths over a shared dictionary, selects positive strength differences, and suppresses both dictionary-level overlap and activation-weighted interference to reconstruct a compact, selectively controlled residual. Visual Complement and Counterfactual Calibration further calibrates the residual against identity-specific RGB-IR visual discrepancies, encouraging retained semantics to provide meaningful compensation while preserving the residual structure. Experiments on Tri-SYSU-MM01, Tri-RegDB, and Tri-LLCM show that SARC consistently improves the VI-ReID backbone and remains competitive with text-assisted methods. Mechanism analyses show that SARC produces more concentrated textual variations, reduces dictionary-level feature interference, and improves residual-visual-complement alignment for most samples. These results demonstrate that effective cross-modal compensation requires textual residuals to be selectively represented and explicitly calibrated, rather than directly treated as visual complements. Code and implementation details will be released upon publication.

AI.tldr: SARC：将文本增强VI-ReID中的稠密文本残差稀疏化并视-反事实校准，使文本差异成为可靠的视觉互补信号。
AI.motivation: 现有文本增强可见光-红外行人重识别方法默认"模态导向文本表示之差即视觉互补信息"，但作者通过语义叠加分析发现稠密文本残差混杂了冗余与干扰，直接残差融合不可靠。
AI.method: 提出Superposition-Aware Residual Calibration (SARC)。(1) Low-Interference Sparse Residual Learning：在共享字典上将模态导向文本嵌入表示为稀疏激活强度，仅保留正强度差，并抑制字典级重叠与激活加权干扰，重建紧凑、可控的残差；(2) Visual Complement and Counterfactual Calibration：以身份特异的RGB-IR视觉差异为参照对残差进行反事实校准，保持残差结构的同时促成有效视觉补偿。
AI.result: 在Tri-SYSU-MM01、Tri-RegDB、Tri-LLCM上稳定提升VI-ReID骨干网络，与文本辅助方法相比具竞争力；机理分析显示文本变化更集中、字典级特征干扰降低、多数样本的残差-视觉互补对齐改善。
AI.conclusion: 跨模态有效补偿要求文本残差被选择性表示并显式校准，而非直接当作视觉互补量使用。

title: CityLift: Compositional 3D Urban Generation from a Single Image
summary: Generating editable 3D urban scenes from a single image requires detailed building assets with a coherent spatial arrangement. Occlusion and perspective ambiguity make it difficult to infer complete building geometry together with consistent relative scales and positions. We present CityLift, a framework that generates individual textured building meshes from an urban image by coupling scene-level spatial modeling with building-level synthesis. CityLift first learns building shape and placement jointly through coupled scene and instance streams, producing coarse sparse structures in a common coordinate system. We then introduce generative spatial inheritance, which maps each building's coarse occupancy and scene-conditioned 3D feature field into a local volume to guide a flow model that generates finer structure. The same coordinate mapping places the generated meshes back into the scene, preserving their spatial relationship to the scaffold. To address the scarcity of urban data pairing scene images with individual 3D buildings, we construct CityLift-5K, comprising 4,997 synthetic scenes with instance masks, building meshes, and placement annotations. Experiments on CityLift-5K and scene blocks from UrbanScene3D and InstanceBuilding demonstrate improved building geometry and scene composition. The project page is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: CityLift 从单张城市场景图像生成可编辑的、逐建筑带纹理网格，通过场景级与实例级双流联合预测建筑形状与放置，并用"生成式空间继承"把粗结构映射到局部体素以引导流模型生成精细几何，最终按同一坐标映射回场景。
AI.motivation: 单图生成可编辑三维城市场景需要同时具备细节化建筑资产与一致的空间布局，但遮挡与透视歧义使得完整建筑几何、相对尺度与位置难以同时推断；现有方法要么只做场景级整体重建、缺乏实例级可编辑资产，要么逐建筑生成但丢失全局空间关系，且缺少图像—单体建筑配对数据。
AI.method: 耦合场景流与实例流共同学习建筑形状与摆放，输出统一坐标系下的稀疏粗结构（scaffold）；提出生成式空间继承，将每栋建筑的粗占用与场景条件三维特征场映射为局部体素，作为条件指导流模型生成精细结构；同一坐标映射把生成网格放回场景以保持与脚手架的空间关系；构建 CityLift-5K（4,997 个合成场景，含实例掩码、建筑网格、放置标注）。
AI.result: 在 CityLift-5K 以及 UrbanScene3D、InstanceBuilding 的场景区块上实验，建筑几何质量与场景组合一致性均有提升；数据集与项目页面已公开。
AI.conclusion: 场景级联合建模与实例级生成式细化相结合，可同时获得可编辑单体建筑资产与连贯空间布局；文中提出的配对数据集为该任务提供了可复现的评测基准。

title: Cross-Architectural Feature Fusion for Coronary Artery Stenosis Detection in X-ray Angiography
summary: Coronary artery disease remains a leading cause of mortality, with stenosis detection from invasive X-ray Coronary Angiography (XCA) critical for diagnosis. Manual interpretation is time-consuming, subjective, and variable, especially under low contrast and vessel overlap. Existing deep learning methods often rely solely on detection or segmentation, limiting this http URL propose a hybrid framework, Fusion-YOLOv11-L, combining a YOLOv11-L detector with a pretrained UNet++ via a channel attention gating module. This enables fusion of semantic and vessel-aware structural features, improving localisation of stenotic regions. The UNet++ is pretrained on ARCADE vessel segmentation dataset to provide anatomically informed representations. Experiments on the relabeled ARCADE (ARCADE*) dataset show improved performance over YOLOv11-L, achieving AP@50 of 0.585 and F1-score of 0.596. Cross-domain evaluation on a dataset from the Oxford Acute Myocardial Infarction (OxAMI) Study reveals performance degradation due to domain shift, mitigated using test-time adaptation and augmentation. Test-time augmentation improves AP@50 from 0.434 to 0.480, indicating better generalisability. These results show that cross-architecture feature fusion and lightweight adaptation improve robustness and generalisability of automated stenosis detection in XCA.

AI.tldr: 提出 Fusion-YOLOv11-L 混合框架,将 YOLOv11-L 检测器与预训练 UNet++ 通过通道注意力门控模块融合,用于 XCA 冠脉狭窄检测。
AI.motivation: XCA 狭窄检测人工判读耗时、主观且一致性差,低对比度和血管重叠时尤甚;现有深度学习方法仅依赖检测或分割,特征信息利用不足。
AI.method: YOLOv11-L 检测分支提供语义目标特征,UNet++ 在 ARCADE 血管分割数据集上预训练提供血管结构先验;两者通过通道注意力门控(channel attention gating)进行跨架构特征融合,增强狭窄区域定位。跨域阶段采用 test-time adaptation 与 test-time augmentation 缓解域偏移。
AI.result: 在重标注的 ARCADE* 数据集上 AP@50=0.585、F1=0.596,优于 YOLOv11-L 基线;跨域至 OxAMI 数据集性能下降,经 TTA 将 AP@50 从 0.434 提升至 0.480。
AI.conclusion: 跨架构特征融合与轻量测试时适配可提升 XCA 自动狭窄检测的鲁棒性与泛化性;但增益幅度有限,且跨域仍存在显著性能衰减。

title: Adaptive World-Models for Anomaly Recognition (AWARE): A Framework for Robot Dynamics Prediction and Introspection
summary: Unrecognized anomalies in critical infrastructure can rapidly cascade into catastrophic physical or operational failures. Current anomaly detection approaches often rely on direct access to the monitored system by utilizing onboard sensors, such as motor encoders, to detect anomalous states. However, legacy hardware often lacks these sensors, or strict security protocols may prohibit access altogether. We therefore present AWARE, a world model framework that is capable of anomaly detection using only external camera monitoring via system dynamics estimation and state prediction. Evaluated across 240 real-world robotic crane trajectories, including payload collisions and motor degradations, AWARE demonstrates a 26% improvement in anomaly classification over our strongest baseline under noisy, camera-only state estimation. Furthermore, the inferred dynamics parameter can be decoded to identify the source of faults, localizing the degrading motor with 88% accuracy.

AI.tldr: AWARE: 仅用外部摄像头的世界模型异常检测框架，通过系统动力学估计与状态预测检测机器人起重机异常，并可从动力学参数解码故障源。
AI.motivation: 关键基础设施中的未识别异常会级联为灾难性故障，但传统异常检测依赖编码器等本体传感器，而老旧硬件常无此类传感器，严格安全协议也可能禁止接入，故需仅靠外部视觉的检测方案。
AI.method: 提出AWARE世界模型框架：在仅有外部摄像头、含噪状态估计条件下，隐式估计系统动力学参数并做状态预测，以预测偏差判定异常；推断出的动力学参数可解码定位故障部件。
AI.result: 在240条真实机器人起重机轨迹（含载荷碰撞、电机退化）上，异常分类较最强基线提升26%；电机故障定位准确率88%。
AI.conclusion: 纯外部视觉的动力学建模可用于无侵入式异常检测与故障归因，适用于传感器缺失或受限的遗留工业系统；未来可扩展至更多设备类型与更复杂故障模式的可解释诊断。

title: Semantic Representation for Agentic Self-Play in Automated Laboratories
summary: Navigating complex, high-dimensional biological search spaces necessitates scalable physical and computational intelligence to explore beyond local optima through iterative self-play across ideation, experimentation, and automation. Translating experimental designs into reliable physical execution remains bottlenecked by static laboratory automation and unmodeled physical variability. To address this, we introduce VERified Infrastructure for Discovery Laboratories, or VERID, a foundational infrastructure designed to bridge the gap between the high-level reasoning of artificial intelligence (AI) agents and complex, error-prone physical realities of wet labs. VERID is a persistent, high-fidelity semantic digital twin of the laboratory workcell that provides four core services: queryable introspection for agentic reasoning, time-compressed simulation for protocol validation, comprehensive trace persistence for a complete scientific record, and a framework for safe execution. We present three case studies using aqueous dye and deionized water mixtures to validate the optical and fluidic foundations of VERID. These studies demonstrate how VERID enables pre-emptive detection of critical errors in experimental protocols, stateful mid-run error recovery and post-hoc identification of subtle physical failures. The simulation functions as a discrete accounting engine, allowing agents to safely and inexpensively explore experimental designs in silico and refine experimental strategies through iterative self-play. VERID also captures structured multimodal experimental data for downstream analysis, knowledge mining and agent training. We argue that this semantic layer is an essential prerequisite for deploying autonomous agents in the biochemical and biomedical sciences, ensuring data integrity, operational safety, and paving the way for tackling previously intractable grand challenges in biology.

AI.tldr: VERID：面向AI智能体自主实验的实验室工作单元高保真语义数字孪生基础设施，提供可查询内省、时间压缩仿真、全量轨迹留存与安全执行四大服务，并用染料/去离子水案例验证光学与流体基础。
AI.motivation: 生物实验搜索空间高维复杂，AI智能体虽能迭代自我博弈规划实验，但从实验设计到可靠物理执行的环节被静态实验室自动化与未建模的物理变异卡住；缺少连接高层AI推理与湿实验室易错物理现实的底层基础设施。
AI.method: 构建实验室工作区的持久化高保真语义数字孪生，并将其作为"离散记账引擎"：①可查询内省，供智能体推理时读取状态；②时间压缩仿真，用于协议预验证；③全量轨迹持久化，形成完整科学记录；④安全执行框架。以水溶液染料与去离子水混合为对象，通过三个案例研究标定并验证光学与流控模型。
AI.result: 案例表明VERID可实现协议关键错误的预先检测、运行中的状态化错误恢复，以及事后对细微物理故障的识别；智能体可在仿真中低成本、安全地探索实验设计并迭代优化策略，同时捕获结构化多模态实验数据用于下游分析、知识挖掘与智能体训练。
AI.conclusion: 语义层是生化与生物医学领域部署自主智能体的必要前提，可保障数据完整性与操作安全，并为攻克生物学长期难题铺路。但工作停留在基础设施与染料-水概念验证层面，尚未扩展到真实复杂生化实验或闭环自主发现。

title: ARENA: Active Region attENtion Aggregation for interpretable solar flare prediction
comment: 7+12 pages (2+8 figures), accepted at the "Representations for the Physical Sciences" workshop at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Predicting solar flares is a challenging space-weather forecasting problem with potentially significant impacts on Earth's upper atmosphere, including disruptions to radio communications. We propose Active Region attENtion Aggregation (ARENA), a neural network architecture that predicts solar flares from a variable number of active-region cutouts while learning to identify the region most relevant to the prediction. ARENA is trained using multiple-instance learning under weak supervision, requiring only a flare/no-flare label for the observation and no labels specifying the flare origin. The learned attention mechanism therefore provides a means of localizing the active region driving the prediction without explicit origin annotations. ARENA achieves a heidke skill score of 0.45 which is comparable to other flare prediction approaches. These results demonstrate that active-region-based aggregation can provide an efficient and interpretable approach to solar flare prediction. The code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: ARENA：基于多示例学习的活动区注意力聚合网络，从可变数量活动区切片预测太阳耀斑，并在无耀斑起源标注条件下定位关键活动区。
AI.motivation: 太阳耀斑预报对空间天气与电离层/无线电通信有实际影响；传统全盘图像方法难以处理可变数量、位置不定的活动区，且缺乏耀斑起源标注，难以判定哪个活动区驱动了预测。
AI.method: 输入为每张观测对应的多个活动区切片（数量可变），用注意力机制对切片特征进行聚合，输出耀斑/无耀斑预测；整体采用多示例学习（MIL）弱监督训练，仅使用观测级二分类标签，注意力权重自然充当活动区重要性/定位信号。
AI.result: Heidke技能评分（HSS）达0.45，与其他耀斑预报方法相当；注意力可视化可在无起源标注情况下给出驱动预测的活动区；代码开源。
AI.conclusion: 活动区级别的注意力聚合为耀斑预报提供了一种高效且可解释的范式，弱监督即可获得区域级定位能力。

title: SCDM-HTD: Spectral-Wise Conditional Diffusion Model for Hyperspectral Target Detection
summary: Hyperspectral target detection (HTD) aims to locate and recognize objects at a fine-grained scale, playing a pivotal role in remote sensing. Despite significant progress, current HTD methods primarily focus on feature comparison while neglecting distribution learning for background-target separation, which can limit detection robustness in practical applications. This paper addresses this issue by introducing a spectral-wise conditional diffusion model that reformulates HTD as a task of generating a detection map. Specifically, we treat background and target confidence scores as training samples and use the corresponding pixel spectra as guiding conditions to capture the distributional discrepancy between background and target through diffusion and denoising. To enhance practical applicability, we propose a lightweight conditional denoising network based on multilayer perceptron to map noisy confidence scores to their ideal counterparts and adopt a deterministic reverse non-Markov chain to skip sampling steps, thereby accelerating the generation process. Furthermore, we introduce a composite loss to improve background-target separation. This loss integrates constrained energy minimization loss to enhance target saliency and suppress the background by maximizing the target response while minimizing average output energy, alongside binary cross-entropy loss to classify background and target using pixel-wise labels. Experimental results on four benchmark datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method, with improvements in both quantitative metrics and qualitative visual effects.

AI.tldr: 提出光谱条件扩散模型，将高光谱目标检测重构为检测图生成任务，配合轻量MLP去噪网络、确定性逆马尔可夫链跳步采样与复合损失实现背景-目标分布分离。
AI.motivation: 现有高光谱目标检测方法聚焦特征比较，忽视背景-目标分离的分布学习，导致实际应用中的检测鲁棒性不足。
AI.method: 把背景/目标置信度分数作为训练样本，以对应像素光谱为条件，通过扩散与去噪捕捉背景-目标分布差异；构建基于多层感知机的轻量条件去噪网络，采用确定性逆非马尔可夫链跳过采样步以加速生成；复合损失含约束能量最小化损失（增强目标显著性、抑制背景）与逐像素二分类交叉熵损失。
AI.result: 在四个基准数据集上定量指标与定性视觉效果均优于对比方法。
AI.conclusion: 将HTD表述为条件生成问题并结合分布学习与复合损失，可在保持轻量高效的同时提升检测鲁棒性与分离能力。

title: Predictive Long-Horizon Progress Modeling with Action-Aware Quantification
summary: Quantitative and dense task progress feedback is essential for robotic manipulation across data curation, policy evaluation, and reinforcement learning. Existing progress annotations often rely on sparse keyframe markings derived from subjective manual judgments, limiting their scalability and cross-task consistency, particularly in long-horizon manipulation. To overcome these challenges, we propose action-aware quantification, a unified progress specification that decomposes long-horizon trajectories into object-level subtasks via a vision-language model (VLM) and assigns weighted action credits to capture fine-grained execution dynamics. Using VLM auto-labeling and human calibration, we construct an 800+ hour training video dataset and LOOM, a long-horizon progress benchmark containing 19,618 human-calibrated evaluation frames. To model these dense progress dynamics, we introduce NimCritic, a predictive progress critic trained via Joint Video-Progress Learning. We further incorporate Historical Progress Perturbation to mitigate sequential drift, and design a contrastive Video-Progress Alignment objective that bridges asymmetric expert streams by mutually grounding intermediate visual dynamics and denoised progress trajectories. NimCritic matches or outperforms state-of-the-art process reward models (PRMs) on the established Video Progress Benchmark (VPB) and LOOM, surpassing GVL (GPT-6-Sol) on VPB by about 65% in terminal success accuracy (TSA). On the large-scale RoboArena policy evaluation benchmark, it also retrieves human-selected successful rollouts with about 97% overall recall. These results establish action-aware quantification as a scalable foundation for dense progress feedback in robotic manipulation.

AI.tldr: 提出 action-aware quantification 进度规范：用 VLM 将长程轨迹分解为物体级子任务并赋予加权动作学分，构建 800+ 小时数据集与 LOOM 基准（19618 帧人工校准），训练 NimCritic 进度评论器用于密集进度反馈。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人操作的任务进度标注依赖主观的人工关键帧稀疏标记，难以规模化且跨任务不一致，长程操作尤为突出。密集、定量的进度反馈对数据筛选、策略评估和强化学习至关重要，因此需要统一、可自动化的进度量化规范。
AI.method: 1) Action-aware quantification：VLM 将长程轨迹分解为物体级子任务，并分配加权动作学分刻画细粒度执行动态；2) 结合 VLM 自动标注与人工校准，构建 800+ 小时训练视频数据集及 LOOM 基准；3) NimCritic：以 Joint Video-Progress Learning 训练的预测式进度评论器，引入 Historical Progress Perturbation 抑制序列漂移，并设计对比式 Video-Progress Alignment 目标，对齐专家流与非专家流的中间视觉动态与去噪进度轨迹。
AI.result: 在 VPB 与 LOOM 上达到或超过现有 SOTA 过程奖励模型（PRM），VPB 终端成功准确率（TSA）较 GVL (GPT-6-Sol) 提升约 65%；在 RoboArena 大规模策略评估基准上以约 97% 总召回率检索出人类选定的成功轨迹。
AI.conclusion: 动作感知量化可作为机器人操作中密集进度反馈的可扩展基础，兼顾标注一致性与长程执行动态刻画；LOOM 基准与 NimCritic 为过程奖励建模与策略评估提供了可复用的评测与建模框架。

title: Video-MemComp: Taylor-Guided Sensitivity-Aware Memory Management for Streaming Video Understanding
comment: Accepted by ACM MM 2026. Project Page: this https URL
summary: The rapid growth of video data has created an urgent need for efficient video understanding systems that can handle long and continuous visual inputs, posing significant challenges for Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) due to severe memory bottlenecks. Moreover, existing compression methods often overlook the explosive accumulation of approximation errors. To address this issue, we propose Video-MemComp, a training-free and sensitivity-aware context management framework for memory-constrained streaming video understanding. Our method theoretically decomposes compression error into orthogonal local approximation error and layer-wise structural sensitivity via a first-order Taylor expansion. To minimize local approximation error, we perform token aggregation in a pre-RoPE safe zone with an attention-conserving logit bias, mitigating geometric distortions caused by RoPE rotations. To manage layer-wise structural sensitivity, we dynamically allocate the KV cache budget based on offline gradient priors and online context entropy, prioritizing high-sensitivity layers. Video-MemComp outperforms or achieves performance comparable to full-cache and state-of-the-art compression methods on benchmarks including MLVU, VideoMME, and EgoSchema. Notably, it improves the overall accuracy of Qwen2.5-VL-3B from 62.3% to 64.1% while reducing the KV cache to an equivalent of 6,000 tokens per layer, saving over 90% of KV memory.

AI.tldr: Video-MemComp：免训练、敏感度感知的流式视频理解上下文管理框架，将压缩误差分解为局部近似误差与层级结构敏感度，在 pre-RoPE 安全区做 token 聚合并按敏感度动态分配 KV 预算。
AI.motivation: 长视频流式输入造成 MLLM 严重显存瓶颈，而现有压缩方法忽略了近似误差随上下文不断累积放大的问题。
AI.method: 基于一阶泰勒展开，将压缩误差分解为正交的局部近似误差与逐层结构敏感度；局部项上，在 RoPE 旋转前的安全区进行 token 聚合，并加入保持注意力的 logit bias 以缓解几何失真；层级项上，结合离线梯度先验与在线上下文熵，动态分配 KV cache 预算，优先保障高敏感层。
AI.result: 在 MLVU、VideoMME、EgoSchema 上与全缓存及 SOTA 压缩方法持平或更优；Qwen2.5-VL-3B 整体准确率从 62.3% 提升至 64.1%，KV cache 压缩至每层等效 6,000 tokens，节省 90% 以上 KV 显存。
AI.conclusion: 以误差分解理论驱动的敏感度感知 KV 管理，可在免训练条件下高效支撑长视频流式理解，兼顾精度与显存效率；但并未涉及具身或物理仿真场景。

title: SREdit: Scene Response Guided Appearance Editing for Projection Mapping
summary: Projection-based appearance editing changes selected visual attributes of a physical object through projection mapping (PM). To display a desired appearance, PM typically uses projector compensation, which computes a projector input that counteracts the geometric and photometric distortions of the scene. Compensation can only approximate this appearance within the available projection range, and it cannot revise the appearance itself. Pretrained LLM-based image editors provide a direct way to produce the desired appearance from a text prompt or reference image; projector compensation can then attempt to reproduce the edited result through projection. However, these editors do not have an accurate measure of the scene geometry or scene response. Therefore, their outputs may contain geometric misalignment, inconsistent shading, or changes outside the available projection range, which downstream projector compensation cannot correct. To address this problem, we introduce SREdit, an efficient response-guided framework for projection-based appearance editing. SREdit estimates a scene response map from the reconstructed scene that reflects how strongly projected illumination can affect different surface regions. SREdit uses the source appearance to constrain the early sampling process and preserve registration with the fixed physical object, while the scene response map adapts the amount of editing across surface regions. Experiments across two pretrained image editors show that SREdit improves projected appearance quality and reproduction fidelity. It adds less than one second per image with negligible VRAM overhead. Participants also consistently preferred the results produced with SREdit in our user study.

AI.tldr: SREdit: 利用从重建场景估计的"场景响应图"引导预训练图像编辑模型（LLM-based）的采样与编辑强度，使投影映射能高保真地复现编辑后的外观，几乎零额外开销。
AI.motivation: 投影映射（PM）中，投影仪补偿只能近似目标外观且无法改变外观本身；直接用预训练LLM图像编辑器生成目标外观时，编辑器缺少对场景几何与光照响应的准确度量，易产生几何错位、阴影不一致、超出投影动态范围的修改，后续补偿无法修正。
AI.method: 从重建场景估计场景响应图（反映各表面区域被投影光照影响的能力）；用源外观约束扩散/编辑器的早期采样以保持与固定物理物体的配准；用响应图在空间上自适应调节编辑强度；再将编辑结果交由投影仪补偿复现。框架与两种预训练图像编辑器兼容。
AI.result: 在两种预训练图像编辑器上，投影外观质量与复现保真度均提升；每张图增加不到1秒、显存开销可忽略；用户研究中被试一致偏好SREdit结果。
AI.conclusion: 将场景响应信息注入图像编辑的采样过程，可在不牺牲几何配准的前提下使投影编辑结果落在可投影范围内，是一种轻量、通用且用户偏好的投影式外观编辑方案。

title: Consommé: Conditioned Token Merging for Split Inference
summary: Split inference partitions a Vision Transformer between a resource-constrained edge device and a server. However, transmitting intermediate tokens across the communication channel is costly. Deploying fine-tuned backbones to every endpoint becomes expensive as well. We study token reduction for split inference under a frozen backbone, where only a small adapter is shipped. We observe that the CLS token plays a dual role: it acts as the global summary the receiver needs for classification, and it serves as a signal on which patches to keep. We propose Consommé, a method utilizing both characteristics. There, an information bottleneck compresses the CLS token into a compact latent which is transmitted in place of the full CLS token and conditions a learned patch gate merging patches into exactly $k$ tokens via soft assignment. It reaches any budget in a single step, thus escaping the per-layer cap of bipartite matching (BPM). On DeiT-S/T, it leads all methods at aggressive token budgets and remains operable at shallow splits where BPM cannot operate, while matching fine-tuned methods at gentle budgets at a fraction of their deployment cost.

AI.tldr: 提出 Consommé：在冻结主干的分割推理下，用信息瓶颈把 CLS token 压成紧凑潜变量传输，并以其条件化学习式 patch gate 通过软分配合并 patch 至恰好 k 个 token，单步达到任意预算。
AI.motivation: ViT 分割推理中中间 token 传输成本高，且为每个端点多部署一个微调主干代价昂贵；因此希望在仅传输小适配器、主干冻结的前提下做 token 缩减。已有 BPM 类二分匹配方法受逐层容量上限约束，且在浅层切分时不可用。
AI.method: 观察 CLS token 的双重作用（接收端分类所需的全局摘要 + 决定保留哪些 patch 的信号）；用信息瓶颈将 CLS 压缩为紧凑潜变量替代完整 CLS 传输，并以该潜变量条件化一个可学习的 patch gate，用软分配把 patch 合并为恰好 k 个 token，单步即可命中任意预算，突破 BPM 的逐层容量限制。
AI.result: 在 DeiT-S/DeiT-T 上，激进 token 预算下领先所有对比方法；在 BPM 无法工作的浅层切分处仍可运行；温和预算下达到微调方法的水平，而部署成本仅为其一小部分。
AI.conclusion: CLS 的"摘要+选择信号"双重角色为冻结主干下的分割推理 token 缩减提供了有效且低成本的设计范式，兼具预算灵活性与浅层切分可行性。

title: CompMVR: Compression-Aware Multi-View Restoration Using Diffusion Models for Geometrically Consistent 3D Reconstruction
summary: Real-world 3D reconstruction pipelines often rely on multi-view images degraded by lossy compression. While compression artifacts have been extensively studied in single-image or video restoration, their impact on multi-view geometry remains largely overlooked. In this work, we identify compression-induced cross-view geometric inconsistency as a critical failure mode, where view-dependent artifacts disrupt feature matching, dense correspondence, camera parameter estimation, and downstream 3D reconstruction tasks such as novel view synthesis. To address this problem, we propose CompMVR, a compression-aware multi-view diffusion restoration framework that jointly refines compressed views while preserving cross-view consistency, and construct compressed datasets for systematic evaluation. Unlike conventional restoration methods that optimize each image independently for 2D perceptual quality, CompMVR leverages learned compression priors and cross-view correspondence to recover visual details while improving geometric reliability across views. Experiments across diverse datasets, codecs, and compression levels demonstrate gains in restoration quality and downstream 3D tasks, including novel-view synthesis, camera pose estimation, and view matching. These results establish compressed multi-view restoration as a distinct problem and highlight its importance for 3D reconstruction under lossy compression. Code and data for this paper are available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: CompMVR：压缩感知的多视图扩散修复框架，联合恢复压缩退化视图并保持跨视图几何一致性，提升新视角合成、相机位姿估计与视图匹配等下游3D任务性能。
AI.motivation: 真实3D重建管线常依赖有损压缩的多视图图像，但压缩伪影对多视图几何的影响长期被忽视。作者指出"压缩引起的跨视图几何不一致"是关键失效模式：视点相关的伪影破坏特征匹配、稠密对应与相机参数估计。
AI.method: 提出CompMVR——压缩感知多视图扩散修复框架，利用学习到的压缩先验与跨视图对应关系，联合精化压缩视图而非逐图独立优化2D感知质量；并构建配套的多视图压缩数据集用于系统评估。
AI.result: 在多种数据集、编解码器和压缩等级下，修复质量与下游3D任务（新视角合成、相机位姿估计、视图匹配）均有提升，验证了跨视图一致性建模的必要性。
AI.conclusion: 将"压缩多视图修复"确立为一个独立问题，说明其对有损压缩下3D重建的重要性；代码与数据已开源。属于前馈3D重建管线的实用前置增强工作，但非端到端重建方法本身。

title: Sounding Surgical Instrument Localisation through Audio-Visual Correspondence
summary: Surgical scene understanding is a prerequisite for context-aware and intelligent systems in the operating room. Current methods rely mostly on visual data, while acoustic sensing has shown potential to provide complementary information on surgical activity. First approaches for the localisation of surgical activity relied on microphone arrays and acoustic beamforming. This work investigates whether the active instrument can be localized from a single microphone and a camera by learning the correspondence between the appearance and the sound of surgical instruments, without annotating its position. We adapt weakly supervised audio-visual localisation, which learns from the co-occurrence of image and sound, to the surgical setting. We record simulated surgical actions, sawing, drilling, and chiseling, and train the model on these recordings without any spatial annotation to produce a heatmap over the sounding tool. We extend the training objective by two terms: a silence term, which suppresses the output for silence and background noise, and a composite term, which trains the model to select the sounding one of two visible instruments. The model localizes the active instrument on an independent corpus recorded with a different camera and microphone, in which instrument positions were obtained by optical tracking. It separates tool activity from silence and background noise and can attribute sound correctly when two tools are present. Audio-visual correspondence learned from in-domain recordings connects the sound of a surgical action to the instrument that produces it, using a single microphone and a camera. This proof of concept introduces a novel paradigm that enables the detection and localisation of surgical activity without manual annotations.

AI.tldr: 仅用单麦克风+单摄像头，通过弱监督视听对应学习，无需位置标注即可生成发声手术器械的热力图定位。
AI.motivation: 手术室情景感知多依赖视觉，声学信息可提供互补线索；已有声定位方法依赖麦克风阵列与波束成形，成本高且部署复杂。作者希望验证能否用单麦克风配合相机，通过视听共现学习直接定位发声器械。
AI.method: 将弱监督视听定位（image–sound co-occurrence）迁移到手术场景；录制锯、钻、凿三类模拟手术动作，不加任何空间标注训练生成发声工具热力图。在训练目标中新增两项：静音项抑制静默与背景噪声输出，复合项训练模型在同时可见的两把器械中选出正在发声的一把。
AI.result: 在由不同相机与麦克风采集、器械位置由光学跟踪获得真值的独立语料上实现器械定位；能区分工具活动与静默/背景噪声；两把工具同现时可正确归因声源。
AI.conclusion: 域内录制的视听对应数据可将手术动作声音与其产生器械关联，单麦克风+单相机即可实现无人工标注的手术活动检测与定位，构成新范式概念验证。

title: SPOOK: Sparse Pixel Optimization for Off-Manifold Knowledge in Vision Encoders
comment: 12 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables, and 14 pages of Supplementary Material with 8 figures
summary: Modern vision encoders are widely used as semantic representations, but the relationship between embedding similarity and human-visible semantics can become unclear far from the natural-image manifold. We probe this regime in a black-box setting by applying sparse pixel edits to blank canvases with a simple pixel-level hill-climbing procedure. Across ImageNet and Flickr30k, we evaluate whether these edited blank canvases can retrieve chosen targets in multimodal contrastive encoders and self-supervised visual encoders. On OpenCLIP, inputs optimized toward class prompts achieve strong top-1 and top-5 targeted retrieval performance; on DINOv3, inputs optimized toward class prototypes achieve high target alignment and near-top prototype ranks. These results show that sparse edits on otherwise blank, visually non-semantic inputs can enter target semantic basins in both language-aligned and self-supervised visual representation spaces. Our findings identify a shared off-manifold failure mode of modern vision encoders and suggest sparse blank-canvas optimization as a simple probe of representation geometry.

AI.tldr: 通过稀疏像素编辑空白画布并做像素级爬山优化，可在黑盒下让OpenCLIP与DINOv3检索到指定目标，揭示视觉编码器在自然图像流形外的共享失效模式。
AI.motivation: 现代视觉编码器常被当作语义表示使用，但在远离自然图像流形处，嵌入相似性与人类可见语义的关系尚不明确。作者希望探究这一非流形区域是否存在可利用的几何脆弱性。
AI.method: 黑盒探测：从空白画布出发，用简单的像素级爬山(hill-climbing)施加稀疏像素编辑；在ImageNet与Flickr30k上，分别对多模态对比编码器(OpenCLIP，以类别提示词为目标)和自监督编码器(DINOv3，以类原型为目标)做目标检索评测。
AI.result: OpenCLIP上朝类别提示优化可获较强top-1/top-5定向检索；DINOv3上朝类原型优化得到高目标对齐度与近顶部原型排名。稀疏编辑后的空白非语义输入可进入目标语义盆地。
AI.conclusion: 语言对齐与自监督视觉表示空间共享同一类off-manifold失效模式；稀疏空白画布优化可作为探测表示几何的简易探针，提示嵌入相似度不能无差别等同于语义相似。

title: OpenStripe supports open-set identification and spatial stripe profiling in wild Amur tigers
comment: 14 pages, 4 figures. Code and nonspatial data: this https URL
summary: Non-invasive camera-trap monitoring of endangered wildlife requires open-set individual identification---grouping field images into identities without predefined classes or a known population size---yet pose deformation and cluttered backgrounds complicate image comparison. Here, we present OpenStripe, a multi-agent framework that reconstructs canonical two-dimensional (2D) tiger torso patterns and encodes four interpretable local stripe structures: breakpoints, bifurcations, irregular structures, and round structures. We evaluated OpenStripe on 100 camera-trap records from 28 wild Amur tigers (Panthera tigris altaica), representing nearly one-third of the documented population in the Northeast China Tiger and Leopard National Park. Combining all four complementary structures enabled automatic identity grouping with 0.90 matched accuracy and a 0.85 adjusted Rand index (ARI), outperforming 49 baseline configurations under the same backend (up to 0.43 accuracy and 0.14 ARI). In addition, results from OpenStripe indicate that stripe similarity in Amur tigers declines with geographic distance and suggest that traits such as fractal dimension and inter-stripe spacing are associated with geographic proximity. OpenStripe thus provides an interpretable representation that connects automated individual grouping with spatial phenotypic profiling in wild populations.

AI.tldr: OpenStripe: 多智能体框架重建虎躯干2D标准条纹图，编码四类局部条纹结构，实现无预设类别的开集个体分组（匹配准确率0.90，ARI 0.85）。
AI.motivation: 相机陷阱对濒危野生动物的非侵入监测需要开集个体识别（未知类别、未知种群规模），但姿态形变与杂乱背景使图像比对困难；现有方法缺乏可解释表征。
AI.method: 多智能体框架：先将野外图像中的虎躯干几何校正为规范2D条纹图案，再提取四类可解释局部结构（断点、分叉、不规则结构、圆形结构）作为表征，组合后进行无监督身份聚类分组；在28只野生东北虎（100条相机陷阱记录）上与49种基线配置对比。
AI.result: 四类结构组合达到0.90匹配准确率与0.85 ARI，显著优于同后端49种基线（最高仅0.43准确率、0.14 ARI）；条纹相似度随地理距离下降，分形维数、条纹间距等性状与地理邻近性相关。
AI.conclusion: OpenStripe 提供可解释表征，将自动个体分组与野生种群空间表型分析结合；属于领域特定的生态CV应用，但与具身/3D核心方向关联较弱，借鉴价值在于规范化解耦与多智能体可解释表征流程。

title: Regularised RL improves sim-to-real transfer
comment: 9 pages of main-body content, with supporting details in the appendices. Under submission
summary: Regularised reinforcement learning (RL) has provable robustness guarantees that should ease the transfer of policies from simulation to robots, known as sim-to-real. Yet, weakly regularised algorithms like Proximal Policy Optimisation (PPO) remain the de facto choice in sim-to-real pipelines, while the practical benefits of regularisation for transfer remain poorly characterised. In this work, we study the sim-to-real performance of commonly used RL algorithms, with the aim of characterising the effects of regularisation on robotic performance. To that end, we derive Soft MellowMax Actor-Critic (SMM-AC), a novel regularised RL algorithm based on the soft mellowmax value function, which carries strong robustness guarantees. On MuJoCo continuous control benchmarks, SMM-AC is competitive with baselines like Soft Actor-Critic (SAC). On real robots, SMM-AC achieves higher return, while exhibiting greater robustness to perturbations in observations, the environment, and dynamics than baselines. Together, these results demonstrate that regularised RL improves real-world policy deployment through better robustness to the sim-to-real gap, and changing real-world conditions.

AI.tldr: 提出正則化强化学习算法SMM-AC（基于soft mellowmax价值函数），在MuJoCo上与SAC相当，在真实机器人上取得更高回报并更鲁棒
AI.motivation: 正則化RL具备可证明的鲁棒性保证，理论上利于sim-to-real迁移，但实践中PPO等弱正則化算法仍是主流，正則化对真实迁移的收益缺乏系统刻画
AI.method: 推导Soft MellowMax Actor-Critic（SMM-AC）：以soft mellowmax价值函数为核心的actor-critic正則化RL算法，具备较强鲁棒性保证；在MuJoCo连续控制基准与SAC等基线对比，并在真实机器人上评估观测、环境与动力学扰动下的鲁棒性
AI.result: MuJoCo上SMM-AC与SAC等基线竞争力相当；真实机器人上回报更高，对观测扰动、环境变化与动力学变化比基线更鲁棒
AI.conclusion: 正則化RL通过提升对sim-to-real gap和真实世界条件变化的鲁棒性，改善真实部署性能，为该方向提供了实证支撑

title: Multimodal Generative AI Assists Comprehensive Echocardiographic Interpretation
summary: Echocardiography is the cornerstone of cardiovascular diagnostics, yet its global utility is constrained by a critical shortage of experienced interpreters. Current artificial intelligence (AI) solutions remain limited, typically operating as opaque "black boxes" or focusing on narrow tasks that fail to capture the holistic, guideline-driven reasoning of a clinician. Here we introduce EchoChat, a generative multimodal vision-language model that performs comprehensive echocardiographic analysis to support clinician interpretation. By emulating the cognitive workflow of a cardiologist, EchoChat integrates vast medical knowledge with a chain-of-thought reasoning mechanism to explicitly ground its conclusions in visual evidence. Trained on echocardiography-instruction pairs from 46,358 examinations, our model establishes a new state-of-the-art across diverse cohorts from six international medical centers. It supports the broadest diagnostic scope of 33 cardiac conditions and findings, including 15 newly added conditions for which it achieves an average F1 of 73.7% across available external evaluations. It surpasses existing best-performing foundation models in cardiac condition recognition (improving average recall by 13.54% on shared tasks) and quantification (average R2 score increase of 0.275 on shared tasks). Furthermore, in a source-blinded echocardiographer reader study, echocardiography reports co-generated with EchoChat were rated higher in diagnostic accuracy and completeness by two senior echocardiographers, and improved diagnostic performance from 72.78% to 82.75% in terms of F1 score over routine-reader only reports. These results demonstrate that integrating clinical reasoning into multimodal AI can democratize specialist expertise and transform the standard of cardiovascular care.

AI.tldr: EchoChat：基于46,358例超声心动图指令数据训练的多模态视觉语言模型，通过模拟超声医师的思维链推理实现33种心脏病的全面分析与量化，在六家国际中心外部队列上达到SOTA，并在盲评读者研究中将报告F1从72.78%提升至82.75%。
AI.motivation: 超声心动图是心血管诊断基石，但合格阅片医师严重短缺；现有AI多为不可解释的"黑箱"或聚焦狭窄单任务，缺乏临床医师整体性、指南驱动的推理方式。
AI.method: 构建生成式多模态视觉语言模型EchoChat，将大规模医学知识与思维链推理机制结合，显式地将结论与视觉证据对齐（grounding）；在46,358例检查的超声心动图-指令对上进行训练，支持33类心脏疾病与征象的诊断与量化任务。
AI.result: 在六个国际医学中心的多队列上取得新SOTA：新增15类病种外部评估平均F1达73.7%；相较现有最佳基础模型，疾病识别平均召回率提升13.54%，量化任务平均R²提升0.275；在来源盲化的读者研究中，两名资深超声医师对联合生成报告在诊断准确性与完整性上评分更高，F1由常规阅片报告的72.78%提升至82.75%。
AI.conclusion: 将临床推理融入多模态AI可有效支持专家解读、缩小专业能力差距，并有望改变心血管诊疗标准；但其贡献主要限定于医学影像诊断领域，属领域专用多模态推理工作。

title: VTRL-Med: Progressive Visual Refinement with Topology-Guided Regularization for Medical Image Clustering
summary: Deep clustering offers a promising approach for analyzing large unlabeled medical image datasets, yet prevailing methods still face two limitations: they may neglect class-agnostic structural priors that capture object boundaries and regions, and they do not explicitly encode topological patterns (e.g., connectivity and holes). These sources of information play distinct and complementary roles: visual-structural features provide the primary discriminative representation for clustering, while topological features provide additional global geometric cues for residual visual ambiguities. We introduce VTRL-Med, a progressive visual-structural learning framework with topology-guided regularization for medical image clustering. VTRL-Med first adapts the Segment Anything Model (SAM) to extract image features that retain structural cues inherited from mask-supervised pretraining. It then generates reliable pseudo-labels through a two-step filtering process that combines prototype-based selection with k-nearest neighbor consistency validation. Finally, it progressively refines the visual branch while an auxiliary topology branch, constructed from persistent homology (PH) descriptors, provides additional geometric regularization during training. Across 13 medical image benchmarks, VTRL-Med achieves state-of-the-art clustering performance, improving average accuracy by 4.48% over existing methods. On three representative datasets, topology-guided regularization further improves accuracy by 1.3--4.3% over visual refinement alone.

AI.tldr: VTRL-Med：将SAM特征作为视觉-结构主干，用原型选择+KNN一致性两步筛选伪标签，并以持久同调(PH)拓扑描述子构成辅助分支做几何正则，逐步精化视觉分支，用于医学图像无监督聚类。
AI.motivation: 现有深度聚类忽视两类互补先验：一类是与类别无关的结构先验（物体边界与区域），另一类是拓扑模式（连通性、孔洞）。前者提供主要判别表征，后者可缓解残余视觉歧义，二者结合尚缺统一框架。
AI.method: 1) 适配SAM（掩码监督预训练继承结构线索）提取图像特征作为视觉结构分支；2) 两阶段伪标签筛选：基于原型的粗选 + kNN一致性验证，得到可靠伪标签；3) 辅助拓扑分支由持久同调描述子构建，在训练中作为额外几何正则项；4) 逐步（progressive）精化视觉分支，拓扑分支作为辅助约束随训练衰减/协同。
AI.result: 在13个医学图像基准上取得SOTA聚类性能，平均准确率较现有方法提升4.48%；在3个代表性数据集上，拓扑引导正则相比仅做视觉精化再提升1.3–4.3个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 视觉-结构特征与拓扑特征在聚类中角色互补：前者主导判别，后者提供全局几何补充；用SAM+可靠伪标签+PH正则可稳定提升医学图像无监督聚类。方法属领域专用（医学影像）聚类，未涉及机器人/具身或3D重建等核心方向。

title: When Human Corrections Travel: Safety in Federated VLA Adaptation
comment: Accepted for presentation at SPAIS workshop in CoRL 2026
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) policies can adapt to local human intervention, while federated learning can combine distributed robot experience without pooling raw records. We examine their prospective intersection: sharing adaptations derived from diverse human corrections across tasks, environments, people, and robot embodiments. Corrections differ in modality, safety semantics(urgency, behavioral scope, etc.), and privacy sensitivity. A shared update that improves mean task success may suppress a rare safety intervention or produce an unsafe response on another robot. We argue for three requirements: preserve the context and uncertainty of multimodal corrections when deciding what to share; assess candidate updates in each receiving robot's closed loop before deployment; and evaluate leakage alongside retention of safety-critical evidence. Immediate, legible defensive behavior remains necessary during human interaction. We offer counterexamples and a falsifiable evaluation agenda, not experimental results.

AI.tldr: 本文未给出方法或实验，而是一篇立场/议程文章：主张将基于人类纠正的VLA适应性更新与联邦学习结合时，需满足三项要求——保留多模态纠正的上下文与不确定性、在接收机器人的闭环中评估候选更新、在保留安全关键证据的同时评估泄露风险。
AI.motivation: VLA策略能吸收局部人类干预，联邦学习能在不集中原始数据的前提下汇聚分布式机器人经验；但纠正数据在模态、安全语义（紧迫性、行为范围）与隐私敏感性上差异极大，一个提升平均任务成功率的共享更新可能压制罕见的安全干预，或在另一台机器人上产生不安全响应。因此需要明确跨任务、环境、人群与本体共享"纠正衍生适应"的设计准则。
AI.method: 无具体方法。提出三项需求性框架：(1) 决定共享内容时保留多模态纠正的上下文与不确定性；(2) 部署前在每台接收机器人自身的闭环中评估候选更新；(3) 同时评估泄露与安全关键证据的保留。并给出反例与可证伪的评估议程。
AI.result: 无实验结果；作者明确声明仅提供反例与可证伪的评估议程。
AI.conclusion: 人机交互过程中，即时、可读的防御性行为仍然必要；联邦式纠正共享的核心难点不是聚合算法，而是上下文保真、闭环验收与安全证据的保留—泄露权衡。

title: Closing the Modality Gap via Simplex-Constrained Representations
summary: While multimodal contrastive models like CLIP and CLAP successfully learn shared representations, their embeddings typically exhibit a persistent \emph{modality gap}. We propose addressing this separation through a purely geometric approach: changing the embedding domain from the unit sphere, $S^{d-1}$, to the probability simplex, $\Delta^{d-1}$. Although both manifolds share the same intrinsic dimension, the simplex acts as a structural prior; its nonnegative, unit-mass constraints serve as a cross-modal calibration that forces both modalities to ground themselves in the same coordinate system. By attaching lightweight softmax adapters and using Total Variation similarity, we reduce the centroid $\ell_2$ gap by 97--99\% across five multimodal retrieval benchmarks. This confirms that simplicial geometry induces genuine semantic alignment, matching or exceeding the retrieval performance of standard unconstrained models.

AI.tldr: 该文提出将多模态对比模型（CLIP/CLAP）的嵌入域从单位球面 S^{d-1} 改为概率单纯形 Δ^{d-1}，通过轻量 softmax 适配器与 Total Variation 相似度实现跨模态标定，在五个检索基准上将质心 ℓ2 模态差距降低 97–99%。
AI.motivation: 多模态对比嵌入普遍存在持久性的"模态间差距"（modality gap），即不同模态嵌入在共享空间中占据分离的锥形区域，削弱跨模态语义对齐。作者希望从几何角度而非额外训练目标出发，利用流形本身的结构先验来消除该分离。
AI.method: 洞察：球面与单纯形内在维度相同，但单纯形的非负、单位质量和约束构成跨模态标定，迫使两模态落于同一坐标系。做法：在已有对比模型上挂接轻量 softmax 适配器将嵌入映射至 Δ^{d-1}，并以 Total Variation 距离替代余弦相似度作为检索度量。
AI.result: 在五个多模态检索基准上，质心 ℓ2 模态差距下降 97–99%，且检索性能与无约束标准模型持平或更优，表明单纯形几何带来真实语义对齐而非仅指标技巧。
AI.conclusion: 嵌入流形的选择本身即可作为有效的结构先验；单纯形约束可作为通用、低成本的模态对齐插件，改善对比学习表示的可对齐性与可解释性。

title: LoCA: Enabling Multi-Modality in Geospatial Location Encoders
summary: Location encoders map geographic coordinates to high-dimensional descriptors through contrastive alignment with paired Earth Observation imagery. We prove that this construction is structurally limited: any Lipschitz location encoder produces an output of intrinsic dimension at most 2, regardless of architecture or bandwidth, which forces the contrastive loss to strictly exceed its asymptotic optimum. Empirically, joint training also collapses the encoder's embedding covariance to low rank. Although dimension-limited, current location encoders sidestep this spectral collapse by training against a frozen image encoder, which we reinterpret as a covariance regularizer that supplies a high-rank target for the location encoder to fold onto. However, extending this approach to multimodal inputs is challenging, as location encoders should simultaneously map a single location to multiple, potentially incompatible, descriptors. We identify two requirements a regularizer must satisfy for location encoding in multimodal regimes: co-alignment across modalities, since adapters alone cannot align independently pretrained encoders; and high effective rank, since the location encoder inherits its target's spectrum. We propose LoCA (Location Contrastive Alignment), a two-stage pipeline that satisfies both. Stage 1 jointly trains Sentinel-1 and Sentinel-2 encoders with contrastive learning, producing a co-aligned, high-rank multimodal target. Stage 2 freezes the image encoders and trains a location and a tabular metadata encoder as projection adapters with multi-view contrastive learning. Against five state-of-the-art encoders on 17 tasks ranging from land cover and wildfire forecasting to geophysical, socio-economic, biodiversity and climate applications, LoCA achieves the most task wins, is the only model to outperform every other on a majority of tasks, and wins 68.8% of all per-task comparisons.

AI.tldr: 该论文证明任何Lipschitz位置编码器输出的内在维度至多为2，导致对比损失无法达到渐近最优，并据此提出两阶段管线LoCA：先联合训练Sentinel-1/2影像编码器获得共对齐高秩目标，再冻结影像编码器训练位置与表格元数据投影适配器。
AI.motivation: 地理位置编码器通过与配对遥感影像做对比对齐来生成高维描述子，但该构造可能结构性地受限；同时把该方法扩展到多模态输入时，单一位置需映射到多个潜在不相容的描述子，存在困难。作者希望从理论上刻画局限，并给出满足多模态正则化要求的新方案。
AI.method: 理论分析：证明Lipschitz位置编码器的输出内在维度上界为2，迫使对比损失严格高于渐近最优，并观察到联合训练使嵌入协方差塌缩为低秩；将冻结影像编码器解释为提供高秩目标的协方差正则器。方法LoCA为两阶段：第一阶段用对比学习联合训练Sentinel-1与Sentinel-2编码器，得到共对齐、高秩的多模态目标；第二阶段冻结影像编码器，以多视角对比学习训练位置编码器和表格元数据编码器作为投影适配器。正则器需满足跨模态共对齐与高有效秩两项要求。
AI.result: 在17项任务（涵盖土地覆盖、野火预测、地球物理、社会经济、生物多样性与气候应用）上与5个最先进编码器对比，LoCA取得最多任务胜出，是唯一在多数任务上优于所有其他模型的模型，赢得68.8%的逐任务比较。
AI.conclusion: 位置编码的维度瓶颈是结构性而非架构或带宽所致；通过两阶段设计（共对齐高秩多模态目标 + 冻结编码器下的适配器训练）可有效规避谱塌缩，并在广泛地理空间下游任务上取得一致的优越性能。

title: HoloBoxing: A Simple Recipe for Humanoid Boxing with 7 Minutes of Single-GPU Training
summary: HoloBoxing presents a simple recipe for learning humanoid boxing by building on a pretrained whole-body controller. The recipe separates reusable motor skills from task decisions: a compact planner requests future body-point targets, while the frozen controller handles joint-level execution. A learned decoder maps 32-dimensional actions to structured target windows, and measured-state imitation initializes the planner before reinforcement learning. Task learning then refines interaction behavior while reusing the decoder and controller, avoiding the need to relearn whole-body control. This combination keeps task optimization focused on a compact upper policy and supplies an initial behavior before reward-driven exploration. Starting from that available controller, the recipe accounts for about seven minutes of additional training, including reused representation fitting and a single-GPU task run. This excludes controller pretraining, data preparation, evaluation, and search. Simulated boxing experiments and component controls evaluate the resulting behavior and the roles of imitation initialization and the target representation.

AI.tldr: HoloBoxing：在预训练全身控制器之上，用紧凑规划器输出32维动作并解码为结构化目标窗口，经实测状态模仿初始化后再强化学习，仅需约7分钟额外训练即可学会人形拳击。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人全身动作学习通常需要重新训练底层控制，成本高、样本效率低。作者希望将可复用的运动技能与任务决策解耦，使任务学习只需优化一个紧凑的上层策略，并能利用已有控制器快速获得初始行为。
AI.method: 分为三层：冻结的预训练全身控制器负责关节级执行；学习的解码器将32维动作映射为结构化的身体点目标窗口；规划器先通过实测状态模仿（measured-state imitation）初始化，再用强化学习精调交互行为。流程为表示拟合（复用）→模仿初始化→单卡RL任务训练，全部在仿真拳击环境中完成，并配有组件消融实验。
AI.result: 在仿真拳击中验证了行为有效性，并通过组件对照实验分析了模仿初始化与目标表示各自的作用。任务学习阶段约7分钟额外训练（含表示拟合与单卡任务运行），不含控制器预训练、数据准备、评估与搜索。
AI.conclusion: 将运动技能与任务决策解耦、冻结底层控制器、以紧凑上层策略配合模仿初始化和RL精调，是一种低成本、可快速适配任务的人形机器人技能学习方法；但目前仅有仿真验证，缺乏真机演示。

title: STROKE: Simple Sparse Structural Occlusions for Black-Box Adversarial Attacks
comment: 13 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables, and 16 pages of Supplementary Information with 3 figures and 5 tables
summary: We introduce STROKE, a query-efficient score-based black-box adversarial attack that constructs perturbations from simple oriented rectangular occlusions. STROKE optimizes these perturbations through a lightweight greedy add-and-refine procedure. Across diverse image classifiers, STROKE achieves high attack success with low query counts at nominal 1--2\% area settings, showing favorable performance relative to existing patch-based attacks in several configurations. Matched comparisons further demonstrate substantial reductions in wall-clock attack time, while ablation studies examine the key design choices and effectiveness across structural primitives. These findings suggest that simple structural occlusions offer an effective and computationally efficient search space for black-box adversarial attacks.

AI.tldr: 提出 STROKE：一种查询高效的基于分数的黑盒对抗攻击，用简单有向矩形遮挡（结构基元）构造扰动，通过轻量贪心"添加-精炼"流程优化，在1-2%面积下实现高成功率与低查询量，并显著降低实际攻击耗时。
AI.motivation: 现有基于patch的黑盒对抗攻击在查询效率和计算开销上仍不够理想；作者希望验证一个更简单、更结构化的搜索空间（有向矩形遮挡）是否能在低查询、低计算成本下依然有效，从而降低对抗攻击的实现与部署门槛。
AI.method: 以简单的有向矩形遮挡作为扰动基元，将多个矩形叠加构成扰动；采用轻量级贪心"add-and-refine"流程，在仅使用查询分数（score-based black-box 设定）的条件下逐步添加并局部精炼矩形的位置、方向与尺寸，无需梯度或代理模型。文中还进行了消融实验，考察关键设计选择以及不同结构基元的有效性。
AI.result: 在多种图像分类器上，STROKE 在名义 1–2% 遮挡面积设置下取得较高攻击成功率且查询次数较少，在若干配置下优于现有基于 patch 的攻击；匹配条件下，实际攻击时间（wall-clock）显著下降。消融实验验证了关键设计选择的作用及不同结构基元的效果差异。
AI.conclusion: 简单的结构遮挡即可构成有效且计算高效的搜索空间，为黑盒对抗攻击提供了一种查询高效、低开销的替代方案，提示结构先验可替代复杂优化在攻击中的作用。

title: If at First You Don't Succeed, Backtrack: Lightweight Recovery for Frozen VLAs
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models perform well on robotic manipulation, yet remain brittle once their own actions carry them into states their training data barely covers. Recovering from such failures usually requires recovery demonstrations, policy retraining, or a separate model at inference time. We introduce Backtrack, a lightweight failure detection and recovery mechanism for frozen VLAs that needs none of these. A small failure prediction head, trained only on outcome-labeled rollouts of the frozen policy, reads the VLA's existing internal representations to estimate whether the current episode will fail. When the predicted failure probability exceeds a threshold, a controller pauses the policy, retraces the arm's recently achieved motion, and hands control back to the unchanged policy so it can retry from an earlier configuration. The head adds only 0.48-0.88% to the policy's parameter count. We evaluate Backtrack on LIBERO with three VLAs spanning two action-generation families: SmolVLA and $\pi$0.5, which use flow-matching action experts, and the autoregressive $\pi$0-FAST. On LIBERO-Long, the suite of long-horizon multi-step tasks and the one on which all three policies fail most often, Backtrack reduces each policy's failure rate by 19-48%, raising success by up to 7.4 percentage points; on the three shorter suites, where control success is already 85-99%, its effect is smaller. On MetaWorld, all twelve controller configurations tested with SmolVLA improve on the unassisted policy.

AI.tldr: Backtrack: a tiny failure-prediction head reads a frozen VLA's internal features to estimate episode failure probability; on threshold violation, the controller pauses the policy, retraces the arm's recent trajectory, and retries from the earlier configuration without any retraining or recovery demos.
AI.motivation: VLA policies are brittle once their own actions push them out of the training distribution; existing recovery needs extra demos, retraining, or an auxiliary inference-time model.
AI.method: Train a small failure-prediction head (0.48–0.88% extra params) on outcome-labeled rollouts of the frozen policy, using the VLA's internal representations. At inference, if predicted failure probability exceeds a threshold, pause the policy, backtrack the end-effector along its recently achieved motion, then return control to the unchanged policy for a retry.
AI.result: Evaluated on LIBERO with SmolVLA, π0.5 (flow-matching action experts) and autoregressive π0-FAST. On LIBERO-Long, failure rate drops 19–48% per policy, success +up to 7.4pp; smaller gains on the three short suites (85–99% baseline success). On MetaWorld, all 12 SmolVLA controller configurations beat the unassisted policy.
AI.conclusion: A lightweight, model-agnostic detect-and-retry wrapper around frozen VLAs yields consistent gains where failures concentrate (long-horizon tasks), with negligible parameter overhead and no policy modification.

title: Beyond Discrete Tokens: Preserving Numerical Continuity in Medical Vision-Language Models
summary: Objective: To develop a unified vision-language model for prompt-conditioned quantitative ultrasound measurement that addresses the mismatch between continuous measurement targets and discrete token-based numerical prediction. Methods: This article presents HAD-VLM, a hybrid autoregressive-diffusion framework that combines autoregressive text generation with continuous measurement prediction within a shared backbone. Visual prompt tuning adapts the vision encoder to ultrasound images. A diffusion process predicts a five-component representation comprising caliper endpoint coordinates and measurement length. A post-processing strategy combining the proposed coordinate-length consistency mechanism with ensemble prediction is introduced to refine measurement estimates. We evaluate four echocardiographic measurement tasks on EchoNet-LVH, with additional assessments of medical question answering and X-ray vertebral measurement. Results: HAD-VLM achieves mean absolute errors of 1.36, 2.77, 3.05, and 1.16 mm for IVSd, LVIDd, LVIDs, and LVPWd, respectively, reducing errors by 21.4-37.6\% relative to the Vicuna-based autoregressive baseline. It also outperforms fine-tuned Qwen3-VL and direct MLP regression across all four tasks. Medical question answering performance is preserved on the evaluated dataset. For X-ray vertebral measurement, HAD-VLM reduces mean absolute error from 11.4 to 6.7 pixels. Conclusion: Integrating autoregressive language generation with diffusion-based continuous prediction improves quantitative medical image measurement while retaining prompt-conditioned task flexibility. Significance: HAD-VLM provides a unified approach to combining language interaction with anatomically grounded numerical prediction for quantitative medical image analysis.

AI.tldr: HAD-VLM：混合自回归-扩散框架，用扩散头连续预测卡尺端点坐标+长度，实现提示条件化的超声定量测量。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM以离散token做数值回归，与连续测量目标不匹配，量化超声测量精度受限。
AI.method: 统一视觉-语言主干；视觉提示微调适配超声；扩散过程预测五分量表示（端点坐标+长度）；后处理结合坐标-长度一致性机制与集成预测精修。
AI.result: EchoNet-LVH四项心超测量MAE 1.36/2.77/3.05/1.16 mm，较Vicuna自回归基线降低21.4–37.6%；优于微调Qwen3-VL与MLP回归；X线椎体测量MAE 11.4→6.7像素；医学VQA性能保持。
AI.conclusion: 自回归语言生成+扩散连续预测可在保留提示任务灵活性的同时提升定量测量精度，为医学影像提供语言交互与解剖 grounding 统一方案。

title: Robotic Optical Coherence Tomography-Guided Geometric Modeling of Soft Tissue: 3D Representations for Data-Driven Closed-Loop Shape Control
summary: In medical robotics, data-driven soft-tissue shape control requires deforming tissue toward desired morphologies through sequential physical interactions. This challenge is particularly important in microscale manipulation, where localized deformation is difficult to observe, represent, and control, while physics-based models can be computationally expensive and difficult to adapt to realistic environments. Optical coherence tomography (OCT) provides high-resolution volumetric perception of tissue deformation, but target-conditioned control requires effective representations of both observed and desired tissue states. In this work, we introduce an OCT-guided data-driven framework for tissue shape control, learned from user-guided demonstrations and executed with closed-loop OCT feedback. We study full-volume, tissue-masked sparse-volume, and voxelized point-cloud representations, with or without residual conditioning, using deterministic (Explicit) and generative diffusion (Diffusion) policies. Across 12 configurations and 576 phantom rollouts on 3-DoF depth and 6-DoF directional tasks, OCT-derived 3D representations support both Explicit and Diffusion policies, with performance depending on representation and residual conditioning. Residual conditioning reduces directional Shape RMSE from 0.748 to 0.555 mm for full-volume Diffusion, while voxelized point-cloud Explicit with residuals achieves 0.534 mm for depth and 0.443 mm for directional control, with comparable accuracy at intermediate unseen targets and consistent performance across deployments. We further evaluate the framework in 60 ex vivo porcine rollouts, extending to biological tissue with final geometric errors comparable to human demonstrations. These results establish volumetric OCT as current and goal representations for learned closed-loop tissue shape control across deterministic and generative action models.

AI.tldr: 提出 OCT 引导的数据驱动机器人软组织形状控制框架，用示范学习 + OCT 闭环反馈，比较全容积/掩膜稀疏体素/点云表示与确定性/扩散策略，在体模与离体猪组织上验证。
AI.motivation: 显微尺度软组织形变难以观测与表示，基于物理的模型计算昂贵且难以适配真实环境；OCT 可提供高分辨率体数据，但需要同时表示当前与目标组织状态以实现目标条件控制。
AI.method: 从用户引导示范中学习模仿策略，采用闭环 OCT 反馈执行。比较三种 OCT 派生 3D 表示（全容积、组织掩膜稀疏体、体素化点云）以及是否引入残差条件，并对比确定性 Explicit 策略与生成式 Diffusion 策略，共 12 种配置。
AI.result: 576 次体模 rollout：全容积 Diffusion 加残差把方向 Shape RMSE 从 0.748 降到 0.555 mm；体素点云 Explicit 加残差在深度任务 0.534 mm、方向任务 0.443 mm，中间未见目标精度相当且多次部署一致；60 次离体猪组织 rollout 最终几何误差与人类示范相当。
AI.conclusion: OCT 体数据可同时作为当前状态与目标表示，支撑确定性与生成式动作模型下的闭环软组织形状控制，并推广到生物组织。

title: Flownomaly: Single-Step Conditional-Mean Recovery for Few-Shot Anomaly Detection
summary: Few-shot industrial anomaly detection requires modeling category-specific normality from only a handful of defect-free images. Common approaches tie inference to stored exemplars, impose rigid linear structure, or risk reproducing anomalous content. Flownomaly instead casts the problem as normal-counterpart recovery in frozen DINOv2 feature space. Given normal supports, a velocity field is learned through conditional flow matching over frozen patch tokens to transport Gaussian noise toward normal features. Along straight paths, a single recovery step using one evaluation of the optimal field yields the posterior mean of the clean normal token without trajectory integration. The operating time governs how strongly recovery modifies a query token. With no anomalous validation samples available for tuning, a normal-only Jacobian gain-to-noise criterion selects this time from the supports alone. Squared residuals between query tokens and their recovered counterparts yield anomaly signals for both dense localization and image-level detection. Across 1-, 2-, and 4-shot benchmarks on MVTec-AD and VisA, together with sample-shot evaluations on Real-IAD, Flownomaly achieves state-of-the-art performance against recent category-specific methods. In the 1-shot setting, image- and pixel-level AUROC reach 97.8% and 98.0% on MVTec-AD and 95.3% and 98.7% on VisA, with a 2.1-point image-level AUROC improvement over the strongest baseline on VisA. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: Flownomaly将few-shot工业异常检测建模为冻结DINOv2特征空间中的"正常对应物恢复"问题,用条件流匹配学习速度场,并用单步最优场恢复得到正常token后验均值,以残差作为异常信号。
AI.motivation: 现有few-shot工业异常检测方法将推理绑定到存储的样本原型、强加刚性线性结构,或在重建时可能复现异常内容,因此需要一种仅依赖无缺陷支持样本、不存储原型且不易复制异常的类别特定正常性建模方式。
AI.method: 在冻结的DINOv2 patch token空间中,以正常支持样本为条件,通过条件流匹配学习速度场,将高斯噪声沿直线路径输运至正常特征;利用最优场的单次求值实现单步恢复,得到干净正常token的后验均值而无需轨迹积分;恢复时间控制修改强度,并在无异常验证样本时用仅基于正常样本的Jacobian增益-噪声准则从支持集自动选取该时间;查询token与恢复对应物之间的平方残差同时用于稠密定位与图像级检测。
AI.result: 在MVTec-AD与VisA的1/2/4-shot基准及Real-IAD的sample-shot评测上超过近期类别特定方法;1-shot下MVTec-AD图像/像素AUROC为97.8%/98.0%,VisA为95.3%/98.7%,VisA图像级AUROC较最强基线提升2.1点。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 单步流匹配恢复可作为高效的few-shot异常检测范式,在不使用任何异常样本调参的前提下取得SOTA,并同时支持定位与检测。

title: RynnUnify: Towards Unified Embodied Brain
summary: We introduce RynnUnify, a 16B unified embodied model that combines strong embodied understanding with long-horizon visual planning through interleaved video--language reasoning. With capabilities spanning spatial reasoning, physical prediction, and grounding, RynnUnify connects an understanding of the physical world with visual anticipation of how it evolves across successive subtasks. Building on these capabilities, we further develop an agentic extension through reinforcement learning to selectively use video predictions for reasoning about unobserved states and interaction outcomes. We also develop a world-action extension of the full RynnUnify model, translating its understanding and prediction capabilities into robot control. To evaluate these capabilities, we introduce Rynn-VP and Rynn-GEU for long-horizon visual planning and anticipatory reasoning. Experiments show that RynnUnify achieves the highest average embodied understanding score among the evaluated unified multimodal models and improves the Rynn-VP overall score by 9.75 points over Cosmos 3 Nano. Its agentic extension improves the Rynn-GEU average by 6.0 points over direct reasoning, while the world-action extension achieves 51.5\% success on 20 selected composite RoboCasa365 tasks and 46.7\% average success across three real-robot tasks. Together, these results establish RynnUnify as a shared foundation for embodied understanding, visual planning, and robot control, taking a step toward a unified embodied brain.

AI.tldr: RynnUnify是一个16B统一具身模型，通过交错视频-语言推理同时实现具身理解与长时程视觉规划，并扩展出强化学习智能体版本与世界-动作（机器人控制）版本。
AI.motivation: 现有统一多模态模型多侧重感知理解，缺乏对物理世界演化的前瞻性视觉预测，且理解、规划与控制在具身系统中彼此割裂，作者希望构建共享底座以迈向"统一具身大脑"。
AI.method: 构建16B交错视频-语言推理统一模型，覆盖空间推理、物理预测与grounding；以强化学习赋予其自适应选择视频预测来推断未观测状态与交互结果；再做world-action扩展将理解与预测能力映射为机器人动作；并提出Rynn-VP（长时程视觉规划）与Rynn-GEU（前瞻推理）两个评测集。
AI.result: 在评测的统一多模态模型中取得最高具身理解平均分；Rynn-VP总分较Cosmos 3 Nano提升9.75；智能体扩展使Rynn-GEU平均分较直接推理提升6.0；world-action扩展在20项RoboCasa365复合任务上成功率51.5%，三个真实机器人任务平均成功率46.7%。
AI.conclusion: RynnUnify可作为具身理解、视觉规划与机器人控制的共同基础模型，体现了理解-预测-控制一体化的可行路径；但实机任务数与成功率仍有限，需更多真实场景验证。

title: ViT-H: Generative Video-To-Humanoid Control with Motion Tracking Feedback
comment: The first four authors contributed equally. Project website: this https URL
summary: Learning humanoid control from monocular human videos offers a scalable way to acquire diverse whole-body behaviors. Yet, existing reconstruction-retargeting-tracking pipelines are limited in system-level scalability by separately optimized intermediate stages and cannot directly optimize reference motion executability using downstream tracking feedback. We present ViT-H, a video-to-humanoid control framework following a generation-and-tracking paradigm. ViT-H directly generates humanoid reference motions from videos with a diffusion model, bypassing human motion reconstruction and retargeting, and uses motion-tracking outcomes to post-train the generator with direct preference optimization. We further introduce an autoregressive variant that enables real-time humanoid video teleoperation with sub-400 ms latency. Extensive experiments on the Unitree G1 demonstrate that ViT-H outperforms state-of-the-art reconstruction-retargeting-tracking pipelines in both motion quality and executability. We further show that ViT-H scales favorably with model size and with both pre-training and post-training data scale, while motion-tracking feedback consistently improves executability across different motion trackers.

AI.tldr: ViT-H：直接从单目人类视频用扩散模型生成人形机器人参考运动，跳过重建-重定向流程，并用下游运动跟踪结果以DPO后训练生成器；另有自回归变体实现<400ms实时遥操作，Unitree G1实验验证性能与可执行性优于SOTA流水线。
AI.motivation: 从人类视频学习人形全身行为具可扩展性，但现有"重建-重定向-跟踪"流水线各阶段独立优化，系统级可扩展性受限，且无法利用下游跟踪反馈直接优化参考运动的可执行性。
AI.method: 提出generation-and-tracking范式：扩散模型直接从视频生成人形参考运动，绕过人体运动重建与重定向；用运动跟踪结果构建偏好数据，以直接偏好优化（DPO）后训练生成器；并给出自回归变体支持实时视频遥操作。
AI.result: 在Unitree G1上，运动质量与可执行性均优于SOTA重建-重定向-跟踪流水线；随模型规模、预训练与后训练数据量呈良好scaling；跟踪反馈在不同跟踪器上一致提升可执行性；实时变体延迟低于400ms。
AI.conclusion: 端到端生成式视频到人形控制可替代分阶段流水线，且跟踪反馈闭环优化与规模扩展效应有效，为可扩展人形全身行为学习提供新路径。

title: MiD-VLM: Detecting and Grounding Global Semantic Misinformation in Image-Caption Pairs
summary: Semantic misinformation can arise when an authentic image is paired with a caption that changes or distorts its narrative. Because the image itself may contain no visible signs of manipulation, methods designed to detect pixel-level artifacts can miss these misleading image-caption pairs. We study this problem using DGM4+, a dataset designed to evaluate the detection of global scene and semantic inconsistencies. We propose a multimodal model that combines image-text representations from SigLIP with visual scene features from DINOv2 through a projection MLP, and adapts Qwen2-VL-7B using LoRA. The model jointly predicts whether an image-caption pair is authentic, identifies the manipulation type, and grounds the misleading caption tokens. On the DGM4+ validation split, the model achieves an F1 score of $0.9679$ for binary authenticity classification. These results suggest that parameter-efficient adaptation of vision-language models is promising for detecting semantic inconsistencies, while also motivating further work on precise token-level grounding.

AI.tldr: 提出基于SigLIP图像-文本表征与DINOv2视觉场景特征融合、并通过LoRA适配Qwen2-VL-7B的多模态模型，用于检测"真实图像+误导性配文"的语义不匹配，在DGM4+验证集上二分类F1达0.9679。
AI.motivation: 真实图像本身无像素级篡改痕迹，配文却扭曲叙事，导致依赖伪造痕迹的检测方法失效，需要专门面向全局场景与语义不一致的检测手段。
AI.method: 用投影MLP将SigLIP的图文表征与DINOv2的视觉场景特征融合，再以LoRA参数高效微调Qwen2-VL-7B；模型联合优化三个目标：真伪二分类、篡改类型识别、以及误导性配文token的定位。
AI.result: DGM4+验证集上真伪二分类F1为0.9679；但token级定位精度仍有提升空间。
AI.conclusion: 视觉语言模型的参数高效适配在检测语义不一致方面具有潜力，后续需重点改进细粒度token级定位能力。

title: DexPort: A Hand-Held Skill Interface for Dexterous Hand Data Collection
summary: Collecting high-quality demonstrations remains a central bottleneck for learning dexterous manipulation. Teleoperation records executable robot actions, but it requires a complete robot setup and places the burden of coordinating many finger joints on the operator. Human demonstrations are easier to collect, but their motions must be estimated and retargeted to the robot, and they do not directly provide robot actions. In this paper, we introduce DexPort, a portable data-collection interface for high-DoF robot hands. It uses the same hand hardware for collection and deployment, avoiding a hand embodiment gap, and records both commanded joint targets and measured joint states. Our key observation is that a small set of skills can support a wide range of dexterous tasks. During collection, the operator moves the hand-held interface to specify the robot wrist motion and selects or adjusts skills that coordinate the finger motion. This removes the need to control each joint independently while retaining behaviors such as precise grasping and in-hand manipulation. We collect demonstrations across several real-world tasks and in unstructured environments without a robot arm. We then use behavior cloning to train visuomotor policies directly on the recorded wrist motions and hand commands, without skill labels. We evaluate across 4 tasks: pick-and-place with diverse objects, screwing with in-hand tool use, drawer stowage which requires simultaneous grasp and pulling, and a bimanual scanning task. We collect over 2,500 demonstrations with our portable device, in both laboratory and in-the-wild settings. Across our tasks, we see an improvement from 11% to 64% when using recorded robot commands instead of states, and an improvement from 36% to 78% for task success when using in-the-wild data.

AI.tldr: DexPort：一种便携式高自由度机器人手数据采集接口，采集与部署使用同一手部硬件，操作员只需指定手腕运动并选择/调整预置手指技能，记录关节指令与状态，用行为克隆训练视觉运动策略。
AI.motivation: 灵巧操作演示采集是瓶颈：遥操作需完整机器人装置且多指关节协调负担重；人类演示需估计与重定向且不直接提供机器人动作。
AI.method: 用与部署相同的手部硬件做手持采集接口：操作员移动接口指定手腕轨迹，通过选择/调整少量手指技能（抓取、手内操作等）生成手指协同；记录指令关节目标与实测关节状态。无需机械臂即可在非结构化环境采集，随后用行为克隆直接以手腕运动与手部指令训练视觉运动策略（无需技能标签）。
AI.result: 采集2500+条实验室与野外演示，覆盖4类任务（多样物体抓放、手内工具拧转、抽屉收纳需同时抓取与拉动、双臂扫描）。使用记录的机器人指令而非关节状态，成功率从11%提升至64%；使用野外数据时任务成功率从36%提升至78%。
AI.conclusion: 少量技能原语+同构硬件接口可低成本、跨场景采集高自由度手部演示，且记录可执行指令对策略学习至关重要；野外数据带来显著泛化增益。

title: RobustRLlib: A Unified Library and Benchmark for Robust Reinforcement Learning Algorithms
comment: Project page, code, and tutorial: this https URL
summary: Robust reinforcement learning (RL) is critical for reliable real-world deployment, where policies may fail under diverse shifts and disruptions. Existing robust RL algorithms offer a rich set of mechanisms and principles, yet two major barriers limit their broader potential: limited algorithm reusability and an unclear empirical capability boundary. We introduce RobustRLlib, an algorithm-centric library and benchmark that addresses both challenges. It integrates 17 representative robust online, offline, and safe RL algorithms under a unified interface for substantially improved reusability, together with an enhanced evaluation platform spanning diverse real-world shifts and advanced humanoid and vision-language-action tasks. Systematic evaluation over 273 perturbation configurations provides an up-to-date capability map of current robust RL algorithms, revealing where they remain effective and where substantial robustness gaps persist. As an open-source, user-friendly platform, RobustRLlib offers a reproducible and extensible codebase for applying existing methods to new problems and developing new robust RL algorithms.

AI.tldr: RobustRLlib：统一17种鲁棒在线/离线/安全强化学习算法的算法中心库与基准，含人形与VLA任务，在273种扰动配置上给出鲁棒RL能力图谱。

title: FlexGlue: Sparse-to-Dense Feature Matching and Visual Disambiguation
summary: To estimate correspondences across images, existing approaches match either sparse interest points, which is highly efficient but limited by repeatability, or dense pixel grids, which is robust but expensive. Furthermore, these approaches are trained with only matching pairs and thus often fail to reject unrelated pairs that exhibit visual symmetries, which is equally important in applications like Structure-from-Motion (SfM). We bridge these gaps by introducing FlexGlue, a neural network for asymmetric sparse-to-dense matching and disambiguation. Given two images and coordinates of points in the first image, FlexGlue estimates the coordinates of the corresponding points in the second image while simultaneously rejecting the pair if non-matching. By searching for a limited set of correspondences among dense pixels, our approach is both fast and effective at both matching and disambiguation: it combines the sub-pixel accuracy of dense matching with the speed of sparse matching, while rejecting incorrect pairs with high precision. Experiments on multiple datasets show that FlexGlue pushes the Pareto frontier in relative pose estimation and significantly outperforms existing approaches for SfM and visual localization. title: UniAction: Unified Action Conditioning for World Models
summary: Actions that condition world models are highly heterogeneous, and thus existing action-conditioned world models are typically built for individual action types, fragmenting already limited action-annotated data across separate models. We introduce UniAction, a unified action-conditioning framework that represents any action as a sparse set of action elements, each with a discrete semantic identity and a continuous spatiotemporal grounding coordinate. By mapping these coordinates directly into the pretrained video model's native positional space, UniAction allows heterogeneous actions to condition a shared world model within the same spatiotemporal structure. We further introduce cardinality-calibrated attention to address the bias from differing action representation granularities. We evaluate UniAction on four representative action forms: force, camera control, hand pose, and robot pose. UniAction outperforms conditioning alternatives in action following, and a single jointly trained model surpasses the action-specific experts, showing that heterogeneous action data benefit from unified model and joint training.

AI.tldr: UniAction将任意异构动作表示为“稀疏动作元素集合”，每个元素含离散语义身份与连续时空坐标，并把坐标映射进预训练视频模型的原生位置空间，实现单一世界模型的统一动作条件化；另提出基数校准注意力（cardinality-calibrated attention）消除不同动作表示粒度带来的偏置。
AI.motivation: 动作条件世界模型的动作形式高度异构（力、相机、手部姿态、机器人位姿等），现有方法为每种动作单独建模，导致本已稀缺的动作标注数据被碎片化到多个模型中。
AI.method: 统一动作表示：稀疏动作元素集合，元素 = 离散语义ID + 连续时空接地坐标；将坐标直接映射到预训练视频模型的原生位置空间，使异构动作在共享时空结构中条件化同一世界模型；引入基数校准注意力以缓解不同动作表示粒度（元素数量差异）导致的偏置。在force、camera control、hand pose、robot pose四种动作形式上评估，含单模型联合训练与动作专用专家对比。
AI.result: 在动作跟随性（action following）上优于其他条件化方案；单一联合训练的UniAction模型超过各动作专用专家模型，表明异构动作数据可从统一模型与联合训练中获益。
AI.conclusion: 通过统一的稀疏元素+时空坐标表示与原生位置空间注入，异构动作可共用一个世界模型并实现跨动作形式的正迁移，为通用动作条件世界模型提供了可行路径。

title: SceneBloom: Agentic Indoor Environment Generation with Realistic and Diverse Layouts for Embodied Learning
summary: Training generalizable embodied agents requires realistic, varied, and simulation-ready indoor environments. Language-guided methods support semantic planning and object-level reasoning, but precise spatial grounding remains difficult. Visual generative models offer rich priors over plausible arrangements, yet their outputs require geometric reasoning to become physically valid 3D scenes. We introduce SceneBloom, an agentic framework that combines visual layout sampling with contract-guided 3D compilation. A hierarchical sampler uses diffusion priors to generate furniture arrangements within functional zones. A compiler then uses relations extracted from each proposal to guide geometric fitting and local pose correction. Across five room types, SceneBloom attains the highest visual quality and physical stability among the compared methods and is the only method with no detected mesh collisions and out-of-bounds objects. Its layouts are also closer to the distribution of real rooms than those of all compared baselines. Object navigation policies trained in these realistic scenes achieve a higher success rate in held-out real scans than those trained on an equal number of real training scans. Code is available at this https URL .

AI.tldr: SceneBloom：智能体式框架，用扩散先验分层采样生成家具布局，再通过“契约引导”的3D编译（几何拟合+局部位姿修正）产出物理有效、无碰撞的室内场景，用于训练具身导航策略。
AI.motivation: 训练通用具身智能体需要真实、多样且可直接仿真的室内环境；语言引导方法擅长语义规划但空间落地精度不足，纯视觉生成先验缺乏几何可行性，因此需将生成先验与几何约束编译结合。
AI.method: 提出agentic框架：分层采样器利用扩散先验在功能区内生成家具布局；编译器从每个提案中抽取空间关系（契约）来引导几何拟合与局部位姿修正，得到物理有效的3D场景。
AI.result: 在五种房间类型上，视觉质量与物理稳定性均最优，且是唯一未检测到网格碰撞与越界物体的方法；布局分布更接近真实房间；在其场景中训练的物体导航策略，在留出真实扫描上的成功率高于用同等数量真实扫描训练的基线。
AI.conclusion: 生成式布局先验+几何契约编译可低成本产出可仿真的高质量室内场景，并可作为真实数据的有效替代/增强用于具身导航策略训练。
